title: Manager, Sales
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

As a 1st line Sales Leader you will be leading a team of Business Development Representatives or Account Executives selling the entire Salesforce Customer Success Platform across multiple verticals. We are looking for a sales leader with great energy, leadership, and initiative to drive team performance and sales for our enterprise team. You will formulate and implement a strategy to increase business growth. This role works in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Pre-sales, Partner Alliances, Services & HR, therefore cross-company engagement and orchestration is crucial. The candidate will be a high impact individual capable of driving outstanding business results & first-class employee development. The Sales Leader is fully responsible for developing and leading the team to generate revenue and achieve individual team and organizational quotas. Aligning to the sales strategy, the Sales Leader defines and implements plans for the assigned Accounts to achieve sales objectives.

You may be aligned to the following verticals and/or clouds:


 
  • Enterprise Corporate Services
  • Financial Services
  • Healthcare & Life Sciences
  • Retail & Consumer Goods
  • Comms, Media and Tech
  • Public Sector
  • Marketing Cloud
  • Slack
  • Mulesoft
  • Tableau
  • Marketing Cloud
  • Specialization Cloud


What You'll Actually Be Doing

The teams you lead here at Salesforce will directly impact the growth of our overall organization. You will be masterful in client engagement and impact how your customers do business in a constantly evolving environment. You will coach your team to develop in their careers, and inspire your team to do the best work of their life.


 
  • Hire, Train, and Develop a team
  • Develop teams into sales-ready candidates for future Account Executive positions
  • Create Industry Specific Pipeline Programs to drive Pipeline and Revenue
  • Motivate Individuals and Team to exceed objectives through coaching, regular broadcast of results, and creative incentives
  • Regularly report on Team/Individual Results - Pipeline Generation, Quality of Pipeline, Revenue Forecasting
  • Work closely with Marketing on defining Campaign follow-up and reporting
  • Work closely with Executive Leadership Team and Sales Leaders to ensure Pipeline Quality/Quantity and proper follow-up
  • Work closely with Operations to make recommendations on process improvements
  • Identify and make recommendations for improvement in the areas of Process, Efficiency, Productivity


You're Our Person If...

Depending on the segment, the years of experience and skills needed to be successful will vary from 3+ yrs of sales leadership experience developing a team of seven or more quota carrying sales people. In addition, a bachelor's degree is strongly preferred.


 
  • Strong background in leading sales teams
  • Shown ability to create hard-working teams and lead them to success
  • Excellent presentation and executive engagement skills
  • Excellent negotiation skills
  • A self-starter that can thrive in a fast paced environment

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. title: Research Scientist - Salesforce AI Research
descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience
Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. Our innovations continue to shape the future of Salesforce products and the broader enterprise AI ecosystem. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Scientists who want to build, ship, and scale the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research role — you work like a founder within Salesforce, identifying high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, validating ideas directly with customers, and turning the strongest concepts into production-ready solutions. You have the freedom to propose and incubate new research ideas, access Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem, and quickly validate new innovations with external and internal customers and stakeholders. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, move with urgency, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this role offers a unique opportunity to build Enterprise AI with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Identify research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.

  • Turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.

  • Work directly with customers to validate needs, test solutions, and refine product direction.

  • Build robust models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.

  • Partner with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.


You're Our Person If...

  • You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or a proven track record of shipping AI research into real-world products.

  • You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.

  • You are motivated by real-world impact — you care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.

  • You bring demonstrated expertise in one or more core focus areas:

    • Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.

    • Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.

    • Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.

    • Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.

  • You bring a demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and translate ideas into impactful systems.


Even Better If...

  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent full-time industry experience in deep learning research or product.

  • Experience building and scaling ML models for real-world business applications.

  • Experience mentoring and advising other researchers.

  • Strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g. ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).

  • Thoughtful about responsible AI, trust, and the real-world impact of the systems you build.

  • Fantastic problem solver — ability to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

  • Demonstrated track record of cultivating strong working relationships and driving cross-functional collaboration.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Responsable de compte de région, affaires des petites entreprises – Canada

The Experience

Notre équipe des petites et moyennes entreprises fait partie de l'unité chargée des affaires en croissance. Elle travaille avec des organisations dynamiques en pleine croissance. Vous aurez l'occasion de travailler dans une équipe dynamique avec des clients de services financiers variés, ainsi que des occasions de formation et de carrière personnalisées.

Canada

Salesforce permet aux entreprises installées au Canada de développer leur processus de ventes, d'améliorer le service client et de prendre des décisions marketing fondées sur des données. Les outils Salesforce CRM fonctionnent sur le nuage et sont compatibles avec les appareils mobiles, permettant à nos clients d'accéder aux données de n'importe où ! Le CRM le plus connu au Canada est rapide, sécurisé et ne nécessite aucune maintenance.

Pourquoi rejoindre Salesforce en tant que responsable de compte, affaires des petites entreprises ?

Cette équipe est extrêmement soudée ; nous célébrons nos différences et nos victoires et apprenons de nos défaites. Nous partageons tous les mêmes objectifs. Vous aurez l'occasion de travailler dans une équipe dynamique avec des occasions de formation et de carrière personnalisées.

Ce rôle est l'occasion idéale de découvrir Salesforce en profondeur. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de diverses équipes internes et unités commerciales, de sorte que votre connaissance globale de notre mode de fonctionnement se développera très rapidement.

Travailler chez Salesforce

Travailler chez Salesforce ne consiste pas uniquement à vendre. Nous vous offrons aussi l'occasion d'apprendre, et nous investissons pleinement en vous avec une immersion et une intégration d'un mois, comprenant un stage d'une semaine sur les produits, un programme de mentorat, ainsi que des programmes hebdomadaires de coaching et de développement.

Avantages

Nous sommes les pionniers du modèle Pledge 1%, qui fournit des produits, des subventions et des services à ceux qui en ont besoin. Nous sommes fiers d'être le numéro 1 du classement Top 50 Companies that Care de PEOPLE et de faire partie de la liste Change the World de Fortune.

Nous offrons à chaque employé sept jours de bénévolat rémunérés par an ainsi qu'une contrepartie pour tous les dons caritatifs approuvés.

Nous offrons d'autres avantages de premier ordre à tous nos employés, notamment :
 
  • Santé, assurance-vie, épargne retraite
  • Allocation bien-être mensuelle
  • Politiques flexibles sur les congés
  • Prestations pour les parents
  • Remises et réductions


Nous garantissons l'égalité des chances et valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Nous ne discriminons pas sur la base de l'origine ethnique, de la religion, de la couleur, de l'origine, du sexe, du genre, de l'expression de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la situation matrimoniale, du statut d'ancien combattant ou du statut d'invalidité. Nous veillerons à ce que les personnes en situation de handicap bénéficient des aménagements nécessaires pour participer au processus de candidature ou d'entretien, pour effectuer des fonctions professionnelles essentielles, ainsi que pour recevoir d'autres avantages et privilèges liés à l'emploi. Veuillez nous contacter pour demander un aménagement.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Nos responsables de compte des PME interagissent avec les clients existants et les nouvelles pistes dans le but de vendre l'intégralité de la plate-forme Salesforce Customer 360. Ils établissent des relations positives et de confiance avec les membres clés de l'équipe et les décideurs dans leur domaine, et apprennent à aider les clients à tirer parti de leurs investissements Salesforce.

Vous utiliserez vos nouvelles compétences en développement commercial pour développer des occasions, à la fois par le biais de pistes prometteuses et par la prospection de comptes à fort potentiel.
 
  • Clore des occasions sur les comptes existants attribués et stimuler les ventes sur de nouveaux comptes
  • Stimuler les ventes dans le segment attribué (affaires des petites entreprises)
  • Acquérir de nouvelles références dans la région attribuée
  • Présenter les offres Salesforce adaptées aux besoins du client et engager d'autres ressources Salesforce si nécessaire
  • Gérer un volume élevé de comptes et de ventes


You're Our Person If...
 
  • Nous sommes ouverts d'esprit en ce qui concerne les PME et nous ne recherchons pas seulement des responsables de compte qui ont de l'expérience en SaaS. Si vous avez occupé un poste de vente avec des quotas dans lequel vous vous chargiez des processus de vente de bout en bout, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer !
  • Vous incarnez une mentalité de croissance ; vous pensez à l'avenir et vous avez déjà établi votre plan de carrière.
  • Vous êtes capable d'élaborer un point de vue, de prendre position et de bâtir votre crédibilité en tant que conseiller ou conseillère de confiance auprès de vos clients.
  • La connaissance de soi est très importante et vous devez comprendre le « pourquoi » de vos actions. Vous êtes curieux(se) de nature et enthousiaste à l'idée de découvrir tout ce que Salesforce a à offrir.
  • Vous n'avez pas besoin d'avoir déjà utilisé Salesforce, mais cela serait un plus. Une véritable passion pour la technologie, le changement et l'innovation est également recommandée.

 Territory Account Executive, Small and Growth Business - Canada

The Experience

Our Small to Medium Business team is part of our wider Growth Business, focusing on working with exciting growth organizations. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied financial services customers and personalized training and career opportunities.

Canada

Salesforce enables Canadian based companies to grow their sales pipeline, improve customer service, and make data-backed marketing decisions. Salesforce CRM tools are cloud-based and mobile friendly, allowing our customers to access data from anywhere! Canada's #1 CRM is fast, secure, and doesn't require maintenance.

Why Join Salesforce as an Account Executive, Small Business?

This team is extremely tight knit; we celebrate our differences and wins and learn from losses. You're joining our team, and we're all working towards the same goals. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with personalized training and career opportunities.

This role is the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in all things Salesforce. You will get exposure to a range of internal teams and business units, so your overall knowledge of how we work and operate will grow very quickly.

Working at Salesforce

Working at Salesforce isn't all about selling. It's also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including: a week-long product bootcamp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.

Benefits

We are pioneers of the Pledge 1% model, providing product, grants and community service to those in need. We are proud to be #1 in PEOPLE's Top 50 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune's Change the World list.

We provide every employee with 7 paid volunteer days off a year, and donation matching for all approved charitable donations.

  • Health, life insurance, retirement saving plan
  • Monthly wellness allowance
  • Flexible time off & leave policies
  • Parental benefits
  • Perks and discounts

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Our SMB Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.

You will use your new business development skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.

  • Drive sales within assigned segment (small business)
  • Acquire new logos within assigned territory
  • Speak to Salesforce offerings as they relate to the customer's needs and engage other Salesforce resources as required

  • Embody a growth mindset – You're thinking ahead and have a plan for yourself.

  • Pipeline Generation: Drive net-new opportunity creation through target whitespace prospecting and warm lead expansion.

    • Informatica AE: IDMC domain expertise, specialist execution, and driving targeted data expansion inside Prime accounts.

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience.

  • Matrix leadership: Exceptional ability to lead and strategize within a matrixed, extended Specialist team structure.
  • AI fluency: A natural curiosity about the evolving AI landscape, with the ability to credibly connect data and integration strategy to real-world AI outcomes.
  • New business focus: Demonstrated expertise in new logo acquisition and greenfield territory development.

Salesforce AI Research Labs is at the forefront of Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Deep Learning. Our team launched Einstein GPT - the world’s first Generative AI for CRM - delivering AI-created content across every sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT interaction at hyper-scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai.   • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion.

  • Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.

  • Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce Marketing platform by:

    • Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer

    • Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer

    • Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation

  • The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.

  • Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.

  • Experienced professional with 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, Customer Success Manager, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.

  • Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.

  • Coordinate and work closely with high volume events and/or key events for the customer.

  • Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.

Salesforce's General Business segment represents a critical growth engine within our Australian go-to-market strategy. Serving organisations with 500–2,000 employees, this segment operates at the intersection of enterprise-level complexity and commercial agility.

These customers are established, strategically significant organisations with layered decision-making structures, multi-cloud opportunity, and transformation agendas that require sophisticated solution design. At the same time, their scale allows for velocity, broader portfolio exposure, and meaningful ownership across the full sales lifecycle.

For experienced enterprise Account Executives, this role offers the opportunity to broaden platform mastery across Salesforce Customer 360, deepen executive engagement capability, and build diversified revenue experience, strengthening long-term mobility into Enterprise, Specialist, or Leadership pathways.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

In the General Business segment, you operate at the intersection of enterprise complexity and portfolio breadth. Your focus is consistent: drive meaningful customer outcomes while growing Salesforce's presence across your territory.

You will:
 
  • Drive new business and expansion across a portfolio of established organisations (500–2,000 employees)
  • Represent the full Salesforce Customer 360 platform, connecting multiple clouds to address complex, cross-functional business challenges
  • Develop thoughtful account strategies that balance immediate revenue opportunities with long-term customer value
  • Build trusted, multi-level relationships within customer organisations, including executive stakeholders
  • Identify whitespace opportunities and expand Salesforce's footprint through strategic cross-cloud positioning
  • Lead sophisticated, multi-product sales cycles end-to-end — from discovery and qualification through deal strategy, negotiation, forecasting, and close
  • Engage in executive conversations, industry forums, and customer roundtables to shape transformation agendas
  • Continuously build platform fluency across Salesforce's evolving product suite and the broader enterprise technology landscape
  • Define territory and vertical strategies, identifying priority accounts and executing structured go-to-market plans
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy within a complex, multi-opportunity environment


Why this matters in GB:
Unlike highly specialised enterprise roles, you will build broad Customer 360 mastery across industries and use cases, strengthening both your commercial adaptability and long-term internal mobility.

How we work
 
  • Collaborative Selling: Success in GB is built through partnership. You will work closely with Business Development, Solution Engineering, Industry Specialists, Alliances, and Customer Success to design and deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Account Leadership: You will be trusted to shape your territory strategy, prioritise opportunities, and execute with autonomy — supported by structured enablement and leadership guidance.
  • Performance with Purpose: We measure success through revenue outcomes, customer impact, and quality of execution. High standards are balanced with collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Continuous Development: The GB segment provides frequent exposure to complex deal cycles, accelerating learning and deepening cross-cloud expertise. We invest in enablement, mentorship, and clear progression pathways.


You're Our Person If...

You are an experienced sales professional who thrives in complex, consultative environments and is motivated to expand your platform expertise.

You likely bring:
 
  • At least 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in enterprise or complex B2B environments
  • Demonstrated experience selling multi-product, platform-based, or business transformation solutions
  • A strong track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets
  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders, or the capability and credibility to do so effectively
  • A consultative approach grounded in structured discovery and value articulation
  • Curiosity and motivation to deepen expertise across multiple products and industries
  • Strong commercial judgement and disciplined pipeline management
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate diverse stakeholder groups
  • Strategic thinking skills, with the ability to develop a clear point of view and guide customer decision-making
  • A growth mindset and intentional approach to professional development
  • Familiarity with structured solution-selling methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, Command of the Message)
  • Experience with CRM or enterprise SaaS environments and the ability to provide credible customer references

title: Salesforce Architect (Multiple Levels)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

職務の目的

「戦略を、実行し、成果に変える。AIと共に」 

顧客のDXパートナーとして、システム構想の策定から実際の導入・運用までを一気通貫でリードします。単なるツールの導入に留まらず、Salesforceを活用してお客様のビジネスを成功へ導くことが本ポジションの重要な役割となります。

本ポジションの特徴

「戦略」と「実行」の両立

  • アドバイザーとして、またはプライムベンダーとして、プロジェクトをサービスインまで責任を持って完遂させる役割を担います。

AIネイティブな働き方

  • Agentforceなどの最新AIをお客様に提案するだけでなく、自らもAIを駆使し、高い生産性と品質を兼ね備えたコンサルティングを提供します。

End-to-Endの関与

  • 構想策定から構築、定着化まで支援するため、幅広い専門スキルを習得する機会が豊富にあります。

具体的な担当領域

Salesforce Architectとして、専門性を活かしたコンサルティング業務を遂行していただきます。当初は以下いずれかのロールを担当していただく想定であり、入社時の役割については選考プロセスを通じて決定します。また、入社後には個々の能力を広げられる機会があり、習得したスキルに応じて多様な役割を担うことが可能です。

主なロール

PM (Project Manager)

  • プロジェクトのリーダーとして牽引し、案件を成功に導く責任者

BA (Business Architect)

  • ビジネス戦略、業務プロセス設計、および定着化の主導

SA (Solution Architect)

  • アプリケーション全体設計、データモデル、標準機能活用、マルチクラウド設計の主導

TA (Technical Architect)

  • インテグレーション、セキュリティ、システム・アーキテクチャ設計・構築、高度な技術実装の主導

主な案件

A.戦略・変革デザイン策定（Strategy & Change Design）

組織およびシステム全体の変革構想とロードマップを策定します。

組織・業務領域変革構想デザイン

  • 業務プロセス改革や組織変革のグランドデザイン策定

システム領域変革構想デザイン

  • ITランドスケープにおけるアーキテクチャ構想

Salesforce Org 戦略

  • Salesforce組織（インスタンス）の活用戦略・ガバナンス戦略策定、ロードマップ策定

Salesforce CTO

  • CTOの視点からAgentic Enterpriseへの変革を支援

変革推進 / 定着化

  • Salesforce活用の定着化計画立案と実行支援

概念実証（PoC)

  • 具体的な解決策の設計や仮説ソリューションの実現可能性を検証

B.プロジェクト実行・支援（Project Execution & Support）

要件定義からリリースまで、各フェーズにおいて支援または実務を遂行します。プロジェクトの特性に応じウォーターフォール型かアジャイル型を選択します。

プロジェクト管理

  • プロジェクト計画の策定、推進、および管理支援

要件定義

  • ビジネス要件およびシステム化要件の抽出・定義、プロセスのファシリテーション

設計

  • アーキテクチャ・詳細設計の作成、または成果物のレビュー

開発・テスト

  • 実装・テストのリード、または開発標準策定・品質管理

移行・展開

  • データ移行・リリースの実行、または移行戦略立案・実行支援

CI/CD

  • DevOpsパイプラインの環境設計・構築・運用の支援

C.ガバナンス・最適化（Governance & Optimization）

Salesforce Governance

  • CoE（Center of Excellence）の設立、運営モデルの組成および運営支援

Design Authority

  • 設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立による設計品質の統制

設計品質BestPracticeの提言・遂行支援（Design Authority）

  • 設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立

Architecture Optimization

  • 既存環境の診断（Org診断 & ヘルスチェック）および最適化提案

応募要件

必須要件（Must）

実務経験

以下の領域のいずれかにおいて、5年以上の主体的な実務経験を有すること

A. 変革デザインと戦略

B. ガバナンスと最適化

C. プロジェクト推進・実行

リーダーシップ 

  • 3年以上のチームリーダー経験（立場は問わない）

コミュニケーション能力

  • 経営層を含む顧客と適切な意思疎通を図り、合意形成を推進できること 
  • 関連組織のメンバーに対し、敬意を払いつつ率直かつ建設的な対話ができること

基礎理解力と学習意欲 

  • 業務要件やSalesforceの技術用語、各種メソッドを短期間で理解できること
  • AIを効率的に活用し、継続的に学習する意欲と実行力があること

マインドセット 

  • 批判的思考（Critical Thinking）とアンラーニング（Unlearning）を実践できること 
  • 過去の成功体験に固執しすぎず、AIなどの新技術に合わせて自らの考えや方法論を柔軟に適合できること

言語能力

  • 日本語：流暢レベル
  • 英語：英文ドキュメントの読解に支障がないレベル以上

望ましい経験・能力（Want）

AI・データ領域の実務経験

  • Data 活用やAI Agentの開発など、先端技術を用いたプロジェクト経験

グローバル案件の遂行能力

  • 英語を用いたビジネスレベルのコミュニケーションおよびプロジェクト遂行能力

AI活用による業務効率化の実績

  • コンサルティング業務やシステム構築において、AIを活用した生産性向上の実務経験

​

本ポジションで得られるキャリア価値

総合的なアーキテクトへの成長

  • 専門的かつ幅広いスキルを習得し、市場価値の高いアーキテクトへ成長できます。

AI時代の先駆者としての経験

  • 最新のAI活用型コンサルティング手法を実践し、最先端の知見を体得できます。

顧客の成功を通じた貢献の実感

  • 変革の中心メンバーとしてプロジェクトを完遂させることで、顧客の成功に直接貢献できたと実感できます。

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Your Mission as an Account Executive:

  • Manage a dedicated territory in Growth Business (51-300 employees) space, overseeing the entire sales cycle. You’ll coordinate multiple sales projects simultaneously and take full responsibility for your customers.

  • Lead the sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics, with a strong focus on new business sales, while rapidly growing existing accounts.

  • Use your solution selling expertise to respond effectively to customer needs and identify business potential, building strategic, long-term partnerships.

  • Strengthen client relationships through regular engagement and face-to-face meetings.

  • Coordinate and lead industry events and user groups to generate market interest.

  • Collaborate with our team of Core AEs, Sales Specialists, Business Developers, Pre-sales, and Marketers for all sales leads and opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Close opportunities at assigned existing accounts and drive sales at new accounts.

  • Drive sales within the assigned segment (SMB segments).

  • Acquire new logos within the assigned territory.

  • Speak to Salesforce offerings as they relate to customer needs and engage other Salesforce resources as required.

  • Effectively manage multiple accounts and sales, with support from our team to ensure a balanced workload.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Proven track record of success in sales.

  • 4-5 years of experience in the entire sales cycle of complex SAAS solutions.

  • Ability to build positive relationships internally and with customers, demonstrating credibility and trust.

  • Effective communication skills with the ability to build influential relationships and deliver results in a cross-functional environment.

  • Successful history of net new business sales, with the ability to consistently deliver against targets.

  • A strong drive, adaptability, and enthusiasm to build a career at Salesforce.

  • Advanced level of English.

​What We Offer:

  • Competitive benefits

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Wellness and Education Reimbursement

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Inclusive Parental Leave

  • And more to support your well-being and growth!

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

The Experience


With Agentforce now deeply embedded across the Salesforce ecosystem, and ANZ businesses actively investing in AI-led marketing strategies, this is one of the most exciting sales opportunities in the market right now. This isn't a transactional sales role — You'll partner with some of Australia's largest organisations to solve complex business challenges, shape executive strategy, and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.


This role will be focused delivering value to customers through our Marketing Cloud, Data 360, Loyalty and Personalisation solutions — You'll be supported by an experienced specialist leadership team, world-class technical resources, and a culture built around coaching, collaboration, and winning together.

We're looking for a commercially sharp Senior Account Executive who thrives on opening new doors and closing meaningful deals across the Australian Commercial segment. You understand that today's marketers are under pressure to do more with less — and you know how to show them exactly how autonomous AI agents can change that. You'll work across a defined commercial patch, matched to your strengths, hunting net new business while expanding relationships across your existing account base.
 

What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Own the full sales cycle with a strong emphasis on net new business, while growing existing commercial accounts across ANZ
  • Managing a portfolio of organisations with 1,000–2,500 FTE in ANZ, driving growth across both new business acquisition and existing customer expansion
  • Building and maintaining trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business stakeholders, aligning technology investments to strategic business priorities
  • Driving consumption-based selling by increasing customer adoption, utilisation, and long-term value of SaaS solutions
  • Identified, developing, and closing net new business opportunities, delivering consistent revenue growth across assigned accounts
  • Positioning data, AI, and cloud solutions to solve critical business challenges while driving measurable business outcomes and return on investment
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, strategic outreach, and ANZ market intelligence — in close collaboration with your Business Development partner
  • Lead compelling conversations with marketing leaders and digital decision-makers, helping them understand the ROI of shifting from rule-based automation to agentic AI-driven engagement
  • Orchestrate internal resources — Solutions Engineers, Professional Services, Partners, and Executives — to move deals forward efficiently in a commercial sales motion
  • Keep your CRM data sharp: accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and weekly/monthly/quarterly revenue reporting
  • Build your presence in the ANZ market through industry events, roundtables, and face-to-face meetings across Australia and New Zealand

You're Our Person If...


  • Partnered cross-functionally with customer success, solution engineering, and partners to maximise customer outcomes and commercial growth.
  • Executed complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, balancing strategic account planning with pipeline generation and deal execution.
  • The ability to translate complex AI and automation concepts into clear business value for both technical and commercial buyers
  • Strong commercial instincts — you know how to build a business case, manage a fast-moving pipeline, and navigate multiple stakeholders
  • Credibility built on doing the work: accurate forecasting, disciplined pipeline management, and genuine customer advocacy
  • Curiosity about AI and where agentic technology is heading — you don't need to be an engineer, but genuine enthusiasm for the space matters
  • Experience is evaluated holistically — leadership roles, non-traditional backgrounds, and diverse career paths are all welcome here

Even Better If...


  • At least 5+ years of Commercial or Enterprise SaaS Sales experience, with proven attainment or over-exceeding of quota
  • Led consultative sales engagements, developing ROI-backed business cases that secured executive sponsorship and accelerated decision-making

title: Trail Architect (Solution Consultant)
descriptionHtml:

Customer Success

Job Details

The Experience

Trail Architect はSalesforce製品導入プロジェクトを支援するコンサルタントです。お客様が直面するビジネス上の課題や目的を理解した上で、当社のベストプラクティスに基づいた包括的なソリューション設計を行います。

お客様の要望に応じて、以下2つの形式でプロジェクトに参画します。

  • アドバイザーとしてお客様・パートナー様主体のSalesforce構築プロジェクトの支援
  • プライムコントラクターとしてSalesforce構築プロジェクトの遂行



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • お客様の成功にフォーカスし、お客様の戦略を理解した上でプロジェクトを推進する
  • 当社のBestPractice（標準機能、各種ナレッジ）に基づき、広い視野と長期的な視点でお客様のビジネスを中心に捉えながら、お客様やパートナー様と共にビジネスニーズに最適なソリューションを提供する
  • お客様のニーズ・ビジネスに適合するソリューションの実現方針を決定づけ、アプリリードとして開発を牽引し、高い品質の成果物を提供することに責任を持つ。計画策定、要件分析、Fit＆Gapアセスメント、開発、テストまでシステム導入フェーズを幅広く担当する
  • 機能もしくは技術面に関する設計レビュー、プロジェクト実装ガイダンスと導入のベストプラクティス提供、既存アプリケーション設定や健全性評価など、当社アプリケーションの導入または最適化に関するアドバイスをお客様ニーズに基いて実施する
  • 案件の種類を問わず、必要に応じた粒度で作業計画（WBS）の作成や進捗管理を含むプロジェクト管理を行い、高いデリバリ品質を実現する
  • プロジェクトの枠を超え、当社製品の専門家としてお客様の様々な課題に対し実現性と実効性のある提案を行い、場合によってはお客様の革新を成功させるための要点を示す
  • 当社が日本含めたGlobalで保持するベストプラクティスを学び、活用し、かつ自己の経験に基づいたナレッジの蓄積にも貢献する
  • 当社製品の年3回のアップデートをはじめとする最新技術の素早いキャッチアップとお客様のプロジェクト支援を並行して実施する
  • お客様やビジネスパートナーとのコミュニケーションを密接に行い、信頼の獲得および期待値の管理を行う
  • プロジェクトマネージャ、ビジネスアーキテクト、テクニカルアーキテクトなど他のロールのメンバと協働し、チームとして成果を出す



You're Our Person If...

  • 4年以上の一般的なエンタープライズソフトウェアソリューション（CRM、ERPなど）に関する技術実装を含むソリューション設計/システム開発経験
  • ITシステム開発プロジェクトへの参画経験。プロジェクト遂行に必要なタスクの洗い出しと遂行
  • ウォーターフォール及び/またはアジャイル方法論における実装経験
  • 論理的思考、課題解決等のコンサルティングスキル
  • 自身の意見やソリューションを論理的かつ的確に伝えることができるドキュメンテーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力
  • 指示を待たずとも自発的、能動的に仕事ができる能力
  • 常に学習を続けられ、謙虚に学ぶことができる。学んだことをすぐに実践し、ご自身でさらに改善できる



Even Better If...

  • Salesforce 認定アドミニストレーター資格を保有し、Salesforceアプリケーションに関する技術者もしくは管理者としての経験
  • コンピュータサイエンス、ソフトウェアエンジニアリングまたは関連分野での学士号
  • お客様現状業務、現行システムの理解に基づき、製品標準機能や社内BestPractice、類似システムをベースとした仮説ToBe業務やシステムを定義した経験
  • 自身で検討したソリューションの導入について施策化とロードマップを作成し、プロジェクト化を支援・推進した経験
  • お客様や自社内の部門に対しての当社製品導入支援を実施した経験
  • クラウドソリューションを用いた導入・コンサルティング経験
  • コンサルティングファームでの実務経験
  • ベストプラクティスやリファレンスアーキテクチャーを使いこなしてお客様のTOBEモデルを構築した経験
  • 文章や口頭でのコミュニケーション時に英語を活用
  • 入社後最初の3ヶ月間に 次の6つの認定取得することのできる学習力Salesforce 認定アドミニストレーターSalesforce 認定上級アドミニストレーターSalesforce 認定 Platform アプリケーションビルダーSalesforce 認定 Sales Cloud コンサルタントSalesforce 認定 Service Cloud コンサルタントSalesforce 認定 Sharing and Visibility アーキテクト



成長機会
Trail Architectは、クロスクラウドや最新の製品などの活用を前提とした難易度の高いプロジェクトに対して参画します。計画の策定から構築、テストまで幅広い領域でベストプラクティス・標準機能を活用したソリューションを提供・支援し、お客様のビジネスおよびデジタルトランスフォーメーションを成功に導きます。
業務の遂行において、Globalの知見・ナレッジに容易にアクセスし、かつ過去10年以上のDelivery経験により蓄積されたアセットやオファリングも活用することが可能なため、一流の当社製品のコンサルタントして成長することができます。
また、自社プライマリーの導入案件やお客様・パートナー向けのアドバイザリ案件何れにも参画可能なため、社員一人ひとりのスキルやキャリア志向に基づき、成長の機会を得ることができます。

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

About Futureforce University Recruiting

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Start Date: August 3, 2026
Relocation is not provided for this opportunity. This position is located in São Paulo.
This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship.

The Experience

Are you looking for a fulfilling career empowering companies to connect with their customers in a whole new way? As a Sales Development Representative in Latin America, you will join our elite sales team and do just that! You will learn how to evangelize Salesforce, the World's #1 AI CRM and the platform powering the Agentic Enterprise with Agentforce, by identifying new business opportunities, driving growth by expanding our market reach, and connecting with new potential clients across the region. You will have a direct impact on our revenue generation goals, and this role is an exciting opportunity to develop your core sales skills and business acumen as you work alongside industry sales leaders. This role provides the foundation for a successful career in sales at Salesforce.

We hire driven individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment and are energized by the pace and impact of a client-facing sales career.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Our SDR team plays a vital role in supporting our sales teams by fielding inbound inquiries and generating new business pipeline across Latin America. Successful SDRs think critically and grow through coaching from their mentors, continuously building and improving their skills throughout their tenure.

  • Strategically managing and prioritizing a high volume of inbound leads, partnering closely with Account Executives to move qualified pipeline through the sales cycle and drive conversion.

  • Leveraging Salesforce's AI tools to streamline sales workflows, build a point of view on customer needs, and articulate the value proposition of our offerings to drive business growth.

  • Building credibility and trust with internal and external stakeholders by demonstrating adaptability, anticipating and overcoming objections, and developing business acumen across various lines of business and personas.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have a genuine desire to build a long-term career in client-facing sales and are motivated by achieving and exceeding metrics, KPIs, and sales quotas.

  • You're a courageous communicator — confident engaging with prospects, asking the questions that matter, and advocating for your point of view.

  • You get it done. You're resourceful, competitive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where ownership and follow-through matter.

  • You make informed decisions. You approach problems with curiosity, use data to prioritize, and learn quickly from coaching and feedback.

  • You've completed a Bachelor's degree within the past three years, or are on track to do so within six months of the role's start date.

  • You're fluent in Portuguese and English — written and verbal.

Even Better If...

  • Previous internship or full-time corporate sales experience

The Experience

The Global Incentive Compensation (GIC) team at Salesforce is a global leader for sales compensation in the technology industry. We manage the sales compensation for all Salesforce, end-to-end - from designing the sales compensation plan to enable the company's go-to-market strategy to administering the payment so that our sales teams get paid on time.

We are currently hiring for an Senior Data Analyst, Global Incentive Compensation Analytics. This highly technical role will focus on generating deeper insights through sophisticated analysis and scientific modeling. You will support strategic compensation plan design decisions through data-driven recommendations, leveraging advanced statistical methods to assess the effectiveness of our existing programs. You will partner closely with stakeholders across the business to determine how best to align our plans with Salesforce's strategic direction.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a dynamic, data-driven environment, demonstrates natural curiosity, and is capable of building models that influence decision-makers.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Advanced Modeling & Simulation: Build and deploy scientific and predictive models using Python to simulate the financial and behavioral impacts of proposed compensation plan changes, providing analytics and data-backed business cases during the annual company GTM planning cycle.
  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Go beyond standard reporting to uncover hidden trends, performing sophisticated statistical analyses to evaluate the true effectiveness and ROI of various Incentive Compensation programs.
  • Data Pipeline & Automation: Extract, manipulate, and transform large datasets using advanced SQL and Python to automate deep insight generation, moving away from manual Excel-based processes.
  • Strategic Partnership: Serve as the dedicated technical analytics partner for aligned GTM organizations, translating complex scientific models into actionable business recommendations to evaluate the impact of compensation plan changes. Forecasting: Track commission costs by developing robust predictive algorithms that forecast future GTM performance and commission payouts.
  • Pay-for-Performance Framework: against quota attainment, utilizing advanced data modeling to optimize commission multipliers and strategically alignDesign and build a comprehensive framework to evaluate current payout rates
  • compensation structures across various roles and performance tiers.



You're Our Person If...

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related highly quantitative field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of related experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or highly technical quantitative analysis.
  • Advanced Programming: Proficiency in Python (or R) for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and building scientific models.
  • SQL/Snowflake: Advanced proficiency in SQL/Snowflake, including complex query authoring, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Data Visualization: Proficiency in building sophisticated, automated dashboards in Tableau or a similar tool.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Ability to independently address complex analytical requests: understand the ask, structure the data pipeline, perform advanced statistical analyses, validate assumptions, and output reliable scientific models.
  • Communication & Storytelling: Ability to synthesize complex data and scientific methodologies into simple, consumable deliverables with clear takeaways, influencing decision making and justifying recommendations across diverse audiences.



Even Better If...

  • Industry Knowledge: A general understanding of how a SaaS GTM engine functions is preferred.
  • CRM: Knowledge of Salesforce products and/or CRM infrastructure preferred

The Experience

カスタマーサクセスマネージャー（CSM）は、深いビジネス、業界、および製品の知識を活用して顧客とパートナーシップを結び、ビジネス価値を加速させ、Salesforceへの投資対効果を最大化できるよう導きます。この役割において、CSMは特定のクラウドの専門性や業界知見をもとに、社内リソースをオーケストレーションし、お客様と同じ目線で語り合い、顧客価値の実現を中長期的に図ります。

理想的なカスタマーサクセスマネージャーは、お客様の言葉で対話できるクラウドの専門知識と業界スキルの両方を備えた人物です。



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • 目標の理解と提案: 当社のカスタマーサクセス・メソドロジーを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して目標を理解し、彼らの能力を評価した上で、ビジネスおよびテクノロジーの目標達成を加速させるための提案を行う
  • Salesforceの啓蒙: お客様のSalesforce導入状況に対する理解と知識を深め、当社のすべてのクラウドにおけるSalesforceの機能をエバンジェライズ（啓蒙）する。
  • ベストプラクティスの提示: お客様のニーズに基づき、組織戦略、ガバナンス、およびチェンジマネジメント（変革管理）のベストプラクティスについて顧客を導く。
  • リスクの特定と軽減: お客様が掲げるビジネス目標の達成を阻害するリスクをプロアクティブに特定し、アカウントチームと連携してリスク軽減計画を策定する。
  • エグゼクティブレベルの関係構築: お客様のITおよびビジネスのエグゼクティブリーダーシップ、スポンサー、意思決定者との経営層レベルの関係を構築・育成し、パートナーシップを強固にし、お客様のビジネスやITスポンサー・チームメンバーへのコミットメントを確実なものにする。
  • 実践的な製品知識の提供: プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。
  • テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。
  • 定着化計画の策定・実行: 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント（定着・活用化）計画を示す、包括的なアダプション（定着化）パスを作成し、実行する。
  • 価値とイノベーションの提供: お客様の主要なビジネス課題と成長の可能性を理解し、お客様のビジネスに価値とイノベーションを提供する。



You’re Our Person If...

  • カスタマーサクセス、テクノロジーコンサルティング、エンタープライズアーキテクチャ、またはテクノロジーソリューション開発における6年以上の経験
  • 情熱 (PASSION): カスタマーサクセスに対して情熱を持っていること。
  • 信頼 (TRUST): 信頼を第一に行動していること。
  • 適応力 (ADAPTABLE): 不確実性が高く、変化の激しい環境において優れた成果を上げられること。



Even Better If...

  • 特定のクラウドにおける深い知識。
  • 顧客のビジネス価値を推進する「Trusted Advisor」として働いた実績と強力なコンサルティングスキル。
  • Cレベル（経営層）との効果的で影響力のある対話を主導する能力。困難な議論を円滑に進め、反論・異論に巧みに対処できること。
  • Salesforce製品およびプラットフォームの機能、性能、ベストプラクティスに関する理解があることが望まれる。
  • 技術的およびビジネス上の概念を迅速に理解し、明確に説明できる能力。
  • 以下の経験・知識のうち、少なくとも2つを有すること：
  • ビジネスプロセス（営業、サービス、マーケティング、サポート）、ビジネスアプリケーション、および自動化に関する深い知識。
  • AIおよび機械学習の概念の理解、エージェントプラットフォームの理解、エージェントの構成および展開方法に関する知識。
  • エンタープライズレベルのソフトウェア開発ライフサイクルやプロジェクトマネジメント経験。（コーディングの経験は有用ですが、必須ではありません）
  • インテグレーション、フローや自動化、API接続などへの統合方法についての知識。
  • クラウドコンピューティングで使用される、ミドルウェア、インフラ知識（例：データベース、ネットワークの基礎知識など）に関する深い理解。
  • 流暢な日本語および基礎的な読み書きができる英語力。
  • 高度な英語力、韓国語力、中国語力（関連部門と業務遂行できるレベル）があると尚良い。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。


The Experience


A Customer Success Manager (CSM) partners with customers, drawing on deep business, industry, and product knowledge to accelerate business value and guide them to maximize their return on investment in Salesforce. In this role, CSMs use their cloud expertise and industry insight to orchestrate internal resources, speak with customers as true partners, and deliver customer value over the medium to long term.

The ideal Customer Success Manager brings both cloud expertise and industry skills, and can engage with customers in their own language.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Understand goals and make recommendations: Use our Customer Success methodology to work with customer stakeholders, understand their goals, assess their capabilities, and make recommendations that accelerate their business and technology goals
  • Evangelize Salesforce: Build understanding of the customer’s Salesforce adoption, and evangelize Salesforce capabilities across all of our clouds.
  • Present best practices: Guide customers on best practices in organizational strategy, governance, and change management based on their needs.
  • Identify and mitigate risks: Proactively identify risks that could prevent customers from achieving their business goals, and work with the account team to develop risk mitigation plans.
  • Build executive-level relationships: Build and nurture executive-level relationships with customers’ IT and business executive leaders, sponsors, and decision makers to strengthen the partnership and ensure commitment to the customer’s business and to IT sponsors and team members.
  • Provide hands-on product knowledge: Demonstrate practical knowledge of Salesforce products by applying platform capabilities and features to the customer’s business priorities and roadmap.
  • Drive Customer Enablement through technical insights: Translate technical information such as product updates, incidents, and end-of-life (EOL) into customer value, and work alongside IT and business teams to help them get the most out of the technology.
  • Create and execute adoption plans: Create and execute a comprehensive adoption path that sets out the current state, a target future state with timelines, and the underlying enablement plan.
  • Deliver value and innovation: Understand the customer’s key business challenges and growth potential, and deliver value and innovation to their business.



You’re Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of experience in customer success, technology consulting, enterprise architecture, or technology solution development
  • PASSION: Passionate about customer success.
  • TRUST: Acts with trust as the first priority.
  • ADAPTABLE: Delivers excellent results in highly uncertain, fast-changing environments.



Even Better If...

  • Deep knowledge of a specific cloud.
  • Track record as a “Trusted Advisor” driving customer business value, with strong consulting skills.
  • Ability to lead effective, influential conversations with C-level executives, facilitating difficult discussions and skillfully handling pushback and objections.
  • Understanding of Salesforce products and platform capabilities, performance, and best practices is desirable.
  • Ability to quickly grasp and clearly explain technical and business concepts.
  • Experience or knowledge in at least two of the following:
  • Deep knowledge of business processes (sales, service, marketing, support), business applications, and automation.
  • Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and agent platforms, and knowledge of how to configure and deploy agents.
  • Enterprise-level software development lifecycle or project management experience. (Coding experience is useful but not required)
  • Knowledge of integration, flows and automation, and API connectivity.
  • Deep understanding of middleware and infrastructure used in cloud computing (e.g., databases, networking fundamentals).
  • Fluent Japanese and basic reading and writing skills in English.
  • Advanced English, Korean, or Chinese (at a level to work with related teams) is a plus.

  • Efficient Sales Cycle: Working directly with decision-makers in the SB/GRB space often means shorter sales cycles. This gives you the opportunity to quickly accumulate a wealth of closing experience.

Basic Requirements

  • Approximately 3-5 years of direct B2B sales experience. 

  • Experience with either products or services, in IT or non-IT sectors, is welcome.

  • Metrics-Driven: Experience working with and consistently meeting sales quotas.

  • Hunter Mentality: A strong track record in new business development and lead generation.

客戶業務經理 (Account Executive)

職務說明 (Role Description)

身為負責台灣中小型企業 (SB) 和一般企業 (GRB) 的客戶業務經理，您將是指定業務區域的負責人。您的首要任務是制定並執行銷售計畫，透過向上銷售 (upselling) 和跨部門銷售 (cross-selling)，拓展新客戶並深化與現有客戶的關係。

您將直接與企業的領導者、創辦人、經理和高階主管等決策者互動。這個職位需要具備顧問式銷售的能力，讓您能扮演客戶的信任夥伴，而不僅僅是個產品銷售員。

  • 推動成長：您將站在新業務拓展與客戶關係深化的最前線。透過與行銷、內勤業務和夥伴團隊的緊密合作，您將發掘商機並建立強健的關係，最終導向成功。

  • 培養關鍵技能：這個職位讓您能直接接觸企業主和決策者，迅速培養製作提案的技能，讓提案與公司的營收緊密連結。

  • 高效銷售循環：直接與中小型企業及一般企業的決策者合作，通常代表著更短的銷售週期。這讓您能在短時間內累積豐富的成交經驗。

基本要求 (Basic Requirements)

  • 業務經驗：3-5 年 B2B 直接銷售經驗。不限於 IT 產業，有形或無形產品的銷售經驗皆可。

  • 目標導向：有制定並執行銷售流程的實戰經驗，能有效排序機會，並持續達成目標。

  • 數據導向：有達成或超越銷售額目標的經驗。

  • Revenue Cloud & Billing

  • Manufacturing Cloud

  • Automotive Cloud

  • Education Cloud

  • Net Zero Cloud

  • 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.

  • Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.

  • Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.

  • Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.

  • Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.

  • Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.

  • Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

  • Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms

  • Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen

  • Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization

  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

The Experience

Tableauのミッションは、 お客様がデータを「見て、理解し、活用できるように支援すること」です。 Tableau はビジネスインテリジェンス市場に影響を与え、常に成長を続けています。

Account Executiveは、担当する業界・規模のお客様に対して、弊社の革新的な製品とソリューションを提案し、販売目標を上回る成果を追求する重要なポジションです。

単なる製品販売にとどまらず、お客様の潜在的な課題を深く掘り下げ、最適な解決策を提示します。市場調査からリード獲得、商談の創出、製品デモンストレーション、導入支援、そしてクロージング、さらには契約後のカスタマーサクセスまで、営業プロセスのすべてを主体的に動かすダイナミックなポジションです。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 戦略的アカウントプランニング: 担当するお客様・地域に合わせた戦略的なテリトリープランやアカウントプランを策定し、実行します。市場調査に基づき、販売機会を最大化し、四半期ごとの売上目標を達成します。
  • パイプラインの構築と管理: 新規顧客の開拓と案件の発掘を通じて、常に目標の3倍規模の営業パイプラインを維持・管理します。お客様のビジネス課題を深く理解し、当社のソリューションによる価値を明確にすることで、案件を成約に導きます。
  • お客様との関係性構築: 現場の担当者だけでなく、CxOレベルを含む経営層との関係を構築・強化し、長期的なパートナーシップを築きます。
  • ソリューション提案能力: お客様の顕在・潜在的な課題を深く掘り下げ、説得力のある製品デモンストレーションを実施することで、お客様のビジネス変革を支援します。
  • チームの成功への貢献: 営業チームのSalesforce Analyticsのエキスパートとして、データ分析をサポートします。また、セールスエンジニア、カスタマーサクセス、製品サポートなど、社内外の様々な関係者と密に連携し、チームとして最高の成果を出します。
  • エキスパートとしての成長: 業界動向や競合情報を常に収集し、自社のソリューションのエキスパートとして、お客様に最高の価値を提供します。



You're Our Person If...

  • IT業界での法人営業経験（5年以上）、および課題解決型の営業経験
  • 既存顧客の深耕および新規顧客開拓の経験
  • お客様のニーズに応じた提案資料の作成・プレゼンテーションスキル
  • 社内外の関係者と連携し、プロジェクトを推進できるチーム連携力・調整力



Even Better If...

  • 大手企業(エンタープライズ)を担当した経験
  • AnalyticsやSaaSソリューションの提案・販売経験

Our Business Development Representative (BDR) team is part of our wider Sales Business, focusing on generating new business and whitespace pipeline through prospecting outbound opportunities with the ultimate goal of closed won business. In this specialist role, you will focus on either of Salesforce's most impactful and fastest-growing verticals — Public Sector (government bodies, central ministries, local authorities, and public agencies) AND .ORG (non-profits, NGOs, and education institutions) — helping to drive Salesforce's mission of digital transformation where it matters most.


You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced team with varied future customers and personalised training and career opportunities.

Sales Development is the foundation of our sales organisation where new business opportunities come to life. Within the BDR role, we support outbound sales teams by assisting them through strategic prospecting efforts and extensive account research. BDRs consistently make a tangible impact in the Sales Development Organisation by generating millions of dollars of new business pipeline each year.


In the Public Sector & .ORG verticals, you'll be at the forefront of Salesforce's mission-driven work — helping governments modernise citizen services and enabling non-profits and educational institutions to maximise their impact. Salesforce is positioned as the #1 AI CRM for Public Sector digital transformation, giving you a powerful story to tell.


Additionally, BDRs are enrolled in an intensive sales training programme designed to provide new professionals with the fundamental skills necessary to achieve a successful sales career at Salesforce.

  • Align with internal account teams across the Public Sector OR .ORG business units

  • Fluency in English and an additional language, as well as a valid working visa for Ireland, are required for this role
  • Experience in business development, sales, or a related field — experience in or a passion for public sector, non-profit, or education sectors is a plus
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and across many different parts of the organisation to get things done
  • Experience researching, account planning, prospecting, and cold calling into a large list of new and existing accounts

Working at Salesforce isn't all about selling. It's also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including: a week-long product bootcamp, mentorship programme, weekly coaching and development programmes.

In Public Sector & .org, you'll also benefit from specialist vertical enablement, helping you deeply understand the challenges and language of your customers — from government digital transformation strategies to non-profit impact measurement.

We are pioneers of the Pledge 1% model, providing product, grants and community service to those in need. We are proud to be #1 in PEOPLE's Top 50 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune's Change the World list.

Salesforce and Google Cloud have embarked on a groundbreaking partnership worth $2.5 billion to revolutionize customer relationship management (CRM) through advanced artificial intelligence (AI). By integrating Google's Gemini AI models into Salesforce's Agentforce platform, we're enabling businesses to harness multi-modal AI capabilities—processing images, audio, and video—to deliver unparalleled customer experiences. Join our team of talented engineers and help us advance the integration of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will have the unique opportunity to work at the forefront of IDP, AI and cloud computing and contribute to enabling a full suite of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud. You will get an opportunity to build a platform on GCP to enable agentic solutions on Salesforce.

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Software Security Engineer to join our GCP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing our security posture across various domains, focusing on development, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, and the security of distributed and scalable distributed systems. This role requires hands-on experience with security systems, a deep understanding of modern threats, and the ability to drive security improvements through engineering solutions.


As a Software Security Engineer, you won’t just find vulnerabilities, you’ll engineer the systems that prevent them. You will play a pivotal role in securing our distributed micro-services architecture on GCP, moving security by building automated, high-performance tools that empower our entire engineering organization.

  • Architecture & Threat Modeling: Partner with DevOps and Product teams to conduct threat modeling and architectural reviews, ensuring new features are resilient and scalable.

  • Compliance & Governance: Act as the technical lead for audits (SOC2, ISO 27001), leveraging automation to provide evidence of consistent monitoring and timely closure of risks.

  • Production Resilience: Troubleshooting and resolving complex security issues in production using distributed tracing and modern monitoring tools.

  • Coding Proficiency: Strong experience in Go, Java, or Python with a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and automation.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise: Deep experience with GCP (similar) and Terraform for managing cloud security posture (CSPM) and infrastructure.

  • Security Domain Knowledge: Practical experience with network protocols, OS hardening (Linux), and modern attack vectors.

  • Collaborative Spirit: A desire to work cross-functionally with DevOps to embed security into the SDLC.

The Experience

Are you ready to be at the forefront of Agentforce and Data 360 activation? If you thrive in ambiguity, move quickly, go deep technically, and can engage at the executive level — and you want to write the playbook, not just execute it — this team is for you. AFD360 operates with the energy of a startup within Salesforce.

About AFD360
AFD360 is a small, high-impact agentic activation team. We engage when customers have purchased Agentforce and Data 360 but haven't yet realized value. We work in the most critical phase of the customer lifecycle — the space between purchase and production — where data readiness, architecture, security and compliance, integration complexity, evaluation, and production hardening consistently prevent customers from seeing results.

Our mission is to prove the path to production, build the customer's capability to sustain and expand it, and hand off cleanly. We remove the blockers that most often stall AI deployments.

What AFD360 is not
We are not an implementation team or a long-term execution owner. We guide, enable, and build the customer's ability to execute agentic use cases so they can sustain and scale independently. We measure success by activation outcomes — agents in production with active usage — not by activity.

We're hiring across two profiles — and the best candidates often blend both:
 
  • Guiders: Expertise in feasibility, activation strategy, orchestration, executive-ready communication, and customer capability development.
  • Doers: Skilled at removing hard blockers, hands-on agent building, grounding and evaluation, production hardening, and navigating integration realities.


What You'll Actually Be Doing
 
  • Prove the path to production — Partner with customers to shape use cases that deliver measurable business value, then define a credible, executable path to a production-grade agent with active usage.
  • Optimize underperforming agents — When live agents aren't driving value, diagnose what's broken — instructions, grounding, topics, evaluation — and fine-tune to improve accuracy, adoption, and business impact.
  • Drive production readiness — Lead grounding and evaluation, guardrails, observability, and runbooks ("trust-by-design") so agents earn approval and sustain usage.
  • Build customer capability — Provide hands-on guidance and capability development so customers can run, harden, and expand independently.
  • Serve as the expert overlay — Unblock decisions, align stakeholders, and drive coordinated C360 orchestration with clean handoffs to FDE, Professional Services, partners, and Success.
  • Close the ATR → NCR gap — Accelerate adoption and consumption ramp on agents that are live but not yet scaling.
  • Chart the expansion roadmap — Define the "what's next" plan: next-best agent, sequencing, dependencies, and the adoption and consumption path that makes expansion inevitable.
  • Scale what works — Document winning patterns, equip Regulated Industries teams, and feed learnings back to Product and AI SMEs.


You're Our Person If...
 
  • B.S. Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS
  • Knowledge of related applications, relational databases, and ERP technologies
  • Solid oral, written, presentation, collaboration and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team to solve technical problems in varied political environments

We are a Data & AI Architects team focused on helping customers understand what this new AI era makes possible, and what it actually takes to make the possible a reality: the right architecture, a trusted data foundation, a clear operating model, and an adoption path that scales. We work in the field, close to customers, close to our Agentforce and Data 360 sellers, and close to Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery teams. We are expected to know the domain, understand the wider ecosystem, bring a strong point of view, and help guide the architectural decisions that turn AI ambition into trusted business outcomes.

We are looking for architects who love hard problems, think in systems, and are energized by the transformation AI is driving across organizations. We value people who understand how the whole landscape fits together and where Salesforce creates the most leverage within it.
 

About the Role

As a Data & AI Technical Architect, you are the expert thought leader and senior field specialist for customers evaluating, implementing, and expanding their use of Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, and the broader enterprise data and AI ecosystem.

Your work sits at the intersection of technical architectural, solution engineering, applied data and AI, and delivery-aware judgment on what it takes to make a solution succeed. You help customers translate their data and AI ambitions into practical, actionable architectures. This role asks you to go both deep and wide: deep on the trusted data and agent foundation that everything else depends on, and wide across the ecosystem on which your customers actually run their business — because real architecture lives at the seams between systems, not inside any single product.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Share a clear point of view on enterprise data and AI — how agents, data platforms, CRM, trust, identity, workflow, governance, and adoption come together into something that delivers value through Salesforce.
  • Deeply understand our data & AI products and articulate the value of the Salesforce platform.
  • Partner with sellers and solution teams to uncover customers' real problems, shape technical strategy, and pressure-test feasibility and cost-to-serve early.
  • Lead customer architectural discussions around Data 360, Agentforce, data structures and patterns, AI readiness, identity management, governance, integration, automation, and business value.
  • Build customer confidence through demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, reference patterns, and architectural walkthroughs that demonstrate what's real as well as what it will take to operationalize and scale.
  • Continuously scan the horizon and tinker to refine your judgement on what's worth building and how to build within the data and AI space.
  • Turn what you learn in the field into reusable assets, enablement, best practices, and product feedback that extend your impact beyond your immediate teams and stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

You are a builder as much as an advisor. You are comfortable picking up new tools and technology, and are not afraid to get hands-on. You can craft and deliver an engaging story and also pressure-test the architecture behind it. You go deep without getting lost and wide without getting shallow. You bring field presence and credibility across a range of levels with your ability to effectively engage customer executives, enterprise architects, data platform owners, security and governance leaders, technical practitioners, sellers, partners, and delivery stakeholders.
 

Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical architecture, enterprise architecture, solution engineering, consulting, implementation, software engineering, product development, or related work in complex enterprise environments.
  • A track record of shaping technical strategy with input from customers and /or stakeholders, validating solution approaches, and connecting business needs to technology decisions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data, AI, integration, governance, security, privacy, and platform architecture concepts and patterns.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery or customer teams to move solutions from idea to execution.
  • The ability to distill and communicate complex technical ideas to executive and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and learning velocity in emerging technologies — especially within the AI, data, automation, and agentic systems space.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, other STEM degrees or equivalent work experience. Graduate study a plus.

Helpful Experience

We care most about architectural judgment, learning velocity, and stakeholder impact. Experience with any of the following technologies and functions is a plus:
 

  • Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, Informatica, or the broader Salesforce Platform.
  • Conversational AI, voice-enabled AI agents, real-time voice orchestration, telephony integrations, or multi-channel service experiences.
  • Modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or RedShift, and the hyperscaler ecosystems around them.
  • AI agents, generative AI, AI governance and observability, external agent ecosystems, hyperscaler AI services, or enterprise automation.
  • Programming languages such as Python, common data structures and tooling, and AI-assisted development pipelines.
  • Building demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, workshops, reference architectures, or field enablement assets.

The Architect Who Thrives Here

You will thrive as part of our team if you seek to understand customers' real problems, not just the stated requirements. You are curious about how organizations work, where data and processes break down, where AI can create leverage, and how businesses need to evolve to succeed. You are a leader who confidently defines the what, how, and why, and challenges the status quo when you see a better path. You are excited about AI while remaining grounded in what makes it work well: trusted data, clear use cases, strong architectures, governance, adoption, and demonstrable value.
