Job Title: Offensive Security Engineer - Red Team

The Experience

  • We are looking for an Offensive Security Engineer to join our Red Team, which simulates real attackers across Salesforce products, platforms, and enterprise environments. You will own complex, end-to-end adversary simulations and partner with the Red Team Director on campaign design.
  • With Agentforce woven into every layer of our platform, you will test how attackers could abuse AI-driven systems. You will also use AI tools to speed up scoping, documentation, and reporting, so you can spend more time on hands-on offensive work.
  • This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Bellevue, WA and is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Design and run end-to-end red team operations that simulate real threat actors, from initial access to objective completion. Use threat intelligence to emulate specific Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) groups and adapt your tactics as defenders respond.
  • Find, exploit, and chain weaknesses across applications, identity, cloud, and enterprise environments. Build custom tooling, payloads, and techniques that test security controls and detections.
  • Work with the Red Team Director, Detection and Response, Detection Engineering, and Blue Teams on campaign design and purple team exercises. Help engineering teams understand root causes and put durable fixes in place.
  • Act as the technical escalation point for complex attack paths and disputed findings, and mentor other engineers. Explain attack chains and business risk clearly to executive leadership, following all rules of engagement, scoping limits, and Operational Security (OPSEC) practices.



You're Our Person If...

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in red teaming, penetration testing, or adversary simulation, including executing end-to-end attack campaigns.
  • Experience with manual exploitation, attack chaining, and custom exploit, tooling, or payload development.
  • Working knowledge of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and of identity, application, cloud, and hybrid enterprise attack surfaces.
  • Experience bypassing layered security controls and detections, and documenting findings and remediation guidance for technical and executive audiences.



Even Better If...

  • Published security research, such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) credits, blog posts, or conference talks.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

At Salesforce, we believe technology should serve the greater good—powering mission outcomes, stewarding taxpayer resources, and enabling innovation at speed and scale. We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our elite Public Sector team at Salesforce. This is a unique and high-impact position, blending the roles of a technologist and strategic partner. In this role, you will be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI and other transformative solutions to life for mission-critical work across the U.S. Department of Defense, Intelligence Community (IC), and Aerospace & Allied Nations.

This isn't a typical engineering job. It's for those who want to roll up their sleeves and make a tangible difference. You will work directly with mission owners and internal teams to design, develop, and implement bespoke solutions—from AI and enterprise business systems to analytics, field operations, and logistics. You'll use our Agentforce platform and other technologies to tackle our customers' most complex problems, driving tangible value from initial concept to successful deployment and ongoing optimization. This role is a fusion of mission, product, and innovation, where your technical mastery and problem-solving skills will help shape and deliver Salesforce's most strategic national security and allied defense programs while influencing our platform's roadmap.

Mission Impact:
 
  • Deploy Cutting-Edge Commercial Innovation—from Slack-based AI agents to Data Cloud analytics to field service automation—into defense, intelligence, and aerospace environments, accelerating transformation and outcomes.
  • Become a Trusted Partner and Collaborate Directly with End-Users in classified and unclassified environments to deeply understand mission needs, operational challenges, and strategic goals and translate them into technical implementations using Salesforce's multi-cloud portfolio.
  • Drive Innovation by serving as a connective bridge between customer missions and Salesforce engineering. You'll gather frontline feedback and help co-design features and capabilities that strengthen national security outcomes.
  • Improve Efficiency, Mission-Readiness, and Trust by helping the U.S. and allied governments deploy technology that delivers faster response times, better personnel utilization, and more effective logistics and asset management.
  • Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation and end-to-end technical delivery of AI solutions, personally writing code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.
  • Build Transformative AI Solutions by designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve leveraging AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to create intelligent agents and automate workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.
  • Direct Ownership of Data Configuration & Integration from end-to-end. You'll design robust data models, build efficient processing pipelines, and establish seamless integration strategies to ingest, transform, and analyze complex datasets. Your work will ensure data is protected and always ready and optimized for our AI applications.
  • Drive Agentforce Innovation by becoming an expert in our innovative agentic platform. You'll directly push its capabilities to the limit, developing bespoke intelligent agents, automating intricate business processes, and crafting intuitive user experiences that deliver tangible value.
  • Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and detailed analysis of complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance and ensure reliability.
  • Prototype and Iterate Rapidly to develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement.
  • Implement Best Practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions.


We're looking for a builder, a problem solver, and a mission-first engineer with a passion for public service.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
 
  • Serve as the technical advisor on high-profile customer engagements—designing, building, and deploying tailored Salesforce solutions for defense, intelligence, and aerospace missions.
  • Partner with internal product and engineering teams to co-develop new platform features that address real-world public sector and IL5/IL6 operational requirements.
  • Facilitate integration of AI/ML models, custom data pipelines, and automation flows that enable predictive maintenance, personnel planning, and mission-critical logistics decisions.
  • Enable customers to adopt Salesforce for field operations, asset visibility, command center operations, and secure collaboration through Slack and Government Cloud Plus.
  • Work with customer IT/security teams to accelerate Authority to Operate (ATO) and production go-lives per DoD IL5/IL6 and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Share lessons learned with the broader Salesforce community to shape playbooks, prototypes, and reusable assets for government innovation.
  • Partner with mission stakeholders to translate operational priorities into actionable technical roadmaps and Salesforce solutions aligned with agency strategy.


You're Our Person If...
 
  • 3-7 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or systems integration.
  • Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., JavaScript, Java, Python, Apex).
  • Proven track record of hands-on, end-to-end delivery of high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment.
  • Hands-on experience building solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including integrating LLMs, applying AI orchestration frameworks, and prompt engineering techniques.
  • Experience with data integration, API design, ETL, and AI/ML model deployment.
  • Familiarity with analytics, data warehouses, and operational dashboards (e.g. Tableau, CRM Analytics, Snowflake).
  • Experience working in or adjacent to secure environments.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with high levels of independence.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of engaging directly with users, executives, and engineers, with a collaborative mindset, bias for action, and customer obsession.
  • Ability to travel 25-50% of the time, as needed to customer sites.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship with the ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role.
  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph required


Even Better If...
 
  • Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), or Federal Civilian agencies.
  • Background in defense/aerospace industries or operational military/logistics experience.
  • Familiarity with IL5/IL6/CNSS #1253 requirements or deployment to classified environments.
  • Direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including configuration, customization, and development.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform.
  • Experience developing conversational AI solutions within regulated industries.
  • Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Administrator, Platform Developer I, Architect, Agentforce Specialist).

#LI-Y

This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

title: Pre-Sales Data and AI Architect - Solution Engineering (United States)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Team

We are a Data & AI Architects team focused on helping customers understand what this new AI era makes possible, and what it actually takes to make the possible a reality: the right architecture, a trusted data foundation, a clear operating model, and an adoption path that scales. We work in the field, close to customers, close to our Agentforce and Data 360 sellers, and close to Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery teams. We are expected to know the domain, understand the wider ecosystem, bring a strong point of view, and help guide the architectural decisions that turn AI ambition into trusted business outcomes.

We are looking for architects who love hard problems, think in systems, and are energized by the transformation AI is driving across organizations. We value people who understand how the whole landscape fits together and where Salesforce creates the most leverage within it.
 

About the Role

As a Data & AI Technical Architect, you are the expert thought leader and senior field specialist for customers evaluating, implementing, and expanding their use of Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, and the broader enterprise data and AI ecosystem.

Your work sits at the intersection of technical architectural, solution engineering, applied data and AI, and delivery-aware judgment on what it takes to make a solution succeed. You help customers translate their data and AI ambitions into practical, actionable architectures. This role asks you to go both deep and wide: deep on the trusted data and agent foundation that everything else depends on, and wide across the ecosystem on which your customers actually run their business — because real architecture lives at the seams between systems, not inside any single product.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Share a clear point of view on enterprise data and AI — how agents, data platforms, CRM, trust, identity, workflow, governance, and adoption come together into something that delivers value through Salesforce.
  • Deeply understand our data & AI products and articulate the value of the Salesforce platform.
  • Partner with sellers and solution teams to uncover customers' real problems, shape technical strategy, and pressure-test feasibility and cost-to-serve early.
  • Lead customer architectural discussions around Data 360, Agentforce, data structures and patterns, AI readiness, identity management, governance, integration, automation, and business value.
  • Build customer confidence through demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, reference patterns, and architectural walkthroughs that demonstrate what's real as well as what it will take to operationalize and scale.
  • Continuously scan the horizon and tinker to refine your judgement on what's worth building and how to build within the data and AI space.
  • Turn what you learn in the field into reusable assets, enablement, best practices, and product feedback that extend your impact beyond your immediate teams and stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

You are a builder as much as an advisor. You are comfortable picking up new tools and technology, and are not afraid to get hands-on. You can craft and deliver an engaging story and also pressure-test the architecture behind it. You go deep without getting lost and wide without getting shallow. You bring field presence and credibility across a range of levels with your ability to effectively engage customer executives, enterprise architects, data platform owners, security and governance leaders, technical practitioners, sellers, partners, and delivery stakeholders.
 

Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical architecture, enterprise architecture, solution engineering, consulting, implementation, software engineering, product development, or related work in complex enterprise environments.
  • A track record of shaping technical strategy with input from customers and /or stakeholders, validating solution approaches, and connecting business needs to technology decisions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data, AI, integration, governance, security, privacy, and platform architecture concepts and patterns.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery or customer teams to move solutions from idea to execution.
  • The ability to distill and communicate complex technical ideas to executive and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and learning velocity in emerging technologies — especially within the AI, data, automation, and agentic systems space.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, other STEM degrees or equivalent work experience. Graduate study a plus.

Helpful Experience

We care most about architectural judgment, learning velocity, and stakeholder impact. Experience with any of the following technologies and functions is a plus:
 

  • Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, Informatica, or the broader Salesforce Platform.
  • Conversational AI, voice-enabled AI agents, real-time voice orchestration, telephony integrations, or multi-channel service experiences.
  • Modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or RedShift, and the hyperscaler ecosystems around them.
  • AI agents, generative AI, AI governance and observability, external agent ecosystems, hyperscaler AI services, or enterprise automation.
  • Programming languages such as Python, common data structures and tooling, and AI-assisted development pipelines.
  • Building demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, workshops, reference architectures, or field enablement assets.

The Architect Who Thrives Here

You will thrive as part of our team if you seek to understand customers' real problems, not just the stated requirements. You are curious about how organizations work, where data and processes break down, where AI can create leverage, and how businesses need to evolve to succeed. You are a leader who confidently defines the what, how, and why, and challenges the status quo when you see a better path. You are excited about AI while remaining grounded in what makes it work well: trusted data, clear use cases, strong architectures, governance, adoption, and demonstrable value.

Unleash Your Potential

The Experience

顧客のAI活用に伴う業務変革を牽引する技術責任者として、現行業務の分析および可視化を起点とし、自律型AIエージェント「Agentforce」をはじめとするSalesforceのAIソリューションにおける設計、構築から定着化までを担当します。本ポジションの役割は、仕様書に沿ったシステム構築にとどまりません。すでにシステム化された領域だけでなく、手作業や属人的に処理されている領域も含めて顧客の業務全体を分析・可視化し、業務モデルとして体系化することから着手します。そのうえで、どの業務をAIエージェントに配置すれば高い効果が得られるかを見極めて切り出し、設計・構築・検証・本番展開、さらには稼働後の定着化、内製化にいたるまで、責任を持って遂行します。

(1) 業務分析からエージェント構築、本番展開、定着化・内製化支援までの一連の工程への関与

提示された仕様に基づくシステム開発ではなく、業務分析からエージェントの構築、本番展開にいたるまでを一貫して担当します。各フェーズにおける主な特徴は以下の通りです。

  • 業務分析・モデリング：システム化されていない手作業や属人的な領域も含めて現行業務を可視化し、業務モデルとして体系化します。各業務を「定型業務（ルールベース）」「判断業務（推論・確率ベース）」「創造業務（人間主導）」に分類し、AIエージェントに任せることで効果が出る業務を切り出します。
  • プロセス設計（推論・確率ベース × ルールベース）：推論・確率ベース（LLM）が持つ柔軟性と、ルールベースが持つ正確性および統制の双方の適用境界を見極め、処理単位ごとにどちらで構築すべきかを判断します。Agentforceのメインルーチンは推論エンジンとなる一方、確実な実行が必要な部分はAgent Scriptで記述する「ハイブリッド推論」により決定論的に制御します。
  • 設計・開発・テストから本番デプロイ：エージェントおよびサブエージェントの構成、トピック（業務分類）、インストラクション（動作指示）、アクション（Flow、Apex、またはAPIなど）を設計・実装します。評価・テストを通じて誤答や意図しない挙動を防ぎ、CI/CDを用いて安全に本番環境へ移行します。
  • 定着化・内製化支援：本番展開後においても、活用の定着化や新たなユースケースの提案、さらには顧客自身がエージェントを運用・改善できる体制（内製化）の構築までを支援します。これにより、Agentforceが顧客の業務基盤として定着するよう継続的な支援を行います。



(2) Agentforceを起点とした広範なAI・データ基盤への技術領域の拡大

対象となる技術領域はAgentforceに限定されません。Data Cloudによるデータのリアルタイム統合およびグラウンディング、Salesforceプラットフォーム全般、Sales、ServiceまたはMarketingなどの各機能、さらには外部AIサービスや他システムとの連携まで、幅広い製品群を活用してシステムを構築します。ご自身の得意な領域から実務に着手し、プロジェクトでの実践を通じて段階的に対応範囲を拡大することが可能です。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

本ポジションの担当者は、特定の役割に固定されることなく、プロジェクトの各フェーズにおいて必要となる以下の業務を幅広く担当します。

  • (1) 業務分析・モデリング：顧客の現行業務を可視化し、定型業務（ルールベース）、判断業務（推論・確率ベース）、創造業務（人間主導）などに分類したうえで、AIエージェントを適用することで効果が見込める業務領域を見極めます。
  • (2) ユースケース策定：切り出した業務について、AIエージェントの動作方針や適用範囲を定め、推論・確率ベース（LLM）で実行する処理とルールベース（FlowまたはApex）で実行する処理を切り分けます。あわせて、Data Cloudを用いたデータ統合・グラウンディングの方針や、AI Trust Layerによるデータ保護・コンプライアンス（ガードレール）を含むデータとAIの統制方針を策定し、必要に応じてPoCにより効果を早期に検証します。
  • (3) Agentforceの設計・開発：業務範囲に応じたエージェント／サブエージェントの構成、トピック（業務分類）・インストラクション（動作指示）・アクション（Flow、Apex、APIなど）を設計・実装します。Agent Scriptを用いたハイブリッド推論の設計により、判断が必要な部分は推論に委ね、順序遵守や予測可能性が求められる処理は決定論的に制御します。必要に応じて外部エージェントやAPI連携を組み込み、Data CloudによるグラウンディングやAI Trust Layerによる機密データのマスキングなど、データ基盤とセキュリティの設計までを担います。
  • (4) 評価・本番デプロイ・運用：プロンプトやインストラクションの調整を通じてエージェントの誤答や意図しない挙動を防ぐ評価・テストを実施し、変更セットやCI/CDを用いて安全に本番環境へ移行します。稼働後は対話履歴や稼働ログを分析し、タスク完了率や顧客満足度（CSAT）の継続的な改善、および業務分類の見直しを行います。
  • (5) 組織統制（Agent CoE）：社内で複数のAIエージェントが乱立・誤動作することを防ぐため、共通のセキュリティ基準、設計・開発標準、プロセスやツール体制、共有部品を定義・管理する組織（Agent CoE：Center of Excellence）の設立および運営を支援します。あわせて、活用の定着化や新たなユースケースの提案など、Agentforceが顧客の業務インフラとして機能するよう、体制やプロセスを含めて包括的に支援します。



You're Our Person If...

以下の経験やスキル、資質を有していることを想定しています。

  • 業務分析・システム構築の実務経験：ITシステム構築における業務分析・要件定義から、設計、構築、テスト、本番移行にいたる一連の工程について、標準的な開発手法やプロジェクト管理手法に基づき、自ら開発に携わった経験、あるいはプロジェクトを責任を持って推進した実績を有していること。必要な経験年数は入社時のグレードに応じて以下を想定します（Consultant クラス：5年以上、Architect クラス：6年以上、Senior / Director Architect クラス：11年以上）。
  • 「推論・確率ベース × ルールベース」双方への基礎的な理解：推論・確率ベース（LLM）の挙動やプロンプト設計の基本と、従来のプログラムや自動化フロー（ルールベース）が持つ確実性の双方を理解し、これらを課題や要件に応じて適切に使い分けられるスキルを有していること。
  • AI・LLM技術を用いたソリューション構築経験：AIおよびLLM技術を用いたソリューションの構築からデプロイにいたる実践的な工程において、LLMの統合や高度なAIオーケストレーションフレームワークの適用、プロンプトエンジニアリング技術、ならびにエージェントフレームワークを用いた開発に直接携わった実務経験を有していること。
  • 技術領域を広げる主体性：既存の技術や開発手法にとどまらず、AgentforceからData Cloud、外部AIサービスにいたるまで、新たな技術を自ら主体的に習得し、対応範囲を拡張する意欲と実行力があること。
  • 論理的なコミュニケーション力：曖昧な要望や複雑な業務・システム構成を図や言葉を用いて論理的に整理・可視化し、開発チームや顧客との間で円滑に合意を形成できる能力があること。
  • AIツールによる実務効率化の経験：生成AIをはじめとするAIツールを、業務分析や設計、構築といった一連の工程に実際に活用し、担当業務の生産性向上やプロセス改善を図った実務経験を有していること。



Even Better If...

以下の経験や知見を有していると、さらに望ましいです。

  • 業務分析やモデリング（業務フローの可視化、業務の分類）の実務経験を有すること。（UML、BPMN、DMNなどのモデリング言語や記法を用いて、業務やプロセスを体系的に整理した経験があれば、なお望ましい。）
  • ITシステム構築プロジェクトにおける顧客折衝・調整・合意形成の経験を有すること。
  • エンタープライズ・アーキテクチャに関する知見を有すること。
  • 外部システムにおけるAPIやサービスの設計、およびインテグレーションに関する設計・開発の実務経験を有すること。
  • 新技術の導入提案、およびユースケース選定・PoCの実施経験を有すること。
  • Salesforceプラットフォーム（標準機能、Apex、Flow、Data Cloudなど）に関する設計・開発経験を有すること。
  • Agentforce、Agent Script、Prompt Builder、Model Builder、その他LLMフレームワークを用いた高度な対話型AIソリューション開発経験を有すること。
  • 英語を用いて海外の技術者と円滑に意思疎通を図り、共同プロジェクトを遂行できる語学力を有すること。

  • 業務変革の実務経験：単なるシステムの置き換えにとどまらず、業務の可視化・分類から、自律型AIを用いた業務プロセスの再設計・実運用までを経験し、先進的なAI導入の実績を積むことができます。

Success Specialistは、1つ以上の製品（Cloud）における深いスペシャリティを持ち、複雑かつ大規模な環境（マルチクラウド等）を抱えるお客様に対し、戦略的なガイダンスを提供します。オンボーディングから高度な機能活用、さらには組織変革を促すアドバイスまで、お客様のフェーズに応じた最適な支援を提供します。また、社内の戦略的プログラムにも参画し、特定のお客様の支援を通じて得られた知見を自社内にフィードバックすることで、標準的な支援フレームワークを改善し、共通した課題をもつより多くのお客様の課題解決に貢献します。

Our employees are empowered to push their bold ideas forward, and we are united by a shared passion for using data to do the extraordinary for each other and the world.The Expansion SAEs will lead the upsell and cross-sell of enterprise software solutions from IDMC products to drive incremental subscription revenue from the existing customer base. The Expansion SAE is expected to evangelize Informatica by generating additional revenue and business from existing customers. Thus, fueling our growth by strategically right sizing their existing footprint to meet their current needs and upcoming use cases. This role nurtures and owns the expansion relationship within assigned territory and maximizes Informatica's footprint within them for cloud products. Incremental Sales revenue will be driven by customers current consumption of cloud products guided by the present adoption and their future expansion needs. We operate with precision and partnership, driving Net Revenue Retention through targeted expansion motions rooted in real-time usage, predictive insights, and licensing clarity.Nothing is more paramount to us in Informatica than customer success. In this role, an Expansion SAE won't simply sell products. They are expected to analyze the consumption metrics, create account analysis', consult, and listen deeply to understand current and future business needs. Expansion of our existing customer base is backed by collaborative cross-functional teams. Incumbents effectively collaborate with other teams, including Sales, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Renewals, Marketing, Channel Management, Finance, and Customer Support, as well as external parties such as Alliances and Channel Partners.As this is a consumption-based expansion role, candidates need a thorough understanding of Informatica platform technologies and/or SaaS consumption pricing. Prior Enterprise sales experience within the SaaS ecosystem is must-have experience. This is mainly a remote selling position where minimum travel to the customer's location is expected based on customer needs.This role will report to the solution sales organization through expansion leadership.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
  • This role is a quota-carrying expansion or incremental sales position.
  • Meet and exceed expansion sales goals (quotas) through analyzing consumption metrics, prospecting, qualifying, managing, and closing sales opportunities end to end within the assigned accounts/territory.
  • Expand sales within existing accounts while getting connected and building strategic relationships with key decision-makers.
  • At this level, incumbents will have expert-level knowledge of selling the company's IDMC products and services.
  • Orchestrate the Ecosystem: You work in close partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Renewals, Marketing, Partner Alliances, and Services to ensure your team has everything they need to succeed. Cross-company engagement is a core part of how you operate at scale to ensure customer health and a value driven expansion is top of mind.
  • Forecast & Report with Precision: You regularly report on individual results — pipeline generation, pipeline quality, forecasting — and keep executive leadership informed with accuracy and candor.
  • Build Pipeline at Scale: You continuously work within your assigned territory to create new pipeline opportunities and drive revenue
  • Manage and track customer and transactional information in a Salesforce CPQ CRM system with high accuracy.
  • Executive Engagement Skills: Excellent presentation and executive engagement skills — you are comfortable in the boardroom and credible with CIOs, CTOs, and C-suite stakeholders
  • AI & Data Curiosity: A natural curiosity about the evolving AI and agentic landscape. You stay close to where enterprise AI is heading and equip yourself to credibly connect data and integration strategy to real-world AI outcomes
  • Provides customer feedback to internal stakeholders for product, systems, and process improvements.
  • Nurture and expand the company's relationship with customer accounts of various sizes. As it's a consumption-based sale, assigned accounts may be high in volume or larger and of the most complex nature. Hence assigned quota will vary.
You're Our Person If...
  • 3+ years of field sales experience in the SaaS space; minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Experience within data management software selling.
  • A clear track record of success in expanding SaaS subscriptions, demonstrated by overachievement of quota ($1M+ of ARR)
  • BA/BS or equivalent educational background, we will consider an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Technical knowledge of Informatica will be added advantage
  • Ability to engage technical and business stakeholders
  • Mix of business and technical acumen with ability to engage and add value in discussions involving both technology and business strategy
  • Passionate about technology, a natural, credible evangelist, and experienced in translating that passion into business impact for customers
  • Strong written and oral presentation skills and ability to engage with a spectrum of executives-technical and non-technical from developers, and architects, to C-level
  • Previous experience in consulting, open source solutions or with an annual subscription sales model is preferred
  • Experience executing sales & expansion strategies with customers including a deep understanding of utilization and consumption models, plays, and importance
  • Learn, be familiar with Informatica solutions, positioning, competition, and product suite Internalize Informatica customer success stories and Customer Success systems and processes and understand the current state of regional performance across customer health, retention, and growth metrics
  • Holds expert-level experience and uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.
  • Deep industry knowledge and understanding of a customer's decision-making process, goals, strategies, and business objectives.
  • Expert-level presentation, financial/business acumen, and negotiation skills at all levels of customer engagement.
  • Knowledge of the enterprise cloud platforms, SaaS, PaaS, and SaaS contracts
  • Full functional knowledge of the deployment of software solutions and how consumption metrics drive expansion
  • Maintain an understanding of Informatica's subscription and Consumption pricing models to provide customers assistance in the usage/use case-based expansion discussions.

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don't, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.

Agentforce Operations is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email. For Salesforce, this represents a massive growth opportunity in the back office, with innovations that flow into the front office. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase. As one user put it: "I've been waiting for this for 20 years."


The Teams

Agentforce Operations & Missionforce Team

As a Site Reliability Engineer for Missionforce Operations, you will be a senior technical contributor who helps shape the infrastructure, process automation and engineering practices behind the product. You will partner closely with product engineers, sector experts, and forward-deployed engineers to deliver the most reliable systems for mission-critical public-sector workflows.

Missionforce Operations is Agentforce Operations’ public-sector counterpart: rebuilt from the ground up to bring core capabilities to some of the world’s most sensitive operating environments. In this role, you will design and ship infrastructure, automation, and cost-efficient platform capabilities that enable customers to run Missionforce Operations reliably and securely in customer-owned, isolated public-cloud environments, where requirements for trust, security, and data classification are uncompromising.


Super Agent Team


As a Site Reliability Engineer for the Agentforce Operations Super Agent team, your mandate will be to radically optimize the scalability, resilience, and performance of our product and platform across the entire stack to help usher in this next phase of growth. The ideal candidate would be able to develop a deep technical understanding of our architecture and then deliver the end-to-end implementation of optimizations that would enable us to achieve greater scalability while simultaneously improving our reliability. Agentforce Operations manages complex, infinitely configurable states with equally complex state transitions and interfaces to teams across the organization. That means you'd be tackling a wide array of challenges that would include optimization of our existing data model, streamlining of our asynchronous operations patterns, profiling and rightsizing our infrastructure, and developing both the tools and observability to run experiments and empirically validate results.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

Agentforce Operations & Missionforce Team
 

  • Scaling & Reliability: Own the reliability roadmap for major product areas, evolving startup-speed architectures into highly available, globally scalable systems for mission-critical customer-operated cloud environments.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with engineers to refine our infrastructure strategy, contributing senior-level perspectives on system design, capacity planning, bottleneck identification, and security.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Define, maintain and evolve our tools for deployments, focusing on making deployments as “push-button” and robust as possible.
  • AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling and deployment of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring the compute, deployment and platform capabilities required to run AI features reliably and cost-effectively.
  • Production Excellence: Design and build the internal systems and processes for testing and releasing the product, along with the tooling and automation that enable customers and partners to deploy, upgrade, diagnose, and run Missionforce Operations successfully with minimal direct engineering involvement.
  • Security Engineering: Design, review, and strengthen identity and access controls, networking, workload isolation, secret management, deployment security, and policy enforcement to ensure the product is secure by default.
  • AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.

Super Agent
 

  • Diagnose and prioritize architectural problems across our distributed backend systems, contributing technical perspective to help the team invest in the right foundational work at the right time
  • Design and implement solutions to hard system problems including application performance optimization, infrastructure management, and data model improvements. 
  • Raise and maintain our engineering quality bar through pragmatic standards, guardrails, and team practices that prevent regressions and keep our product healthy and performant. 
  • Collaborate with peers across customer, product, and engineering to deeply understand customer needs, make pragmatic tradeoffs that maximize impact, and align on engineering reality
  • Mentor engineers as a senior peer and force multiplier, sharing expertise across backend architecture and system design while helping shape stronger engineering judgment, more effective collaboration, and a higher-performing team

You're Our Person If...
 

Agentforce Operations & Missionforce Team

  • Proven Production Experience: Experience supporting mission-critical production systems and helping high-growth products navigate the technical debt and architectural changes required to scale reliably.
  • Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Coding Mastery: Ability to write and review production-level code in Golang, TypeScript, or Python—you view automation as a software engineering problem.
  • Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.
  • Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.
  • Mentorship Mindset: Enthusiasm for learning and growing as an engineer, and for helping your peers do the same.
  • AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.
  • Drive: Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment.  
  • Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with people from varied technical backgrounds.

Super Agent
 

  • 5+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and infrastructure.
  • Mastery of Golang, GraphQL, and PSQL, with demonstrated experience delivering high-performance optimizations. Experience with RDS, Redis/Elasticache, and EKS. 
  • Deep expertise in multiple areas of backend engineering such as data modeling, db performance tuning, state management, API design, transactionality, concurrency, memory management, fault tolerance, and scaling, with the ability to pick up new technologies quickly
  • Repeated ownership of foundational system work in complex distributed systems, from diagnosing architectural problems to designing solutions to driving adoption across a team. 
  • Excellent writing and speaking skills and ability to lead real-time technical-design discussions
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability, with a consistent track record of high standards, continuous improvement, and low-ego collaboration



Even Better If...
 

Agentforce Operations & Missionforce Team


  • Advanced Degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Compliance and Regulated Industries: Experience building products for regulated industries, particularly the public sector or environments with strong security, compliance, and data-sovereignty requirements.
  • Familiarity with developing for classified or limited-connectivity environments, including Department of Defense Impact Levels such as IL6.
  • Advanced knowledge of microservice orchestration and durability patterns, including hands-on experience with Temporal for workflow reliability and service mesh for secure, observable service-to-service communication in high-growth SaaS environments.
  • Deep knowledge of networking, security, and identity management within major cloud providers.
  • Experience building AI products for supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or operational workflows.

Super Agent

Modern warfare is a data problem. As a MuleSoft Account Executive for COCOMs, you will be at the center of the military’s most critical priority: Interoperability. Your mission is to help Combatant Commands break down data silos across disparate legacy systems, partner nation networks, and "at-the-edge" environments. You will position MuleSoft as the connective tissue for initiatives such as Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2), enabling a unified data layer that connects data at the edge.

Key Responsibilities

  • The "Integration First" Strategy: Position MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform and DataGraph as the standard for API-led connectivity across COCOM J-code directorates.
  • JADC2 & Mission Partner Environment (MPE): Drive adoption of secure data-sharing frameworks between the US and coalition partners to ensure seamless coordination during joint exercises and real-world operations.
  • Legacy Modernization: Help COCOMs move away from "brittle" point-to-point integrations and custom-coded middleware toward a scalable, governed API ecosystem.
  • Complex Stakeholder Management: Navigate the "Three-Legged Stool" of defense sales: the COCOM end-user, the Service Component, and the Systems Integrator (SI) executing the program.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Salesforce "Core" AEs to provide the integration layer that powers CRM, Tableau, and Slack mission sets.

  • COCOM Domain Deep-Dive: Direct experience navigating the mission requirements of commands like INDOPACOM, SOCOM, or EUCOM. You understand the challenges of the "Disconnected, Mid-range, and Low-bandwidth" (DDIL) environments.
  • SaaS & Hybrid Cloud Fluency: Proven success selling subscription-based software within the DOW. Knowledge of FedRAMP High, IL5, and IL6 security architectures is non-negotiable.

Salesforce is looking for a Mulesoft Mission Programs Account Executive to serve as the primary domain expert within DOW and the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Your mission is to bridge the gap between Mulesoft's industry-leading technology and the complex operational requirements of the Department of War (DOW).
You are not a traditional salesperson; you are a Mission Programs Partner. You will use your deep experience in the DOW and DIB operations—likely gained through military service, business development, or capture management—to help navigate the "mission-speak" of Defense Services, identify high-value operational gaps, and position Mulesoft as the engine to enable a unified layer that connects data at the edge within large mission programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mission Mapping: Translate complex operational needs (e.g., Joint All-Domain Command & Control (JADC2), Theater Posture, Logistics, Readiness) into Mulesoft and Informatica technical solutions.
  • Capture & Influence: Support the capture process by shaping requirements before the RFP is released. You will help "pre-wire" the mission value proposition with key stakeholders within the DIB. Also support post-award of a program to position Mulesoft and Informatica as key components to improve the defense program.
  • Executive Presence: Serve as a peer-level advisor to DOW and DIB leadership, demonstrating a deep understanding of the Services and Industry.
  • Programmatic Thought Leadership: Develop "Mission Plays"—repeatable frameworks for how Mulesoft and Informatica can solve specific DOW problems, from personnel readiness to real-time asset tracking in contested environments.
  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Work with System Integrators (SIs) and mission partners to ensure Salesforce is integrated into the broader digital battlefield architecture.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Salesforce "Core" AEs to provide the integration layer that powers CRM, Tableau, and Slack mission sets.
  • Complex Stakeholder Management: Navigate the "Three-Legged Stool" of defense sales: the DOW end-user, the Service Component, and the Systems Integrator (SI) executing the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep DOW Domain Expertise: Minimum of 5+ years of experience working within or directly supporting DOW. You understand the hierarchy, the funding flows (FYDP), and the operational "pain points."
  • MuleSoft/Middleware Domain Expertise: 5+ years of experience selling Integration (iPaaS), API Management, or Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) solutions. You must understand how to sell "the plumbing" as a strategic mission asset.
  • The "Translator" Ability: Proven ability to translate military operational requirements into digital transformation strategies.
  • Capture or BD Background: Experience in Federal Business Development or Capture Management, specifically winning large-scale programs within the DOW.
  • SaaS & Hybrid Cloud Fluency: Proven success selling subscription-based software within the DOW. Knowledge of FedRAMP High, IL5, and IL6 security architectures is non-negotiable.
  • Clearance: Active Secret clearance required; TS/SCI preferred.

Preferred Experience

  • Technical Credibility: Ability to engage in high-level architectural discussions about Microservices, Service Mesh, and Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Former Military Leadership: Retired O-5+ or Senior NCO with experience in DOW preferred.
  • Industry Advisory: Prior experience as an Industry Advisor or "Mission Lead" at a major systems integrator or cloud service provider.
  • Outcome-Oriented: A track record of closing $1M+ ACV deals by focusing on mission outcomes (e.g., "reducing data latency") rather than just technical features.
  • Network: An established network of contacts within the DOW and DIB.
This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience

カスタマーサクセスマネージャー（CSM）は、深いビジネス、業界、および製品の知識を活用して顧客とパートナーシップを結び、ビジネス価値を加速させ、Salesforceへの投資対効果を最大化できるよう導きます。この役割において、CSMは特定のクラウドの専門性や業界知見をもとに、社内リソースをオーケストレーションし、お客様と同じ目線で語り合い、顧客価値の実現を中長期的に図ります。

理想的なカスタマーサクセスマネージャーは、お客様の言葉で対話できるクラウドの専門知識と業界スキルの両方を備えた人物です。

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • 目標の理解と提案: 当社のカスタマーサクセス・メソドロジーを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して目標を理解し、彼らの能力を評価した上で、ビジネスおよびテクノロジーの目標達成を加速させるための提案を行う
  • Salesforceの啓蒙: お客様のSalesforce導入状況に対する理解と知識を深め、当社のすべてのクラウドにおけるSalesforceの機能をエバンジェライズ（啓蒙）する。
  • ベストプラクティスの提示: お客様のニーズに基づき、組織戦略、ガバナンス、およびチェンジマネジメント（変革管理）のベストプラクティスについて顧客を導く。
  • リスクの特定と軽減: お客様が掲げるビジネス目標の達成を阻害するリスクをプロアクティブに特定し、アカウントチームと連携してリスク軽減計画を策定する。
  • 実践的な製品知識の提供: プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。
  • テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。
  • 定着化計画の策定・実行: 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント（定着・活用化）計画を示す、包括的なアダプション（定着化）パスを作成し、実行する。
  • 価値とイノベーションの提供: お客様の主要なビジネス課題と成長の可能性を理解し、お客様のビジネスに価値とイノベーションを提供する。



You’re Our Person If...

  • カスタマーサクセス、テクノロジーコンサルティング、エンタープライズアーキテクチャ、またはテクノロジーソリューション開発、サポートエンジニアにおける3年以上の経験
  • 情熱 (PASSION): カスタマーサクセスに対して情熱を持っていること。
  • 信頼 (TRUST): 信頼を第一に行動していること。
  • 適応力 (ADAPTABLE): 不確実性が高く、変化の激しい環境において優れた成果を上げられること。



Even Better If...

  • 特定のクラウドにおける深い知識。
  • 顧客のビジネス価値を推進する「Trusted Advisor」として働いた実績と強力なコンサルティングスキル
  • Salesforce製品およびプラットフォームの機能、性能、ベストプラクティスに関する理解があることが望まれる。
  • 技術的およびビジネス上の概念を迅速に理解し、明確に説明できる能力。
  • 以下の経験・知識のうち、少なくとも1つを有すること：
  • ビジネスプロセス（営業、サービス、マーケティング、サポート）、ビジネスアプリケーション、および自動化に関する深い知識。
  • AIおよび機械学習の概念の理解、エージェントプラットフォームの理解、エージェントの構成および展開方法に関する深い知識。
  • エンタープライズレベルのソフトウェア開発ライフサイクルやプロジェクトマネジメント経験。（コーディングの経験は有用ですが、必須ではありません）
  • インテグレーション、フローや自動化、API接続などへの統合方法についての知識。
  • クラウドコンピューティングで使用される、ミドルウェア、インフラ知識（例：データベース、ネットワークの基礎知識など）に関する深い理解。
  • 流暢な日本語および基礎的な読み書きができる英語力。
  • 高度な英語力、韓国語力、中国語力（関連部門と業務遂行できるレベル）があると尚良い。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。



The Experience

A Customer Success Manager (CSM) partners with customers, drawing on deep business, industry, and product knowledge to accelerate business value and guide them to maximize their return on investment in Salesforce. In this role, CSMs use their cloud expertise and industry insight to orchestrate internal resources, speak with customers as true partners, and deliver customer value over the medium to long term.

The ideal Customer Success Manager brings both cloud expertise and industry skills, and can engage with customers in their own language.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Understand goals and make recommendations: Use our Customer Success methodology to work with customer stakeholders, understand their goals, assess their capabilities, and make recommendations that accelerate their business and technology goals
  • Evangelize Salesforce: Build understanding of the customer’s Salesforce adoption, and evangelize Salesforce capabilities across all of our clouds.
  • Present best practices: Guide customers on best practices in organizational strategy, governance, and change management based on their needs.
  • Identify and mitigate risks: Proactively identify risks that could prevent customers from achieving their business goals, and work with the account team to develop risk mitigation plans.
  • Provide hands-on product knowledge: Demonstrate practical knowledge of Salesforce products by applying platform capabilities and features to the customer’s business priorities and roadmap.
  • Drive Customer Enablement through technical insights: Translate technical information such as product updates, incidents, and end-of-life (EOL) into customer value, and work alongside IT and business teams to help them get the most out of the technology.
  • Create and execute adoption plans: Create and execute a comprehensive adoption path that sets out the current state, a target future state with timelines, and the underlying enablement plan.
  • Deliver value and innovation: Understand the customer’s key business challenges and growth potential, and deliver value and innovation to their business.



You’re Our Person If...

  • 3+ years of experience in customer success, technology consulting, enterprise architecture, technology solution development, or as a support engineer
  • PASSION: Passionate about customer success.
  • TRUST: Acts with trust as the first priority.
  • ADAPTABLE: Delivers excellent results in highly uncertain, fast-changing environments.



Even Better If...

  • Deep knowledge of a specific cloud.
  • Track record as a “Trusted Advisor” driving customer business value, with strong consulting skills
  • Understanding of Salesforce products and platform capabilities, performance, and best practices is desirable.
  • Ability to quickly grasp and clearly explain technical and business concepts.
  • Experience or knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Deep knowledge of business processes (sales, service, marketing, support), business applications, and automation.
  • Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and agent platforms, and deep knowledge of how to configure and deploy agents.
  • Enterprise-level software development lifecycle or project management experience. (Coding experience is useful but not required)
  • Knowledge of integration, flows and automation, and API connectivity.
  • Deep understanding of middleware and infrastructure used in cloud computing (e.g., databases, networking fundamentals).

title: Lead Software Engineer – Identity Platform Services
descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

The Experience

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for Trailblazer Identity (TBID), a tier-1 B2C identity platform supporting more than 10 million users and 30+ Salesforce digital experiences and partner properties.

This is a highly technical individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep hands-on engineering experience with strong architectural judgment, technical leadership, and the ability to influence across teams.

You will be part of the Platform Services team within Digital Marketing Technology and will provide technical leadership for the services that power Trailblazer Identity.

You will work across multiple engineering teams and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, and other technology organizations to design and evolve secure, scalable, highly available identity and platform services.

This role requires someone who can move comfortably between architecture and implementation: defining technical direction, evaluating trade-offs, solving complex engineering problems, mentoring engineers, and remaining close enough to the code to lead by example.

Success in this role requires more than designing strong systems. You will be expected to influence technical decisions across teams, navigate ambiguity and disagreement, drive alignment with stakeholders, and raise the engineering bar for the broader platform.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of large-scale, secure, and resilient backend platform services.
  • Provide technical leadership for services supporting Salesforce’s Trailblazer Identity platform and broader digital ecosystem.
  • Translate ambiguous product and business requirements into clear technical architectures and implementation strategies.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and clearly articulate trade-offs related to scale, reliability, security, performance, operability, and development velocity.
  • Remain hands-on with engineering and contribute directly to the design, implementation, review, and evolution of production systems.
  • Drive technical decisions and alignment across multiple engineering teams, architects, product partners, and dependent organizations.
  • Lead the design of APIs, distributed systems, data flows, and event-driven architectures supporting high-scale customer-facing experiences.
  • Establish and champion engineering best practices across system design, testing, observability, operational readiness, security, CI/CD, and software quality.
  • Identify technical risks early and drive pragmatic solutions across teams.
  • Mentor and coach engineers while helping improve technical decision-making and engineering effectiveness across the organization.
  • Use data, prototypes, and technical evidence to influence architectural decisions and resolve technical disagreement.
  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted engineering tools and practices that improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity.



You're Our Person If...

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience building and operating large-scale production systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex distributed systems or backend platforms.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering skills and the ability to remain technically close to implementation.
  • Strong architectural judgment, including the ability to evaluate alternatives, explain trade-offs, and make decisions across scalability, availability, reliability, security, performance, and operational complexity.
  • Experience influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team and driving alignment across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives from architecture through implementation, testing, production readiness, and ongoing operation.
  • Strong experience with microservices, API design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong experience with AWS and modern cloud architectures, including serverless and event-driven patterns.
  • Experience designing and operating highly available customer-facing services.
  • Strong understanding of application and web security principles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise engineering standards across a team.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity and software delivery.



We are looking for an experienced technical leader who has demonstrated the ability to operate at Lead Engineer level in complex, production-scale environments.

You should have:

Technical Experience

Strong experience in the following areas is important for success in this role:

  • TypeScript and JavaScript
  • Node.js and modern backend application development
  • AWS cloud services and serverless architectures
  • RESTful API design
  • Distributed systems and microservices
  • NoSQL and relational data stores
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems
  • Infrastructure as code
  • Automated testing and test-driven engineering practices
  • Observability, monitoring, and operational readiness
  • Web and application security



Experience with technologies such as API Gateway, Lambda, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, AppSync, Kafka, Kinesis, Terraform, Jest, and Playwright is highly relevant.

Identity & Security Experience

Experience building or operating consumer identity platforms is strongly valued.

Relevant experience may include:

  • B2C identity platforms such as Okta or Auth0
  • OAuth 2.0
  • OpenID Connect
  • JWT lifecycle management
  • Authentication and authorization patterns
  • Identity federation
  • Secure API design
  • CORS, CSP, XSS prevention, and related web security practices



Technical Leadership Expectations

At Lead Engineer level, we expect you to:

  • Independently drive architecture for complex systems rather than rely on others to define the technical direction.
  • Ask the right questions before designing a solution and establish clear functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Explain not only what you would build, but why — including alternatives considered and trade-offs made.
  • Lead technical discussions through ambiguity and disagreement.
  • Influence engineers and stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
  • Balance long-term architecture with pragmatic delivery.
  • Identify risks, challenge assumptions, and use technical evidence to drive decisions.
  • Take ownership for outcomes, not only implementation.
  • Improve the effectiveness of the engineers and teams around you.
  • Communicate technical ideas with clarity, structure, and appropriate depth.



Why Join the Team

You will have the opportunity to provide technical leadership for a critical Salesforce identity platform supporting more than 10 million users and 30+ digital experiences and partner properties, including experiences across the broader Trailblazer ecosystem.

You will work on complex challenges involving identity, distributed systems, scalability, reliability, security, and platform evolution while partnering across multiple engineering teams and organizations.

This is an opportunity to have significant technical influence on a highly visible platform while remaining a hands-on engineer.

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

About Scale Test: Today, customers facing high-stakes launches, multi-org transformations, or seasonal traffic spikes operate in the dark — hoping their systems scale rather than knowing they will. Scale Test changes that equation. Scale Test is Salesforce's native, comprehensive performance testing platform - the only solution that scans your production org to generate AI-powered test plan insights, then transforms your Full Copy Sandbox into a production-like environment for true scale validation.

Our mission: make any developer a performance engineer through a low-code, intuitive test automation experience.

The Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to led the Scale Test product. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of platform engineering, enterprise customer success, and AI-driven testing innovation.

You won't just manage a backlog — you'll be a strategic owner who deeply understands how our largest customers architect and test their Salesforce implementations, translates that into a compelling product roadmap, and drives Scale Test toward its next phase of growth across Agentforce, Partners, and GovCloud.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Customer & Market Engagement

  • Serve as the primary PM interface for enterprise customers running Scale Test, working closely with them through complex, time-sensitive testing windows to gather deep technical feedback
  • Partner with ISVs, SIs, and GovCloud customers to understand their unique testing requirements (e.g., data residency, compliance, FedRamp) and drive feature development accordingly
  • Translate complex enterprise customer scenarios — from Hyperforce migrations to Agentforce go-lives to peak load events — into clear, prioritized product specs and user stories



Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the prioritized roadmap for Scale Test — covering test plan creation, test scheduler, test execution, load generation, UI script recorder/builder, and AI-powered features (Scale Agent, AI Script Healing)
  • Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Scale Test across multiple engineering teams (managed load generation, analytics platform, DevOps integration)
  • Define and drive the Agentforce testing strategy — understanding how customers build and validate Agentforce implementations at scale and driving features to support their go-lives
  • Lead the Vibe Testing capabilities roadmap: enabling PMs, admins, and non-engineers to intuitively define, run, and interpret performance tests through natural language and AI-guided flows — reducing reliance on scripting expertise and democratizing scale testing across teams
  • Drive the Pilot-to-GA pipeline for cutting-edge capabilities including Scale Agent (AI assistant for test analysis), Load Generation, and AI Script Healing
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in performance testing, AI/Agentforce workload patterns, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise DevOps practices



Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work across Salesforce product teams (Agentforce, Data Cloud, Hyperforce, Platform) to ensure Scale Test integrates effectively and is positioned as a required step in every major go-live
  • Partner with Sales, AEs, CSMs, and Solution Architects on GTM strategies — including sales plays, competitive positioning, customer enablement, and new market expansion
  • Collaborate with the enablement team on Trailhead modules, internal FAQs, sales canvases, and persona-based selling guides



Execution & Delivery

  • Drive sprint planning, feature scoping, and launch readiness across engineering and research teams
  • Define success metrics and monitor product KPIs — including RPS thresholds tested, scale test days consumed, customer satisfaction, and renewal rates
  • Represent Scale Test at customer conversations, TDX/Dreamforce sessions, partner discussions, and internal executive reviews



You're Our Person If...

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4+ years in a B2B SaaS or platform product role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or technical field; MBA or Master's degree in Business, Product Management, or related field a plus
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex, technically deep products end-to-end — from discovery through launch and iteration
  • Strong technical fluency — ability to engage meaningfully with engineering on infrastructure, load generation, APIs, and system design without needing to code
  • Track record of working directly with enterprise customers to surface insights and drive product improvements — ideally in performance-critical or platform contexts
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills — equally comfortable in an engineering sprint review, a customer-facing demo, and an executive business review
  • Ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and make high-quality decisions with incomplete information
  • Prior experience with performance testing, load testing, or developer tooling products (e.g., LoadRunner, JMeter, or similar)
  • Agentic testing experience — you've built or managed products that test AI agents, agentic workflows, or autonomous systems; you understand how to validate quality, reliability, and performance for non-deterministic AI systems
  • Deep technical fluency across performance testing, load generation, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and SaaS architecture — able to engage deeply with engineering teams and communicate clearly to executive audiences
  • Experience with testing/observability/monitoring products — you've built or managed products in the DevOps toolchain (load testing, APM, observability, CI/CD, test automation)



Even Better If...

  • Hands-on exposure to Agentforce, Hyperforce, Salesforce Platform, or adjacent Salesforce products
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform — multi-tenant SaaS architecture, sandboxes (Full Copy, Partial Copy, Developer), Hyperforce, governor limits, metadata model, Apex/LWC performance
  • Experience with Salesforce developer tooling or platform products — DevOps Center, Code Analyzer, Optimizer, CLI, VS Code extensions, or similar DX products
  • Understanding of Agentforce testing needs — what metrics matter (prompt latency, action execution time, LLM error rates, agent success rate, reasoning quality), how to measure quality at scale
  • Experience working with Partners (ISVs / SIs) and managing partner-driven product requirements
  • Familiarity with GovCloud / public sector requirements including FedRamp or equivalent data residency standards
  • Passion for democratizing developer tooling — making complex workflows accessible to non-engineers through low-code and AI-guided experiences (Vibe Testing)
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience driving Pilot-to-GA product launches with strong customer feedback loops

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the world's #1 AI CRM, helping companies of every size and industry connect with their customers in a whole new way. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, Salesforce is a Fortune 500 company with over 70,000 employees worldwide, serving more than 150,000 customers globally.

Our platform — spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Analytics, and more — is trusted by companies from startups to Fortune 500s to build stronger customer relationships, drive growth, and create meaningful impact. At Salesforce, we believe business is the greatest platform for change, and our values — Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, Equality, and Sustainability — guide everything we do.

We're growing our Creative & Brand organization in Mexico City, and we're looking for bold, systems-driven design leaders to shape how Salesforce looks, moves, and communicates at scale.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Motion Design to lead the origination of foundational motion identity systems for Salesforce's global brand. This is not a production or execution role — this is a strategic, systems-level design leadership position based in Mexico City.

In this role, you will be responsible for architecting repeatable "motion DNA" and scalable toolkits that creative teams across the globe can adopt, adapt, and build upon. You will also pioneer Agentic Creativity at Salesforce, leveraging a cutting-edge AI stack to scale these systems 30% faster while preserving the human brand craft that defines our visual identity.

What You'll Do

Strategic Motion System Design

  • Originate and architect foundational motion identity systems that serve as the repeatable "motion DNA" for Salesforce's global brand

  • Develop systemic motion toolkits, templates, and frameworks that enable global creative teams to self-serve with consistency

  • Define and govern motion standards, ensuring 100% brand compliance across all system outputs

  • Shift the team's creative output so that 40% is dedicated purely to systemic origination — moving away from one-off execution toward scalable, reusable infrastructure


Agentic Creativity & AI-Powered Workflows

  • Pioneer the use of an advanced AI stack to accelerate motion design workflows at enterprise scale

  • Bridge traditional motion tools (e.g., After Effects) with modern generative AI and agentic workflows

  • Drive a 30% increase in system production speed without sacrificing brand integrity or human craft

  • Evaluate and implement emerging AI-powered motion technologies as the creative landscape evolves

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present and defend original motion systems to executive audiences, targeting a 70% immediate executive approval rate on first presentation

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand, Marketing, and Creative leadership to align motion systems with broader brand strategy

  • Communicate design decisions with clarity, persuasion, and executive-level fluency in English

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and inspire a team of motion designers, establishing a culture of systemic thinking and creative innovation

  • Mentor designers in both traditional craft and AI-augmented workflows

  • Set quality standards and KPI frameworks to measure the systemic impact of the team's output

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of world-class motion design experience, with a demonstrated portfolio of systems-level, brand-defining work

  • Proven track record of originating motion identity systems — not just executing videos or adapting existing assets

  • Deep expertise in After Effects and the broader Adobe Creative Suite

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools applied to motion and video workflows

  • Executive-level English communication skills (written and verbal) — mandatory

  • Demonstrated ability to present design strategy and systems to senior and C-level stakeholders

  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

  • Advanced Stack & AI Generative Mastery: full command of the contemporary AI creative stack, including tools like Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Luma Agents, and Runway Gen-4.5. 

  • Ability to build custom, AI-native generative workflows that prioritize brand soul over generic output, successfully bridging traditional motion tools like After Effects (used for final quality checks) with modern production models. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading motion design at a global technology or enterprise software company

  • Background in brand systems design (not just campaign or video production contexts)

  • Knowledge of prompt engineering for AI-assisted visual and motion content generation

  • Experience building and scaling creative toolkits for geographically distributed teams

How Success Is Measured

This role is KPI-driven. Performance will be evaluated against the following metrics:

  • Executive approval rate on original motion systems: 70% on first presentation

  • Brand compliance rate across all system outputs: 100%

  • Team output dedicated to systemic origination: 40% of total output

  • Production speed improvement via AI stack: 30% faster vs. baseline

Why Salesforce

Joining Salesforce means joining a company that puts its values into action every day.

As a Senior Manager, Motion Design in Mexico City, you will:

  • Define how one of the world's most recognized enterprise brands moves and feels globally

  • Work at the frontier of AI-augmented creative workflows, alongside world-class designers and technologists

  • Build systems that scale your craft across markets, teams, and platforms

  • Be part of a company consistently recognized as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies and a Best Place to Work

  • Grow your career within a global organization committed to equality, innovation, and sustainability

  • Access competitive compensation, benefits, equity, and professional development resources.

Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. The Experience

Sales Cloud AI is revolutionizing how organizations strategize, execute, and refine their lead outreach and pipeline management. We are looking for engineers to develop the Sales Intelligence Platform (SIP) within Sales Cloud. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and operation of a high-scale, low-latency platform that manages real-time ingestion and streaming pipelines.

The Sales Intelligence Platform (SIP) processes conversational data from voice, video, and email to power various Sales Cloud AI agents. These agents provide tools for lead outreach and pipeline management, significantly boosting sales productivity. By generating intelligent insights from conversational data, the platform empowers sellers to enhance their overall efficiency.

You're Our Person If...


  • Over 7+ years of practical experience architecting, implementing, and managing durable distributed systems at scale for major enterprise cloud providers.
  • Proven track record in constructing high-availability, large-scale distributed architectures for client-facing environments.
  • Hands-on experience with building big data high availability pipelines with Flink
  • Demonstrated experience acting as a CI/CD champion, with a proven ability to uplift and mentor teams in best practices and automation.
  • Extensive knowledge of contemporary public cloud frameworks (including AWS, GCP, or Azure) and high-performance backend infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming with mastery in at least one language such as Java, Go, Python, C++, or Ruby.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation, cloud provisioning, and AI-assisted development methodologies.
  • Strong interpersonal and professional communication skills, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration and leadership.
  • Commitment to technical excellence through meticulous attention to detail and proactive mentorship of junior engineers.



Even Better If...

  • Proven ability to develop low-latency, large-scale data ingestion pipelines
  • Background in creating enterprise-grade, AI-driven sales solutions
  • History of architecting distributed real-time streaming systems
  • Expertise with message queuing technologies like Kafka
