The Experience

Salesforce では、Account Executiveとしてチームに加わる優秀な人材を求めています。収益の増加を促進し、顧客との永続的な関係を育む上で、あなたの役割は極めて重要です。顧客エクスペリエンスに革命をもたらすという当社の取り組みは、当社のすべての活動の中心です。当社の主力イノベーションである Salesforce Data Cloud は、リアルタイム データの力を利用して Customer 360 を構築し、顧客との真にパーソナライズされたコミュニケーションによるロイヤリティを高めるエンゲージメントをあらゆる顧客接点で実現することを可能にします。

Specialist AEとは？
Salesforceの代表的な営業ポジションであるAccount Executiveは、アカウント攻略という視点で数字を最大化させるための営業スキルを学べる一方、製品のSpecialist AEでは担当するセグメントのビジネスをどうしたら成長させられるかという視点が求められるため、目の前の商談をCloseするための営業スキルを磨くことはもちろん、Generalistとしての視点でビジネスを進めていく経験ができます。Salesforceという大きな会社の中でこのような経験ができることは、これまでの営業職とは違った形で皆さんのキャリアアップに大きく貢献できるポジションとなっています。

Data Cloud AEの魅力とは？
Data Cloudはプロダクトライフサイクルにおいては今がまさに導入期のため、1つの製品で市場の導入期の立ち上げフェーズから、成長期、成熟期に向けて一貫した経験ができるという点では非常に魅力的なポジションになっております。また、成功の型が決まってないからこそ、ご自身のアイデアやプランを形にもしやすいという点でも魅力的かと思います。会社としての注目度も高く製品開発やMarketingへの投資も積極的に行われているため、もちろん責任重大なポジションではありますが、ここでの成功はみなさんのキャリア史にとって代えがたい経験となるはずです。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Data Cloudの商談支援（シーンによっては商談自体をリードすることもあります）
  • AE向けEnablementの企画および実行
  • PipeGen、Progression目的のイベント企画および実行
  • SWTTやプライベートセミナーでの登壇
  • セリングに必要な事例やナレッジ、コンテンツなどのAsset作成および整備
  • 担当セグメントのACV、Pipeline、PipeGenなどの数字把握および分析、課題解決のためのプランニングおよび実行
  • 担当セグメントの3rd Line、2nd Line、1st Lineとのコミュニケーションおよび方針策定

Specialist AEも営業職であるためメインミッションはACVの獲得になりますが、担当セグメントの成長も同時に担っている点では商談対応以外にも様々な業務に関わっていくことになります。以下ではSpecialist AEの代表的な業務について紹介します。

CRMをより良くするための外部データ活用、また、AIに良質なアウトプットをさせるためのデータ活用というニーズは今後ますます増加することが予想されますが、導入期における現在のフェーズでは担当セグメントのあらゆるリソース (人・モノ・カネ・情報) をフル活用し、イノベーター、アーリーアダプターの開拓、リファレンスカスタマーの開拓などを能動的にアクションしていく必要があります。したがって本ポジションにおける求める人物像は以下となります。


You're Our Person If...

  • B2B/B2C向けのSaaSやクラウド領域における営業経験があること
  • お客様にとってNice to Haveな製品を販売するために必要なプロセスを理解し説明できること（カタログセリングではなくソリューションセリングのプロセスを理解し説明できること）
  • 分解思考で問題や課題に取り組み優先順位をつけて行動できること
  • 目的達成のためにスタンスや行動を柔軟に変化していけること
  • 担当セグメントのOwnerとして中長期のGrowth視点でリーダーシップを発揮できること


Even Better If...

  • CDP、DWH、Data Lakeの販売経験
  • プロダクトライフサイクルの導入期〜成熟期までを一貫して経験したことがある


The Experience

At Salesforce, we are looking for outstanding people to join our team as an Account Executive. Your role is critical to driving revenue growth and building lasting customer relationships. Our commitment to revolutionizing the customer experience is at the heart of everything we do. Our flagship innovation, Salesforce Data Cloud, harnesses the power of real-time data to build Customer 360 and enables loyalty-building engagement through truly personalized communication with customers at every touchpoint.

What is a Specialist AE?
The Account Executive, Salesforce's flagship sales position, lets you learn sales skills to maximize results from an account-conquest perspective. A product Specialist AE, on the other hand, is expected to think about how to grow the business of the segment they cover. You will not only sharpen the sales skills needed to close the deals in front of you, but also gain experience driving the business with a Generalist's perspective. Gaining this kind of experience within a large company like Salesforce makes this a position that can contribute greatly to your career advancement in a way that differs from previous sales roles.

What makes the Data Cloud AE role attractive?
Data Cloud is right now in the introduction stage of its product lifecycle, so this is a very attractive position in that, with a single product, you can gain consistent experience from the market's introduction and launch phase through the growth and maturity phases. Also, because the formula for success has not yet been set, it is easier to turn your own ideas and plans into reality. The company's attention on it is high, and investment in product development and Marketing is active. It is of course a position with significant responsibility, but success here should become an irreplaceable experience in your career history.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support Data Cloud deals (in some situations, you may lead the deal itself)
  • Plan and execute Enablement for AEs
  • Plan and execute events aimed at PipeGen and Progression
  • Speak at SWTT and private seminars
  • Create and maintain Assets such as case studies, knowledge, and content needed for selling
  • Understand and analyze numbers such as ACV, Pipeline, and PipeGen for your segment, and plan and execute to solve issues
  • Communicate and set direction with the 3rd Line, 2nd Line, and 1st Line of your segment

As a Specialist AE is also a sales role, the main mission is to win ACV, but because you are also responsible for the growth of your segment, you will be involved in a variety of tasks beyond handling deals. Below, we introduce the representative tasks of a Specialist AE.

The need to use external data to improve CRM, and to use data so that AI produces high-quality output, is expected to keep growing. In the current introduction stage, however, you need to make full use of every resource of your segment (people, goods, money, information) and proactively take action, such as developing innovators and early adopters and developing reference customers. The ideal candidate profile for this position is therefore as follows.

You're Our Person If...

  • Sales experience in the SaaS or cloud space for B2B/B2C
  • Ability to understand and explain the process needed to sell products that are nice-to-have for customers (understanding and explaining the solution-selling process, not catalog selling)
  • Ability to tackle problems and issues with decomposition thinking and act with prioritization
  • Ability to flexibly change stance and actions to achieve objectives
  • Ability to demonstrate leadership from a mid- to long-term growth perspective as the Owner of your segment


Even Better If...

  • Experience selling CDP, DWH, and Data Lake
  • Experience with the entire product lifecycle from introduction through maturity

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. As a Slack Proactive Monitoring (ProM) Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of platform engineering, site reliability, and strategic customer success. You are a highly technical, customer-centric specialist dedicated to safeguarding the health and performance of Slack’s largest and most complex global enterprise deployments (Enterprise Grid).

Rather than waiting for customers to report problems, you will continuously monitor Slack workspace metrics, performance thresholds, API integrations, enterprise security events, and custom app behavior. You will proactively detect anomalies, triage system exceptions, and orchestrate rapid mitigation steps—frequently initiating preemptive customer outreach before their internal users even experience a slowdown.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Continuously monitor dashboards, alerting systems, and telemetry data (error rates, latency spikes, API failures, deployment anomalies) for early signals of degradation.
  • Triage and correlate alerts from multiple sources (Splunk, internal tools, etc) to identify patterns before customers report issues.
  • Actively monitor Slack platform health dashboards, network latency signals, message delivery queues, and database capacities for high-frequency workspaces.
  • Monitor critical custom automations, Slack Workflow Builder runs, Enterprise Key Management (EKM) operations, and Identity Provider (IDP) authentication syncs.
  • Identify customers potentially affected by degraded service conditions and coordinate proactive outreach with Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Partner with the Incident Management team to escalate signals that meet incident-threshold criteria.
  • Technical Advisory: Partner with Customer Success Managers and Success Architects to deliver annual technical health check reviews, assessing platform metrics, configuration limits, and custom integration health.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on proactively detected issues, documenting findings in internal case and incident management systems.
  • Work closely with Engineering and SRE teams to drive rapid remediation of identified issues
  • Intervene in low-risk system exceptions (e.g., advising clients on misconfigured Slack Webhooks, API rate limit exhaustion, or broken Salesforce-Slack app connections) before they trigger widespread downtime.
  • Build and maintain Slack-based automations and workflows to streamline proactive monitoring operations.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, site reliability engineering, or a related operations role.
  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, PagerDuty, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS architecture, APIs, and common failure modes.
  • Proficiency in reading and analyzing logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to clearly convey technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to optimize workflows, conduct research, and enhance daily productivity.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience working with Slack platform (Slack API, Slack workflows, Bolt framework).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud / OrgCS case management.
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, JavaScript, Bash).
  • Experience in a customer-facing support engineering or reliability role at a SaaS company.

We know that relocation is a big decision, which is why we walk with you every step of the way. From the moment you accept your offer to the day you arrive in Dublin, you'll have access to a full support system.

How it works:

Join Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, as an Account Executive focusing on the Central market. Based in our Dublin hub, you will lead the "agentic era" of technology, helping Central businesses transform through AI, Data, and CRM.

Key Requirements:

  • Language: Full professional fluency in German and English is mandatory.
  • Location: This is an office-based role based in Dublin, Ireland (relocation assistance included).

As an Account Executive for the Central team, you own the end-to-end sales cycle. You aren't just selling software, you are selling the Salesforce platform, including AI-powered innovation across the Customer 360. You will balance "whitespace" prospecting (new business) with strategic expansion within existing accounts.

  • Strategic Growth: Drive performance against key metrics with a primary focus on new business acquisition and expansion.
  • Solution Selling: Use a consultative approach to identify business challenges and align Salesforce AI and Data solutions to customer goals.
  • Relationship Building: Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers through regular digital engagement and face-to-face meetings, independently identifying decision-makers and influencers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Business Development, Pre-sales, and Marketing to optimize the sales funnel, as well as other teams to structure and close deals, bringing in SEs and cross-functional resources as needed.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and a commitment to working collaboratively to drive team results.
  • Proficiency in using CRM and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) platforms, as well as AI-powered tools, to support quote analysis and workflow efficiency.

Technical depth required. Architectural judgment expected.

Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you'll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

 

The Senior Builder Experience

  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the  highest engineering  standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly. 
  • AI-Supported  Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your  daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.

  • You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, embedded with customer engineers.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, System Architect)
  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks

title: Resource Management Senior Analyst
descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Operations

Job Details

About Salesforce

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

CSGとは、顧客を成功に導くことを最重要ミッションとするカスタマーサクセスグループのことです。事業戦略の観点からは、Salesforceのポストセールス部門にあたり、顧客マネジメント部門やコンサルティング部門、サポート部門やリニューアル部門で構成されています。

このロールの候補者は、CSGのプロフェッショナルサービス部門(コンサルティング部門)のリーダーに対し、リソース管理の観点から戦略的示唆を提示し、定常的な部門運営を推進する「サービス・オペレーションチーム」のシニアアナリストです。リソース管理(国内外のコンサルタントおよび社外パートナ)を通じてビジネスの成長に貢献します。

CSGサービス部門のリーダーにとって信頼に足るアドバイザーとして、ビジネス戦略のビジョンを共有し、顧客の成功や組織の成長に向けた革新的なアプローチを特定します。また、コンサルタントがもたらす成果について、客観的かつデータに基づいた洞察を提示することが求められます。

このロールの成功は、CSGサービス部門のBooking(受注額)、売上、利益率および顧客満足度等によって測られます。戦略的なアウトプットとしては、サービス部門の要員構成を踏まえた戦略的な成長プランの策定や社外パートナーとの協業計画策定、部門パフォーマンスの財務・事業両面での測定や傾向分析、示唆の提示などがあります。

業務上は、サービス部門のコンサルティング・マネージャーと営業担当者の間に立って、案件への最適な人員配置の実現やパートナー選定、海外リソースの調達などを論理的、効率的、かつ強力に推進することが求められます。

候補者は、部門内だけではなくグローバルCSG組織、財務や採用、人事、部門戦略担当者と密接に協業することが求められます。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 中長期戦略の立案・推進：CSGサービス部門の状況を分析し、リソース（要員・スキル）の観点から部門の成長につながる戦略やイニシアチブを積極的に立案・推進する
  • リソース供給能力の最大化：サービス提供能力（デリバリーキャパシティ）を最大化するため、社内コンサルタントの稼働率管理や、海外協業推進、パートナー拡大を行う
  • アサインメントの最適化：リソース調整会議をリードし、コンサルティング・マネージャーや営業担当者と連携しながら、プロジェクトへの最適な人員配置、パートナー選定、海外リソースの調達を推進する
  • グローバル・他部門との連携：日本のCSG全体の方向性や戦略との整合性を図るため、グローバル組織や財務、人事、IT等の各部門と協業し、部門運営プロセス（オペレーション）の継続的な改善を行う
  • メトリクスの定義と可視化：高いレベルのビジネス目標（KPI）に対し、進捗を測定するためのメトリクスを定義し、レポートやダッシュボード（Salesforce等）を用いて可視化・計測する
  • データ駆動型の意思決定支援：ビジネスの進捗やKPIを定期的に分析・報告し、データと客観的な分析に基づいてマネジメント層の迅速な意思決定をサポートする



You're Our Person If...

  • 3〜5年の事業部門運営（Business Operations）、リソースマネジメント、またはそれに準ずる部門管理・オペレーション経験
  • コンサルティングファームやITサービス企業などの「プロフェッショナルサービス・ビジネス」における実務経験、または密接な協業経験
  • プロジェクトマネージャー、営業、財務など、多様なステークホルダーとの高度な交渉・調整能力（コンフリクトマネジメント能力）
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力（グローバルチームとの会議、メール、チャットでの円滑な意思決定・交渉が可能であること）および流暢な日本語力
  • 変化の速い環境（アジャイルな環境）や新しい要求に対して、柔軟かつ適切に対応できる能力
  • 異文化に対する理解、および多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーと協業できるダイバーシティへの高い意識



Even Better If...

  • Salesforce製品の知識・利用経験、または認定資格
  • IT project への参画経験
  • BIツールやダッシュボード（Tableau、Salesforce Reports等）を用いたデータ分析・可視化の実務経験

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

  • ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。

In addition The Director — Tableau Next is an execution-focused technical leader responsible for designing and delivering migrations from legacy Business Intelligence and reporting platforms (Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, legacy Tableau Server) to Tableau Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Tableau Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will be owning the analytics platform architecture, legacy BI content migration strategy, data source re-architecture, governance model design and Tableau Next feature adoption roadmap.


You will combine deep Tableau expertise with strong data engineering and cloud data platform knowledge to ensure that dashboards, data sources, calculated fields, permissions and governance structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance and accelerated time-to-insight for the client's business users. This role is of  people leader and 50% billable role, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s  Cloud.


Responsibilities:


  • Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
  • Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Analytics migration projects, contributing hands-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
  • Serve as the Technical Lead for Tableau Next migration workstreams, architecting the end-to-end transition from legacy BI platforms to Tableau Next — including dashboard migration, data source re-architecture, semantic layer design and governance model.
  • Design the legacy BI content migration strategy — inventorying, assessing and prioritising all legacy reports, dashboards, datasets and calculated fields for migration, retirement or rebuild in Tableau Next.
  • Architect the Tableau Next data source framework — designing live connections, published data sources, virtual connections, data policies and extract schedules optimised for performance and governance.
  • Design the Tableau Next site and governance model — including project hierarchy, permission groups, content certification workflow, data quality warnings and usage analytics configuration.
  • Own the cloud data platform integration architecture — designing connections between Tableau Next and Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse and Salesforce Data Cloud as analytical data sources.
  • Lead the semantic layer and data model migration — translating legacy BI semantic models, universe layers (Business Objects) and subject areas (Cognos) into Tableau Next published data source designs and calculations.
  • Define end-to-end data lineage for all analytics objects — mapping source data fields through transformation layers to Tableau Next calculated fields, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved or improved.
  • Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client business intelligence, data engineering and business analytics teams to assess legacy report complexity, data source dependencies and user adoption patterns.
  • Manage the functional depth of Source vs. Target systems — maintaining deep understanding of how legacy BI platform features (Cognos report types, Business Objects universes, Power BI DAX measures) translate to Tableau Next capabilities.
  • Serve as a Trusted Advisor to the client, driving conversations with CDOs, Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, data governance strategy and self-service analytics vision.
  • Establish best-in-class standards for the Tableau Next migration practice — building reusable dashboard migration templates, data source connection templates, naming convention standards and governance configuration playbooks as factory accelerators.
  • Lead performance optimisation — profiling legacy dashboard performance baselines, designing Tableau Next data extracts and published data sources to meet or exceed baseline performance, and establishing performance monitoring.
  • Lead cutover planning and execution — including legacy BI platform deprecation scheduling, user access migration, Tableau Next URL/bookmark migration for key dashboards and post-go-live self-service training.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks proactively — data source credential migration, calculated field logic parity gaps, row-level security re-implementation, extract refresh SLA continuity and legacy report complexity underestimation.
  • Contribute to the Migration Factory by building reusable Tableau Next migration playbooks, dashboard assessment tools, data source templates and performance benchmarking scripts to reduce wave delivery time.

Experience Requirements:


  • 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling as individual contributors.
  • 8+ years of people management experience
  • Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
  • Demonstrated experience migrating large BI content estates (500+ reports/dashboards) from legacy platforms to Tableau.

Salesforce & Platform Certifications:


  • Tableau Certified Architect (Preferred)
  • Tableau Certified Data Analyst (Required)
  • Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant (Required)
  • Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant (Preferred)
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced (Preferred)
  • Databricks Certified Associate Developer (Preferred)
  • dbt Analytics Engineering Certification (Preferred)

Cross Cutting Qualifications:


  • Proven expertise in executing complex data migrations — multiple end-to-end migration projects from legacy systems to Salesforce or vice versa.
  • Integration Architecture (Must Have): Understanding of how data flows between systems and the mechanisms for high-volume data transport.
  • Data Architecture & Management (Must Have): Expertise in ERD design, data cleansing, managing high volumes of data and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies.
  • Platform Security (Must Have): Knowledge of data encryption, field-level security, Shield and compliance-aligned data movement during migration windows.
  • Identity & Access Management (Must Have): Understanding of user migration, permission set mapping, SSO and visibility model design.
  • Sharing & Visibility (Must Have): How migrated data will be secured and accessed post-deployment.
  • Platform Development (Must Have): Proficiency in Apex, Async Design, Governor limit, LWC components and Salesforce Flows.
  • Excellent communication skills — ability to articulate complex migration strategies to both technical teams and C-suite business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a factory delivery model — reusing and contributing to shared accelerators, playbooks and templates across concurrent wave teams.
  • Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
  • Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
  • Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue

Role Description:
The Salesforce Critical Customer Response (CCR) team seeks a Senior Analyst with excellent communication, organizational, and creative problem-solving skills to contribute to our incident management program.
This role is primarily focused on effectively communicating with Salesforce customers, customer-facing organizations, and executives during critical technical incidents, ensuring that the information shared is timely, accurate, and meaningful. You will serve as a primary member of the CCR team, collaborating on a variety of communications outputs for unplanned service disruptions, performance degradations, security incidents, and other urgent customer-impacting events as needed. The role requires critical thinking and handling ambiguity in fast-paced, ever-changing incident response situations.


This responsibility includes collaborating and partnering with the entire Salesforce organization to drive action and foster growth. As a member of the Global Critical Incident Center, the CCR team member is both technically competent and business-oriented.


As the Critical Incident Center is a 24/7 operation, the CCR Senior Analyst may occasionally be required to provide additional coverage a few times a year under special circumstances.


This role is for communicators with a passion for customer advocacy and helping customers achieve success and business growth while maintaining Salesforce’s key values of trust and transparency.

Team Vision:

Trust is built through clear, concise, and timely communication. Our customers and internal stakeholders rely on the information they need to make decisions and respond to change, and we provide it. We are a technology and business communications program that builds and maintains high-trusted relationships in times of expected change and rebuilds that trust in times of challenges.
Our efforts, impact, and achievements in these spaces are how we build and deliver the “voice of Salesforce” across the Salesforce product catalogue and achieve visibility.


We build and cultivate a team-first approach that focuses on equality and trust within our group, where every individual has a voice and contributions are recognized. We help our team grow through feedback and focus on creating a high-performance culture.

Responsibilities:

  • Take complex technical issues and concepts during critical incidents and translate them into “business-speak” quickly and efficiently.

  • Consolidate information from different sources (engineering and support) and write appropriate updates for different audiences, including customers (external Trust site), executives (internal summaries), and customer-facing (internal with greater detail,) ensuring stakeholders are kept informed during incidents and always have the most up-to-date information.

  • Develop trusted partnerships and collaborate throughout the Salesforce enterprise to build good working relationships across all functions and alignment across the business.

  • Help build strategies and action plans that enable customers for success

  • Develop close partnerships and collaborate across the enterprise to build good working relationships across all functions and alignment across the business

  • Ensure Incident Response readiness through training sessions, periodic incident response simulations, tests, and drills

  • Be part of an occasional on-call rotation for crisis communications to develop customer-facing materials to address unplanned incidents and events that impact customers’ ability to use the Salesforce service


Minimum Requirements:

  • 4-8 years of experience in areas of incident management, crisis communications, or technical writing

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Understanding and experience in cloud infrastructure and platforms, such as AWS and GCP

  • Ability to learn and deeply understand technical information and concepts, especially as it relates to database architecture, security, networks, and customer relationship management principles

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, in sometimes high-pressure or stressful situations, while successfully handling multiple priorities

  • Ability to synthesize technical and non-technical details from different teams and determine which information is most relevant for different audiences

  • Experience working with customers, executives, and customer-facing teams, with the ability to lead without direct authority

  • Excruciating attention to detail, a commitment to quality, and dogged perseverance to meet deadlines

  • Collaborative team player who doesn't just say ‘no, we can't do this’, but approaches challenges in a way to meets the needs of others

  • Accommodation of an on-call schedule for technology crisis communications, where some weekend and holiday on-call work can be required


Preferred Requirements:

  • Prior experience in a 24/7/365 operations environment is a benefit

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and technical delivery lead supporting multiple customers - meaning you must be equally comfortable defining high-level strategic data roadmaps for executives and executing tactical hands-on development in the code.


The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of deep technical fluency within the Informatica IDMC platform, migrating legacy systems to the cloud, and a passion for embedding robust data governance into the core of enterprise data estates.

Key Responsibilities & Technical Requirements

  • Lead the end-to-end design, data modeling, and deployment of robust, enterprise-wide Master Data Management (MDM) architectures spanning multiple core business domains (e.g., Customer, Product, Supplier).
  • Demonstrate extensive hands-on expertise with the Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) platform, explicitly leveraging Cloud Data Integration (CDI) and Cloud Application Integration (CAI).
  • Architect and configure Informatica MDM SaaS products, including Customer 360 (C360), Reference 360 (R360), and related cloud-native multidomain MDM solutions.
  • Successfully operate at both the strategic level (defining roadmaps, target architectures) and the tactical level (hands-on development, configuration, and deep-dive troubleshooting).
  • Lead complex legacy-to-cloud modernization initiatives, transitioning older, on-premises Informatica MDM Hub architectures into cloud-native IDMC environments.
  • Infuse data governance frameworks, metadata catalogs, data lineage, and data quality standards natively into the MDM lifecycle using Cloud Data Quality (CDQ) and governance tools.
  • Effectively manage and support multiple customers simultaneously, aligning their unique business requirements with scalable, high-performing technical strategies.
  • Architect real-time API integrations, event-driven streaming, and batch ETL pipelines connecting MDM with modern cloud data platforms and SaaS applications.
  • Design and fine-tune complex match/merge rules, survivorship matrices, hierarchy management configurations, and multi-source ingestion frameworks.
  • • Design intuitive data stewardship interfaces, custom task workflows (e.g., CAI, ActiveVOS), and business validation rules to maximize operational efficiency for data stewards.
  • Articulate complex technical designs, trade-offs, and strategic visions with clarity, reasoned judgment, and relevance to both engineering teams and business executive sponsors.
  • Actively leverage modern AI tools and generative AI features to accelerate development workflows, optimize code/configurations, and streamline technical documentation processes.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of strong, hands-on technical experience dedicated to Informatica MDM and data integration products (with 15+ years of overall IT/Data Architecture experience highly preferred to match senior market demands).
  • Successful delivery of multiple full-lifecycle enterprise MDM implementations from discovery and blueprinting through to production go-live.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.


Note: This is an exceptionally hands-on technical architecture role. If you are a purely high-level strategist or administrative manager who no longer configures platforms or builds components, this position will not be a proper fit.

The Experience

私たちはSalesforce Strategyを担うStrategy & Programsの一員として、主にCustomer Success Group(CSG)のゴール実現に責任を持つチームです。GlobalおよびSales Strategyとの連携を通じて会社のGo-To-Market(GTM)戦略をCSGの施策に落とし込み、顧客維持・成長の実現に向けてCustomer Success Businessを牽引するリーダー陣の意思決定をデータと戦略的思考で支えます。Sales Strategy、Finance、Operations、Enablementなど多様な部門との連携を主導しながら、戦略をビジネスの現場で実現することに情熱を持つ方を歓迎します。

CSG Business Partnerは、担当チームのリーダー陣に最も近い存在として機能するStrategic Advisorです。データの提供やレポーティングが主な役割ではなく、リーダーと共に戦略を策定し、Customer Success実現に向けたお客様のSalesforce活用促進・製品利用量(Consumption)の拡大・解約リスクの最小化という重要なGoal達成に向けた方向性と優先課題を定めます。CSG Data & Insights Analystチームと緊密に連携し、何のためのデータか・どんなInsightが必要かをビジネスの観点から定義した上で、すべての戦略的議論にデータを組み込み、より確かな意思決定を実現します。

CSGにおいて、既存のお客様がSalesforceの各製品を最大限に活用し、継続的なビジネス価値を実現できるよう支援することをミッションとするチームです。お客様のオンボーディング支援から継続的な活用支援・リスク対応まで、製品ライフサイクル全体を通じてプロアクティブに関与します。CS Operationsは、CSG全体のデリバリー活動を支えるオペレーション組織です。Product Successなど顧客対応の最前線に立つチームが最大限のパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう、オペレーション設計・プロセス改善・Operation上のデータ分析・戦略的投資プログラムの運営など、ビジネスを支える多様な機能を担います。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic Advisory: 担当チームのリーダーとStrategyおよび目標設定を共にリードする。Salesforce活用促進・製品利用量(Consumption)の拡大・解約リスクの最小化という重要なGoal達成に向けた方向性を定め、何のためのデータか・どんなInsightが必要かをビジネスの観点から定義した上で、現場の実態とデータに基づいた提言を行い、リーダーを意思決定・実行へと導く
  • Decision Support: CSG Data & Insights Analystチームと連携し、担当チームのリーダー陣のより確かな意思決定を支えるInsightを提供する。リーダーとの日常的な会話から生まれた検討事項をデータ分析につなげ、意思決定の場でInsightを活かす
  • Performance & Improvement: KPIの定義・優先順位付け基準の設定・フィードバックループの確立を通じて、成果の測定と継続的改善を推進する。Salesforce活用促進・製品利用量(Consumption)の拡大・解約リスクの最小化に向けた進捗をリーダーと共に管理し、必要に応じて方針修正をリードする
  • Business Management: 担当チームの優先課題と予算を管理し、戦略実行に必要なリソースと体制を整える。Global CSG Strategyの動向をタイムリーに把握し、日本側への影響をリーダー陣と議論する



You're Our Person If...

  • Customer Success現場業務(Customer Success Manger / Engagementによる支援 / Technical Support等)に対する深い実務理解
  • SaaSビジネスのFinancial KPI(Attrition・Net Revenue Retention・Usage/Consumption・Renewal等)に関する深い理解
  • 5年以上のCustomer Success・SaaS営業・営業企画・経営企画・コンサルティング等の関連業務における実績
  • VPレベル以上のシニアリーダーに対してTrusted Advisorとして機能した実績
  • Data Analyst・Finance・Operationsなど複数の部門と連携して成果を出したクロスファンクショナルな協働経験
  • 戦略立案から実行・効果測定までを一貫してリードした経験
  • 複雑な課題を構造化し、データと論理に基づいた提言をエグゼクティブに対して行えるコミュニケーション能力
  • 流暢な日本語およびビジネスレベルの英語力



Even Better If...

  • コンサルティングファームでの戦略立案・業務改革の経験、またはSaaS企業でのOperations業務の経験
  • SaaS企業においてGlobal組織・GTM・Sales Strategy等の複数の機能と横断的に連携した経験
  • BIツール(Tableau等)を活用したデータ活用・レポーティングの基礎的な経験
  • 社内CRMおよび関連データソースの実務利用経験
  • SQLやデータ分析ツールの基礎的な経験(Data Analystとの連携をより深めるため)


The Experience

As part of Strategy & Programs, which leads Salesforce Strategy, our team is primarily responsible for delivering on the goals of the Customer Success Group (CSG). We translate the company's Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy into CSG initiatives in partnership with Global and Sales Strategy, and support the decision-making of the leaders driving the Customer Success Business with data and strategic thinking to achieve customer retention and growth. We welcome those who are passionate about leading cross-functional collaboration with diverse teams such as Sales Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Enablement, and bringing strategy to life in the business.

A CSG Business Partner functions as a Strategic Advisor closest to the leaders of their assigned team. Rather than primarily providing data or reporting, this role works with leaders to shape strategy and defines direction and priorities toward achieving critical goals: driving Salesforce product adoption, expanding product consumption, and minimizing churn risk. By partnering closely with the CSG Data & Insights Analyst team to define, from a business perspective, what the data is for and what insights are needed, this role embeds data into every strategic discussion to enable more confident decision-making.

Within CSG, this team's mission is to help existing customers maximize the use of Salesforce products and realize ongoing business value, proactively engaging throughout the product lifecycle — from onboarding support to continuous adoption support and risk management. CS Operations is the operations organization supporting delivery activities across CSG, covering functions such as operations design, process improvement, operational data analysis, and strategic investment program management to help frontline customer-facing teams like Product Success perform at their best.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic Advisory: Co-lead strategy and goal-setting with the leaders of your assigned team. Define direction toward achieving critical goals — driving Salesforce product adoption, expanding product consumption, and minimizing churn risk — define from a business perspective what data and insights are needed, and guide leaders toward decisions and execution based on field realities and data
  • Decision Support: Partner with the CSG Data & Insights Analyst team to provide insights that support more confident decision-making for the leaders of your assigned team, turning topics from day-to-day conversations with leaders into data analysis and bringing insights to decision-making moments
  • Performance & Improvement: Drive measurement of outcomes and continuous improvement by defining KPIs, setting prioritization criteria, and establishing feedback loops. descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

The Migration Delivery Lead is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.


This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

Note: By applying to this Migration Delivery Lead, your resume will be reviewed by recruiters and hiring managers across the organization. Multiple roles are available supporting various product areas, including Data360, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Marketing Cloud. Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

What You'll Be Doing
 

Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

  • Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.

  • Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.

  • Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.

  • Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.

Strategic Partnerships & Tooling

  • Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.

  • Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.

  • Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.

  • Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.

Technical Expertise & Incident Response

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.

  • Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.

  • Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.

  • Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.

  • Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.

  • Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.

  • Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.

  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).

  • Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.

  • Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.

  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).

  • Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.

  • Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.

This role demands a seasoned technologist and strategic partner who can not only design and develop bespoke solutions leveraging our Agentforce platform and other cutting-edge technologies but also lead technical engagements and mentor junior peers. You'll be the primary driver of transformative AI solutions, operating with deep technical mastery, unparalleled problem-solving prowess, and a relentless focus on delivering tangible value in dynamic, real-world environments, from initial concept to successful deployment and ongoing optimisation.

As a Senior Agentforce Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI solutions to our most strategic clients. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond. You'll be a hands-on leader, shaping technical strategy and ensuring successful outcomes.


Your Impact:

  • Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation: Be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of complex AI solutions, personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues, while also guiding and reviewing the work of junior team members to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.

  • Build Transformative AI Solutions: Take primary ownership of designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve architecting and deploying complex AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.

  • Engineer Bespoke Agentic AI Solutions: Work directly with customers to design and build custom intelligent agents using the Agentforce platform, ensuring they precisely meet unique business requirements and integrate seamlessly with existing customer ecosystems.

  • Data Configuration & Integration : Own the entire data lifecycle, from strategic design of data models to hands-on building of efficient processing pipelines and establishing seamless integration strategies. You'll ensure data is always ready, optimised, and secure for our advanced AI applications, often navigating complex enterprise data environments.

  • Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyse, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, from intricate data integration to sophisticated model deployment and advanced agent orchestration. You'll be the ultimate go-to expert for unblocking progress.

  • Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become a foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, pushing its capabilities to the limit. You'll lead the development of bespoke intelligent agents, automate intricate business processes, and craft intuitive user experiences. Your insights from the field will directly influence future product enhancements and help shape the strategic direction of our platform, often representing the voice of the customer in product discussions.

  • Become a Trusted Strategic Partner: Embed yourself deeply with client teams to truly grasp their operational challenges and strategic goals. You'll translate these nuanced needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and solution designs, building strong relationships as their primary technical advisor and leading technical discussions.

  • Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and Root Cause Analysis: Perform detailed analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviours to optimise performance, ensure reliability, and prevent recurrence of issues.

  • Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Quickly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement, setting the pace for rapid delivery.

  • Implement and Enforce Best Practices: Directly apply and evangelise engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions, serving as a technical role model.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment.

  • Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.

  • Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., JavaScript, Java, Python, Apex).

  • Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including integrating LLMs, applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), prompt engineering techniques, and experience with agentic frameworks.

  • Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).

  • Significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customisation, and complex development.

  • Demonstrated entrepreneurship, a "get-things-done" attitude, and a focus on fast, impactful delivery, with a proven ability to lead technical initiatives.

  • Exceptional collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior team members, and oversee technical aspects of projects.

  • Ability to travel 25-50% of the time, as needed to customer sites.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform.

  • Experience developing and deploying conversational AI solutions within highly regulated industries.

  • Expert-level experience with Apex and/or Python coding languages in a professional setting.

  • Prior experience in a customer-facing, hands-on technical lead or architect role.

  • Advanced Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Platform Developer II, Application Architect, System Architect).

  • Deep knowledge across Salesforce CRM (Service, Sales, and Marketing Clouds).

  • Extensive experience with Salesforce Flows and Lightning Web Components (LWC), including complex custom development.

  • Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or libraries.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations

  • Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce

  • Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits

  • Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases

  • Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation

  • Follow and help define coding standards while leading code reviews during projects to ensure quality, using tools like GitHub Copilot and AI coding assistants to enforce design patterns, optimize performance, and accelerate the delivery of custom code, integrations, and data migrations

  • Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases

  • Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role

  • Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly

  • From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly

  • Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations

  • Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...

  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

  • 14+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform

  • Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce

  • Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits

  • Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks

  • Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture

  • Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely

  • Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas

  • Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies

  • Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)

  • Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality

  • Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes

  • Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure

  • Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

  • Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect

  • Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications

As SMB Account Executive within these teams, you will drive transformational outcomes for our customers using market-leading integration and data management technologies.

Our SMB segment is made up of two subsegments - Small Business, and Growth Business. These segments focus on selling into different company sizes:

  • Small Business (SB)- 1-50 Employees
  • Growth Business (GRB) - 51-300 Employees


This single posting covers two distinct selling tracks:

  • Data Foundation Account Executive (Quarterback / Prime AE): You are the overall account owner and leader of the backend data strategy. Carrying a dual-product quota across MuleSoft and Informatica ACV, you own long-term account growth and orchestrate extended team resources—including Informatica specialists—to deliver the complete data foundation story.
  • Informatica Account Executive (Specialist AE): You are the deep domain expert for Informatica's Intelligent Data Management Cloud™ (IDMC). Partnering directly with Prime Account Executives, you uncover complex digital transformation opportunities, advise C-level executives, and drive maximum value from Informatica investments within larger account strategies.

  • Financial Services
  • Retail & Consumer Goods
  • Manufacturing, Automotive, and Energy
  • Consumer & Business Services

  • Travel, Transportation and Hospitality

  • Pipeline Generation: Drive net-new opportunity creation through target whitespace prospecting and warm lead expansion.

    • Data Foundation AE: Dual-quota attainment, primary account ownership, and overarching platform strategy.

  • 2+ years of full-cycle software sales experience in fast-paced, competitive market
  • Proven track record selling complex technical platforms, with market awareness in Integration, API Management, or Data Management.
  • Business-value seller: Demonstrated ability to translate technical capabilities into executive-level business outcomes (revenue, risk mitigation, and competitive advantage).
  • Matrix leadership: Exceptional ability to lead and strategize within a matrixed, extended specialist team structure.
  • AI fluency: A natural curiosity about the evolving AI landscape, with the ability to credibly connect data and integration strategy to real-world AI outcomes.
  • New business focus: Demonstrated expertise in new logo acquisition and greenfield territory development.
  • Location: Close proximity to office hub required; role is 4 days on-site per week



Even Better If...

  • Completion of formal sales methodology training (MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger Sales).
  • Familiarity with complex IT selling involving multi-stakeholder approval matrixes across global organizations.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture concepts, digital transformation frameworks, and hybrid integration patterns.
  • Background in technical solution architecture or management consulting in relevant sector.
  • Data Foundation AE Preference: Strong understanding of API management, integration platforms, middleware, and data connectivity solutions.
  • Informatica AE Preference: Prior experience with data management, MDM, or data quality platforms.



Core Competencies

  • Consultative sales approach grounded in customer success and integrity
  • Collaborative team spirit with "company-first" mentality
  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles spanning multiple business units

title: Senior Technical Consultant — Salesforce DevOps
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Senior Technical Consultant — Salesforce DevOps & Release Engineering ensures Migration Factory solutions align with industry best practices to drive long-term customer success. You are a big-picture thinker and an in-depth problem solver, with broad and deep technical expertise. You take pride in designing resilient systems that withstand high volumes and critical migration demands while balancing technical and enterprise-level considerations.

This is a cross-track, shared-services role — not dedicated to a single product track — responsible for designing, building and continuously improving the CI/CD pipelines, environment management frameworks, deployment automation toolkits and release governance standards that underpin every migration wave. You will partner with all track Technical Architects to provision environments, automate deployment pipelines, enforce code quality gates, manage metadata versioning and execute cutover automation scripts — enabling the factory to deliver migrations faster, safer and more predictably at scale.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables and manage expectations across all migration factory tracks — acting as the DevOps point of contact for both internal track teams and client release management leads.
  • Assess existing DevOps processes, tools and practices at the start of each migration engagement — recommending targeted improvements to branching strategy, environment management, deployment models and quality gate maturity to align with factory standards.
  • Design, present and implement best-fit DevOps solutions considering customer needs, tool preferences and commercial constraints — selecting and configuring the right combination of Gearset, Copado, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or GitLab CI for each wave context.
  • Drive the selection and implementation of DevOps tools and technologies across the Migration Factory — evaluating tooling against factory requirements for multi-org support, concurrent wave isolation, metadata conflict management and automated test integration.
  • Lead the setup and execution of Salesforce DevOps frameworks for small-to-medium migration waves — independently owning pipeline design, environment provisioning, branching setup, quality gate configuration and go-live cutover automation from kickoff to production release.
  • Collaborate closely with Technical Architects and track leads on larger migration engagements — translating complex multi-track solution designs into phased deployment pipelines, environment dependency sequences and release governance procedures.
  • Ensure successful continuous delivery deployments across environments — maintaining environment pyramid integrity (Dev → SIT → UAT → Pre-Prod → Production) across all tracks, with automated promotion gates, sandbox refresh scheduling and environment health monitoring.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations — escalating platform DevOps issues, validating metadata API behaviours for new feature releases and incorporating Salesforce-recommended deployment patterns as they evolve.
  • Design and own the Migration Factory's CI/CD pipeline architecture — building and maintaining shared GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or GitLab CI pipelines that orchestrate environment provisioning, metadata deployment, automated testing, quality scanning and environment promotion across all product tracks.
  • Implement source-driven development standards — enforcing Salesforce DX project structure, package-based or source-tracked deployment patterns & metadata API versioning.
  • Lead cutover pipeline design and automation — building automated cutover deployment scripts, pre-cutover validation checklists, automated smoke test suites and post-cutover health dashboards that each track team executes on go-live night.
  • Build and maintain the DevOps accelerator library — developing reusable pipeline templates, custom GitHub Actions, SFDX wrapper utilities and deployment configuration manifests that reduce pipeline setup time for each new migration wave.
  • Govern metadata versioning and conflict resolution — managing metadata conflict resolution protocols when concurrent track teams modify shared metadata objects, defining org-level metadata ownership maps and merge arbitration procedures.
  • Define and report on DevOps metrics — establishing and reporting on pipeline health KPIs including deployment success rate, pipeline execution time, code coverage trends, test failure rates, environment availability and cutover execution accuracy.
  • Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) — representing the DevOps perspective in all ARB sessions, reviewing track solution designs for CI/CD compatibility, environment feasibility and deployment risk, and enforcing factory DevOps standards.
  • Support developer onboarding and DevOps enablement — running internal enablement sessions for track STC and TC teams on Salesforce DX, Git workflows, pipeline usage and local development environment setup, reducing onboarding ramp time.



You're Our Person If...

  • Salesforce Platform Experience (6+ years): Deep, hands-on Salesforce platform experience with a primary focus on DevOps, release management and CI/CD implementation — spanning multiple product clouds and enterprise delivery programmes.
  • Salesforce DX, CLI & Metadata API: Expert proficiency with Salesforce DX, Salesforce CLI, Metadata API and Apex — including SFDX project structure, source tracking, scratch org management, .forceignore configuration and programmatic org inspection via Tooling API. Core toolchain for all factory pipelines.
  • Apex & Lightning Web Components: Hands-on Salesforce development in Apex (Triggers, Batch, Schedulable, REST/SOAP callouts) and Lightning Web Components — sufficient to build and maintain DevOps tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform: pipeline dashboards, environment health monitors, deployment validators and wave progress trackers.
  • CI/CD Tools — Copado, Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps: Strong working knowledge of enterprise CI/CD tools for Salesforce — Copado (user stories, pipelines, quality gates), Jenkins, GitLab CI and Azure DevOps Pipelines. Ability to author complex multi-stage pipelines with conditional logic, secrets management and parallel track execution.
  • Version Control — GitHub, Bitbucket: Expert Git discipline — GitFlow, GitHub Flow and trunk-based development applied to Salesforce multi-org delivery. Ability to design environment-to-branch mapping, PR gate policies, automated merge conflict detection and long-running release branch management for concurrent wave teams.
  • Sandbox Strategy & Source-Driven Development: Deep understanding of Salesforce sandbox lifecycle management — full/partial/developer/scratch org provisioning, refresh scheduling, post-refresh automation and source-driven deployment patterns. Ability to design a full migration environment pyramid and automate its management.
  • Deployment Models — Change Sets, Packages, Metadata Deployments: Comprehensive knowledge of all Salesforce deployment models — Change Set migration, Unlocked/Managed 2GP package development and direct Metadata API deployments. Ability to select and implement the right model for each track's migration phase and wave complexity.
  • Test Automation Tools — Provar, CRT, TOSCA, ApexUnit, JMeter: Exposure to Salesforce test automation tooling — Provar, Copado Robotic Testing (CRT), TOSCA, Selenium for UI regression, ApexUnit for Apex coverage and JMeter for performance testing. Ability to integrate automated test execution as quality gates in CI pipelines across all tracks.
  • Code Quality & Security Tools — SonarQube, PMD, Checkmarx: Hands-on experience integrating static analysis and security scanning tools — PMD for Apex rule enforcement, ESLint for LWC, SonarQube or Checkmarx for SAST — authoring custom rule sets for migration-specific anti-patterns and enforcing blocking gates in CI pipelines.
  • Docker & Orchestration Pipelines: Experience with Docker for building hermetic CI build environments, SFDX toolchain version management and containerised deployment execution. Understanding of orchestration pipeline patterns for sequencing multi-track deployment dependencies.
  • Security Integration in CI/CD: Understanding of how to integrate security scanning, secrets management (Vault, Azure Key Vault, GitHub Secrets), encrypted credential injection and compliance gate enforcement into factory deployment pipelines.
  • Performance Monitoring Tools: Understanding of performance monitoring and observability tools — Salesforce Event Monitoring, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor — to validate post-deployment environment health and track migration wave performance baselines.
  • Branching & Release Governance: Expert knowledge of branching strategies, release governance frameworks, sandbox refresh sequencing and metadata version control discipline applied to concurrent Salesforce migration wave delivery.
  • Client-Facing Communication & Project Leadership: Strong client-facing communication skills — ability to lead small/medium migration waves independently or support Technical Architects on large-scale programmes, translating DevOps constraints into clear delivery impact language for stakeholders.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience on the Salesforce platform with a primary focus on DevOps, release management and CI/CD implementation (aligned to Salesforce Sr. TC — DevOps career framework)
  • Demonstrated experience leading DevOps setup and execution for small-to-medium Salesforce projects independently, and supporting Technical Architects as the DevOps lead on large-scale enterprise programmes
  • 3+ years of dedicated CI/CD pipeline design for Salesforce — managing multi-org environment strategies, sandbox lifecycle automation and metadata deployment pipelines
  • Experience supporting concurrent multi-track or multi-workstream delivery programmes in a DevOps or release engineering capacity — managing pipeline conflicts and environment contention across parallel teams
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing go-live cutover automation for at least 2 Salesforce migration or implementation programmes
  • Proven track record of building reusable pipeline templates, DevOps accelerators and branching governance standards adopted across multiple project teams



Even Better If...

  • Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for Salesforce end-to-end UI regression test automation integrated into migration validation pipelines
  • Experience with Terraform or Pulumi for Infrastructure as Code — managing Salesforce Connected App provisioning, Named Credentials and OAuth configurations programmatically
  • Knowledge of Docker/containerisation for building hermetic CI build environments and SFDX toolchain version management
  • Experience with Salesforce Shield — Platform Encryption key management, Event Monitoring and Field Audit Trail — ensuring encryption-compatible deployments during migration waves
  • Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps Center (native Salesforce DevOps tooling) as an alternative or complement to Gearset/Copado pipelines
  • Experience integrating SonarQube or Veracode for advanced security scanning beyond PMD/ESLint
  • Knowledge of Salesforce CLI plugins ecosystem — sfdx-git-delta, sfdx-hardis, sf-org-compare — for delta deployment optimisation and org difference reporting
  • Understanding of cross-cloud deployment patterns — coordinating simultaneous deployments across Salesforce core org, Marketing Cloud, Tableau Cloud and Data Cloud in a single migration wave
  • Experience with migration-specific test data generation tools (Mockaroo, Snowfakery) for synthetic data seeding in scratch orgs and developer sandboxes
  • Python scripting for Tableau REST API automation, Salesforce Bulk API data operations and custom migration pipeline orchestration scripts

  • Salesforce Certified DevOps Accredited Professional (Required)
  • Salesforce Administrator (Required)

  • Consumer Business Services (CBS) – Supports companies in professional services, hospitality, travel, transportation, and business services sectors, helping them optimize customer engagement and operational efficiency across complex service delivery models.
  • Technology Media Telecommunication (TMT) – Works with technology companies, telecommunications providers, media organizations, and high-tech firms to accelerate innovation, improve customer success outcomes, and drive platform adoption at scale (Direct experience with Media Cloud strongly preferred).
  • Financial Services (FINS) – Partners with banks, insurance companies, wealth management firms, and fintech organizations to drive digital banking transformation, enhance customer experiences, ensure regulatory compliance, and maximize ROI on Salesforce investments.



This is an Individual Contributor position.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
  • Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.



Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Drive adoption of Sales and Service Cloud features with reps, agents, managers, supervisors, and ops teams.
  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers’ business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
  • Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.
