  • Drive adoption of Tableau features with business users and analysts and track usage metrics (active users, workbook views, data source adoption).
  • Conduct enablement sessions and share best practices on dashboard creation and performance, data exploration, and visualization design.
  • Escalate complex data modeling or server configuration questions to technical resources.
  • AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
  • Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
  • AI Engagement Monitoring: Use AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
  • Collaborative Learning: Actively seek out Agentblazer training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
  • Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnostic questions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
  • Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
  • Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
  • Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources.



You're Our Person If...

  • Experienced business professional, preferably with 3+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields.
  • Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
  • Possesses industry-relevant expertise and is actively honing skills in a relevant functional area, with an understanding of the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
  • Actively seeks out relevant learning activities, approaches obstacles as growth opportunities, and seeks experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.
  • Position requirements: Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. Company visa sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.



Cloud/Platform Requirements (included with the above):

  • 3+ years of experience supporting customers using Tableau, with a demonstrated understanding of how Tableau connects to Salesforce data.
  • Working knowledge of Tableau Desktop, Tableau Cloud/Server, and Tableau Prep.
  • Understanding of data visualization best practices and dashboard design.
  • Familiarity with common data sources (databases, spreadsheets, cloud apps).
  • Ability to demonstrate Tableau features and navigate workbooks and dashboards.
  • Knowledge of basic analytics use cases (sales dashboards, operational reporting, KPI tracking) and experience with Tableau governance basics (permissions, projects, data sources).

Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you'll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

The Senior Builder Experience

  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the  highest engineering  standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly. 

  • AI-Supported  Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your  daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.

  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.

  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.

  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.

  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.

  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.

  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.

  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.

  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.

  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.

  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 8+ years of software engineering and technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.

  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.

  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.

  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.

  • You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.

  • You have an entrepreneurial, get-things-done mindset focused on fast, impactful delivery — and the judgment to know when "fast" is the wrong call.

  • You've mentored technical talent and created reusable assets — frameworks, playbooks, internal tooling.

  • You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.

  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

  • Ability to travel to customer sites as needed to ensure client success

  • Business level proficiency in Italian and English

  • Computer Science (CS) degree or related.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, System Architect)

  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks

  • Experience architecting multi-cloud, multi-system enterprise AI solutions for Global 500 customers

  • Track record of influencing enterprise software product roadmaps through field engineering insight

  • Open-source contributions, published technical writing, or conference presentations

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform  and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the  product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

  • Channel AI-Native Superpowers: Champion and harness the unique, fast-paced 'group chat' collaboration styles and intuitive AI habits of recent graduates, turning their fresh perspectives into a competitive advantage for our delivery teams.

  • Manage & Mentor: Act as the direct people manager for a cohort of Emerging Talent AI Builders. Deliver regular 1:1s, performance reviews, career development planning, and compensation management.

  • Bridge the Gap: Help AI natives pivot from 'building experimental side projects' to deploying production-grade, secure, and ethical enterprise software, showing them how to scale their boundary-pushing ideas responsibly. 

  • Consulting Coaching: Teach technical grads how to "translate tech into business value." Coach them on active listening, stakeholder management, discovery sessions, presentation skills, and handling pushback from customers.

  • Cultivating Belonging and Long-term Engagement: Establish a vibrant, inclusive atmosphere. Provide guidance through the specific challenges of early-career excellence, including managing rapid advancement paths, addressing imposter syndrome, and meeting the distinct professional needs of high-potential recent graduates.

2. Technical Leadership & Project Governance (30%)

  • Agentforce Guardrails: Guide graduates through the design of agentic reasoning, prompt engineering, and tool calls. Ensure they are evaluating AI outputs with strict engineering rigor rather than trial-and-error.

  • Technical Coaching: Support Graduates in building scalable and secure agentic solutions. Act as an internal technical sounding partner when a Graduate encounters roadblocks, ensuring they are equipped to succeed.

  • Project Matching & Bench Management: Oversee the pipeline of customer work, strategically pairing Grads with projects that stretch their technical capabilities while balancing business needs.

  • University Recruiting Partner: Collaborate with the University Recruiting team to interview, assess, and attract top-tier Computer Science talent from target universities.

You can speak their language...

You have a deep background in computer science or software engineering. You understand object-oriented programming, data structures, and the current landscape of LLMs/prompt engineering. 

...and you can teach them yours.

You are a seasoned consultant or customer-facing tech lead. You know how to read a room, handle a tough customer question during a live deployment, and unpack complex business requirements into technical user stories. You view communication, empathy, and business acumen as core engineering skills. Crucially, you are energized by working with early-career talent who naturally think AI-first. You know how to guide their ambition to push boundaries, helping them refine raw creativity into high-impact business strategy. 

Qualifications & Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a highly technical discipline.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, software engineering, or a highly technical customer-facing role.

  • Leadership: 1+ years of experience managing technical teams, acting as a tech lead, or significantly mentoring early-career engineers/consultants.

  • Technical Fluency: Proficient in at least one classic powerhouse language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java) and a solid understanding of modern web architectures (React, REST APIs, GraphQL). A passion for high quality code and best practices (OOP, SOLID, Git, etc.)

  • AI/LLM Curiosity: Practical, hands-on experience or profound familiarity with Generative AI frameworks, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience managing university graduate programs, technical rotation programs, or tech boot camps.

  • Direct experience with the Salesforce ecosystem, Apex, or building on Agentforce.

  • Background in Enterprise Agile delivery and technical scoping.

Unlike traditional engineering managers who operate strictly behind the scenes, or traditional consulting managers focused purely on utilization metrics, you are at the epicenter of a workforce revolution. You are not just teaching a syllabus, you are leading a generation of AI natives who will fundamentally rewrite how businesses operate. In this role, you have a blank canvas to push boundaries, experiment with leading-edge agentic technology, and serve as the premier showcase for Salesforce's company-wide up-skilling strategy.   • High level of proficiency in Hebrew and English

Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.



Even Better If...

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life.   • お客様のTableau環境、ビジネス部門のステークホルダー、レポート作成および分析のニーズを深く理解する。
  • Tableauエコシステムの最適な健全性とパフォーマンスのために、ベストプラクティスに基づくガイダンスと推奨事項を提供する。

  • 営業、エンジニアリング、プロダクトマネジメントと強固な部門横断の協力関係を築く。
  • 重大なケースについては、サポート、サステイニングエンジニアリング、開発部門と緊密に連携してエスカレーションを管理し、お客様に定期的に状況を報告する。
  • 重要なサポートケースや優先度の高い課題について、必要なすべてのステークホルダーとのコミュニケーションを調整する。
  • お客様の状況や目標設定に焦点を当てたロードマップを作成し、四半期ごとのレポートおよびデプロイメントレビューを実施して、傾向を把握し、潜在的な問題を事前に特定し、安定性、パフォーマンス、新機能の要件に応じたリリースの提案を行う。
  • お客様先でのTableau活用の確立・拡大に向けて、（ワークショップの実施を含む）ソリューションと提案を提供する。
  • 収益機会を特定し、アカウントチームと連携して、現在のニーズと将来の成長に対応する有償サービス、ライセンス、トレーニング、追加のTableau製品を提案する。
  • ITおよびビジネス双方のステークホルダーとコミュニケーションを取り、関係を構築する。
  • Tableauに関するナレッジ、コミュニティ、トレーニングリソースに貢献する。
  • 社内、お客様先、Tableauカンファレンスにおいて、ビジネスおよび技術に関するカスタムのプレゼンテーションやトレーニングを準備し、実施する。

  • 面接プロセスに参加し、候補者の見極めを支援する。

  • その他、割り当てられる業務
  • チームを強化するため、他のTableauチームメンバーのトレーニングやスキルアップに貢献する。

  • エンタープライズレベルのミッションクリティカルなアプリケーションをサポートした実績
  • リレーショナルデータベースへの深い理解、エンタープライズデータウェアハウスの手法、OLAPなどへの理解
  • クラウド、データベース、SQL、Windows Serverにおける10年以上の経験（Linuxの経験も歓迎）
  • ネットワーキング、サーバーの構築・管理への深い理解、およびインターネットアーキテクチャ、ファイアウォール、プロキシサーバー、リバースプロキシサーバー、Webサーバーに関するトラブルシューティング経験
  • 創造性と好奇心にあふれた技術者、問題解決者としての実績

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Our most senior technical voice on AI and agentic strategy in EMEA — someone who's actually shipped an AI product into production, not just prototyped one, and knows how to turn LLM/agentic capability into measurable business value customers can trust. Solid on at least one Salesforce cloud, but the real bar is production trust, transparency, and business-process ROI — not Salesforce platform depth or fine-tuning mechanics.

The Field CAIO need to be credible enough to help a CDAIO shape their AI strategy and vision for enterprise AI at scale — and then translate that vision into the role Salesforce plays within it, connecting enterprise-wide AI ambition to what's actually buildable and trustworthy on our platform.
 

Your Impact

1. AI & Agentic Thought Leadership

  • The field's go-to authority on LLMs and agentic implementations — not the hyperparameters or fine-tuning mechanics, but how to put the technology to real, measurable work based on the Salesforce Platform.
  • Sales-driven, C-level presence: CAIOs, CTOs, and business leaders treat you as the peer who can turn "we should use AI" into a funded, working plan
  • Present at events, analyst briefings, and customer boards; publish points of view on what actually works in production AI versus what's hype


2. From Idea to Production — Business Value & Trust

  • Own the hardest part of the AI story: getting tools out of the demo and into production, with the trust and transparency for a business to depend on them
  • Translate AI capability into concrete business process improvement — help customers frame the problem, size the value, and pick the right first use case
  • Bring hands-on architectural credibility on agentic patterns (orchestration, tool use, guardrails, observability) so customers trust what an agent will and won't do
  • Long-term trusted advisor to strategic accounts on their AI roadmap, beyond any single deal


3. Reference Architecture & Technical GTM for AI

  • Build reference architectures and GTM narratives for new AI/agentic offerings ahead of launch
  • Package proof points and playbooks — ideally drawn from your own track record of shipping AI products — that the wider architect community can reuse
  • Co-own architecture patterns with AI ecosystem partners (hyperscalers, model providers, agent-framework vendors) to accelerate joint solutioning

Qualifications

  • 10-15+ years in AI/ML, applied data science, or technical consulting, with recent deep focus on LLMs and agentic systems
  • Demonstrated track record of taking AI tools into production — ideally: built an AI product or company, and can show references for the business impact delivered to customers
  • Good tech depth on at least one Salesforce cloud and core/platform, and agood understanding of major features and capabilities of Salesforce offering
  • Strong grasp of what makes production AI trustworthy: transparency, observability, guardrails, evaluation — able to speak to this with engineering and business audiences alike
  • Demonstrated C-level advisory experience, translating AI potential into business-process outcomes
  • Fluent English required; additional EMEA languages a plus
  • Degree or equivalent experience

Technical Skill Set

  • AI & Agentic: LLMs, RAG, vector stores, agent orchestration, MCP/A2A interoperability, evaluation/observability frameworks
  • Applied AI-to-Value: Use-case framing, business process redesign, ROI measurement for AI initiatives
  • Salesforce Platform: Solid working knowledge of Agentforce and at least one cloud (Data 360, Sales, Service, or Industry Clouds)
  • Data Foundations: Enough data-platform fluency (cloud DWH/DL) to know when data quality is the real blocker to AI value
  • Production & Trust: Guardrails, governance, monitoring, and transparency patterns for deployed AI systems

Key Qualities

  • Builder — has shipped an AI product, not just prototyped one
  • Pragmatist — cares about measurable business value over technical novelty
  • Trust Broker — makes customers comfortable putting AI into production
  • Storyteller — moves a room from "interesting demo" to "let's fund this"
  • Sales Instinct — genuinely enthusiastic, commercially driven

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Account Executive – Enterprise Corporate Sales


About the Team

Our Enterprise Corporate Sales (ECS) team partners closely with Enterprise Account Directors to sell into the largest and most prominent organizations in Belgium & Luxembourg.


This is your opportunity to step into the fast-paced world of enterprise selling, utilizing a collaborative sales model that champions teamwork to accelerate your career.


Why Join Salesforce as an Account Executive, ECS?

We embrace top performers from all backgrounds. We challenge and push each other to be the best, and we have fun along the way. We move fast, think faster, and celebrate our wins—both big and small.


Our Enterprise Account Directors are some of the most experienced and successful reps in the industry. As an ECS Account Executive, you will work hand-in-hand with them, experiencing one of the steepest and most exciting learning curves in the market. This role is the ideal opportunity to be exposed to enterprise selling "the Salesforce way," with a wealth of global resources at your disposal and a broad internal support network.


We offer extensive formal and informal training entirely focused around your strengths and goals. We encourage 360-degree feedback, giving you the space to take your own initiative and blaze your own trail. The ECS role serves as a true enterprise-selling apprenticeship.


Day to Day

For our ECS Account Executives, no two days are the same. You will sell our Salesforce Customer 360 platform into top-tier enterprise accounts across the Belgium & Luxembourg market. We build trusted relationships with existing accounts to seek out and identify new business opportunities.

On any given day, you could be:

  • Running complex deals end-to-end, forecasting, and prospecting.
  • Building go-to-market strategies and executing target account plans.
  • Running or attending executive roundtables, workshops, and regional events.
  • Managing urgent customer requests and navigating complex organizational structures.

You will leverage your business development and relationship-building skills to:

  • Advise customers on the Salesforce Platform and industry-specific solutions to help them achieve their digital transformation goals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional supporting teams (Pre-sales, Success, Partners) to lead the end-to-end sales process.
  • Uncover critical customer challenges using solution-selling expertise, demonstrating how Salesforce technology solves complex business problems.
  • Establish a regular customer cadence to manage and build high-value, long-lasting relationships.
  • Research territories and specific industry verticals to formalize a localized go-to-market strategy.
  • Balance short-term transaction execution with a long-term strategic perspective to maximize overall revenue generation.

Who You Are

  • Experienced: You are a tenured Account Executive who has had exposure to enterprise or commercial accounts, or you can demonstrate the business acumen and gravitas needed to influence C-level executives. You have a proven track record of carrying a quota and hitting sales targets.
  • Driven: You are self-motivated and thrive in a fast-paced sales environment. Ambiguity doesn’t scare you; you are driven to not only achieve your target but to blow past it.
  • Resilient: You have a high EQ. We operate in a highly matrixed team environment with multiple stakeholders, so maintaining a collaborative, calm attitude is essential.
  • Growth-Minded: You embody a growth mindset. You are thinking ahead, planning your career trajectory, and are an avid learner.
  • A Trusted Adviser: You are able to craft a strong point of view, hold an opinion, and build credibility with your customers.
  • Curious: Self-awareness is highly important to you, and you understand your personal "why." You are passionate about the chance to absorb all that Salesforce has to offer.

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The era of the Agentic Enterprise is here. With the rollout of Salesforce Agentforce, autonomous AI agents are revolutionizing how global organizations automate decisions, orchestrate workflows, and engage customers.

However, AI models are only as effective as the data feeding them. To deliver real-time, trusted decisions, AI agents depend on seamless connectivity across fragmented hybrid environments. That is why MuleSoft and Informatica are mission-critical to Salesforce’s core AI strategy. By bringing together MuleSoft’s API orchestration and Informatica’s enterprise data management, you will sell the fundamental data backbone powering the next generation of enterprise AI.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to join our high-growth Data Foundation team. This is a strategic, C-level sales role where you will drive multi-million dollar transformations across top-tier enterprise accounts.

Because the majority of our field leaders are promoted internally, this role offers a clear path for career acceleration within Salesforce.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic GTM Leadership: Own and execute the Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for a high-value enterprise territory, focusing on new logo acquisition and greenfield expansion.
  • C-Suite Engagement: Partner directly with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, and line-of-business executives to articulate the strategic ROI of AI-ready data infrastructure.
  • Complex Deal Execution: Navigate high-stakes, multi-stakeholder sales cycles ($500K to $1M+ ACV) from initial discovery to final closing.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Lead a dedicated pod of Solution Architects, Pre-Sales Engineers, and Professional Services experts, while leveraging the broader Salesforce partner ecosystem.
  • Forecasting & Territory Planning: Conduct whitespace analysis, maintain a healthy pipeline, and deliver precise quarterly forecasts.



You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience in high-growth, competitive markets.
  • Consistent track record of quota overachievement selling complex, six- and seven-figure deals.
  • Deep experience in New Business Acquisition and territory mapping within complex matrix organizations.



Even Better If...

  • Solid functional understanding of API management, integration platforms (iPaaS), middleware, or enterprise data architecture.

State, Local Government, and Education (SLED). This includes working with state and municipal agencies, county and city governments, and K-12 or higher education institutions.

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing
  • Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience



Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Drive adoption of Sales and Service Cloud features with reps, agents, managers, supervisors, and ops teams
  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores)
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers’ business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
  • Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

  • AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.

  • Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out “Agentblazer” training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
  • Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
  • Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
  • Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
  • Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources



You're Our Person If...

  • Experienced business professional, preferably with 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields.
  • Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
  • Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
  • Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development



Cloud/Platform Requirements included:

  • 3-4 years experience with deep Salesforce Service Cloud expertise.
  • Knowledge of advanced Service Cloud features: Omni-Channel, Service Cloud Voice, Digital Engagement (messaging, chat), Field Service Lightning.



Even Better If...

  • Service Cloud Consultant certifications.
  • Salesforce Admin + Service Cloud Consultant certification.
  • Data Cloud experience/certification.
  • Additional Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Data 360 Specialist, Agentblazer).
  • Understanding of Service Cloud integrates with telephony, chat, messaging, and self-service portals.
  • Understanding of Einstein AI for Service (case routing, chatbots, predictive service).

The Experience

Design at Qualified is small and intentional. There's no design systems team or research ops function, just close access to the product, fast feedback loops, and problems that rarely have obvious solutions.

Most of those problems are about AI where the interface is rarely the hard part. The challenge is helping users understand what the AI is doing, trust it when it's right, catch it when it's wrong, and shape it toward what they actually need. That takes judgment more than process.

We're building Piper, an AI SDR that runs autonomous sales conversations, follows up with prospects, and moves pipeline without a human in the loop. Piper is not a chatbot and not a copilot. Piper is an agent. You will work on two of its most interesting surfaces: the AI brain (how Piper understands prospects and explains its reasoning) and conversational presence (the live chat and video experience where the AI is the rep).

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • The first surface is Piper's brain: how Piper understands a lead, forms a plan, and explains its reasoning. You'll design the interface for shaping its personality, goals, and objection handling. Not a settings panel. Something closer to a thinking partner you can tune.
  • The second is Piper's live presence, the chat and video experience where the AI is the rep. The work is in the details: the micro-interactions, latency handling, turn-taking, and tone that make it feel credible instead of uncanny.
  • The design patterns for autonomous agents in enterprise sales are still being figured out. You'll be part of that.

You're Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of product design, with at least 2 years on AI or conversational experiences
  • You understand LLM behavior (latency, streaming, confidence, failure modes) and design for it honestly
  • Fluent in AI tooling as a core part of how you work, not an experiment
  • Strong visual and interaction craft. You have taste.
  • Comfortable without a detailed brief. You define the problem alongside the solution.
  • Works directly with eng and ML. No handoff culture here.

Even Better If...

  • Voice, video, or real-time communication design background
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales or CRM workflows
  • Experience designing multi-step autonomous workflows


How you work

Taste over process. Prototypes over presentations. Speed is a quality, judgment is the craft. You think of yourself as a creative director of AI collaborators, not a solo craftsperson. Concretely:

  • You prototype in code or with AI tools, not just Figma
  • You're faster with agents than most designers are without them
  • You ship design decisions, not just document them


Why Join Qualified

The design patterns for AI agents in enterprise sales are still being established. You'd be one of a few people defining them at production scale, on a product that's already live and growing.

Ownership here is genuine. You'll work directly with leadership, influence product direction, and own your work from problem definition through ship. No gatekeeping, no waiting for a brief.

The Salesforce acquisition puts our work in front of one of the largest enterprise customer bases on the planet. It is important that the team remains nimble and autonomous to keep innovation moving.

title: Account Executive, Agentforce Marketing
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforceの Agentforce Marketing は、単なるメール配信ツールではありません。メール、モバイル、SNS、ウェブなど、あらゆる顧客接点をつなぎ、企業と顧客の間に「真の絆」を作るための、世界最高峰のデジタルマーケティング・プラットフォームです。
私たちは、誰よりもマーケターの苦労と喜びを知っています。なぜなら、私たち自身も一人のマーケターとして、現場のニーズを深く追求し続けてきたからです。だからこそ、他社の追随を許さない圧倒的な製品投資を行い、常に最先端のAI技術をお客様に提供し続けています。クラウドの先駆者であるSalesforceの基盤の上で、あなたも「次世代のマーケティング」を形にしてみませんか？

日本を代表する大手企業（エンタープライズ企業）の戦略的パートナーとして、お客様のビジネスを根底から変革する提案をリードしていただきます。
単に製品を売るのではなく、お客様の経営課題に寄り添い、将来の収益を共に創り出す役割です。既存のお客様との関係性を深めつつ、新たな可能性（新規ビジネス）を切り拓いていく、非常にやりがいのあるポジションです。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • パートナーシップの構築: お客様と日々向き合い、ビジネスモデルやマーケティング戦略の「核心」を理解した上で、伴走しながら成長を支えます。
  • マーケティングの高度化を支援: 最新のAIエージェント（Agentforce）やデータ基盤（Data Cloud）を駆使し、お客様のマーケティングを一段高い次元へと引き上げます。
  • 経営層へのプレゼンテーション: 四半期ごとのビジネスレビュー（QBR）などを通じて、役員・経営層（C-level）に対し、テクノロジーがもたらす未来のビジョンを提案します。
  • 現場の声を製品へ: 現場で得たリアルな知見を社内にフィードバックし、Salesforceの製品進化を支える「顧客の代弁者」としての役割も担います。
  • プロフェッショナルな契約管理: 複雑なエンタープライズ契約の交渉から締結まで、ビジネスのプロとして全プロセスをリードします。


You're Our Person If...

  • エンタープライズIT業界での経験（5年以上）: 大手企業向けの複雑なソリューション営業を経験してきた方。
  • 数字へのコミットメント: 四半期・年間の目標達成に向け、粘り強く戦略的に動ける方。
  • 高い交渉力と論理的思考: 複雑な契約をまとめ上げ、適正な価値を形にする力をお持ちの方。
  • コミュニケーション能力: 日本語での円滑かつ、プロフェッショナルなコミュニケーションができる方（読み・書き・対話）。


Even Better If...

  • C-levelとの折衝経験: 経営層に対し、物怖じせずビジネスの本質を語れる方。
  • グローバルな視点: 多様な文化や組織を理解し、広い視野でアカウントマネジメントができる方。
  • 知的好奇心: AIやデータ活用など、新しいテクノロジーを自ら学び、楽しんで提案に活かせる方。


The Experience

Salesforce's Agentforce Marketing is not just an email delivery tool. It is a world-class digital marketing platform that connects every customer touchpoint, including email, mobile, social media, and web, to build a "true bond" between companies and their customers.
We know the struggles and joys of marketers better than anyone, because we ourselves are marketers who have continued to pursue the needs of the field in depth. That is why we make overwhelming product investments that no competitor can match and continue to offer customers the most advanced AI technology. Built on the foundation of Salesforce, the pioneer of the cloud, would you like to shape "next-generation marketing" too?

As a strategic partner to Japan's leading large enterprises, you will lead proposals that fundamentally transform your customers' businesses.
Rather than simply selling products, you will stand alongside customers' management challenges and co-create future revenue. It is a highly rewarding position where you deepen relationships with existing customers while opening up new possibilities (new business).

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Building partnerships: Work with customers every day, understand the "core" of their business models and marketing strategies, and support their growth by running alongside them.
  • Advancing marketing sophistication: Make full use of the latest AI agents (Agentforce) and data foundation (Data Cloud) to lift customers' marketing to a higher level.
  • Presenting to executives: Through quarterly business reviews (QBR) and similar occasions, propose to executives and management (C-level) the future vision that technology brings.
  • Bringing the voice of the field to the product: Feed the real insights gained in the field back internally, acting as the "voice of the customer" that supports Salesforce's product evolution.
  • Professional contract management: Lead the entire process, from negotiation to closing of complex enterprise contracts, as a business professional.

The Technical Architect for Tableau Next is an execution-focused analytics architect and primary subject matter expert for the Tableau Next platform. You will design and deliver migrations from Salesforce CRM Analytics, Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, and legacy Tableau Server to a modern data stack. As the primary technical authority for this migration track, you will own the Tableau Next analytics platform architecture, legacy content migration strategy, and feature adoption roadmap.

Operating at the forefront of the modern data stack, you will architect scalable and secure solutions that bridge Data Cloud's foundational architecture with Tableau Next. You will combine deep Analytics, Data 360, and Salesforce knowledge to ensure dashboards, data sources, permissions, and security structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance, and accelerated time-to-insight for business users.

You will use approved enterprise AI tools as an authorized input to relevant architecture, migration, analysis, and documentation work. You will validate AI-assisted outputs, test assumptions, protect confidential information, and remain accountable for technical decisions, migration quality, and customer outcomes.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Tableau Next Platform Ownership: Act as the definitive technical authority for Tableau Next, leading the end-to-end transition of dashboards and reporting from Salesforce CRM Analytics, Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, and legacy Tableau Server.
  • AI-Assisted Architecture and Migration: Use approved enterprise AI tools to support architecture documentation, legacy-to-target mappings, migration planning, test-case development, diagnostics, and technical communications. Apply expert judgment to validate outputs and preserve business logic, data fidelity, and platform compatibility.
  • Security and Governance Architecture: Design and implement comprehensive data governance and security frameworks within the new architecture, enforcing policy-based data visibility and row-level security (RLS) to ensure strict, role-aligned data access.
  • Human Accountability and Validation: Review AI-assisted recommendations, mappings, and analysis for accuracy, completeness, security, privacy, and alignment with approved architecture and governance standards before they inform delivery or customer decisions.
  • Data Source Architecture: Architect the data source framework using Analytics, Data 360, and Salesforce knowledge to design live connections and optimized models tailored for Tableau Next.
  • Data Ingestion and Engineering: Own and manage data ingestion directly within Salesforce Data Cloud to power the Tableau Next reporting layer.
  • Semantic Layer Design: Design and build the semantic layer strictly within Salesforce Data Cloud to support all Tableau Next analytical requirements.
  • Model Translation: Map and translate legacy BI semantic models into Data Cloud Calculated Insights and semantic models, using structured validation to confirm business logic equivalence.
  • Data Lineage: Define end-to-end data lineage, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved when migrating fields through Data Cloud transformation layers.
  • Discovery and Strategy: Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client teams to assess legacy report complexity, usage analytics, and data source dependencies.
  • Advisory: Serve as a Trusted Advisor to Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, self-service analytics vision, and data governance strategy.
  • Migration Standards: Establish best-in-class standards for the migration practice, building reusable Tableau Next dashboard templates, Data Cloud connection frameworks, migration validation methods, and governance playbooks.
  • Execution and Cutover: Plan and execute cutover strategies, including legacy BI deprecation, user access migration, and post-go-live enablement.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively mitigate technical risks related to data source credentials, calculated field logic parity, RLS re-implementation, extract refresh SLAs, data readiness, and AI-assisted migration outputs.
  • Technical Communication: Translate architecture decisions, migration risks, data limitations, and validation findings into clear guidance for client teams, Analytics leaders, and Enterprise Architects.



Experience:

  • Tableau Next: Comprehensive, hands-on mastery of the Tableau Next platform, including advanced dashboarding, platform capabilities, and usage reporting.
  • Salesforce Data Cloud Expertise: Deep technical understanding of data connections, data ingestion, Data Streams, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), Data Model Objects (DMOs), Data Governance, and Calculated Insights.
  • Data Governance and Security: Proven ability to design and execute complex data governance models, specifically implementing policy-based data visibility and row-level security (RLS).
  • Salesforce CRM Analytics: Proven experience and technical depth in CRM Analytics, formerly Einstein Analytics.
  • Semantic Models: Advanced ability to design, build, and migrate semantic layers, specifically within the Salesforce Data Cloud architecture.
  • Salesforce Administrator Knowledge: Deep understanding of Salesforce platform administration, security models, and user management.
  • Salesforce Core Platform: Functional knowledge of at least one Salesforce Cloud, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Financial Services Cloud.
  • AI-Fluent Technical Practice: Demonstrated ability to use approved enterprise AI tools or comparable authorized AI-assisted methods for role-relevant work products such as architecture documentation, migration mappings, test cases, diagnostics, or technical analysis, with human validation and accountability for the final result.



Preferred Experience:

  • Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud One.
  • Experience migrating from IBM Cognos, SAP Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Microsoft Power BI, Looker, or legacy Tableau Server to Tableau Next.
  • Familiarity with Tableau Site and Governance Architecture, including project hierarchy, permission models, and content certification workflows.
  • Understanding of broader cloud data platform integrations, including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Azure Synapse, as secondary analytical sources.
  • Knowledge of dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar orchestration tools for upstream data pipeline dependencies.
  • Familiarity with Tableau Embedded Analytics for migrating legacy embedded BI into external applications.
  • Understanding of Tableau Bridge for on-premises data source connectivity.
  • 10+ years of general experience in Business Intelligence, analytics, and data platform solutions.
  • 5+ years of hands-on analytics development and architecture experience.

    Required Certifications
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator
  • Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant



Highly Desired (Very Strong Plus)

  • Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
  • Tableau Desktop Specialist



Nice to Have

  • Tableau Certified Architect
  • Tableau Certified Data Analyst
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced
  • Databricks Certified Associate Developer
  • dbt Analytics Engineering Certification

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 
  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


What You'll Actually Be Building
 
  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.


You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 
  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.


Nice-to-Haves
 
  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

 À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 
  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.
  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.
  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.
  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.


Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 
  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.
  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.
  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.
  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.

  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.
  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.

  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.
  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.
  • Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage parmi Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Apex — et êtes prêt à en ajouter d'autres selon les besoins.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des LLMs et du prompt engineering. Vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un prompt a échoué et ce que vous changeriez.

Partnering with an Account Partner, you will lead the pre-sales discovery process, defining customer outcomes and translating them into a viable high-level solution design. Your primary responsibility is developing and articulating comprehensive implementation proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs), including detailed estimates, timelines, and staffing plans. You will apply proven methodologies and orchestrate subject matter experts to validate the solution's viability. After the sale, you will ensure a clean transition to the delivery team, ensuring all project details, scope, and commitments are clearly understood to enable rapid mobilization.

Your Impact

  • Contribute to high client satisfaction by ensuring the solutions you shape are set up for delivery success and align tightly with customer objectives.

  • Ensure business value is defined and realized by translating executive-level customer objectives into clear, executable implementation plans.

  • Partner closely with Account Partners to structure the deal’s financial strategy and implementation roadmap, and then co-presenting the value and strategic outcomes directly to the client.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level customers, developing narratives that articulate the execution plan and timeline of the transformation program.

  • Prescriptively shape large, complex, and transformational engagements, moving beyond stated requirements to recommend the right path for customer success.

  • Uncover and articulate future opportunities to drive sustained customer value and Salesforce expansion.

  • Partner with Services Sales Solution Architects, Business Strategists and other relevant roles, as necessary, on comprehensive pre-sales discovery workshops, engaging functional stakeholders to understand the complete business challenge and desired outcomess.

  • Define and manage the end-to-end engagement scoping process, establishing clear boundaries, assumptions, and success criteria.

  • Lead the high-level functional solutioning and scope definition, ensuring the proposed approach is viable and aligns with Salesforce best practices.

  • Harmonize diverse perspectives—from Customer Business/IT to Sales, Legal, and Revenue Recognition—to synthesize competing interests into a cohesive solution that aligns with commercial targets and delivery excellence.

  • Own the creation of the final Statement of Work, defining precise deliverables, scope, and implementation terms and conditions in partnership with Legal and Revenue Recognition teams for a clean hand-off.

  • Develop detailed, accurate project estimates, staffing plans, and resource mixes, ensuring the engagement is properly structured for success.

  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate engagement risks during the pre-sales cycle, leading Risk assignments to protect both the customer and Salesforce.

  • Manage a seamless transition from the pre-sales phase to the delivery team, ensuring all project details, scope, and commitments are clearly understood.

  • Serve as a multiplier, mentoring others and amplifying the team's knowledge by sharing best practices in solutioning, scoping, and engagement shaping.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum Experience: 10+ years’ experience delivering enterprise-level consulting services, with 7+ years focused on the Salesforce platform.

  • Project Leadership: 7+ years of deep enterprise-level project or program experience (SaaS preferred), utilized to inform accurate scoping and estimation.

  • Pre-Sales Leadership: Demonstrable experience leading the end-to-end discovery, solutioning, estimating, and SOW-creation process for multi-cloud, transformational programs.

  • Sales Collaboration: Active involvement in supporting the sale of professional services, including leading proposal development and presenting to C-level executives.

  • Go-to-Market Support: Experience leading strategic scoping, proposal development, RFP responses, and executive-level presentations.

  • Platform Expertise: Deep demonstrated technical and/or functional proficiency in the Salesforce platform and its solutions.

  • Ideal Certifications: Salesforce Platform Administrator, Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, and Salesforce Service Cloud certifications are strongly preferred.

  • Executive Presence: Extremely strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build advisory relationships and establish credibility with executives.

  • Facilitation Skills: Demonstrated ability to influence a group audience, facilitate complex solutioning workshops, and lead executive-level discussions regarding roadmap and scope.

  • Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills; adept at mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue during negotiation.

  • Business Acumen: A delivery-informed mindset with a deep understanding of cloud-based technologies and the ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into tangible, scoped solutions.

  • Commercial Acumen: Proficiency in deal architecture and pricing levers; demonstrated ability to manage discounting and lead commercial negotiations to maximize deal profitability.

  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead and mentor cross-functional teams and individuals, exercising discretion and latitude in reaching critical goals.

  • Logistics: Ability to travel will be required and varies based on client needs.

Technical depth required. Architectural judgment expected.
Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you'll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

The Senior Builder Experience
  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the  highest engineering  standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly.
  • AI-Supported  Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your  daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building
  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Senior Forward Deployed Engineer If…
  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
  • You have an entrepreneurial, get-things-done mindset focused on fast, impactful delivery — and the judgment to know when "fast" is the wrong call.
  • You've mentored technical talent and created reusable assets — frameworks, playbooks, internal tooling.
  • You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, embedded with customer engineers.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, System Architect)
  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks
  • Experience architecting multi-cloud, multi-system enterprise AI solutions for Global 500 customers
  • Track record of influencing enterprise software product roadmaps through field engineering insight
  • Open-source contributions, published technical writing, or conference presentations

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Profondeur technique requise. Jugement architectural attendu.

Salesforce recrute des Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — les Bâtisseurs Techniques, responsables des décisions qui conduisent à la conception, au développement et au déploiement des solutions d'IA agentique les plus complexes directement dans les environnements clients entreprise. En étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Bâtisseur Stratégique - un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et favorise l'adoption), vous assumerez les résultats de bout en bout, de la décision d'architecture à la mise en production. Votre passion pour des logiciels bien conçus qui résolvent de vrais problèmes sera soutenue par des outils IA de premier plan et une équipe de bâtisseurs talentueux à vos côtés.
