Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About the Role

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it. 

What You'll Do

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.

  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).

  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.

  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.

  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.

  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.

  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.

  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.

  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.

  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.

  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.

  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.

  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.

  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.

  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.

  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.

  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.

  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.

  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.

  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.

  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.

  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.

  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.

  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.

  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

  • Understanding of ITIL framework, particularly incident, problem, and change management processes.

You will help articulate clear business facts, define requirements, and support critical design decisions to ensure our systems support our accounting needs.

As part of the Experience Services Competency in Salesforce Professional Services, the team is seeking a Business Strategy Senior Manager. The Business Strategy Senior Manager is responsible for ensuring overall delivery excellence and quality across Salesforce Professional Services customers. Partnering with C-level customers, Business Strategists craft innovative, industry-specific strategies that clearly define the vision, metrics, and roadmap to achieve desired business outcomes. They work with our key enterprise customers, partners, and technical delivery leaders to drive scale, speed to value, and a sustained landscape for future success. They bring deep expertise in enterprise business strategy, operating model design, and value realization — translating customer ambitions into actionable, multi-year programs. They have strong Public Sector consulting experience and a deep understanding of Business Strategy services deliverables. They strive to better understand and improve processes to help our Experience Services team thrive. The Business Strategy Senior Manager also partners with other roles on customer engagements to ensure customer and Salesforce Professional Services success.

We believe the best Business Strategists are those who obsess over the creation of customer and business value. They have a customer-centric and collaborative mentality, a willingness to commit to the customer, and the drive to break down barriers to ensure customer success.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Ability to develop industry POVs, including identifying market trends, responses, and solution offerings.

A proactive, resourceful, creative thinker with the ability to inspire others and who can navigate dynamic situations.

You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity.    

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments.
You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation.
This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle.
 

Responsibilities

  • Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams.

  • Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production.

  • Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths.

  • Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments.

  • Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally.

  • Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems.

  • Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities.

  • Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services.

  • Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services.

  • Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle — requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience.

  • Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization.

  • Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production.

  • Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.

  • Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.

  • Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.

  • Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.

     

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems.

  • Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems.

  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation.

  • Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems.

  • Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences.

  • Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security.

  • Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale.

  • Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies.

  • Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks.

  • Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies.

  • Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce's real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

Job Description: Product Management Director - Salesforce Success Plans


The Experience

The Customer Success (CS) Success Plan product management organization is responsible for managing Salesforce's Customer Success Plan offer portfolio (Standard, Premier, and Signature Success Plans) with which we enable our customers to realize value from their Salesforce technology investments. We work backward from the customer to address their needs across all customer segments (Small Business, Commercial, and Enterprise) and across all Salesforce products. The team is the "voice of the customer and market" to the rest of the CS organization and we work across all functions within CS and the Salesforce product organizations to continuously enhance the customer value and experience delivered by the Success Plans offer portfolio.

We're looking for a Product Management Director to build, justify, and operationalize changes to our Success Plans offers. This senior individual contributor (IC) role owns the path from evidence to execution: grounding decisions in customer and stakeholder research, developing and presenting the business cases — financial modeling included — that earn senior leadership alignment, and then owning the operating discipline that keeps those offers accountable once they're live, including feedback loops, performance reporting, and V2MOM updates. You'll also keep a close eye on industry trends, the market landscape, and Salesforce's AI roadmap, translating what you see into concrete implications, and drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers in market. This senior IC role reports to the Vice President, Product Management for Salesforce Success Plans.

Ideal candidates have deep Salesforce platform knowledge, proven Product Management experience (ideally in Customer Success), a strong record of turning strategy into actionable roadmaps, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Conduct customer and stakeholder research to understand needs, analyze feedback, and drive innovation.
  • Act as a thought leader and craft clear, concise and unbiased point of view documents on necessary changes to features, the portfolio, and the go-to-market (GTM) model.
  • Develop and present business cases for new offers or enhancements, including financial modeling, and secure senior leadership alignment.
  • Drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers
  • Own the operating rhythm behind the offer: feedback loops, offer performance reporting, and V2MOM updates, so the team stays accountable to its goals.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, the market landscape, and Salesforce's own AI roadmap so you can proactively flag implications to Success Plans



You're Our Person If...

  • Deep Salesforce Knowledge: You have a strong working knowledge of Salesforce products and a keen understanding of how enterprise software companies go to market.
  • A First-Principles Thinker: You don't just accept the status quo. You excel at breaking down ambiguous, complex business problems into their fundamental components and reassembling them into a coherent solution that is defensible with data.
  • Connect the Dots: You excel at systems thinking and can anticipate the second and third-order effects of a strategic decision. You naturally see how a change in one part of the business impacts another.
  • Proven Strategist: You have a background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a product management role that was heavily focused on monetization and business strategy. You have a portfolio of work that demonstrates your ability to drive significant strategic change.
  • Exceptional Communicator: You are a clear, concise writer and presenter. You can create the definitive document that persuades executives and aligns disparate teams on a complex issue.
  • Problem-Solver at Heart: You are not content to simply identify problems; you are driven to design the solution and see it through.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management or Strategy, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including packaging/pricing of B2B SaaS support, success, or services offerings
  • Track record owning a product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, GTM enablement, and post-launch iteration
  • Strong cross-functional influence skills — comfortable driving alignment across Sales, CS, and Marketing without direct reporting lines
  • Experience with subscription/tiered pricing models and customer retention/adoption metrics
  • Familiarity with how AI and agentic technologies (e.g., Agentforce) are changing customer adoption, enablement, and support needs — and how that translates into offer GTM decisions



Even Better If...

  • M.B.A.
  • Experience building or evolving offers/programs tied to AI-driven products, including how to measure and support customer success with agentic or generative AI capabilities

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

The Tableau Success Architect provides strategic technical guidance to our most important Tableau customers, helping them maximize value from their Tableau and Salesforce investments. What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor for strategic customers, providing architectural guidance and best practice recommendations for Tableau deployments.
  • Analyze customer requirements and business objectives, and translate them into clear, actionable technical recommendations and solution designs.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and provide optimization recommendations across data sources, dashboards, governance, and performance.
  • Support post-sales activities, resolving complex software issues, and ensuring smooth product configuration and optimization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (Sales, SE, Technical Support, Product) to deliver consistent and valuable customer experiences.
  • Build and present customized solutions and live product demonstrations to showcase how Salesforce and Tableau can accelerate business strategies. (Nice-to-have)
  • Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, coordinating timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables.



You're Our Person If...

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solution Engineering, Technical Support, or a related field.
  • Strong ability to analyze and structure customer requirements into clear technical recommendations and solution designs.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, enterprise BI, and web technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting mission-critical software applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Korean.



Even Better If...

  • Project Management experience — able to plan, coordinate, and drive multi-stakeholder engagements to completion.
  • Salesforce and/or Tableau certifications.
  • Proficiency in business intelligence tools like Tableau and/or building analytics data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Python/R, web development, and AI/statistical analysis.


The Experience

Tableau Success Architect는 Salesforce의 주요 전략 고객들을 대상으로 전략적인 기술 자문을 제공하며, 고객이 Tableau 및 Salesforce 투자로부터 최대한의 가치를 얻을 수 있도록 지원하는 역할입니다. 이 역할은 깊이 있는 Tableau/BI 전문성과 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 능력을 결합하여, 고객의 비즈니스 요구사항을 효과적인 기술 솔루션과 아키텍처 권고안으로 전환합니다.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 전략 고객을 위한 신뢰받는 기술 자문 역할을 수행하며, Tableau 도입에 대한 아키텍처 가이드와 모범 사례를 제공합니다.
  • 고객의 요구사항과 비즈니스 목표를 분석하고, 이를 명확하고 실행 가능한 기술적 권고안 및 솔루션 설계로 정리합니다.
  • 데이터 소스, 대시보드, 거버넌스, 성능 전반에 대한 아키텍처 리뷰 및 최적화 권고를 수행합니다.
  • 판매 후 활동을 지원하고 복잡한 소프트웨어 문제를 해결하며, 원활한 제품 구성 및 최적화를 보장합니다.
  • 영업, SE, 기술지원, 제품팀 등 여러 부서와 긴밀히 협력하여 일관되고 가치 있는 고객 경험을 제공합니다.
  • 맞춤형 솔루션과 라이브 제품 데모를 구축 및 발표하여 Salesforce와 Tableau가 비즈니스 전략을 신속하게 추진하는 방법을 보여줍니다. (Nice-to-have)
  • 여러 고객 인게이지먼트를 동시에 관리하며, 일정, 이해관계자, 결과물을 조율합니다.



You're Our Person If...

  • 컴퓨터 과학, 소프트웨어 공학, MIS 학사 또는 이와 동등한 관련 경력.
  • TAM(Technical Account Management), 솔루션 엔지니어링, 기술 지원 또는 관련 분야에서 10년 이상의 경력.
  • 고객 요구사항을 분석하고 이를 명확한 기술적 권고안과 솔루션 설계로 정리할 수 있는 강력한 능력.
  • 관계형 데이터베이스, 엔터프라이즈 BI, 웹 기술에 대한 탄탄한 지식.
  • 미션 크리티컬 소프트웨어 애플리케이션 문제 해결 경험.
  • 영어와 한국어 모두에서 뛰어난 서면 및 구두 커뮤니케이션 능력.



Even Better If...

  • PM(프로젝트 관리) 경력 — 다수의 이해관계자가 관여하는 인게이지먼트를 계획, 조율, 완수할 수 있는 능력.

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

Salesforce's platforms — including Core CRM and Marketing Cloud — let companies build, deliver, monitor, and scale their engagement with customers globally. Not everyone uses that access responsibly. We're looking for a Platform Trust and Safety Engineer who is dedicated to identifying and stopping abusers who commit fraud, phishing, and account takeover, or who otherwise use our services to make the internet a hostile space.

The Platform Defense and Safety (PDS) team detects and responds to malicious user activity — misuse, abuse, fraud, and crime — that occurs even when our systems are working as designed. At any given time, bad actors attempt to bypass detection and response systems by posing as legitimate customers to take unfair advantage of our services. Unlike account compromise, abuse tends to be a slow, simmering problem rather than a single event.

The Experience
 

  • Extensive experience in information security roles involving platform abuse, threat intelligence, incident response, or threat detection
  • Experience managing security or abuse investigations end to end: triage, evidence collection, risk assessment, containment, escalation, and closure
  • Specialization in at least one of: log analysis, file-level forensics, or data mining
  • Experience authoring detection rules using languages such as YARA or Splunk SPL, and comfort working from a command line



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build and tune detection and response rules in Splunk, and author and maintain automated response playbooks
  • Partner with our Office of Ethical Usage and Legal teams — including on regulatory reporting such as the EU Digital Services Act (DSA) — to keep our platforms free of malicious content
  • Identify and document anti-abuse tooling requirements for engineering teams, and evaluate third-party vendor tools to close detection gaps

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

Salesforce's Platform Security team protects the foundation that our customers, partners, and developers build on. We are hands-on security engineers who work closely with Product and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle.

As a Product Security Lead, you will be the technical security lead for the user-facing application and experience layers of the platform. This includes front-end frameworks, runtimes, and rendering surfaces, plus fast-growing AI agent experiences and web data-access surfaces that appear in our own products, third-party channels, and external agentic clients.

You will set the security bar for these areas by shaping how controls are designed and making secure patterns the default. With Agentforce woven into our platform, you will help define the trust model for the next generation of agent-driven experiences.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, or Seattle/Bellevue, WA, and is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead security assurance for the experience and user interface (UI) layer. Run threat modeling, security design reviews, and code review (JavaScript, TypeScript, and Java) across web frameworks, runtimes, rendering pipelines, and the data-access Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) beneath them. Design platform-level fixes for recurring weaknesses such as cross-site scripting (XSS), cross-site request forgery (CSRF), server-side request forgery (SSRF), injection, and broken access control.
  • Serve as the standing security lead for multi-release programs that span quarters and teams. Examples include expanding guest-user data access, rendering first-party experiences into third-party surfaces, and defining the trust model for agent-facing products.
  • Reduce AI and agentic risk. Address threats such as prompt injection, excessive agency, tool abuse, and memory poisoning. Design human approval steps for high-impact actions. Define least-privilege tool scoping, audit logging, and short-lived scoped credentials for Model Context Protocol (MCP) and connector integrations.
  • Set the standard and mentor others. Build secure patterns into frameworks, software development kits (SDKs), and rendering pipelines so unsafe code is hard to write. Author security guidelines that other teams adopt, and coach experienced developers on secure design.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 8+ years in product, application, or platform security, and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have deep expertise in web and application security, including the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) injection classes, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, broken access control, and the browser security model.
  • You have hands-on experience securing modern UI frameworks, web runtimes, and rendering pipelines, including guest-user or unauthenticated surfaces.
  • You have experience securing GraphQL and REST APIs, including authentication, cross-tenant data exposure, and abuse of expensive queries.
  • You have led threat modeling across complex web, UI, or data-access environments and driven findings to resolution.
  • You understand AI and large language model (LLM) risks in real product work, including prompt injection, tool abuse, and MCP connector security, and you know the controls that keep sensitive data from reaching an LLM.
  • You can review JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one other language, such as Java, Python, or Go, for design and source-code issues.
  • You have written security standards and led cross-team programs to measurable results, and you can influence experienced developers with clear, actionable review feedback.



Even Better If...

  • You have secured UI frameworks or data-access APIs at scale for a large multi-tenant software-as-a-service (SaaS) product.
  • You have hands-on experience with LLM application security or agent frameworks.
  • You have bug bounty or red-team experience.

Unleash Your Potential

Job Title: Senior Product Security Engineer

The Experience

  • Salesforce's Platform Security team protects the platform that our customers, partners, and developers build on. We are hands-on security engineers who work closely with Product and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you secure the platform's integration and service-connectivity layer. This includes events, messaging, connectors, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and the agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors that let external tools and AI models talk to the platform.
  • You help a fast-moving Engineering organization ship safely. You do this through threat modeling, design and code reviews, and secure-by-default guidance. You also get to shape how AI agents connect securely to the world's #1 AI CRM.
  • This role is based in San Francisco, CA, or Seattle/Bellevue, WA and is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for the platform's event, messaging, and integration pathways, connectors, and APIs that move customer data between systems. Trace issues to their root cause so fixes land in the right place.
  • Secure service-to-service authentication, external client apps, and agent and MCP connectors, where excessive privilege, secret leakage, and misuse of delegated access are key threats.
  • Build secure-by-default patterns into frameworks, connector software development kits (SDKs), and onboarding paths. Review Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript code in a large codebase to validate design assumptions and find risk in authentication, integration, and access-control flows.
  • Partner with architects, engineers, and product owners to move findings to resolution, and mentor junior security engineers on secure design and threat modeling.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in product, application, or platform security.
  • You have hands-on experience securing backend, integration, or service-connectivity systems, including API security (REST and GraphQL authentication, rate limiting, and input validation).
  • You have working experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and JSON Web Tokens (JWT), plus service-to-service authentication and permission models.
  • You have reviewed source code in Java and at least one other language (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Go) to confirm security risk.



Even Better If...

  • You have secured eventing, messaging, integration, or API platforms at scale.
  • You have connector security, agent integration, or MCP experience, including how trust boundaries work in agentic systems beyond basic prompt injection.
  • You have multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) backend security experience at the application layer.
  • You have served as the embedded security subject-matter expert (SME) for a product area.

For our customers who wish to get the most value out of Salesforce with an enterprise experience and the fastest support, delivered by our most skilled experts, they purchase our Signature Success Plan. Signature drives the right insights and people at the right time - which can make all the difference. When you have Signature, you unlock our deepest level of partnership, most skilled expertise, and tools to stay agile.


We are currently looking for a versatile Customer Success Manager with expertise in Salesforce to join our team. In this role, you will act as an extension of our customer's workforce, offering guidance and advice to ensure they receive a significant return on investment with Salesforce.

As a CSM, you will be responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns and requests, aligning them with customer priorities, projects, and problems. You will bring senior-level expertise and will be responsible for coordinating all deliverables the customer is entitled to, including overseeing the day-to-day customer experience from onboarding through Signature contract renewal and expansion. As the main point of contact for the account's success, you will work closely with Product Management, Sales, Technical Support, and Engineering to lead the customer relationship.

Your impact will be to serve as the Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the customer's technical and operational configuration and needs. Act as the single point of accountability for orchestrating all Signature deliverables, the customer experience, renewals, and expansion. Cultivate and maintain relationships with the customer's IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers in organizations that have purchased Signature.


Shift Timings: Candidate should be comfortable working in 24*7 shifts (specifically Night shifts) and the below timings are subject to change basis the business need. (5.30/6.30 PM - 2:30/3:30 AM) IST
  

Responsibilities:

  • Customer Success Advocacy: Act as the primary point of contact, leveraging deep industry, product, and technical knowledge to guide them to achieve business objectives 
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Develop and nurture strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, aligning with customer needs across various market segments, sizes, and solution complexities. 
  • Strategic Guidance: Assess customer goals and capabilities, offer recommendations for ecosystem health, performance optimization, and achieving business and technology objectives.
  • Business Value Delivery: Cultivate executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership, solidifying partnership commitments and driving innovation aligned with customers' business challenges and growth potential.
  • Adoption Path & Enablement: Contribute to SF  knowledge, community, and training resources, comprehensive adoption plans showcasing current and future states, enabling the customer through an underlying roadmap.
  • Technical Expertise Application: Apply SF / tech product knowledge to address technical concerns, ensure acceptable resolutions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps. Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities
  • Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs
  • Operate with an AI First approach to account management, using Salesforce Einstein and AI-powered health scoring as the primary lens for monitoring customer sentiment, product adoption, and engagement across your book of business
  • Use Agentforce and generative AI tools to build and personalize executive business reviews, success plans, renewal narratives, and strategic communications — with human judgment applied to tone, accuracy, and customer context
  • Apply AI-generated insights to proactively identify expansion opportunities, adoption gaps, and churn risk indicators, taking timely and targeted action to protect and grow revenue
  • Leverage AI to automate meeting preparation, call summarization, and follow-up documentation, freeing capacity for higher-value customer engagement


​Required Skills:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce product and platform features, governance principles, methodologies, and enterprise architecture.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to prioritize customer needs, take ownership, and drive resolutions.
  • Experience with databases, SQL, Windows/Linux Server, and security infrastructure. Strong technical skills or the ability to acquire in-depth knowledge.
  • Demonstrated AI First approach to account management — you use AI as your default starting point across workflow, communication, and planning, not as an occasional aid
  • Experience using AI features within Salesforce (Einstein, Agentforce) and customer success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, Catalyst) to manage and grow a book of business
  • Ability to interpret AI-generated health signals and account insights with sound judgment, translating outputs into meaningful customer conversations and action plans
  • Proficiency using generative AI to draft, personalize, and refine customer-facing communications with a strong eye for quality, accuracy, and brand standards
  • Diligent. Nothing gets overlooked.
  • This position will require you to work from your local Salesforce office 3 days a week
     

​Preferred Skills:

  • Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, and/or Solutions Architecture, and +2 years in Salesforce Ecosystem.
  • Demonstrating expertise in Salesforce Technical, (Lightning, Apex, Customisation, Implementation, Product knowledge, Major releases of Salesforce, Different Clouds knowledge, etc.). Strong consulting skills and validated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
  • Candidates currently in roles such as Salesforce Technical Architect, Salesforce Solution Architect, Salesforce Business Analyst, Salesforce Functional Consultant, Salesforce Technical Lead, Salesforce Technical Account Manager, Salesforce Team Lead, or Salesforce Senior Technical Consultant—with a strong ability to manage customer relationships—are encouraged to apply for this position.
  • Salesforce product certifications are a plus (Marketing Associate, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Salesforce Certified Associate, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist).
  • Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
  • Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce product suite and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy, including knowledge of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem.
  • Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a deeply technical engineer who thrives at the intersection of software development, security infrastructure, and platform engineering.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end software development across complex security data pipelines from ingestion to canonical data stores and downstream consumers.
  • Own system architecture for endpoint protection platforms, including authoring System Design Records (SDRs) and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Drive platform reliability through availability monitoring strategies, alerting frameworks, and infrastructure hardening.
  • Design and build APIs and services including REST API optimization, policy evaluation engines, integration adapter registries, and projection/aggregation services.
  • Set engineering standards across the team for code quality, design consistency, and documentation practices.
  • Mentor and guide other engineers on team through PR reviews, sprint planning, and technical deep dives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with security architects, platform teams, and partner engineering orgs to ensure clean system integration and dependency alignment
  • Support on-call operations on a rotating schedule, including flexibility for major incidents across time zones.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, enforce engineering rigor, and support multi-language development.
  • Ensure company and customer data remains secure, utilizing knowledge of a wide variety of security disciplines, including network, application and infrastructure security.
  • Audit Salesforce cloud infrastructure against industry and company security standards, develop uplift plan, and execute on plan to align cloud infrastructure with those standards.
  • Collaborate with various internal teams, including infrastructure, engineering, operations, and product development to design and architect infrastructure (i.e. network, operating system, databases) and applications to protect against attackers.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical specialist, responsible for handling the complex and detailed technical work necessary to establish and maintain enhanced cloud security.
  • Architect, configure, manage, and deploy technologies to improve Salesforce's ability to prevent intrusions. Track down targeted vulnerabilities and defend against active adversaries. Research, gather threat intelligence and build, optimize, and automate systems to consume threat feeds and track adversaries
  • Create innovative solutions to complex security problems, including the design and use of software to identify security issues, deploy security solutions, and perform reporting activities
  • Mentor and guide engineering teams to achieve team deliverables.
  • Communicate clearly to both Engineering and Executive audiences.



You're Our Person If...

  • 7+ years of core software development experience with mastery in multiple programming languages and platforms.
  • Strong foundation in database engineering, API development, and data pipeline construction, including experience with event-driven architectures, and distributed systems
  • Demonstrated ability to craft and deliver large, sophisticated projects across the full software lifecycle, including experience with products released for public consumption across multiple releases.
  • Proven experience with infrastructure hardening and operational reliability (alerting, availability monitoring, MTTR reduction).
  • Ability to design systems at scale including experience with architecture reviews, design documentation, and cross-team alignment; experience working with engineering teams, architects, and executive leadership to craft architectural vision and roadmap.
  • Develops technical performance architecture that solves the most complex performance and scalability challenges, with the ability to drive long-term design strategies spanning multiple complex projects.
  • Strong engineering process discipline: PR reviews, design reviews, sprint execution, and documentation; experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and short release cycles
  • Ability to provide mentorship to team members, supporting their understanding of architecture and aiding in their technical growth
  • Skilled at fostering cross-functional technical collaboration to surface, escalate, and resolve critical issues effectively.
  • Ability to deliver technical reports and performance presentations to customers and at industry events
  • A related technical degree required



Even Better If...

  • Familiarity with security tooling ecosystems
  • Experience working on or with security data pipelines
  • You have 5+ years experience in a computer network-related occupation
  • You have 2+ years experience in each of the following skills:
  • Unix/Linux system administration, including working with Windows environments and hardening guidelines;
  • Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure and other public and private cloud infrastructure (EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, EMR, IAM); and

The Experience

Salesforce Data Security is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale our unified certificate Registration Authority (RA), the front door for cryptographic trust across our global multi-cloud platform. This foundational trust layer authenticates and authorizes millions of certificate issuance requests daily, securing machine-to-machine communication, workload identity, and data-in-transit for the world's most trusted enterprise cloud. You lead the technical design and delivery of a highly concurrent, multi-substrate Go codebase, stay deep in the code while mentoring senior engineers, and drive architectural consensus across a distributed system where availability and security are non-negotiable. This is an AI-first engineering team: you use advanced AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, and shared-system-context tools daily to accelerate your workflows, review code, and generate comprehensive tests, setting the standard for AI-augmented software development.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain the unified Registration Authority (RA) that serves as the single certificate-issuance front door for a global, multi-cloud platform.

  • Design and optimize highly concurrent, multi-substrate build paths in Go, ensuring seamless deployment across diverse public-cloud environments.

  • Develop and scale both synchronous and asynchronous certificate issuance paths using robust distributed state-machine orchestration.

  • Implement strictly evaluated hierarchical policy engines and authorization controls to validate substrate-specific workload identity and attestation.

  • Drive robust certificate lifecycle management and automation by integrating with and abstracting multiple public and private Certificate Authorities (CAs).

  • Lead the team's engineering excellence by writing resilient, observable, and strictly tested code capable of surviving underlying infrastructure degradation.

  • Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow, pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.

  • Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.

  • Contribute to building and maintaining shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably, and critically evaluate code (human- or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 9+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.

  • You have deep, production-grade expertise in Go (Golang), Java, or Rust, including advanced concurrency patterns, memory management, and multi-substrate build configurations.

  • You have extensive experience deploying and operating highly available, mission-critical services across public cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • You can design resilient Representational State Transfer (RESTful) and gRPC web services, backed by robust distributed state machines and asynchronous processing pipelines.

  • You have a strong background in observability (telemetry, distributed tracing, metrics) and modern continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) deployment pipelines.

  • You are proficient with AI coding assistants and shared-context workflows that enhance engineering velocity.

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Even Better If...

  • You have deep domain knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), X.509 certificate profiles, and mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) architectures.

  • You have a strong understanding of certificate lifecycle management and automated certificate provisioning.

  • You are aware of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, such as Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), and crypto-agility design principles.

The Experience

Our Public Cloud engineering teams are responsible for innovating and maintaining a large scale distributed systems engineering platform that ships hundreds of features to production for tens of millions of users across all industries every day. Our users count on our platform to be highly reliable, lightning fast, supremely secure, and to preserve all of their customizations and integrations every time we ship.

You will need deep experience with concurrency, large scale systems, proficiency with solving real-world data management challenges, a strong understanding of how to craft solutions that are highly available, and a proven ability to design, develop, and optimize the core back-end systems. This role requires advanced prompt engineering skills — the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Deliver cloud infrastructure automation tools, frameworks, workflows, and validation platforms on our public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba
  • Designing, developing, debugging, and operating resilient distributed systems that run across thousands of compute nodes in multiple data centers
  • Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude, OpenAI API) to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.
  • Using and contributing to open source technology (Spinnaker, Zookeeper, etc.)

About Slack & The Role

Slack is at an inflection point. We're evolving from the world's most beloved team communication tool into something fundamentally new: an AI operating system where humans and agents work together to get things done. This isn't incremental improvement. It's a reimagining of how work happens.

As Slack VP, Product Design (Individual Contributor; Principal Architect) you will be one of the most important design voices shaping that future. This is not a management role. It's a rare seat at the table for a designer who wants to define the product; to hold the vision, drive the craft, and personally execute at the highest level on the next generation of Slack.

You will report to the SVP & Chief Design Officer and partner deeply with product and engineering leadership to prototype, pressure-test, and shape the platform Slack must become. You'll make work that millions of people use every day and you'll help us make the hardest design problems look inevitable in hindsight.

The Opportunity: Designing Slack as the AI Operating System for Action

Slack's defining role in this next era is as the context layer for work: the intelligent interface where humans and AI agents collaborate fluidly to drive outcomes. Built on context, Slack becomes the single, personalized command center that replaces fragmented apps, inboxes, and point solutions.

As Slack VP, Product Design (Individual Contributor; Principal Architect) you will be the designer helping us answer the hardest questions at the frontier of this transformation:

  • Human-Agent Collaboration: What are the right interaction models for a world where AI agents are co-workers? How do agents present information, take action, and hand back control in ways that feel natural, not jarring?
  • Radical Simplification: How do we strip Slack down to its most essential, powerful form while making it capable of far more? How do we absorb complexity so users never have to feel it?
  • Dynamic & Ambient Interfaces: How do we design surfaces that appear when and where decisions need to be made (across voice, mobile, wearables, and desktop) rather than requiring users to navigate to them?
  • The AI Operating System: What does it look like when Slack becomes the single pane of glass for every kind of worker: the CEO, the service agent, the developer, the sales rep? How do we make that feel personal and not overwhelming?

Key Responsibilities

  • Vision & Concept Design: Define and prototype the long-range design vision for Slack's agentic future, producing the seminal concepts and vignettes that align the organization and inspire the roadmap
  • Executional Craft: Personal, hands-on design at the highest level, pixel-perfect, conceptually sharp, deeply considered. Uses whatever tools work best (AI, code, and emerging prototyping techniques) to turn ideas into working experiences fast, explore possibilities, and raise the bar. The bar you set becomes the bar for the team.
  • Strategic Design Influence: Partner with the CDO, CPO, and Engineering leadership to shape product strategy through design. Influence decisions at the SVP and C-level through the power of your work and your thinking
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive alignment across product, engineering, research, and brand through the quality and clarity of your design work, without needing formal authority
  • Simplification as a Design Discipline: Lead the work to radically simplify Slack's current experience, defining what we kill, what we keep, and what we transform as we move toward an AI-first paradigm
  • Emerging Interaction Patterns: Invent new design patterns for agentic UX, for voice-anchored experiences, ambient AI surfaces, multiplayer human-agent co-creation, and dynamic UI generation
  • User Advocacy at Scale: Be a relentless champion for the user, particularly the enterprise user under pressure; the worker with 500 unread messages, zero configuration tolerance, and no time to learn a new paradigm

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of product design experience, with senior IC work at significant scale
  • A portfolio that demonstrates both visionary concept work and exceptional executional craft
  • Proven ability to define product direction through design, not just respond to it
  • Experience designing consumer-grade experiences, deeply intuitive, delightful, effortless, in complex product contexts
  • A track record of influencing product strategy at the leadership level without relying on hierarchy
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; can make complex ideas simple and make simple ideas compelling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for AI, machine learning, or human-agent collaboration. Ideally at the interaction pattern level, not just the UI level
  • Experience with enterprise software and the unique constraints of B2B SaaS at scale
  • Familiarity with emerging modalities: voice UX, ambient/wearable surfaces, AI-generated UI
  • Experience working directly with C-suite leadership to define and evolve product vision
  • Understanding of Slack, its ecosystem, and what makes it uniquely powerful; and what needs to change

What Makes This Role Different

Most senior IC design roles ask you to execute within a defined vision. This one asks you to be the vision while still doing the work. You'll have the strategic altitude of a leadership role and the craft latitude of a builder role. You'll ship things that change how millions of people experience their working lives.

If you've ever looked at a product you love and thought "I could take this somewhere no one's been yet"...this is that role.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineering - Data Science & Integration
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

*Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship with the ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role.**

**Candidates interested in the Hawaii location must be based in Oahu or DC, Northern VA, WMATA.**

**PLEASE NOTE: Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation as well as your having and maintaining the specific level of U.S. government background investigation and clearance required for this role.**

---

About the Role

We believe technology should serve the greater good—powering mission outcomes, stewarding taxpayer resources, and enabling innovation at speed and scale. We are seeking a highly accomplished and senior-level Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our elite Public Sector team. This is a unique and high-impact position, blending the roles of a hands-on data scientist, integration architect, and strategic partner embedded directly with customers.

In this role, you will be the primary driver for bringing cutting-edge data science pipelines, intelligent automation, and enterprise integration solutions to life for mission-critical work across the U.S. Department of Defense, Intelligence Community (IC), and Aerospace & Allied Nations.

This role demands a seasoned technologist who thrives working forward-deployed at customer sites, building bespoke solutions leveraging enterprise workflow orchestration platforms such as Regrello and API-led connectivity platforms such as MuleSoft, while also designing and delivering advanced AI/ML systems. Candidates with equivalent experience in comparable platforms are strongly encouraged to apply; direct experience with these specific tools is a plus. You will work directly with mission owners and internal teams—from initial concept through deployment and ongoing optimization—to solve the most complex data and integration challenges in national security environments.

---

Mission Impact

- Deploy Cutting-Edge Data Science & Integration Innovation—from API-led integration ecosystems to orchestrated operational workflows to advanced ML pipelines—directly at customer sites in defense, intelligence, and aerospace environments, accelerating mission transformation. Experience with platforms such as MuleSoft and Regrello, or comparable tools, is leveraged to deliver these outcomes.

-Become a Trusted Partner Embedded with Mission Owners, working in classified and unclassified environments to deeply understand operational challenges and translate them into end-to-end data science and integration solutions using best-fit tooling.

- Drive Innovation at the Front Lines by serving as the connective bridge between customer missions and internal engineering teams, gathering frontline feedback to help co-design integration patterns, workflow templates, and data science capabilities that strengthen national security outcomes.

- Improve Efficiency, Mission-Readiness, and Trust by helping the U.S. and allied governments deploy integrated data technology stacks that deliver faster response times, better personnel utilization, and more effective logistics and asset management.

- Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation, taking responsibility for end-to-end technical delivery of complex data pipelines, integration flows, and predictive models—personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues in the field while guiding junior team members.

- Build Transformative Data Science Solutions by taking primary ownership of designing, developing, and implementing high-quality, scalable production ML and analytics systems, including predictive models, intelligent automation pipelines, and LLM-augmented workflows.

-Engineer Bespoke Integration Architectures, designing and building custom API-led integrations using enterprise integration platforms—such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or equivalent middleware solutions—to ensure seamless connectivity across enterprise data sources, operational systems, and cloud environments in highly regulated settings. Demonstrated experience with comparable iPaaS or API management platforms (e.g., Dell Boomi, Azure API Management, Apigee, AWS API Gateway) is strongly considered; direct MuleSoft experience is a plus.

- Orchestrate Complex Workflows, leveraging modern workflow automation and process orchestration platforms—such as Regrello or equivalent solutions—to model, automate, and optimize multi-stakeholder operational processes in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and mission operations contexts. Candidates with hands-on experience in comparable platforms (e.g., Temporal, Prefect, Apache Airflow, ServiceNow) are strongly encouraged to apply; direct Regrello experience is a plus.

- Own the Entire Data Lifecycle- on-site with customers—from strategic data modeling to hands-on ETL/ELT pipeline construction, feature engineering, and integration strategy—ensuring data is always ready, optimized, and secure for advanced analytics and AI applications.

- Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration, developing proofs-of-concept and MVPs side-by-side with customer teams to demonstrate data science and integration capabilities and set the pace for rapid, mission-aligned delivery.

---

Mission Responsibilities

- Serve as the forward-deployed technical lead on high-profile customer engagements—designing, building, and deploying tailored data science and integration solutions for defense, intelligence, and aerospace missions on-site.

- Architect and implement enterprise integration solutions—using platforms such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or equivalent iPaaS tooling—including API design, development, and management across REST, SOAP, and event-driven integration patterns within secure customer environments.

- Design and deploy workflow automation solutions—leveraging platforms such as Regrello or equivalent orchestration tooling—to model complex operational processes, coordinate cross-functional teams, and surface data-driven insights at key mission decision points.

- Lead integration of AI/ML models, custom data pipelines, and automation flows that enable predictive maintenance, personnel planning, and mission-critical logistics decisions.

- Work with customer IT and security teams to accelerate Authority to Operate (ATO) and production go-lives per DoD IL5/IL6 and applicable regulatory frameworks.

- Partner with internal product and engineering teams to co-develop integration patterns and data science capabilities informed by frontline customer feedback.

- Enable customers to adopt modern data platforms and integration middleware for field operations, asset visibility, command center analytics, and secure operational workflows.

- Mentor junior FDEs and share lessons learned with the broader engineering community to shape playbooks, integration templates, and reusable data science assets for government innovation.

- Translate mission priorities into actionable data and integration roadmaps aligned with agency strategy, presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

---

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a builder, a problem solver, and a mission-first leader who thrives in forward-deployed environments. The ideal candidate brings:

- 8+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions, ideally in customer-facing or field-deployed settings.

- Strong background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline.

- Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, SQL).

- Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions, including model development, MLOps pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).

- Demonstrated expertise in enterprise integration platforms and API-led connectivity design, with experience in tools such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Dell Boomi, Apigee, Azure API Management, or equivalent; direct MuleSoft experience is a plus.

- Demonstrated expertise in workflow orchestration and process automation platforms, with experience in tools such as Regrello, Temporal, Prefect, Apache Airflow, or equivalent; direct Regrello experience is a plus.

- Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, and analytics with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift).

- A "get-things-done" attitude with a proven ability to deliver fast and impactfully in ambiguous, customer-site environments.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills—able to articulate complex data science and integration concepts to both technical and non-technical mission stakeholders.

- Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior FDEs, and own technical delivery end-to-end.

- **Ability to travel 50-75% of the time to customer sites, including classified facilities.**

- **Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship.**

- **Eligible for and willing to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance.**

---

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in a forward-deployed, field engineer, or embedded technical advisor role with direct customer engagement.

- Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), or Federal Civilian agencies.

- Background in defense, aerospace, or military logistics operations.

- Familiarity with IL5/IL6/CNSS #1253 requirements or deployment to classified environments.

- Direct hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including advanced DataWeave and Runtime Fabric deployments.

- Direct hands-on experience with Regrello for operational workflow orchestration in manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics domains.

- Expert-level Python and/or Java proficiency in a professional data science or integration engineering setting.

- Experience developing and deploying LLM-augmented solutions within highly regulated or classified industries.

- Relevant platform certifications such as:
- MuleSoft Certified Developer / Architect
- Databricks Certified Associate/Professional
- AWS/GCP/Azure Data or ML Engineer certifications
- Data Science and Analysis Certifications or relevant experience

- Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and streaming data pipelines.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices in regulated environments.

This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.
