Job Title: Senior Product Security Engineer, Infrastructure
Job Category: Technology / Security
Location: San Francisco, CA or Bellevue, WA

The Experience

Join our Infrastructure Product Security Assurance team as a Senior Product Security Engineer, where you play a pivotal role in fortifying the bedrock of Salesforce's entire product ecosystem. In this highly impactful position, you leverage deep technical expertise to provide strategic security guidance and leadership to engineering teams responsible for our foundational services, including technical controls, infrastructure databases, and monitoring tools across public cloud platforms.

As a trusted security engineer, you serve as the primary point of contact for engineering partners and leadership, cultivating strong relationships and delivering critical security recommendations. Your contributions directly shape and enhance the security posture of our core infrastructure platforms, ensuring the resilience and integrity of Salesforce's offerings.

Our team specializes in providing deep architectural and infrastructure security expertise across a diverse range of technologies, both on-premises and in public cloud environments, including web applications, distributed systems, and virtualized infrastructures. You champion secure software development lifecycle (SSDL) best practices, empowering engineering teams to build secure products from the ground up.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Provide expert security advisory for large-scale cloud initiatives, offering strategic guidance to engineering teams on complex enterprise architectures across the application and infrastructure stack.
  • Drive proactive security through architecture and threat modeling, partnering with engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities and develop risk mitigation plans throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Influence secure design and implementation by collaborating with product teams to recommend design solutions that balance functional goals with security requirements.
  • Align security priorities with business risk by working with Product Business Information Security Officers (BISOs) to curate and prioritize risk-based security initiatives, and by analyzing risk signals and emerging threats to shape security roadmaps.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5-8 years of experience in a security engineering, security architecture, or security assurance role.
  • Cloud Security: You have experience securing products and infrastructure across one or more public cloud environments (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, or equivalent), with an understanding of cloud service models, shared responsibility boundaries, and identity primitives at scale.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment: You have experience conducting structured security design reviews and threat modeling across infrastructure and application security domains, with familiarity with common vulnerability classes (Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10, Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Top 25), and can evaluate and communicate security risk to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Identity, Access, and Network Fundamentals: You understand authentication and authorization patterns including Open Authorization (OAuth) / OpenID Connect (OIDC), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), service-to-service authentication, and API authorization models, as well as TCP/IP, Transport Layer Security (TLS), network segmentation, and key management, certificate lifecycles, secrets handling, and encryption standards.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams toward secure outcomes without relying on direct organizational authority.



Even Better If...

  • You can reason through abuse cases and attack paths, not just defensive recommendations, with some familiarity with penetration testing methodologies or offensive security techniques.
  • You have experience participating in or driving improvements to a secure development lifecycle, security review process, or security advisory program within an engineering organization.
  • You can work with structured data, identify patterns across a broad service portfolio, and propose mitigations that address root causes rather than individual findings.
  • You can read and reason about code in one or more languages common in cloud-native engineering environments — particularly Java, Go, or Python — and have hands-on familiarity with container orchestration and workload security (Kubernetes, Docker, service mesh such as Istio), secrets/key management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) tooling, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and vulnerability scanning tools, or static analysis (SAST) and infrastructure-as-code security scanning.

AI agents are reshaping how companies automate decisions, orchestrate processes, and engage customers at scale. But AI is only as powerful as the data foundation behind it. As Commercial Account Executive within these teams, you will drive transformational outcomes for our customers using market-leading integration and data management technologies.

Our Commercial segment is made up of two subsegments - Mid-Market and General Business. These segments focus on selling into different company sizes:

  • Mid-Market- 200-1000 Employees
  • General Business - 1000-5000 Employees



This single posting covers two distinct selling tracks:

  • Data Foundation Account Executive (Quarterback / Prime AE): You are the overall account owner and leader of the backend data strategy. Carrying a dual-product quota across MuleSoft and Informatica ACV, you own long-term account growth and orchestrate extended team resources—including Informatica specialists—to deliver the complete data foundation story.
  • Informatica Account Executive (Specialist AE): You are the deep domain expert for Informatica's Intelligent Data Management Cloud™ (IDMC). Partnering directly with Prime Account Executives, you uncover complex digital transformation opportunities, advise C-level executives, and drive maximum value from Informatica investments within larger account strategies.



Industry Verticals

  • Healthcare & Life Sciences
  • Financial Services
  • Retail & Consumer Goods
  • Manufacturing, Automotive, and Energy
  • Consumer & Business Services
  • High Tech, Media and Telco
  • Travel, Transportation and Hospitality



Why Join Either Team?

  • Data Foundation AE (Prime): Total portfolio ownership—drive end-to-end strategy and uncapped ACV growth with two flagship solutions (MuleSoft + Informatica) under one quota.
  • Informatica AE (Specialist): Pure domain focus—drive high-value IDMC deals by teaming up with established Prime AEs who open doors to C-suite relationships and top accounts.
  • The Unfair Advantage: Sell the #1 priority for C-suites—turning "static data" into "agentic action"—with a portfolio no single competitor can match.
  • The Power Trio: Stand at the center of enterprise AI by bringing together MuleSoft for API-led integration, Informatica for deep data governance and quality, and Data Cloud to bridge the "Data Gap" holding AI back.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Relationship Building: Establish executive presence and trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite decision-makers and key technical stakeholders.
  • Strategy & Execution: Build and execute long-term, objective-aligned account plans that drive customer business outcomes.
  • Resource Orchestration: Align cross-functional internal teams (SEs, Product Specialists, Cloud Sales, and Executives) to accelerate deal velocity.
  • Value Messaging: Articulate the combined power of MuleSoft, Informatica, and the broader Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Pipeline Generation: Drive net-new opportunity creation through target whitespace prospecting and warm lead expansion.
  • Role Focus:Data Foundation AE: Dual-quota attainment, primary account ownership, and overarching platform strategy.Informatica AE: IDMC domain expertise, specialist execution, and driving targeted data expansion inside Prime accounts.



You're Our Person If...

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 戦略的伴走とロードマップ策定:顧客のビジネス・技術目標をヒアリングし、現状分析から目標達成を加速する「導入パス(アダプション・パス)」やイネーブルメント計画を策定・実行する。顧客と共にロードマップを作成し、四半期ごとにQBR(Quarterly Business Review)を実施する。
  • 製品活用とガバナンス推進:Salesforce全クラウド・製品群(Sales、Service、Slack、Tableau等)の機能を駆使して活用を推進し、組織戦略・ガバナンス・変更管理(チェンジマネジメント)のベストプラクティスを指導する。
  • プロジェクトのオーケストレーションとリスク管理:顧客の期待値に応じた支援プランを立案・推進し、社内リソース(SA、アーキテクト、営業等)を適宜アサイン・連携させる。目的達成に対するリスクを早期に察知し、アカウントチームと協力して軽減策を講じる。
  • エグゼクティブ・コミュニケーション:CIO、CTO、ビジネス役員などの経営層・意思決定者とエグゼクティブレベルの関係を築き、安定稼動やビジネス効果創出をリードする。技術的な製品変更、障害、サポート終了(EOL)などのアップデートを能動的に伝達する。

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。


The Experience

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) leverages deep business, industry, and product knowledge to partner with customers on a Signature support plan (each CSM managing 2–5 accounts). This role builds strong relationships from executive leadership to the front line, driving value realization through Salesforce products and maximizing return on investment (ROI).

Build a roadmap together with the customer and conduct quarterly QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews).

Overview of the role


As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales, owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, translating complex business objectives into enticing, practical recommendations that drive real change.

  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges.

Key Professional Skills

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage and influence internal and external stakeholders, navigating different interests to reach a common goal.

  • Communication & Presence: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. You are good at explaining complex ideas and finding ways to keep an audience’s attention.
  • Prioritisation: Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Experience & Adaptability

  • Industry Insight: Ability to understand business requirements within multiple industries and translate them into a compelling vision and roadmap.

  • Agility: Comfortable working as part of a team to tackle problems in energizing environments and willing to travel occasionally.

  • Fluency in English plus one or more additional languages is required from the following: Spanish, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian.

  • Salesforce Ecosystem: Existing Salesforce product knowledge and certifications (e.g., AI Associate, Administrator, or Cloud Consultant) are highly preferred.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

  • Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

  • Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

  • Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

  • Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.

  • If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!

  • Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

  • Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

  • Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

  • Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

  • Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

  • Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

  • Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

  • Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

  • Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.

  • External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

  • Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

  • AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

  • Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

  • Hands-On Development - Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.

  • Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

  • Curiosity & Continuous Learning - Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting-edge technologies.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Expertise - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.

  • Advanced Integration - Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).

  • Governance & Observability - Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

  • Cross-Platform Background - Background in cross-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).

  • Multimodal Pipelines - Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.

本ポジションはEngagement managerとしてコンシューマビジネスや通信メディア事業の顧客(消費財メーカー、小売、ユーティリティ、旅行・運輸、製薬、通信、メディア業)の大規模な変革プロジェクトのあるべき姿やプロジェクトアプローチを策定し、また自らそのプロジェクトの実行を推進・リードすることにより、顧客とその変革プロジェクトを成功に導くために重要な役割を果たします。大きく2つの役割があります。

  • 顧客へのプロジェクト提案アカウントパートナー（サービスセールス担当者）と連携して、SalesforceのProfessional Servicesによるコンサルティングプロジェクト、インプリメンテーションプロジェクト等の提案を行い、受注前および受注後の提案活動を主導します。特にプロジェクト提案にあたって、顧客の課題、変革プロジェクトの目的から最適なプロジェクトアプローチを策定すること、必要なサービスリソースを特定するために、アカウントパートナーだけでなく組織全体の他の専門領域のメンバーと協力することが求められます。
  • プロジェクト成功に導くリーダーシッププロジェクト受注後にインダストリーまたはデリバリーのエキスパートとしてプロジェクト全体を推進、または支援し、プロジェクトを成功させること、最終的に顧客の成功に導くことに責任を持ちます。顧客のエグゼクティブとの関係を構築・維持すること、プロアクティブにプロジェクトの品質を高めること、また組織全体の専門領域のメンバーと協力することで必要な知見等をプロジェクトにもたらすよう働きかけることが求められます。


特に通信/メディア業界を中心とした顧客に対するコンサルティングビジネスの拡大に貢献いただきます。このロールでは、組織の関係者と協業しながら、顧客との関係性をどう構築するのか、SalesforceのProfessional ServicesをどうSellingするのかを裁量を持って働くことができます。戦略的で自由な発想を活かし、次のSalesforce Servicesのビジネスを作り上げる意欲のある方を採用したいと考えています。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 顧客固有の実装提案、SOW、人員配置計画の策定を主導し、組織全体の他の専門領域メンバと協力して、受け入れ可能な提案について合意形成を図ります。
  • アカウントセールスおよびサービスセールスと緊密に連携して、スコーピング、ソリューション作成、SOW作成、プロジェクト人員配置などのプリセールス活動に責任を持ちます。
  • プロフェッショナルサービスチームに、提案されたソリューションと顧客ニーズに関係する専門家としての知見を提供し、プロジェクトを確実に成功させます。
  • カスタマーサクセスに適切かつ必要な場合は、エンゲージメントのライフサイクル全体にわたってプロジェクトチームを直接リード、または支援し、プロジェクトの成功に貢献します。
  • プロジェクトチームと連携し、アカウントチームおよびデリバリーチームの両方へのエスカレーションポイントとして機能します。
  • 複数の戦略的顧客を同時にマネジメントし、新しい潜在顧客のリファレンスになりそうなプロジェクトを意図的に構築・実行することで、ビジネス拡大に貢献します。
  • 重要なエスカレーションやリスクのあるアカウントに対して、将来を見越したリスクの軽減やマネジメントをします。
  • 社内外のリーダーや幹部と効果的、且つ適切にコミュニケーションします。


Even Better If...

  • 10年以上のコンサルティングサービスのデリバリー経験、または同等以上の事業会社での経験（グループITの内製化組織の立ち上げ、実行、マネジメント、事業会社内部での変革プロジェクト・DXプロジェクト等の遂行等）
  • 実務経験に裏付けられた業務コンサルティング、または、IT技術やアプリケーション機能、プロジェクトマネジメントに対する知識・経験（トランスフォーメーションの企画、業務構築、ソリューション作成、実装方法論やロードマップの策定等）
  • アーキテクトや専門領域メンバーと効果的に協業し、プリセールス活動やプロジェクトデリバリーを推進するリーダーシップ能力
  • エグゼクティブレベルでの文書および口頭での高いコミュニケーションスキル、分析および問題解決の能力

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】
株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。

ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?

You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. You’ll own substantial systems from design through deployment and help take a new offering from early customer adoption through general availability, backed by Salesforce’s scale and reach.

  • Build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.

  • Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.

  • Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.

  • Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers

  • Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.

  • Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.

  • Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.

  • Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

  • You have hands-on experience building and evaluating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how you assessed their quality and failure modes.

The Authentication Platform Engineering Manager leads the team responsible for the core identity services that power Salesforce's production infrastructure, including Kerberos-based authentication, Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP), and Fast Identity Online 2 (FIDO2) systems. You will manage a team of specialists who bridge legacy infrastructure protocols and modern, cloud-native identity standards to defend against sophisticated threats.

You're Our Person If...
 
  • You have 13+ years of software engineering experience, including 3-5 years leading teams in high-pressure, infrastructure-centric environments.

  • You have experience managing systems with massive throughput and high-availability requirements in public cloud (AWS/GCP) or hybrid environments.
  • You're familiar with Java, Go, or C#, and have experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and modern continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

Even Better If...

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Rejoignez l'équipe Slack de Salesforce pour piloter la transformation numérique de nos clients.


Slack transforme la façon dont les organisations communiquent, collaborent et atteignent leurs objectifs dans un monde digitalisé. En tant que solution intégrée à Salesforce, Slack permet aux équipes de se connecter, d'automatiser leurs processus et de prospérer en créant des « Digital HQs » adaptés aux enjeux actuels.

Cette opportunité vous permet d'accompagner le changement et de contribuer au succès d'une solution innovante, leader sur son marché.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique auprès des dirigeants, identifier leurs enjeux et positionner Slack comme solution essentielle.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les Account Executives « Core » de Salesforce (co-selling).
  • Piloter des cycles de vente complexes impliquant plusieurs décideurs.
  • Élaborer des récits clients convaincants pour illustrer l'impact de Slack sur la productivité et la collaboration.
  • Développer et exécuter des plans de comptes stratégiques pour dépasser les objectifs fixés.
  • Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente : génération de pipeline, négociation et clôture des contrats.
  • Travailler avec les ingénieurs solutions pour proposer des démonstrations et business cases personnalisés.
  • Représenter Slack lors d'événements sectoriels et partager des idées innovantes avec la clientèle.



You're Our Person If...

  • Expérience avérée en vente SaaS, avec un historique de dépassement des objectifs.
  • Maîtrise de la gestion de cycles de vente complexes et de comptes stratégiques.
  • Excellente capacité à formuler une proposition de valeur adaptée aux grandes entreprises.
  • Expérience dans l'interaction avec des dirigeants et la conduite de phases de découverte stratégique.
  • Aptitude à prospecter, activer le réseau et développer de nouvelles relations commerciales.
  • Goût du travail collaboratif et aisance dans des environnements de vente en équipe.
  • Solides compétences en négociation, communication et présentation.
  • Une expérience dans les logiciels de collaboration ou de productivité constitue un atout.


*****************


The Experience

Join Salesforce's Slack team to drive our customers' digital transformation.

Slack is transforming how organizations communicate, collaborate and achieve their goals in a digital world. As a solution integrated with Salesforce, Slack enables teams to connect, automate their processes and thrive by creating "Digital HQs" suited to today's challenges.


This opportunity lets you support change and contribute to the success of an innovative, market-leading solution.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Act as a strategic partner to executives, identify their challenges and position Slack as an essential solution.
  • Work closely with Salesforce "Core" Account Executives (co-selling).
  • Lead complex sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers.
  • Craft compelling customer stories that illustrate Slack's impact on productivity and collaboration.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to exceed set targets.
  • Manage the full sales cycle: pipeline generation, negotiation and contract closing.
  • Work with solution engineers to deliver tailored demonstrations and business cases.
  • Represent Slack at industry events and share innovative ideas with customers.



You're Our Person If...

  • Proven SaaS sales experience, with a track record of exceeding targets.
  • Mastery of managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
  • Excellent ability to articulate a value proposition tailored to large enterprises.
  • Experience engaging with executives and leading strategic discovery phases.
  • Ability to prospect, activate networks and develop new business relationships.
  • Enjoyment of collaborative work and ease in team-selling environments.
  • Strong negotiation, communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience with collaboration or productivity software is an asset.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit.   • Working technical literacy in AI/agentic tooling - able to speak credibly on LLMs, enterprise search, and system integration patterns without needing a Solution Engineer in every call

  • A track record of engaging C-level executives and leading discovery conversations that drive outcomes

  • Pipeline generation expertise, leveraging existing relationships and building new connections to drive opportunities

  • Familiarity with team-selling environments, aligning with Salesforce core AEs and Partners

title: Data Engineering Senior Associate- Finance
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Digital Enterprise Technology blazes the trail for enterprise IT at Salesforce. Built on our core values—Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, Equality, and Sustainability—we go beyond traditional IT by partnering closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes.

Our organization oversees enterprise technology strategy, Salesforce on Salesforce, customer and partner enablement, application engineering, data platforms, infrastructure, collaboration, enterprise operations, architecture, and program enablement. We operate one of the world’s most sophisticated Salesforce implementations and enable our global Ohana to do their best work through secure, scalable, and innovative technology.

This role is part of the Digital Enterprise Technology team supporting enterprise data, application integrations, and business-critical production services for the IT Finance & Employee Success team.

The team develops and operates cloud-based solutions connecting Salesforce with finance, HCM, and other enterprise platforms. Our technology environment includes Salesforce APIs, Workday and other data models, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Python, SQL, ETL/ELT platforms, and modern monitoring and service-management tools. The team works closely with engineering, business, security, infrastructure, both Internal and External SoX and operations partners to deliver reliable data flows, resilient integrations, and continuous improvements across the enterprise technology landscape.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Develop, enhance, and support data ingestion and ETL/ELT solutions using Python, Snowflake, SQL, Informatica, or BusinessObjects Data Integrator.
  • Design, maintain, and monitor Apache Airflow DAGs for scheduling, workflow orchestration, dependency management, retries, and failure recovery.
  • Develop and support MuleSoft APIs and integrations connecting Salesforce, enterprise applications, databases, and data platforms.
  • Provide production and agentic support using AI-assisted monitoring, troubleshooting, knowledge retrieval, incident summarization, and resolution recommendations.
  • Monitor scheduled jobs, APIs, interfaces, data availability, data quality, and upstream/downstream dependencies to meet operational SLAs.
  • Perform incident triage, restore failed services, coordinate with stakeholders, and track Time to Resolution (TTR).
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities by assisting with the SoX process in collaboration with Internal and External Auditors
  • Knowledge of Finance and HCM systems is a significant advantage.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or critical incidents. Document corrective and preventive actions and track them through closure.
  • Support release management activities, including deployment planning, release validation, production verification, rollback readiness, and post-release monitoring.
  • Create and maintain operational run lists, production schedules, release checklists, job inventories, dependency details, and escalation contacts.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, support documentation, knowledge articles, and RCA reports.
  • Perform operational activities such as system patching, password and credential rotation, certificate renewal, access management, configuration changes, and environment migrations.
  • Support Salesforce-related integrations with an understanding of Salesforce objects, APIs, authentication, batch interfaces, data flows, and integration troubleshooting.
  • Perform data validation, source-to-target reconciliation, completeness checks, and failed-job recovery to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, Salesforce, application, infrastructure, security, database, and business teams to resolve issues and deliver stable solutions.



You're Our Person If...

  • Strong SQL development, data analysis, and production troubleshooting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and Snowflake.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow workflow development, scheduling, and monitoring.
  • Experience supporting MuleSoft APIs and enterprise integrations.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, API integrations, job monitoring, incident management, release management, and SLA-based production support.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce platform concepts, objects, APIs, authentication, and integration patterns.
  • Knowledge of data warehouse concepts, including fact and dimension tables, star and snowflake schemas, conformed dimensions, and Slowly Changing Dimensions.
  • Ability to create clear SOPs, runbooks, RCAs, operational reports, and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills.


Even Better If...

  • Experience with Informatica or Data Integrator.
  • Tableau reporting and dashboard-development experience.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The next Salesforce will be shaped by how well people and agents can understand one another, share context, delegate authority, recover from failure, and accomplish meaningful outcomes together. These behaviors unfold across roles, products, implementations, data, policies, channels, and time. They cannot be understood through episodic studies or a single adoption metric.

The SVP, Research + Insights will lead Research across Salesforce Experience Design and build a continuous intelligence capability spanning Customer 360, Platform, Data 360, Agentforce, Slack, and emerging surfaces. Reporting to the EVP, Chief Experience Officer, this executive will move Research further upstream into enterprise and product strategy while extending evaluation through implementation, production, and longitudinal use.

What you will lead - 4 Connected Capabilities:

  • Enterprise Experience Intelligence + Foresight. Foundational domain research, longitudinal customer programs, strategic opportunity intelligence, ecosystem and competitive synthesis, failed-adoption and win/loss evidence, foresight, and executive synthesis.
  • Portfolio Research + Insights. Deeply embedded research leadership and teams serving Salesforce's major product portfolios while operating within one enterprise agenda, talent system, evidence standard, and knowledge environment.
  • Human-Agent Research, Evaluation + Measurement. Human factors, behavioral science, trust and delegation, agent-behavior evaluation, scenario and rubric development, production-evidence interpretation, and experience-outcome measurement.
  • Research Operations + Knowledge. Participant systems, customer access, governance and ethics, methods and standards, knowledge infrastructure, evidence taxonomy, tooling, vendors, and research program operations.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Establish one enterprise Research + Insights agenda tied to Salesforce's most consequential customer, product, platform, architecture, and business decisions.
  • Build Experience Intelligence as a live, cumulative understanding of how customers, industries, organizations, roles, and work actually operate and how they change over time.
  • Ensure foundational, generative, and evaluative research shape product strategy before solution direction and roadmap commitments harden.
  • Create a continuous evaluation system spanning early concepts, working prototypes, implementations, shipped products, production behavior, and longitudinal customer outcomes.
  • Define the research and measurement models Salesforce needs for human-agent collaboration, including trust, delegation, autonomy, authority, observability, intervention, correction, escalation, learning, and recovery.
  • Integrate relevant evidence across Product Analytics, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Services, Trust, implementation, and market intelligence without duplicating those organizations or collapsing distinct evidence into one score.
  • Build a durable knowledge system that makes customer and product evidence searchable, reusable, appropriately contextualized, and available at the moment consequential decisions are made.
  • Protect the independence and integrity of customer evidence, including confidence, limitations, contradictions, and unresolved questions, even when the findings challenge a committed direction.
  • Recruit and develop an exceptional bench of research leaders, distinguished researchers, behavioral scientists, measurement experts, research technologists, knowledge architects, and Research Operations talent.



You're Our Person If...

  • A record of leading Research across a complex, multi-product enterprise, platform, or ecosystem at significant scale.
  • Evidence that research you personally led changed product strategy, architecture, investment, operating decisions, or shipped experiences, not merely stakeholder understanding.
  • Deep expertise across qualitative research, behavioral science, mixed methods, experimentation, measurement, and interpretation of product and production data.
  • Meaningful experience with AI, automation, human factors, intelligent systems, trust, or human-machine collaboration.
  • The ability to reconstruct how complex domains and people actually work across roles, systems, incentives, constraints, implementations, and time.
  • Demonstrated strength in foundational research, generative product influence, continuous evaluation, and enterprise synthesis.
  • Experience integrating qualitative, quantitative, behavioral, commercial, implementation, and service evidence without overstating certainty or confusing correlation with customer understanding.
  • Executive presence and organizational courage sufficient to challenge powerful stakeholders, protect difficult findings, and redirect consequential decisions.
  • Experience leading a centrally connected research organization with senior portfolio leaders and deeply embedded teams.
  • A record of identifying, recruiting, and developing exceptional research leaders and distinguished practitioners.



What success looks like:
Within the first year, Research should operate as an enterprise decision system: close enough to change the work and independent enough to challenge it.

  • A single enterprise research agenda is actively shaping priority product, portfolio, architecture, and business decisions.
  • Live domain and work models are in place for the highest-priority areas and are changing what teams choose to build or stop.
  • A continuous evaluation model connects prototypes, production behavior, implementation evidence, customer outcomes, and longitudinal learning.
  • Human-agent research and measurement are informing Agentforce, Slack, Experience Architecture, and selected portfolio experiences.
  • Evidence from implementation, support, service, win/loss, telemetry, and direct research is entering decisions with clear provenance and interpretation.
  • The research knowledge environment is reducing duplicated discovery and making prior evidence available without stripping it of context.
  • Salesforce has one strong Research leadership and talent system, with deep portfolio proximity and a credible distinguished-practitioner bench.
  • Unsupported directions are redirected or stopped before major investment because the evidence is timely, credible, and consequential.



Your leadership signature
You are a truth-teller with product consequence. You combine deep curiosity and methodological rigor with exceptional product judgment. You can hold contradiction, identify the non-obvious implication, and make complex evidence clear without manufacturing certainty. You are independent without becoming distant from the work, and influential without allowing stakeholder preference to rewrite what is true.

Why this role matters
The Agentic Enterprise introduces questions of trust, authority, delegation, learning, and organizational change that no existing product metric can answer alone. This role will ensure Salesforce builds from a continuously updated understanding of customers and real work, and that the company learns as its products and agents change. The right leader will make customer truth a durable source of strategic and product advantage.

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is looking for a Technical Product Strategist to join its Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of market dynamics, product positioning, and complex technical architecture, helping define where Salesforce invests, how we position our platform, and why.

You will contribute to our forward-looking technology thesis. Rather than managing sprint backlogs, feature prioritization, or short-term execution roadmaps, you will work within a team of technical product strategists to identify emerging opportunities ("white spaces"), evaluate "build-buy-partner" options, and translate major market trends into concrete platform strategies.

We are looking for a strategy professional who can anticipate trends: someone who can methodically analyze portfolio gaps, evaluate technical investment options, and help design the strategic frameworks that will shape our enterprise platform.

From analyzing the productization trajectories of key capabilities (from trust infrastructure to workflow automation to agentic AI architectures) to researching investment theses in high-growth areas such as supply chain agentification, developer tools, and AI-native systems of record, you will help Salesforce make the right bets through solid commercial and technical models.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support long-term product strategy: Conduct market studies, whitespace analyses, and competitive assessments to support multi-year positioning frameworks across Salesforce's enterprise AI and platform portfolio.
  • Analyze productization trajectories: Evaluate the strategic transition of internal technical capabilities (trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI, and data platforms) into standalone product lines or platform-integrated offerings.
  • Apply "Build-Buy-Partner" frameworks: Conduct structured assessments for internal development, acquisition, or partnership decisions, analyzing platform integration timelines against independent go-to-market strategies.
  • Translate technology and market paradigms: Track fundamental shifts (including agentic coding, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source ecosystems) and translate them into clear, data-backed investment theses.
  • Map portfolio gaps: Collaborate with strategy and product management leaders to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and market opportunities beyond traditional competitive analysis.
  • Synthesize cross-functional signals: Integrate technical research, engineering capabilities, strategic market intelligence, and M&A (mergers and acquisitions) trends into solid, well-supported strategic perspectives.
  • Assess market viability: Perform market sizing, economic modeling, and competitive analyses to justify capital allocation and strategic redirections.
  • Support global strategic initiatives: Work with regional leadership to adapt platform strategies to international markets, accounting for local regulatory frameworks and the competitive landscape.
  • Evaluate go-to-market models: Analyze monetization structures (open source, platform integration, standalone SaaS, API-first), balancing long-term revenue potential, developer adoption, and defensibility.
  • Monitor emerging signals: Track venture capital activity, developer ecosystem shifts, and emerging research to identify new technology paradigms before they become consensus.

The Experience

Salesforce recherche un(e) Technical Product Strategist (Stratège Produit Technique) pour rejoindre son équipe Product Strategy & Innovation. C’est une opportunité unique d’évoluer à la croisée des dynamiques de marché, du positionnement produit et de l’architecture technique complexe, en contribuant à définir où Salesforce investit, comment nous positionnons notre plateforme et pourquoi.

Vous contribuerez à notre thèse technologique prospective. Plutôt que de gérer des backlogs de sprint, la priorisation de fonctionnalités ou des feuilles de route d’exécution à court terme, vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe de stratèges produit techniques pour identifier les opportunités émergentes (« white spaces »), évaluer les options « build-buy-partner » (développer, acheter ou s’associer) et traduire les grandes tendances du marché en stratégies de plateforme concrètes.

Nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) de la stratégie capable d’anticiper les tendances : une personne sachant analyser méthodiquement les lacunes du portefeuille, évaluer les options d’investissement technique et aider à concevoir les cadres stratégiques qui façonneront notre plateforme d’entreprise.

De l’analyse des trajectoires de produitisation des capacités clés (de l’infrastructure de confiance à l’automatisation des flux de travail en passant par les architectures d’IA agentique) à la recherche de thèses d’investissement dans des secteurs à forte croissance comme l’agentification de la chaîne logistique, les outils pour développeurs et les systèmes de référence natifs de l’IA (« AI-native systems of record »), vous aiderez Salesforce à miser sur les bons choix grâce à des modèles commerciaux et techniques solides.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Soutenir la stratégie produit à long terme : Mener des études de marché, des analyses d’opportunités (« whitespace ») et des évaluations concurrentielles afin de soutenir les cadres de positionnement pluriannuels sur l’ensemble du portefeuille d’IA d’entreprise et de plateforme de Salesforce.
  • Analyser les trajectoires de produitisation : Évaluer la transition stratégique des capacités techniques internes (infrastructure de confiance, automatisation des flux de travail, IA agentique et plateformes de données) vers des gammes de produits autonomes ou des offres intégrées à la plateforme.
  • Appliquer les cadres « Build-Buy-Partner » : Mener des évaluations structurelles pour les décisions de développement interne, d’acquisition ou de partenariat, en analysant les délais d’intégration à la plateforme par rapport aux stratégies de commercialisation (« go-to-market ») indépendantes.
  • Traduire les paradigmes technologiques et de marché : Suivre les mutations fondamentales (notamment le codage agentique, les architectures d’applications natives de l’IA, l’automatisation de la chaîne logistique et les écosystèmes open source) et les traduire en thèses d’investissement claires et appuyées par les données.
  • Cartographier les lacunes du portefeuille : Collaborer avec les responsables de la stratégie et de la gestion produit pour identifier les vulnérabilités du portefeuille et les opportunités de marché au-delà de l’analyse concurrentielle classique.
  • Synthétiser les signaux transversaux : Intégrer la recherche technique, les capacités d’ingénierie, la veille stratégique de marché et les tendances M&A (fusions-acquisitions) dans des perspectives stratégiques solides et étayées.
  • Évaluer la viabilité du marché : Effectuer le dimensionnement du marché, la modélisation économique et des analyses concurrentielles pour justifier l’allocation de capital et les réorientations stratégiques.
  • Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques mondiales : Travailler avec la direction régionale pour adapter les stratégies de plateforme aux marchés internationaux, en tenant compte des cadres réglementaires locaux et du paysage concurrentiel.
  • Évaluer les modèles de commercialisation (« Go-to-Market ») : Analyser les structures de monétisation (open source, intégration à la plateforme, SaaS autonome, API-first) en équilibrant le potentiel de revenus à long terme, l’adoption par les développeurs et la défendabilité.
  • Surveiller les signaux émergents : Suivre l’activité du capital-risque, les évolutions de l’écosystème de développeurs et les recherches émergentes afin d’identifier les nouveaux paradigmes technologiques avant qu’ils ne fassent consensus.
  • Formuler des recommandations pour le comité directeur : Rédiger des notes stratégiques et des présentations claires et bien structurées destinées aux directeurs de la stratégie, VP Produit et dirigeants exécutifs.



You're Our Person If...

  • 5 à 8 ans d’expérience (post-licence ou diplôme supérieur) en stratégie produit, stratégie technologique, stratégie d’entreprise, conseil en management ou gestion de produit technique au sein d’une entreprise majeure du cloud ou de logiciels d’entreprise.

  • Maîtrise des systèmes de référence d’entreprise, des plateformes de données et des infrastructures SaaS, incluant la compréhension de l’impact des couches d’IA sur le modèle économique du logiciel.
  • Solides bases en conception de modèles économiques, notamment les compromis entre les modèles de commercialisation open source, propriétaires, natifs de plateforme et axés sur les API.
  • Expérience dans la participation aux évaluations « build-buy-partner », aux stratégies d’entrée sur le marché ou aux études de marché pour les fusions-acquisitions.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, avec une aptitude éprouvée à traduire des sujets techniques complexes et multivariables en récits synthétiques pour les dirigeants.
  • Forte aisance face à l’ambiguïté et solides compétences en résolution de problèmes quantitatifs et qualitatifs pour structurer des enjeux complexes et tester des hypothèses stratégiques.



Even Better If...

As a member of the Controllership organisation, the Director of Finance Data Strategy & Stewardship will lead the end-to-end strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of Finance data across the enterprise. This role oversees the intake of new data into the Finance data lake, defines data models and governance standards, and ensures the reliability, quality, and compliance of Finance data used for reporting and analytics. The Director will also manage and develop a dedicated Data Governance and Reporting Controls team located in India, responsible for data stewardship, SOX-related data certification, and support for Finance reporting.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:


1. Data Strategy & Intake Management

  • Define and drive the Finance data strategy, aligned with business priorities and downstream reporting needs.
  • Oversee the onboarding of new data sources into the Finance data lake, ensuring scalability, traceability, and alignment with enterprise architecture.
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and product teams to assess new data requirements and convert them into actionable data delivery roadmaps.



2. Data Modeling & Architecture

  • Lead the design of enterprise-grade Finance data models and semantic layers to support analytics, regulatory reporting, and operational Finance needs.
  • Ensure metadata standards, master data alignment, and consistent data definitions across systems.
  • Collaborate with data architects and engineering teams to ensure robust and efficient data pipelines.



3. Data Governance & Controls

  • Establish and enforce data governance standards, policies, and stewardship processes for Finance data.
  • Oversee the definition and monitoring of data quality rules, issue management, and remediation workflows.
  • Ensure compliance with SOX controls and certification requirements related to financial data and reporting.



4. Leadership of the India Data Governance Team

  • Lead and develop a team in India responsible for data governance, data quality operations, and stewardship activities.
  • Oversee processes related to Finance reporting controls, SOX testing support, and data certification.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior executives on Finance data risks, data quality, and opportunities to improve reporting and insights.
  • Drive alignment between business requirements and technical implementation across the data value chain.



6. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish KPIs, dashboards, and operating mechanisms to measure data quality, controls effectiveness, and team performance.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and best practices in data governance and data delivery.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and regulatory trends shaping Finance data management.

Reporting to the Executive Producer, this role centralizes creative leadership, video assembly, structural storytelling, and multi-stakeholder feedback management. The Senior Editor delivers premium, brand-consistent content while managing a critical-volume output that meets Salesforce Studios' visual standards. As a primary storytelling contributor, each editor handles advanced footage pacing, UI/product imagery, multi-source editing, audio design conceptual, and color grading direction.


Key Responsibilities


End-to-End Post-Production: Lead the structural assembly, pacing, and final delivery of corporate films, global brand campaigns, virtual broadcast events, and deal support videos.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with the Executive Producer, Creative Directors, Sales Account Teams, and Product Marketing Managers (PMM), Motion Graphics, VFX & sound editors, to translate complex corporate messaging into emotionally resonant narratives.

Hybrid Workflow Management: Oversee full internal post-production for core customer films while collaborating with and organizing source assets for external agencies handling the remaining workload.

Global Intake & Support: Support global intake requests, providing guidance, creative recommendations, and editing execution.

Brand Stewardship: Ensure all final video exports align strictly with Salesforce’s corporate visual identity, timing standards, and premium narrative tone.


Qualifications & Skills


Every Deal Editor joining the Mexico City hub will be expected to seamlessly integrate generative AI tools into traditional video workflows to accelerate timeline assembly, asset optimization, and rough-cut generation.


Experience: 5+ years of professional, hands-on video editing experience within a fast-paced corporate studio, creative agency, or tech-industry production hub.

Technical Skills: Expert-level mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro. Intermediate-to-advanced familiarity with Adobe After Effects to successfully implement motion graphic templates created by the hub's design team. Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity 'startup-within-Salesforce,' following our recent acquisition. You’ll be working alongside the founding team and engineers in an organization offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce. You will have the unique opportunity to build a '0 to 1' product in one of the fastest growing verticals within Salesforce.


Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. Nowhere does modernizing them matter more than in the public sector, where the scale and stakes are highest.


Missionforce Operations is reimagining the public sector supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email. For Salesforce, this represents a massive growth opportunity into public sector back office processes, with innovations that flow into the front office. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase. As one user put it: “I’ve been waiting for this for 20 years.”


What you’ll do

As a Senior AI Angineer Agentforce & Missionforce Operations, you will help shape both the product and the engineering team. You will partner closely with product leaders, sector experts, and platform and forward-deployed engineers to deliver trusted AI systems for mission-critical public-sector workflows.


Missionforce Operations is Agentforce Operations’ public-sector counterpart: rebuilt from the ground up to bring core capabilities to some of the world's most sensitive operating environments. In this role, you will lead the development of AI products and platform capabilities that perform complex tasks reliably, securely, and cost-effectively in environments where trust is mission-critical and data classification requirements are uncompromising.


You will tackle a broad range of challenges, from building AI features tailored to public-sector customers, to designing systems with security, compliance, reliability, and operational constraints at their core. You will operate with wide autonomy, build alignment across engineering and product stakeholders, and raise the bar for technical quality, execution, and mentorship across the team.

Responsibilities


Day-to-Day & Project Execution

  • Partner with product and forward-deployed engineers to build reliable new features for our AI platform.
  • Lead development of intelligent agents that complete complex supply chain tasks with reliability and consistency
  • Design and implement planning, orchestration, and evaluation systems that enable agents to execute multi-step workflows autonomously.
  • Make and drive architectural decisions for mission-critical, highly available systems that operate across varied and constrained deployment environments.
  • Establish engineering practices for model evaluation, AI safety, observability, reliability, and cost management.

Long-Term Goals & Strategic Impact

  • Partner with Product Management and executive leadership to translate product vision into multi-year technical roadmaps.
  • Guide technical strategy for AI model deployment, safety constraints, reliability frameworks, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Drive the adoption of enterprise-grade observability, operational excellence, and cloud infrastructure practices.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks related to security, compliance, scale, availability, and model behavior.
  • Help shape the organization by raising the engineering bar, contributing to hiring, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and high ownership.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must have the following to be considered:

  • B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent with coursework in Artificial Intelligence (M.S. is a plus).
  • 4+ years of industry experience in Software Engineering, with a focus in AI/ML.
  • Strong proficiency in multiple programming languages, such as Python, Go, Java, or C++.
  • Experience designing and operating production-grade distributed systems, APIs and data models.
  • Deep expertise in model evaluation, including designing custom benchmarks, automated evaluation suites, and production telemetry for monitoring model quality, drift, reliability, and safety.
  • Experience building production systems with LLM orchestration frameworks, along with the judgment to extend or move beyond those frameworks when reliability requirements demand it.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, make sound architectural decisions, and deliver through ambiguity.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, product, customer-facing, and executive stakeholders to build alignment and drive decisions.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the quality of technical execution across a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • チームメンバーとのコミュニケーションを通じて、少しずつ業務範囲を広げていきたい方
  • AIツールを使った新しい働き方に興味がある方

主な業務内容

IT・SaaS市場の最新情報のリサーチ

  • 上記で収集した情報の中から、Salesforceのビジネスに関連する重要なトピックを抽出・整理し、チーム内に共有する。
  • SlackbotやClaudeなどのAIツールを活用することで、リサーチプロセスの効率化を推進する。

  • オンラインで開催されるウェビナーや製品発表イベントを視聴し、要点を整理する。

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

The Forward Deployed Consultant owns a customer engagement end to end: from the executive business case, through rapid design and deployment of automated process solutions (“Blueprints”) on the Agentforce platform, to a clean handoff to partners and client teams. You will advise enterprise leaders, quantify ROI, and map multi-year automation roadmaps. You bring domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes, including where people patch over system gaps. You will also roll up your sleeves to build, test, and iterate Blueprints with AI agents and prompting tools, proving value fast in live production. You are customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-focused, with the speed and quality to turn fragmented manual workflows into scalable, value-driven solutions.


Responsibilities

Strategic advisory and business case

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to enterprise stakeholders, building a deep understanding of business goals and operational pain points.
  • Build business cases and define success criteria up front: KPIs such as cycle time and cost per transaction, with a measured baseline.
  • Own multi-year roadmaps for process Blueprints and automation, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution.
  • Present to executives in terms of their priorities; flag when work is off track early and plainly, with a fix, and drive to a decision.

Blueprint design and rapid value proof

  • Lead structured discovery (workshops, process maps) and turn it into a solution design and a first working version in days to weeks.
  • Automate business processes end to end (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, supplier onboarding), deciding what stays in the ERP, what is automated around it, and what AI decides versus people.
  • Build hands-on with AI agents and prompting tools: design prompts, structure outputs with schemas and examples, and debug and iterate when they fail.
  • Identify integration points with core systems (REST, event-based), managing risks such as auth, latency, payload limits, and retries.

Specification and delivery

  • Translate strategic goals into clear PRDs and technical acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver in continuous build loops (design, build, validate, refine), where each loop proves value and expands scope toward AI-first operations.
  • Lead an AI-first delivery experience, using AI agents and skills to accelerate requirements, build, testing, and documentation.
  • Own delivery end to end through go-live: scoping, build, UAT, data migration, and cutover, managing scope change along the way.
  • Cut scope to the highest-value slice(Day 1 Scope/MVP)) when needed to get live, and justify the trade-off to the customer.

Ownership transfer to customer or partner

  • Design and run handoff processes, documentation, and enablement that transition ownership to implementation partners and customer teams.
  • Set handoff guidelines, solution architecture documentation, and success criteria for sustained post-deployment success.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Forward Deployed roles, Strategic or Management Consulting, Product Management, Process Automation, or Business Analysis.
  • Domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, AP/AR, supplier onboarding), including where people patch over system gaps.
  • Hands-on experience building AI or agent-based automation yourself, including prompt design, output structuring, and iterating on failures.
  • Experience engaging enterprise executives in B2B SaaS to build business cases and long-term roadmaps.
  • Proven track record owning engagements from discovery through go-live (UAT, data migration, cutover), not just POCs, followed by structured handoffs.
  • Strong grounding in workflow mapping, process modeling, process improvement, and change management.
  • Experience translating business requirements into automated workflows, PRDs, and user stories.
  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (REST, SOAP, event-based) and common risks such as auth, latency, and payload limits.
  • Track record of setting success KPIs and baselines up front and measuring outcomes after go-live.
  • Executive presence: confident with skeptical executives and willing to deliver bad news early, with a plan.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services).
  • Track record building or navigating partner ecosystems and implementation channels.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification.
  • Technical or business degree; MBA a plus.

Success metrics

  • Time to first working version: days to weeks from discovery, not months.
  • Go-live rate: share of engagements that reach production, not just a POC.
  • Measured value against baseline: KPI movement after go-live (such as cycle time or cost per transaction) compared with the baseline set up front.
  • Roadmap and expansion: each go-live earns the next swing, with adjacent processes added to the roadmap and expansion driven in the account.

ROLE OVERVIEW
The Senior Technical Consultant — Marketing Cloud Next is a hands-on delivery specialist responsible for
executing the build, configuration, data migration and testing workstreams within Marketing Cloud Next
migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns
specific delivery workstreams end-to-end — including Email Studio configuration, Journey Builder
implementation, subscriber data migration, AMPscript and SSJS development, Data Cloud data stream
configuration and automated migration validation tooling. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants on the
wave team, reviewing their work and ensuring factory quality standards are upheld across all MCN
deliverables.

RESPONSIBILITIES
● Execute Marketing Cloud Next platform configuration — building Email Studio sending domains, IP
configurations, Content Builder templates, Automation Studio programs, Journey Builder flows and
subscriber data extension schemas as specified in the Technical Architect's solution design.
● Execute subscriber data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle: data profiling,
transformation scripting, data extension population, suppression list loading, consent record migration
and bulk data load execution using ETL tools and Salesforce Bulk API.
● Develop AMPscript and SSJS personalisation — writing dynamic content personalisation scripts for
migrated email templates, recreating legacy segmentation logic, lookup functions and conditional content
rules in MCN native scripting.
● Configure Salesforce Data Cloud data streams — setting up data stream ingestion from source
systems, configuring DLO schemas, mapping fields to DMOs and validating data completeness per the
Data Cloud Architect's design.
● Migrate and rebuild Journey Builder flows — translating legacy marketing automation workflows,
drip campaigns and triggered sends into Journey Builder — recreating entry sources, decision splits, wait
steps, send activities and exit criteria.
● Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing Apex batch utilities, LWC
dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations for subscriber count reconciliation, data extension record
validation and consent flag verification.
● Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating migration dry runs against SIT/UAT environments,
capturing reconciliation counts, logging validation failures and iterating until dry run success criteria are
met.
● Configure sender authentication and deliverability — implementing SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS
records, private domain configuration, reply mail management and IP warm-up scheduling as directed by
the TA.

● Develop and execute unit and system integration tests — writing test scripts for migrated journeys,
data extensions and automations; executing SIT cycles; logging defects; retesting fixes against factory
quality thresholds.
● Support go-live cutover execution — following the cutover runbook: executing final subscriber data
loads, activating journeys, validating data extension record counts and confirming suppression lists are
active.
● Prepare technical handover documentation — producing configuration workbooks, data mapping
sheets, AMPscript library documentation and journey flow diagrams for client team handover post go-
live.
● Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC deliverables for quality, explaining MCN platform
patterns, unblocking technical issues and providing feedback aligned to factory standards.
● Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating reusable MCN
configuration templates, AMPscript snippet libraries, data migration scripts and validation toolkits in the
shared accelerator repository.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS — MUST HAVE
● Marketing Cloud Next — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Email Studio, Journey
Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder and Contact Builder end-to-end, including sending domain
configuration, journey entry sources, decision splits and triggered sends.
● AMPscript & SSJS Development: Proficiency in AMPscript and SSJS for dynamic email personalisation
— lookup functions, conditional content, row sets, attribute rendering and legacy personalisation logic
recreation.
● Subscriber Data Migration Execution: Hands-on experience executing subscriber data migrations —
data extension population, bulk data loading via Import Wizard and API, suppression list management,
consent record migration and reconciliation validation at scale.
● Salesforce Data Cloud — Configuration: Working knowledge of Data Cloud data stream setup,
DLO/DMO schema configuration, field mapping and data ingestion validation.
● ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica Cloud, Talend, Azure
Data Factory, MuleSoft) or scripted Bulk API / REST API approaches for subscriber data extraction,
transformation and loading.
● Apex & Platform Development: Ability to write Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, REST callout handlers
and Apex test classes for migration utility development, including subscriber reconciliation tools and
consent flag verification.
● Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, subscriber
count trackers and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling.
● CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable working within Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows —
committing changes, following branching conventions, submitting PRs and using Gearset/Copado for
environment promotion.

PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE
● Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud
Next
● Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross-channel reporting post-migration
● Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS or LINE channel configuration in Marketing Cloud Next

● Familiarity with Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP API for programmatic data operations and triggered
sends
● Understanding of IP warm-up strategy and email deliverability monitoring tools (250ok, Validity/Return
Path)
● Exposure to Agentforce journeys triggered from Data Cloud activation segments

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
● 5–8 years of Salesforce and marketing technology delivery experience
● 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketing Cloud Next configuration experience
● Experience executing at least 1 end-to-end Marketing Cloud migration or large implementation project as
a key delivery contributor
● Demonstrated hands-on experience with subscriber data migration — bulk loading, data extension setup,
consent migration and reconciliation validation
● Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on MCN configuration and data migration tasks

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The era of the Agentic Enterprise is here. With the rollout of Salesforce Agentforce, autonomous AI agents are revolutionizing how global organizations automate decisions, orchestrate workflows, and engage customers.

However, AI models are only as effective as the data feeding them. To deliver real-time, trusted decisions, AI agents depend on seamless connectivity across fragmented hybrid environments. That is why MuleSoft and Informatica are mission-critical to Salesforce’s core AI strategy.

By bringing together MuleSoft’s API orchestration and Informatica’s enterprise data management, you will sell the fundamental data backbone powering the next generation of enterprise AI.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to join our high-growth Data Foundation team. This is a strategic, C-level sales role where you will drive multi-million dollar transformations across top-tier enterprise accounts.

Because the majority of our field leaders are promoted internally, this role offers a clear path for career acceleration within Salesforce.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic GTM Leadership: Own and execute the Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for a high-value enterprise territory, focusing on new logo acquisition and greenfield expansion.
  • C-Suite Engagement: Partner directly with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, and line-of-business executives to articulate the strategic ROI of AI-ready data infrastructure.
  • Complex Deal Execution: Navigate high-stakes, multi-stakeholder sales cycles ($500K to $1M+ ACV) from initial discovery to final closing.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Lead a dedicated pod of Solution Architects, Pre-Sales Engineers, and Professional Services experts, while leveraging the broader Salesforce partner ecosystem.
  • Forecasting & Territory Planning: Conduct whitespace analysis, maintain a healthy pipeline, and deliver precise quarterly forecasts.



You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience in high-growth, competitive markets.
  • Consistent track record of quota overachievement selling complex, six- and seven-figure deals.
  • Deep experience in New Business Acquisition and territory mapping within complex matrix organizations.



Even Better If...

  • Solid functional understanding of API management, integration platforms (iPaaS), middleware, or enterprise data architecture.
  • Proven ability to translate technical concepts (data governance, ETL, microservices, dynamic API integration) into compelling executive ROI arguments.
  • Formal sales methodology training (MEDDPICC, Challenger, or SPIN).
  • Strong consultative approach rooted in business outcomes and long-term customer value.

Tableau is the world's leading analytics platform, helping people and organizations become data-driven by putting the power of data into the hands of everyday people. As part of Salesforce, Tableau gives you the chance to sell trusted analytics that turn data into visual insight — helping customers see and understand their data to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Tableau Account Executive, you are the go-to expert for Tableau across your dedicated UKI customer set. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tableau opportunities — from prospecting through close — using your solution selling expertise and deep product knowledge to respond efficiently to customer needs, identify Tableau-specific business potential, and build a strategic, long-term partnership with your customers.
