You're Our Person If...

  • Full-Cycle Sales: Proven track record of quota-carrying, tech/SaaS sales experience managing the sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Territory & Account Planning: Create territory & account plans to identify, qualify, and successfully close specialist-led opportunities.
  • Research & Discovery: Uncover prospect's business challenges, processes, and strategic goals.
  • Solutioning: Craft value propositions that map to customer needs, demonstrating deep understanding of specialized technology solutions.
  • Communication: Clear, effective and timely engagement across writing, speech, presentation, and tools (Slack, Zoom, Google Slides).
  • Resourcefulness: Drive results using all tools and resources available.
  • Team Selling: Align with core AEs, Pre-sales, and partners to support deals and customer success.
  • Mindset: Coachable, competitive, and motivated by ambitious goals.
  • Language: Fluent in English.

Even Better If...

  • Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Value Selling.
  • Strategic Alliances: Ability to develop cases and lead strategic partnerships.
  • Adaptability: Thriving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Track Record: Consistently meeting or exceeding quota.

  • Personal Wellbeing: Private health insurance, life insurance, a retirement savings plan, and a monthly wellness allowance.
  • Flexibility: Flexible time off and leave policies, plus comprehensive parental support programs.

The Opportunity: The Platform Guardian

We are seeking a Salesforce Platform Expert who specializes in security implementation. You are not just a compliance officer; you are a builder. You understand the Salesforce metadata API better than anyone, you know the limits of Apex Managed Sharing, and you know exactly which "Session Settings" break the user experience if configured incorrectly.

In this role, you will be the bridge between our security requirements and the technical reality of the Salesforce platform. You will use your deep platform expertise to architect, configure, and implement the controls that keep our ecosystem secure without sacrificing performance or agility.


Role Summary

The Salesforce Platform Security Architect is responsible for the hands-on design and implementation of security controls within the Salesforce org. You will own the technical configuration of Sharing & Visibility, Shield Encryption, and Identity flows.

You will work alongside developers and admins to ensure that every Flow, Apex Class, and Integration is built securely from the ground up. You translate abstract security policies (e.g., "Least Privilege") into concrete Salesforce configurations (e.g., "Permission Set Groups" and "Field Level Security").


Key Responsibilities

Platform Security Implementation (The "Hands-On" Work)

  • Sharing Architecture: Design and implement complex sharing models. Optimize Org-Wide Defaults (OWD), Sharing Rules, Account Teams, and Territory Management to ensure strict data segregation.
  • Shield Implementation: Lead the technical deployment of Salesforce Shield. Manage Tenant Secrets, define encryption policies for standard/custom fields, and configure Field Audit Trails to meet retention policies.
  • Identity Configuration: Configure and troubleshoot SSO (SAML/OIDC), Connected Apps, and Login Flows. managing certificates and Key Management (BYOK) where applicable.

Event Monitoring & Detection

  • Real-Time Monitoring: Build Transaction Security Policies (using Apex or Low-Code) to block data exfiltration attempts in real-time.
  • Log Analysis: Configure Event Monitoring to export logs to our SIEM (Splunk/New Relic). Create dashboards to visualize login anomalies and report exports.

Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

  • Code Security: Act as the "Security Gatekeeper" for deployments. Review Apex and LWC code for common vulnerabilities (SOQL Injection, XSS, Enforcing Sharing).
  • DevOps Integration: Configure static code analysis tools (e.g., PMD, Checkmarx, Clayton) within our CI/CD pipeline (Copado/Gearset/Jenkins) to auto-reject insecure code.

Connected App & OAuth Governance (Critical Focus)

  • OAuth Flow Architecture: Select and implement the correct OAuth flows for specific use cases (e.g., JWT Bearer Flow for server-to-server integration vs. Web Server Flow for user-facing apps vs. Device Flow for IoT).
  • Scope Management: Enforce the principle of Least Privilege by meticulously defining and auditing OAuth Scopes (e.g., ensuring an integration only has api access and not full access).
  • Session Policies: Configure granular session policies per Connected App, enforcing High Assurance sessions (MFA) for sensitive apps and defining strict timeout values.
  • Client Secret Management: Manage the lifecycle of Consumer Keys and Secrets, including rotation strategies and ensuring secrets are never hardcoded in external systems.
  • IP Relaxation: configure "Enforce IP Restrictions" vs. "Relax IP Restrictions" settings on a per-app basis to balance security with accessibility.
  • Security Center & Multi-Org Governance
  • Centralized Policy Management: Implement and manage Salesforce Security Center to define and push baseline security policies (e.g., Password Policies, Session Settings, Trusted IP Ranges) from a central tenant to all child orgs.
  • Drift Detection: Configure Security Center to monitor for Configuration Drift. Create alerts that trigger immediately if a local admin in a child org attempts to weaken security settings (e.g., disabling MFA or relaxing IP restrictions).
  • Health Visibility: Maintain a single-pane-of-glass view of security health scores across the entire multi-org landscape, reporting on KPI improvements to leadership.

Technical Advisory

  • Platform Limits: Advise the business on the performance impacts of security decisions (e.g., "How will encrypting this field impact SOQL query performance?").
  • Release Readiness: Review the Salesforce Release Notes (3x/year) specifically for security updates (e.g., MFA enforcement, Browser policy changes) and proactively prepare the org.

Qualifications

  • Required Salesforce Expertise (The "Must Haves"):
  • 10+ Years of hands-on experience in the Salesforce ecosystem as a Technical Architect, Developer, or Senior Administrator.
  • Sharing & Visibility Master: You can explain "Implicit Sharing," "Group Maintenance Tables," and "Apex Managed Sharing" in your sleep.
  • Apex & Metadata Fluency: You can read Apex triggers and understand how to query the LoginHistory or SetupAuditTrail objects via SOQL.
  • Implementation Experience: Proven track record of actually turning on and configuring Platform Encryption, Event Monitoring, or multi-factor authentication in a large, complex org.
  • Security Fundamentals:
  • Understanding of basic security concepts: Least Privilege, Separation of Duties, Encryption (At Rest vs. In Transit), and CIA Triad.
  • Familiarity with common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) specifically in the context of Salesforce (e.g., "How to prevent XSS in Visualforce/LWC").

Certifications:

  • Required: Salesforce Certified System Architect (or progress towards it).
  • Required: Salesforce Certified Sharing and Visibility Architect.
  • Required: Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Architect.
  • Bonus: Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA).

Why This Role?

Technical Depth: You won't be writing policies in Word documents all day. You will be in the Setup menu, in the IDE, and in the metadata, building tangible security solutions.

High Impact: You will control the keys to the kingdom, securing the data of millions of customers on one of the world's largest SaaS platforms.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Building
 

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.



Nice-to-Haves
 

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 

  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.

  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.

  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.

  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.



Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 

  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.

  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.

  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.

  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.

  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.

  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.



Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 

  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.

  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.

  • Vous explorez activement le paysage IA/data en évolution — en testant de nouveaux outils, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles, et en restant sincèrement curieux de ce qui arrive.

AI agents can reason about what needs to happen. Getting them to reliably do work inside the software businesses actually run on is the next frontier.

We’re building Systems Integration Agent: computer use for the enterprise. It learns how to operate applications like SAP, Oracle, and Workday, then turns that knowledge into reusable, code-backed actions. Our team operates as a small startup within Salesforce AI Labs, separate from the main engineering and product organizations. You’ll work directly with the team’s leader and engineers, alongside customers, with the autonomy to shape an early product and the resources of Salesforce to back you up.

As a Value Acceleration Engineer, you’ll write code, build alongside customers, and get real workflows into production. This is forward-deployed engineering on an emerging product: what you learn in deployments will help determine what we build next.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Build Directly With Customers

  • Work with process owners and customer IT to select workflows, define success, and secure the test access and data needed to build.
  • Run hands-on sessions that help customers use the product themselves, with clear scope and readiness expectations.
  • Help customers understand where the product can deliver value, explain its capabilities and limitations clearly, and connect technical results to business outcomes.

Engineer Reliable Automation

  • Write custom JavaScript tools when existing capabilities cannot complete a task.
  • Debug failures across browser behavior, agent execution, application state, and backend services.
  • Build tests for business outcomes, exceptions, partial completion, and recovery.
  • Help launch and stabilize workflows, documenting monitoring and recovery procedures and establishing support ownership with the team.

Make the Next Deployment Easier

  • Turn deployment lessons into reusable tools and tests, and work with core engineering to address recurring product gaps.
  • Use AI development tools thoughtfully while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.

Working With Customers

  • Expect approximately 40–60% travel, typically several days onsite at a time, for customer discovery, hands-on build sessions, and launches.

You’re Our Person If…

  • You can write and debug JavaScript or TypeScript and reason about web applications, APIs, and data flow.
  • You enjoy working directly with users: asking precise questions, building alongside them, and explaining technical problems clearly.
  • You’ve led complex customer-facing deployments and built tools or practices that improved outcomes beyond your own projects.
  • You can align stakeholders on when to extend the product, narrow scope, or stop an unsafe rollout.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

Even Better If…

  • Playwright, browser automation, browser extensions, RPA, or enterprise integration.

Named Account Manager, Public Banks

About the Role

As a Named Account Manager in the Public Sector, you will be based in Brasília and will be responsible for building and expanding strategic relationships with State and Municipal Public Banks, with a nationwide scope. You will lead the full sales cycle—from prospecting to closing and renewals. The goal is to help these institutions modernize services and improve citizen experience through Salesforce solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of named public sector accounts (State and Municipal Banks), achieving revenue and pipeline targets.
  • Develop strategic account plans and identify high-value use cases with agency and institutional leaders.
  • Drive consultative sales cycles: discovery, demonstrations, proposals, negotiations, and closing.
  • Navigate public procurement processes (Brazilian Law 14,133/2021), such as reverse auctions (pregão), direct awards (dispensa e inexigibilidade), price registration frameworks (atas de registro de preços), contract piggybacking (adesões), and partner-led contracts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams: Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Legal, Partners, and Professional Services.
  • Collaborate with partners and system integrators to expand reach and project execution.
  • Forecast performance with accuracy and keep the CRM updated with strong pipeline discipline.
  • Monitor budget cycles, public policies, and digital government initiatives.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Solid experience in enterprise B2B software/SaaS sales focused on the government sector, preferably with State and Municipal Banks.
  • Proven track record of quota attainment in long, complex sales cycles.
  • Practical knowledge of public procurement processes and relevant legislation.
  • Established network within federal public agencies in Brasília.
  • Excellent communication skills and executive presence.
  • Advanced English; native or fluent Portuguese.
  • Willingness to travel. Based in Brasília.

Preferred Qualifications / Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with CRM, cloud, data, AI, or digital transformation.
  • Experience with partner-led sales and large-scale public contracts.
  • Proficiency in sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Challenger.

Overview

We're looking for a dynamic, strategic, and outcomes-driven Enterprise Account Executive to drive Data Foundations growth across large enterprise organisations. In this highly visible role, you will build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, identify new opportunities for engagement, and position Salesforce's industry-leading data management and analytics platform as a critical enabler of digital transformation across the enterprise.

This is a quota-carrying role where you will act as the "CEO" of your territory, owning the strategy, engagement model, and execution plan across your assigned accounts. You will lead complex sales cycles in partnership with cross-functional teams and help enterprise organisations address challenges related to data silos, data quality, fragmented reporting, and the need for trusted, unified data to drive better decisions and outcomes.

By bringing together strong account planning, consultative selling, and enterprise industry insight, you will help organisations modernise how they manage, govern, and activate data — enabling smarter business decisions, improved customer experience, and accelerated growth.

This is not a typical software sales role. As an Enterprise Account Executive for Data Foundations, you will play a direct role in helping large organisations transform how they collect, connect, and trust their data. You will engage with decision-makers across business units to understand strategic data priorities, navigate buying complexity, and align Data Foundations solutions to enterprise-wide transformation agendas.

Success in this role requires a strong ability to build executive relationships, create demand, and drive long-term strategic engagement across a complex enterprise environment.

Establish yourself as a credible advisor who understands the enterprise data landscape.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Lead and coordinate cross-functional support across Business Development, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Alliances, and leadership teams to drive account strategy and deliver a strong customer experience.
  • Enterprise Market Insight: Maintain a strong understanding of the enterprise landscape, including industry data priorities, buying frameworks, budget cycles, and digital transformation trends.
  • Forecasting and CRM Discipline: Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity updates, pipeline visibility, and forecast hygiene in Salesforce CRM.



You're Our Person If...

  • Proven Enterprise Sales Success: Demonstrated success in enterprise software sales with a track record of meeting and exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Enterprise Experience: Experience selling into large enterprise organisations, with a strong understanding of how they operate, buy, and deliver transformation programs.
  • Data & Analytics Expertise: Familiarity with data management, data governance, analytics, or data platform solutions, and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for enterprise stakeholders.
  • Strategic Territory Management: Ability to build and execute territory and account strategies that create long-term pipeline and drive growth across a defined enterprise portfolio.
  • Consultative Selling Skills: Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders, uncover business needs, articulate value, and lead strategic, solution-based sales conversations.
  • Executive Presence: Confidence engaging senior leaders and navigating complex account environments with credibility, commercial acumen, and strong communication skills.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Ability to orchestrate internal resources effectively and lead virtual teams to drive aligned execution and customer outcomes.
  • Resilience and Adaptability: Strong interpersonal skills, curiosity, and a growth mindset, with the ability to navigate long sales cycles, evolving priorities, and ambiguity.

Your primary responsibility is developing and articulating comprehensive implementation proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs), including detailed estimates, timelines, and staffing plans. You will apply proven methodologies and orchestrate subject matter experts to validate the solution’s viability. After the sale, you will ensure a clean transition to the delivery team, ensuring all project details, scope, and commitments are clearly understood to enable rapid mobilization.

Your Impact

  • Contribute to high client satisfaction by ensuring the solutions you shape are set up for delivery success and align tightly with customer objectives.
  • Champion AI-Augmented and AI-Native delivery models within proposals, embedding Agentforce and other AI-driven approaches into solution designs and SOWs to accelerate time-to-value and differentiate Salesforce’s implementation approach.
  • Ensure business value is defined and realized by translating executive-level customer objectives into clear, executable implementation plans.
  • Partner closely with Account Partners to structure the deal’s financial strategy and implementation roadmap, and then co-presenting the value and strategic outcomes directly to the client.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level customers, developing narratives that articulate the execution plan and timeline of the transformation program.
  • Prescriptively shape large, complex, and transformational engagements, moving beyond stated requirements to recommend the right path for customer success.
  • Uncover and articulate future opportunities to drive sustained customer value and Salesforce expansion.
  • Partner with Services Architects, Business Strategists and other relevant roles, as necessary, on comprehensive pre-sales discovery workshops, engaging functional stakeholders to understand the complete business challenge and desired outcomes.
  • Define and manage the end-to-end engagement scoping process, establishing clear boundaries, assumptions, and success criteria.
  • Lead the high-level functional solutioning and scope definition, ensuring the proposed approach is viable and aligns with Salesforce best practices.
  • Harmonize diverse perspectives—from Customer Business/IT to Sales, Legal, and Revenue Recognition—to synthesize competing interests into a cohesive solution that aligns with commercial targets and delivery excellence.
  • Own the creation of the final Statement of Work, defining precise deliverables, scope, and implementation terms and conditions in partnership with Legal and Revenue Recognition teams for a clean hand-off.
  • Develop detailed, accurate project estimates, staffing plans, and resource mixes, ensuring the engagement is properly structured for success.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate engagement risks during the pre-sales cycle, leading Risk assignments to protect both the customer and Salesforce.
  • Manage a seamless transition from the pre-sales phase to the delivery team, ensuring all project details, scope, and commitments are clearly understood.

Above all, they are people and customer-focused, collaborative, resourceful, and committed to delivering results.


The following is a list of characteristics that make a great leader at Salesforce. We expect our next Director, Customer Success Manager to exhibit each of these characteristics:

  • Get it Done – Drives processes that scale. Challenges the organization to think with a beginner’s mind and act efficiently to achieve the desired outcome. Calm, organized, positive, and can-do attitude. Results-driven, tenacious, drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

Tailors message and style to the audience, uses storytelling to deliver effective presentations and messages.
  • Motivate and Champion – Invests in and tries new things in the talent and career development of our people. Holds self and team accountable to expectations.

  • ​​Experience developing and applying analytics adoption frameworks and value realization methodologies, such as Tableau Blueprint
  • Experience supporting the Intelligence Community or Department of Defense, working with cleared personnel or military customers.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching data analytics, data literacy, business intelligence, and guiding use case development
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking and ability to use data and insights to identify trends and risks.
  • Entrepreneurial and "lead from the front". You’re a proven leader and motivator, with deep experience leading technical organizations. You drive results and outcomes while balancing empathy and a people-first culture.
  • You have a strong emotional intelligence for customers and deliver customer support like you expect to receive it; with excellence.
  • You know what to say and more importantly, how to say it. You have demonstrable experience building strong internal and external relations, and influence outcomes and leverage relationships.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce's product offerings, services, and the larger industry landscape

We deliver objective, actionable insights that shape customer-facing experiences and internal tools across Salesforce’s digital marketing portfolio, including websites and digital destinations, email and messaging, in-person and virtual events, and marketing-focused agentic experiences.

As Lead User Researcher, you will own research across two of the team’s most strategic areas: agentic experiences and event technology. You will help teams understand emerging mental models, unmet needs, friction, trust, and where people need transparency, control, guidance, or human support. You will also lead research that improves the digital experiences supporting Salesforce events across in-person, virtual, and on-demand formats.

We are seeking a curious, experienced researcher who knows how to select and combine methods such as interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral data analysis to answer complex questions. You will lead research across multiple products and stakeholder groups, develop strategy across a portfolio of projects, build alignment around the research questions and opportunities that matter most, and communicate insights that influence product strategy and experience decisions.

  • Translate evidence into clear recommendations, strategic guidance, measurement frameworks, and future-state direction that shape digital strategies, experience roadmaps, requirements, and experiments.
  • Create compelling narratives and data visualizations, present to audiences ranging from product teams to executives, and lead workshops that turn research findings into aligned decisions and follow-up actions.
  • Advance research methods, reusable tools, measurement standards, and responsible uses of AI; mentor others, and champion inclusive and accessible research.

In this role, you will help customers put Data 360 into production and build the technical foundation for reliable, enterprise-grade use cases.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Person If....

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

The Experience

Salesforceをご利用のお客様を成功に導くサクセスプラン（Success Plan）は、お客様のニーズにあわせたプランをご用意し、リソース、ガイダンス、技術サポートを提供します。そのサクセスプランのオペレーションに責任を持ち、サービスデリバリーチームがお客様の成功を促進できるよう、重要な役割を果たすのがカスタマーサクセスのオペレーションズチームです。

オペレーションズチームがアラインする主要業績指標は、お客様の満足度、Salesforceの利用状況スコア、解約率、サービスの利用促進度と多岐に渡ります。

本ポジション（ビジネスオペレーションズマネージャー）は、主要業績指標の達成に向けて、オペレーショナルエクセレンスの側面で組織戦略を主導します。単一の業務や特定のチームのオペレーションにとどまらず、自らハンズオンで複数の領域・プログラムに深く関与し、全体像を理解した上で、カスタマーサクセスに大きなインパクトのある組織全体の取り組みや、テクニカルサポートを中心としたコアサービスのオペレーション全体をリードします。複数のプロジェクト／チームメンバーを横断的にまとめ、方向性を揃えながら、グローバル本社のメンバーも含め、チーム内外の関係者と密接に連携し、最良の顧客体験を提供できるオペレーションを追求します。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • プログラム／プロジェクトマネジメント：業務戦略の策定・複数プログラム/プロジェクトの実行統括（サービス/オペレーション強化、グローバル施策含む）、データに基づく改善サイクルの管理
  • クロスプロジェクト・チームコーディネーション：複数プロジェクト／メンバーの横断的な把握・方向付け（人事権を伴わないハンズオンなリード）
  • チェンジマネジメント：経営層含むステークホルダとの連携、変革の主導、デリバリーチームへの新しい働き方の適用
  • プロセス改善・業務効率化：業務改善機会の特定、最適化戦略の立案・実行
  • パフォーマンス監視と分析：KPI（対応品質・対応時間・顧客満足度、等）の追跡・評価、経営層向け分析モデル・ダッシュボードの構築、意思決定への提言
  • クロスファンクショナルな協業：部門間の調整・整合性確保、部門横断の合意形成



You're Our Person If...

  • 強いリーダーシップと当事者意識：複数メンバー・プロジェクトを牽引し、自ら積極的に領域・案件に関与して課題を自走推進する能力
  • マネジメント経験：プロジェクトまたはプログラムマネジメントの実務経験（5年以上）
  • テクニカルサポート業務の理解：オペレーション・業務プロセスの実務知見、改善リード経験
  • システムIssue／インシデントハンドリング：システム障害・不具合発生時の切り分け・調査、Global（エンジニアリングチーム等）へのエスカレーションと連携、暫定ワークアラウンドの策定・関係者への周知、解決までのフォローアップができる能力
  • 卓越したコミュニケーションスキル：経営層を含む多様なステークホルダーとの協業、グローバルメンバーとの業務経験
  • 言語スキル：ネイティブレベルの日本語、ビジネスレベルの英語
  • 戦略的思考と問題解決能力：組織レベルでの業務戦略の策定・実施、課題対応力
  • データ分析と報告のスキル：業務データ分析、傾向特定、経営層向け分析モデル・ダッシュボード・レポート作成



Even Better If...

  • Salesforce導入・関連DXプロジェクトのマネジメント経験
  • Salesforce製品ベースのカスタマーサクセス支援 もしくは テクニカルサポート業務経験
  • テクニカルサポート（L3以上）のオペレーション改善・マネジメント経験（ケース管理、エスカレーションプロセス、SLA管理、DevOps環境・プロセスの基本知識等）
  • インシデントマネージメント、RCA（根本原因分析）・再発防止策の策定経験、開発・SRE・プロダクトチームとの協働経験
  • オペレーション改善へのAI活用経験
  • プロジェクトマネジメント／チェンジマネジメントの資格
  • 中国語または韓国語の語学力（あれば尚可）

The Experience

Salesforce's Customer Success Operations team is responsible for operating Success Plans — tailored plans that provide customers with the resources, guidance, and technical support they need to succeed. This team plays a key role in enabling the service delivery team to drive customer success through Success Plan operations.

The key performance indicators the Operations team aligns to span customer satisfaction, Salesforce adoption scores, churn rate, and service utilization, among others.

This position (Business Operations Manager) leads organizational strategy for operational excellence toward achieving these KPIs. Rather than staying within a single function or one team's operations, this role is hands-on across multiple areas and programs, understands the big picture, and leads organization-wide initiatives with major impact on Customer Success, as well as the operations of core services centered on technical support. The role coordinates across multiple projects and team members, aligns direction, and works closely with stakeholders inside and outside the team — including members at global headquarters — to deliver the best possible customer experience.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Program/Project Management: Develop operational strategy and oversee execution of multiple programs/projects (including service/operations enhancements and global initiatives); manage data-driven improvement cycles
  • Cross-Project and Team Coordination: Understand and align direction across multiple projects/members (hands-on leadership without direct management authority)
  • Change Management: Partner with stakeholders including leadership, drive transformation, and roll out new ways of working to delivery teams
  • Process Improvement and Operational Efficiency: Identify improvement opportunities and plan/execute optimization strategies
  • Performance Monitoring and Analysis: Track and evaluate KPIs (response quality, response time, customer satisfaction, etc.), build analytical models/dashboards for leadership, and provide recommendations for decision-making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate across departments, ensure alignment, and build cross-departmental consensus



You're Our Person If...

  • Strong Leadership and Ownership: Able to lead multiple members and projects, proactively engage with areas and initiatives, and drive issues to resolution independently
  • Management Experience: 5+ years of experience in project or program management
  • Understanding of Technical Support Operations: Practical knowledge of operations/business processes and experience leading improvements
  • System Issue/Incident Handling: Able to triage and investigate system outages/defects, escalate to and coordinate with Global teams (e.g., Engineering), develop and communicate interim workarounds, and follow through to resolution

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity 'startup-within-Salesforce,' following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce. You will have the unique opportunity to perfect the original  '0 to 1' product with the founding team, as we push towards an order-of-magnitude increase in the scale of our customer base. 

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don’t, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.

Agentforce Operations is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and orchestrating end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email and Slack. For Salesforce, this represents a major back-office growth opportunity, while also delivering innovations that enhance the existing front-office business. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase. As one user put it: “I’ve been waiting for this for 20 years.”

What you’ll do

You would be joining at an exciting inflection point in Agentforce Operations’ history. Our product was built with intentional startup speed that created tight coupling, limited observability, and reliability and scaling gaps that are now surfacing as customer adoption accelerates.

As a performance engineer for Agentforce Operations, your mandate will be to radically optimize the scalability, resilience, and performance of our product and platform across the entire stack to help usher in this next phase of growth. The ideal candidate would be able to develop a deep technical understanding of our architecture and then deliver the end-to-end implementation of optimizations that would enable us to achieve greater scalability while simultaneously improving our reliability. Agentforce Operations manages complex, infinitely configurable states with equally complex state transitions and interfaces to teams across the organization. That means you'd be tackling a wide array of challenges that would include optimization of our existing data model, streamlining of our asynchronous operations patterns, profiling and rightsizing our infrastructure, and developing both the tools and observability to run experiments and empirically validate results. 


You would be considered the subject matter expert in matters of application performance and as such you’d operate with meaningful autonomy while building alignment across engineering. This role comes with ample opportunity for advancement by raising the bar on system quality, leveling up the engineers around you, and ultimately accelerating us toward our ambitious scaling goals.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and prioritize architectural problems across our distributed backend systems, contributing technical perspective to help the team invest in the right foundational work at the right time
  • Design and implement solutions to hard system problems including application performance optimization, infrastructure management, and data model improvements. 
  • Raise and maintain our engineering quality bar through pragmatic standards, guardrails, and team practices that prevent regressions and keep our product healthy and performant. 
  • Collaborate with peers across customer, product, and engineering to deeply understand customer needs, make pragmatic tradeoffs that maximize impact, and align on engineering reality
  • Mentor engineers as a senior peer and force multiplier, sharing expertise across backend architecture and system design while helping shape stronger engineering judgment, more effective collaboration, and a higher-performing team

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience as a backend engineer, building and operating user-facing applications and their underlying infrastructure 
  • Mastery of Golang, GraphQL, and Postgres, with demonstrated experience delivering high-performance optimizations. 
  • Major public cloud provider experience (AWS preferred). 
  • Deep expertise in multiple areas of backend engineering such as data modeling, db performance tuning, state management, API design, transactionality, concurrency, memory management, fault tolerance, and scaling, with the ability to pick up new technologies quickly
  • Repeated ownership of foundational system work in complex distributed systems, from diagnosing architectural problems to designing solutions to driving adoption across a team. 
  • Excellent writing and speaking skills and ability to lead real-time technical-design discussions
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability, with a consistent track record of high standards, continuous improvement, and low-ego collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science (M.S. preferred)
  • Experience working in AWS, specifically with RDS, Elasticache, S3, and EKS. 
  • Exposure to Temporal, Istio, or Typesense 
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, specifically Jenkins and Spinnaker.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Finance

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience
We are seeking a dedicated and forward-thinking Senior Manager to join our management-led SOX 360 Program Office team. The role will report to the Senior Director of the SOX team and in this role, you will reduce the long-term testing burden of our control environment while ensuring our testing function runs cleanly, efficiently, and on time.
This role is split between overseeing our outsourced management testing operations and building a best-in-class business process Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) program — with the balance shifting toward continuous monitoring as the roadmap matures.
The ideal candidate pairs deep SOX/internal audit technical fundamentals with a builder's mindset: comfortable evaluating which controls are ripe for automation, partnering with control owners, AI, and tooling teams to implement monitoring solutions, and leveraging data analytics to increase testing precision, reduce reliance on point-in-time sampling, and optimize program spend.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
Continuous Monitoring Strategy & Implementation (the growth engine of this role)

  • Build & Own the Business Process Continuous Controls Monitoring Roadmap: Systematically assess in-scope controls to identify viable candidates for automated or system-based testing. Sequence them into a multi-year plan to measurably reduce overall manual testing effort.
  • Design & Implement Solutions: Partner with process owners, engineering, and tooling leads to build continuous monitoring solutions—ranging from exception-based dashboards and automated queries to fully automated control testing.
  • Drive Full-Population Assurance: Champion data analytics to shift the program from periodic sample-based testing toward ongoing full-population monitoring, enabling earlier issue detection and control precision.
  • Build Business Cases & Track Metrics: Quantify the ROI for continuous monitoring investments (effort saved, risk coverage, testing velocity) and socialize results with leadership. Track continuous monitoring coverage as a standing metric of program health.
  • External Audit Reliance Alignment: Partner with external auditors to ensure continuous monitoring outputs, automated scripts, and Information Produced by Entity satisfy audit reliance standards.

Outsourced Testing & Vendor Optimization

  • Testing Oversight: Serve as the primary point of contact overseeing our outsourced management testing provider, ensuring testing completes successfully, on time, and to a high quality standard.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Pushback: Push back on and effectively negotiate testing approaches, scope, and timelines with external auditors, outsourced firms, and internal control owners. Proactively remove bottlenecks and resolve stalled controls.
  • Vendor Optimization & Budget Management: Own day-to-day vendor management, Statement of Work (SOW) negotiations, and testing budget oversight. Partner collaboratively with vendor leadership to ensure continuous monitoring innovations directly convert into reduced billable testing hours and program cost efficiencies.

External Audit Alignment: Act as key liaison between the outsourced testing firm and our external auditors on Continuous Controls Monitoring reliance, data completeness/accuracy, and automated testing strategy

You're Our Person If...

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or risk & controls, including direct experience managing or interfacing with external audit/testing firms (Big 4 or equivalent) — preferably in a fast-paced tech or SaaS environment
  • A proven track record of building or implementing Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) — a track record of measurably reducing manual testing effort, not just familiarity with the concept
  • Hands-on comfort with data analytics/visualization tools and evaluating which controls are automation-ready
  • Demonstrated ability to hold firm and negotiate effectively with senior stakeholders and external partners under deadline pressure, including SOW negotiations and vendor SLAs
  • Deep understanding of PCAOB standards and the COSO framework, including how external auditors evaluate Information Produced by Entity (IPE) when relying on automated controls and data analytics
  • Demonstrated ability to bridge traditional accounting/finance and technical engineering/IT/data teams

Even Better If...

  • Recent Big 4 public accounting experience
  • CPA, CIA, CISA, or CDPSE certification
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Information Systems, Finance, or Computer Science (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience building home-grown continuous monitoring solutions or GRC/audit tooling integrations (dashboards, RPA, analytics pipelines)
  • Self-motivated, thrives in a high-growth environment with strong multi-tasking, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • Critical thinking self-starter with strong leadership and project management capabilities, including leading projects through a fast-paced life cycle

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team's expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

Salesforce is currently seeking a Data Cloud & Marketing Cloud Technical Architect to join our Professional Services team within the Customer Success Group (CSG). This role is centered on being a "Data" subject matter expert, leading the design and implementation of enterprise-grade Data Management solutions. While Data Cloud (Data 360) expertise is a must, the ideal candidate will also possess a strong background in Salesforce Marketing Cloud to drive cross-cloud success.

The Technical Architect is responsible for architecting scalable solutions across enterprise landscapes, ensuring data is democratized and ready for enterprise AI usage. You will work closely with Project Managers and Technical Architects to ensure on-time, fully functioning integrations. The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial atmosphere, communicates tactfully with business operations, and effectively designs, tests, and deploys complex software solutions. You must be an excellent communicator who can tailor delivery to a variety of audiences and communicate both in English and Italian fluently.

What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Become a Trusted SME: Act as the primary authority for Data Cloud to support project delivery, including how data architecture relates to the success of Agentforce and AI.
  • Strategic Design: Drive the creation of application and technical design documents (Blueprints/FSD) which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer's infrastructure.
  • Data Democratization: Design and guide customer's enterprise data architecture, highlighting the importance of Data Governance and ensuring solutions adhere to security and privacy regulations.

As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.

You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. This is a customer-billable delivery role — a hands-on/senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
Advisory & Strategy

  • Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
  • Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
  • Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
  • Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)
  • Represent the practice in complex, high-stakes engagements



Architecture & Delivery

  • Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
  • Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
  • Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
  • Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
  • Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
  • Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines



Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)

  • Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
  • Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management



AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
  • Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
  • Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
  • Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP



Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)

  • Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
  • Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
  • Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery



Governance & Enablement

  • Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
  • Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
  • Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)


How Success Is Measured (First 12 Months)

  • Certification Attainment: complete required certifications to be compliant and ready for customer engagements
  • Discovery-to-roadmap / Customer impact: consistently produce customer-calibrated maturity assessments and roadmaps that secure signed charters; ramp quickly to be billable on one or more engagements
  • Delivery / Architecture standard: ship working, governed capability increments each phase, with consistent, governed, dual-purpose foundations across the portfolio
  • Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
  • AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels
  • Thought leadership: bring a credible agentic-SaaS-future perspective into engagements; at Director level, own a defined, published practice POV shaping customer engagements and market positioning
  • Governance / Enablement: leave every engagement with a sustainable stewardship and operating model; delivery teams ramped and productive through technical leadership

You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
  • Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
  • Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
  • Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
  • Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Solution Engineering Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both solution engineering and sales. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned an experienced Solution Engineering Buddy who will provide hands-on coaching and involve you in some of their live deals. You will also be paired with experienced Sales Development Buddies during the Sales Rotation and you also get to call your first salesforce leads and find your first deals. Who are we looking for?

    • For the Solution Engineering Path, we consider applicants from the following academic backgrounds:
      Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other adjacent disciplines
  • You are a creative problem-solver

  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English and Hebrew is essential

What does our new EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni


Rotations

During the Graduate Program, you will experience both the Solution Engineering Path and the Sales Path. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will gain exposure to both roles. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.

Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

With the EMEA Graduate Program - Solution Engineering Path, you can continue to progress:

At Salesforce, we're seeking outstanding individuals to join our team as an Apromore Account Executive with a strong technical background and expertise in process intelligence & AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will be pivotal in driving revenue growth, encouraging enduring client relationships and applying innovative process intelligence technology to redefine customer engagement.

Apromore is a global leader in AI-driven process intelligence technology. Now part of Salesforce, Apromore provides organizations with an "Intelligent Process Twin" to gain complete operational transparency. As enterprises rush to scale AI, Apromore bridges the gap between process perception and reality, acting as the critical backbone that enables organizations to systematically discover, de-risk, deploy, and govern Agentic AI automation across the enterprise.

As a part of our Apromore AE selling team, you will act as a strategic prospector and evangelist for Apromore, Salesforce's process intelligence platform, focusing heavily on Agentic AI adoption. You will target, among others, enterprise clients who are scaling AI into production, positioning Apromore as the definitive mechanism to identify the ideal high-propensity, high-ROI use cases for AI agents (such as Agentforce). You will navigate complex, enterprise-grade B2B sales cycles by helping C-level executives move away from broad anecdotes and scope precisely defined, value-driven automation pipelines. We are looking for individuals with strong experience in selling process intelligence/process mining solutions, understanding AI and cloud-based services, and designing bespoke B2B solutions.



What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Drive Agentic AI Adoption: Employ your wealth of sales knowledge, to position Apromore as the key solution for scaling AI initiatives such as Agentforce, showing customers how clean process context, clear handoffs, and well-understood workflows are required to deploy agents safely and productively.
  • Deliver Value-Based Messaging: Target executive decision makers across Automation/AI, Digital Transformation, Operational Excellence, and Risk & Compliance to map process frictions directly to financial business impact.
  • Conduct comprehensive technical discovery to analyze sophisticated business problems and craft compelling Points of View that underscore the tangible value of Apromore across both business and technical users
  • Manage Full Sales Lifecycles: Own end-to-end B2B sales processes—from pipeline generation and prospecting to qualifying and closing complex enterprise software transactions.
  • Sustain Continuous Value Post-Deployment: Shift clients from an initial deployment mindset to long-term partnerships. Drive ongoing account expansion by selling further process intelligence capabilities to ensure realized value scales with their business.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Value Engineers, Solution Consultants, and Salesforce sales teams to deliver a unified "One Salesforce" enterprise experience.



You're Our Person If...


  • 10+ Years of Enterprise Software Sales Experience: Proven track record of selling enterprise SaaS, cloud software, or complex business analytics tools to executive buyers.
  • Proven Process Intelligence Expertise: Deep background selling process intelligence and related technologies, such as process analytics, task mining and simulation (e.g. from Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS).
  • Sophisticated intuition for business and able to conduct technical in-depth discovery mapping aligning clients needs to the Apromore platform
  • Strong technical selling skills including the ability to explain process intelligence solutions to non-technical clients and how such solutions can translate to business outcomes
  • A proven track record of consistently surpassing sales targets within a technical sales environment, underscoring your proficiency in intricate sales processes.
  • Outstanding communication and negotiation skills honed through your experience

Even Better If...


  • Industry/Vertical Knowledge: Deep insight into Financial Services, Energy & Utilities or Manufacturing & Supply Chains.
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with extensive background in technology sales.



Key Attributes We’re Looking For:

  • This role requires an outstanding blend of technical depth, sales competence, and can articulate complex AI-driven solutions to a mix of customers.
  • Results motivated: you show your ability to exceed sales goals.
  • Business-focused outlook: Skillfully translates technical solutions into palpable business value
  • A talent for relationship-building: Establishes enduring client connections, rooted in your extensive sales expertise.
  • A curiosity about problem-solving: Devises innovative solutions to address sophisticated client challenges, using your extensive technology sales experience
  • Technical Skills: Ability to understand sophisticated technical solutions and clearly articulate business value to businesses and technical partners
  • Creativity. Agile, roll-up-your-sleeves demeanor. Progress over perfection.

Chez Salesforce, nous recherchons des talents exceptionnels pour rejoindre nos équipes en tant qu'Account Executive Apromore, disposant d'un solide bagage technique et d'une expertise reconnue en process intelligence et en solutions pilotées par l'IA. À ce poste, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour stimuler la croissance du chiffre d'affaires, développer des relations clients durables et exploiter des technologies innovantes de process intelligence afin de redéfinir l'engagement client.


À propos d'Apromore

Apromore est un leader mondial de la technologie de process intelligence pilotée par l'IA. Faisant désormais partie de Salesforce, Apromore fournit aux entreprises un « jumeau numérique de processus » (Intelligent Process Twin) pour leur offrir une transparence opérationnelle totale. Alors que les entreprises s'efforcent d'incrémenter l'IA à grande échelle, Apromore comble le fossé entre la perception des processus et leur réalité du terrain. La solution sert de socle critique permettant aux organisations de découvrir, sécuriser, déployer et gouverner de manière systématique l'automatisation par l'IA agentique à l'échelle de l'entreprise.


À propos du rôle

Au sein de notre équipe de vente spécialisée Apromore, vous agirez en tant que chasseur stratégique et évangéliste pour Apromore, la plateforme de process intelligence de Salesforce, avec une forte orientation vers l'adoption de l'IA agentique. Vous cibleriez, entre autres, des comptes Entreprise qui déploient l'IA en production, en positionnant Apromore comme le mécanisme incontournable pour identifier les cas d'usage à fort ROI et à forte valeur ajoutée pour les agents IA (tels qu'Agentforce). Vous piloterez des cycles de vente B2B complexes en aidant les dirigeants C-Level à dépasser les idées reçues pour définir des pipelines d'automatisation précis et créateurs de valeur. Nous recherchons des profils disposant d'une solide expérience dans la vente de solutions de process intelligence / process mining, comprenant les enjeux de l'IA et des services Cloud, et capables de concevoir des solutions B2B sur mesure.


Vos missions :

  • Stimuler l'adoption de l'IA agentique : Mettre à profit votre expertise commerciale pour positionner Apromore comme la solution clé de la mise à l'échelle des initiatives d'IA (comme Agentforce), en démontrant aux clients qu'un contexte de processus clair, des passages de relais fluides et des flux de travail bien maîtrisés sont indispensables pour déployer des agents de manière sûre et productive.
  • Délivrer un message à forte valeur ajoutée : Cibler les décideurs exécutifs (Automatisations/IA, Transformation Numérique, Excellence Opérationnelle, Risques & Conformité) pour relier directement les dysfonctionnements opérationnels à leur impact financier.
  • Mener une phase de découverte technique approfondie : Analyser les problématiques complexes des clients pour construire des preuves de valeur (Points of View) convaincantes qui soulignent la valeur tangible d'Apromore auprès des utilisateurs métiers et techniques.
  • Gérer le cycle de vente complet : Piloter le processus de vente B2B de bout en bout — de la génération de pipeline et la prospection jusqu'à la qualification et le closing de transactions logicielles complexes.
  • Assurer une création de valeur continue après le déploiement : Faire évoluer les clients d'une logique de déploiement initial vers un partenariat à long terme. Stimuler l'expansion des comptes (upsell) en vendant de nouvelles capacités de process intelligence pour garantir que la valeur générée suive la croissance de leur activité.
  • Collaboration transversale : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes d'Ingénierie de la Valeur (Value Engineers), les Consultants Avant-Vente (Solution Consultants) et les équipes commerciales Salesforce afin d'offrir une expérience entreprise unifiée (« One Salesforce »).

Votre profil :

  • 10+ ans d'expérience dans la vente de logiciels Entreprise : Track record éprouvé dans la vente de SaaS Entreprise, de logiciels Cloud ou d'outils complexes d'analyse de données auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs.
  • Expertise avérée en Process Intelligence : Solide expérience dans la vente de technologies de process intelligence et connexes (analyse de processus, task mining, simulation — ex. Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS).
  • Sens aigu des affaires : Capacité à mener des découvertes techniques approfondies et à aligner les besoins clients sur la plateforme Apromore.

  • Connaissance sectorielle : Connaissance approfondie des services financiers, de l'énergie & utilities, ou de l'industrie & chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain).
