Nos Account Executives interagissent avec les clients existants ainsi qu'avec de nouveaux prospects pour vendre l'ensemble de la plateforme Salesforce Customer 360, en se focalisant particulièrement sur la croissance du chiffre d'affaires via les écosystèmes de partenaires et l'optimisation des opérations de vente indirecte. Ils construisent des relations solides et de confiance tant avec les collaborateurs clés qu'avec les dirigeants décisionnaires (C-Level) de leur secteur, et deviennent des experts pour aider les clients à mesurer la valeur de leurs investissements Salesforce. Les parties prenantes clés incluent notamment les Directeurs/VP des ventes indirectes, les Directeurs des partenariats, les Directeurs des Systèmes d'Information (DSI/CIO), les Directeurs Commerciaux (CRO), les responsables financiers, les Directeurs Financiers (CFO) et les responsables des remises et incitations (Rebate/Incentive Managers).


Vous mettrez à profit vos compétences pour développer des opportunités, tant à partir de prospects qualifiés que par de la prospection sur des comptes vierges (whitespace), en vous ciblant sur les entreprises qui vendent via des revendeurs, distributeurs, prestataires de services gérés (MSP), concessionnaires, courtiers indépendants ou agents. 75 % du commerce mondial passe par les canaux de vente indirects. Vos activités quotidiennes comprendront :

  • Le développement de relations clés avec les parties prenantes chez les clients et la maximisation de la satisfaction client sur les comptes attribués, en vous concentrant spécifiquement sur leurs ventes indirectes et leurs stratégies de partenariat.
  • L'élaboration et le pilotage de la stratégie globale à long terme pour le compte, alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux du client liés à l'optimisation des revenus des canaux de vente, à l'engagement des partenaires et à la rentabilité.
  • La coordination des ressources internes de Salesforce, comme les spécialistes en gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, pour répondre aux besoins métiers du client.
  • La planification stratégique sur les comptes attribués (account planning), en coordination avec les équipes de vente Prime et Cloud pour garantir un alignement stratégique sur les initiatives liées aux canaux de vente.
  • La mise en valeur de la proposition de valeur de Salesforce pour les solutions de gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, en mettant en avant des bénéfices tels que : la simplification de l'ensemble du cycle de vie des partenaires, la stimulation de la croissance de l'écosystème, la maximisation de la rentabilité, la simplification des flux de travail des partenaires grâce à l'automatisation, l'accélération de la collaboration en temps réel, l'amélioration de la productivité des partenaires, l'obtention d'une visibilité de bout en bout sur les stocks, incitations et prix des canaux de vente, ainsi que la maximisation des profits grâce à une gestion automatisée des remises.
  • La prise en charge des problématiques clients telles que : une stratégie partenaire inefficace, des difficultés à fidéliser les partenaires, des problèmes de routage des pistes commercialisables (leads), une mauvaise qualité des données impactant les transactions partenaires, des difficultés de communication avec les partenaires, des architectures technologiques complexes pour la gestion des canaux, des difficultés à engager efficacement les partenaires et une charge de travail administrative manuelle excessive.
  • Le pilotage de la croissance au sein des comptes existants attribués en identifiant des opportunités d'extension de l'utilisation des solutions PRM, PRM+ et ChRM.
  • L'utilisation des fonctionnalités d'IA de la plateforme pour démontrer sa valeur, notamment via le lead scoring (notation des pistes) et l'analyse du pipeline des partenaires.
  • Le positionnement de la solution Partner Tracks comme un module complémentaire pour les clients PRM existants afin d'optimiser la montée en compétences des partenaires, de développer et d'étendre le réseau de partenaires, et d'augmenter le chiffre d'affaires par canal.

Qualifications souhaitées :

  • Minimum 6 ans d'expérience dans la vente de cycle complet (full cycle sales) au sein d'environnements complexes et/ou SaaS.
  • Maîtrise courante du français à l'oral et à l'écrit, avec un excellent niveau d'anglais.
  • Capacité à élaborer des stratégies conjointement avec une grande équipe étendue.
  • Une expérience dans la vente auprès d'entreprises utilisant des canaux de vente indirects (revendeurs, distributeurs, concessionnaires, etc.) constitue un atout majeur.
  • Une expérience dans la vente de solutions CRM, PRM ou de gestion des canaux de vente est très vivement souhaitée.
  • Bonne compréhension des processus de vente indirecte, des programmes partenaires, des incitations, ainsi que des enjeux de stock et de tarification liés aux canaux indirects.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Trailhead

Trailhead is Salesforce's free online learning platform and the front door to the Salesforce ecosystem. It empowers anyone to build in-demand skills across AI, Agentforce, CRM, data, and business fundamentals, and helps organizations re-skill their workforce for the agentic era. Today, Trailhead is also an AI-powered learning experience, with personalized pathways and the Trailhead Learning Agent guiding learners every step of the way.


The Trailhead Content team generates ideas, writes and edits content, develops hands-on challenges, and publishes and maintains the learning content that makes all of this possible. We believe content should be accessible, educational, relevant, and enjoyable. Right now, we're building some of the most important learning content in the Salesforce ecosystem. This is your chance to be part of it.


Role Description

As Senior Data Analyst, you are a senior lead and expert on the team across three connected facets of Trailhead measurement: content analytics and performance (the Content Intelligence Engine — catalog health, portfolio performance, journey tracking), learner satisfaction and feedback (structured survey data — CSAT, confidence gain, qualitative themes), and business impact (whether Trailhead engagement moves Pipeline Generation, Deal Velocity & Win Rate, and Product Adoption). You build the semantic models, data pipelines, and predictive frameworks that turn structured and unstructured signals into decisions — for content owners, executives, and increasingly, AI agents.


Your Impact

  • Content analytics and performance: Own the Content Intelligence Engine's core metrics and portfolio views (catalog-level completions, L1 product performance, content health vs. performance, journey drop-off) and lead its evolution from MVP through fast-follows and V2 capability.
  • Learner satisfaction and feedback: Design how unstructured/qualitative learner feedback (open-text survey responses, confidence pre/post scores) is captured, structured, and made analyzable at catalog scale — building the pipeline from raw survey response to reportable CSAT/confidence-gain metrics and automated qualitative theme surfacing for content owners.
  • Business impact: Own cohort design and methodology (propensity/segment matching) connecting Trailhead engagement signals (TBIDs, badges, Agentblazer status) to commercial outcomes (NNAOV, Win Rate Lift, Time-to-Close, Account Penetration), with defensible bias controls, not just directional correlation.
  • Architect and own a living semantic model of content performance spanning all three facets — shared metric and cohort definitions that persist and adapt as the Trailhead catalog, survey infrastructure, and AI tooling evolve, rather than one-off analyses that go stale.
  • Structure both structured (engagement, business) and unstructured (survey/qualitative) data to be agent-queryable — usable by AI layers to reason directly over content quality, learner sentiment, and business outcome questions, not just populate a static dashboard.
  • Own the logic and definitions that connect learner identity data to business/sales records, content completions to sales opportunities, and survey responses to the specific content they reference 
  • Lead the platform strategy for dashboards and models — keeping pace with Salesforce's evolving analytics and approved AI tooling — and lead the build of the underlying semantic model as our platform evolves.
  • Translate findings across all three facets into a single, clear narrative for content owners, Trailhead leadership, Marketing, Product, Sales and Customer Success leadership — distinguishing high-confidence findings from directional ones.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years in data analytics or data science, spanning both structured (SQL/engagement/CRM) and unstructured (qualitative/text/survey) data analysis — this is a genuinely three-sided role, not a single-discipline one.
  • Comfort applying data science methods (cohort/propensity matching, predictive modeling, causal inference) to answer "does this actually work" questions, not just descriptive reporting. 
  • Advanced SQL experience querying large-scale cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake), including learner activity data and sales/CRM data (opportunities, order line items, contracts). 
  • Experience structuring and analyzing unstructured/qualitative data — open-text survey responses, sentiment/theme extraction — turning free text into reportable, comparable signal.
  • Working knowledge of cohort/propensity-matching methodology for business impact analysis.
  • Expert Tableau dashboard-building, with strong data visualization and design sense; hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to build, query, and maintain dashboards and models. 
  • Executive-ready storytelling across content performance, learner sentiment, and commercial impact narratives.
  • Advanced English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, AI-driven analytics, or NLP/text-analytics workflows.
  • Python for cohort modeling or qualitative theme extraction.
  • Direct experience with Trailhead 
  • Tableau Certified (Desktop Specialist or Certified Data Analyst).
  • Familiarity with agentic or AI-native BI tooling (e.g. Hex) or notebook-based visualization (e.g. Python + Plotly/Streamlit) as complements to Tableau.
  • Openness to adopting new dashboard and BI tooling as it emerges. 

What We Look For In Every Hire

  • Learner-first mindset: You design everything with the Trailblazer in mind, not just internal stakeholder requirements.
  • Clear communicator: Your writing and conversations are direct, jargon-free, and respectful of people's time.
  • Collaborative by default: You seek out other perspectives, share your work early, and give feedback that helps.
  • High ownership: You are accountable for your work, proactive about blockers, and remain calm under pressure.
  • Curious about AI and technology: You actively explore how emerging tools can improve what we build for learners.


NOTE: By applying to the Sr Data Analyst posting recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring these roles will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.


BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
  • World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead.com
  • Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership
  • Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1:1:1 model for giving back to the community

Overview of the Role 

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes - email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don’t, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.


Agentforce for Supply Chain is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase.


We are looking for an early-career, highly driven Value Acceleration Engineer to join us for a unique, high-impact "tour of duty." In this forward-deployed role, you will be on the front lines of our post-sales engine, embedding directly with our enterprise customers and Customer Success teams to bring AI concepts to life and compress their time-to-value. You will be the technical muscle that unblocks implementations, designs agentic workflows, and helps gets 1-2 critical business processes live in production during an intensive 90-day window.


This role is designed as a rotational "Field Residency." After spending your first 6-12 months mastering production edge cases, developing deep customer empathy, and learning the real-world complexities our customers face, you will rotate back into a core AFO product and engineering pod. You will bring those invaluable frontline insights with you to help us build the paved pathways of our future platform.


Responsibilities

Day-to-Day & Project Execution

  • Work hands-on with strategic customers to design and build "Day 1" agentic workflows and blueprints.
  • Participate in 90-day Value Acceleration programs, acting as the technical builder to get 1-2 primary use cases live in production.

  • Facilitate working sessions with customers and deployment strategists, bridging the gap between business needs and technical feasibility.
  • Enable and support implementation partners to take over ongoing build work post-engagement.

Long-Term Goals & Strategic Impact

  • Document design decisions and build patterns from your bespoke customer engagements to feed our use case library and core product roadmap.

  • Successfully graduate from your forward-deployed rotation, transitioning your hands-on deployment expertise into a permanent builder role within the core product pods.

Through our Value Acceleration Residency curriculum, you will move rapidly from shadowing senior team members to independently owning end-to-end customer projects. You will learn how large enterprise supply chains operate on the ground, master customer empathy, and build a unique techno-functional skillset.
  • Impact Made: Your work will directly accelerate time-to-value for our most strategic accounts, clearing onboarding blockers, and setting the stage for massive account expansion. You will be the critical link that turns a signed deal into a highly successful, live deployment.

  • High empathy and exceptional written and verbal communication skills; you must be comfortable presenting to external customers and navigating complex enterprise environments.
  • A strong desire to learn both technical systems and business processes.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment where quick problem-solving is required to unblock implementations.
  • Enthusiasm for a rotational model: excited to spend the first phase of your career at the company deployed in the field before transitioning into core product engineering.

  • Experience with modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, JavaScript) and a proven ability to pick up new technologies quickly.

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Performance & Talent will lead the planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of enterprise talent programs, beginning with promotions. Salesforce is looking for a technically strong, energetic, and collaborative engineers to join the software engineering team for the AppExchange Go To Market App. This is a new platform transforming Salesforce’s AppExchange from a basic listing platform into a fully integrated, transactable marketplace — accelerating ISV sales and recovering lost revenue by giving partners a seamless way to sell and customers an easy way to purchase, deploy, and pay for solutions, all without manual intervention. You’ll help build a product that’s streamlined (a cohesive purchasing and billing experience with fewer manual touchpoints), scalable (faster time to market with reduced overhead), and flexible (supporting a wider range of pricing models, including consumption-based selling). You’ll be part of a team of outstanding engineers with quality top of mind, in an environment built on open communication, feedback, and continuous learning.

As a member on the AppExchange Go To Market App Quality Assurance Team, you will be accountable for the quality of a distributed system that crosses many products and business units, through all phases of the software delivery life cycle. You will own end to end quality of complex or highly ambiguous features, which requires a broad understanding of the distributed architecture and of all functionality owned by the scrum teams. You will use agile methodologies to plan, coordinate, and execute on Test Plans that result in automated tests, hands on tests and guidance to product teams. We are looking for a critical thinker with a natural curiosity to learn our customers’ business, use skills to extract user scenarios from conversations and data and then translate your findings into automatable test plans which either you or a member of the team will automate. A successful team member should have a strong quality approach and will ensure our customers receive high quality work. You will constantly find opportunities to share information and collaborate with other teams for the benefit of our customers, partners, and each other!

What You'll Actually Be Doing:

  • Master the Salesforce development process and codebase, in order to improve it
  • Participate in a Test Design Review Board for integration test plans within and across clouds with focus on functional, business, scenarios, high impact projects, usability, and accessibility
  • Master clouds requirements (e.g. underlying tech stack, business usage, implementation)
  • Build end-to-end, cross cloud-impacting, integration automation (API and UI) with variegated organizations
  • Connect with customers to understand real-life usage, build test cases
  • Execute Testing with sophisticated org setup, multifaceted data shapes
  • Prioritize and drive cross-product testing
  • Advocate for customer improvements
  • Observe product and/or feature-level quality health metrics (testability, test health, test coverage, etc)
  • Works closely with senior developers, PM, and UX to ensure their features are delivered to meet business and quality requirements
  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted testing approaches, such as generating test cases from requirements and analyzing test failures, and share what works with the scrum team.
  • Tackle production issues


You're Our Person If...

  • A related technical degree required
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to address intricate problems in real-time and keep services operational and highly available
  • 4+ years experience in software engineering, quality engineering, usability, or business analysis

The Experience

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team’s expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

Salesforce is currently seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team within the Public Sector pillar of our Customer Success Group (CSG). The Solution Architect leads one or more workstreams in complex enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key collaborators to drive and achieve the vision while completing key deliverables. They serve as hands-on advisors, using strong interpersonal skills, solution and/or technical knowledge, Salesforce product knowledge, industry experience, consulting experience, and knowledge of their client’s business to deliver customer return on investment.

Solution Architects are strong presenters and facilitators that are able to co-create the vision and lead the execution with the customer as well as acquire customer acceptance of the delivered solution. They are capable of driving difficult conversations and removing roadblocks to implement the business strategies. They are proficient at analyzing issues and obstacles to settle root cause, and can identify appropriate corrective action. They communicate with technical and business team members from all levels through C-suite. On a day-to-day basis, they interact with customer product owner, business process owner and technical resources to understand requirements, analyze information, and craft comprehensive solutions. They also show a strong understanding of typical business challenges or common objectives faced by customers within the industry.

Solution Architects are custodians of the Professional Services Methodology and use their networks to ensure that standard processes are followed. They engage with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure the solutions are driving the most effective achievement of the value objectives. Solution Architects supply to thought leadership and standard processes by engaging with the cloud-specific practices teams. They will supply both internally in their community and externally in the marketplace.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the client.
  • Identify and lead internal pivotal initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serve as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise.
  • Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying new technologies that drive increased business value.
  • Work collaboratively and having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching sophisticated concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking across various levels of a client organization.
  • Identify and proactively run risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution.
  • Lead customer expectations; negotiate solutions to sophisticated problems with both the customer and third-party partners.
  • Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artifacts to keep programs on track and solutions extendable and maintainable going forward.
  • Drive a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies to enable technologies including the Salesforce platform.



You're Our Person If...

  • Experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes.
  • Experience leading discovery sessions, defining business requirements, writing user stories and providing detailed system and functional designs.
  • Experience in detailing business processes and wire-framing system designs using process flow diagram tools, UML, sequence diagrams, etc. as well as making recommendations for future state improved processes and system designs.
  • Strong presentation skills; able to optimally present a point of view and clearly articulate the rationale to a variety of team members.
  • Detailed individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.

agents — that scales delivery. You are an industry thought leader who shapes the practice's point of view on the agentic future of the SaaS industry, translating where enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem are heading into how we advise and deliver for customers today.

Who We Are


We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.


About MuleSoft, a Salesforce Company

Our mission is to help organizations change and innovate faster by making it easy to connect the world’s applications, data, and devices. Companies like Spotify, McDonald’s, and Unilever rely on MuleSoft to stay agile, deliver faster, and make the most of their IT investment with API-led connectivity. 


Hiring exceptional people who want to build a great company together is our number one priority, and we’re committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace where everyone is supported and inspired to do their best work. We work tirelessly to build this culture, and we’re proud to have been named the #1 Top Workplace in the Bay Area and a best place to work 6 years in a row.


Role Overview

MuleSoft’s Professional Services team works across every technology and system to deliver solutions to customers in every industry. As a Technical Architect on our Services team, you will work hands-on with our customers and partners to tackle business challenges using MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform. You will provide onsite technical mentorship on MuleSoft implementation projects, evaluate the customer’s technical and functional requirements, and develop efficient solutions to provide customers with demonstrable returns.

As a subject-matter expert in the field, you will develop solutions to help customers realize their business goals and advise them on standard methodologies for on-premise, cloud, and hybrid integration, and API management!


Your Impact

3 months:

  • Participate in MuleSoft Technical Product and Consulting Services training, methodology, and enablement
  • Begin participation in field activities with clients by shadowing seasoned architects/senior consultants and practicing enablement gained from training
  • Begin to complete MuleSoft implementations for customers and start on your journey to internalize business outcomes and business context relevance to MuleSoft implementation methodologies and approaches
  • Complete MuleSoft technical certifications and fully ramp on technology and implementation methodologies; start to develop and contribute subject-matter expertise and project deliverables to architects to review for incorporation into internal knowledge exchanges
  • Begin mentorship and guidance of junior services team members in our services organization

12 months:

  • Continue to provide delivery of projects and provide hands-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and operational life cycle
  • Internalize frameworks, project deliverables, policies and implementations and vet with Senior Architects to contribute to internal collaboration networks and IP sharing
  • Identify ongoing risks and problems throughout project experiences in the field and contribute to developing and implementing internal mitigation measures to meet customer needs
  • Contribute to technical brainstorming sessions and publish reusable content to the field
  • Deliver compelling presentations, architectural blueprint documents, and requirements-gathering workshops to influence the strategic direction of our projects and lead customers through solution design

Qualifications

  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
  • Three to six years minimum hands-on development experience implementing integration solutions
  • Hands-on integration development experience with at least one of the following: MuleSoft or other solutions (e.g., IBM, BEA, Oracle Fusion, TIBCO, Dell Boomi, Progress Sonic, Apigee)
  • API Management solutions (Apigee, Mashery, etc)
  • One or more on-premise/SaaS packaged COTS (Commercial Off-the-Shelf) solutions for ERP, CRM, e-Commerce, or mobile (e.g. Salesforce.com, NetSuite, Oracle, Siebel, SAP, WorkDay, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience implementing multiple technical integration project SDLCs (Software Development Life Cycle) end-to-end
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively implement solutions within a diverse technical team of client, SIs, contractors, and internal teams
  • Contribute integration artifacts to internal initiatives to enrich services organization practices
  • Working knowledge of on-premise infrastructure and cloud-based deployments and configurations along with monitoring and management
  • Experience developing, profiling, and troubleshooting Java application code and automated testing tools
  • Experience in completing technical design documentation and technical reference materials for client/internal consumption
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time (varies depending on customer needs, focused within Region) 

NOTE: By applying to the MuleSoft Technical Architect posting, recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring Technical Architects will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
  • World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead.com
  • Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership
  • Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1:1:1 model for giving back to the community
  • For more details, visit https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/

Internal Audit is modernizing the way we perform our audits, using technology, AI, and analytics to fuel the transformation. The Forward Deployed Consultant owns a customer engagement end to end: from the executive business case, through rapid design and deployment of automated process solutions ("Blueprints") on the Agentforce platform, to a clean handoff to partners and client teams. You will advise enterprise leaders, quantify ROI, and map multi-year automation roadmaps.

You bring domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes, including where people patch over system gaps.

You will also roll up your sleeves to build, test, and iterate Blueprints with AI agents and prompting tools, proving value fast in live production.

You are customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-focused, with the speed and quality to turn fragmented manual workflows into scalable, value-driven solutions.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to enterprise stakeholders, building a deep understanding of business goals and operational pain points.
  • Build business cases and define success criteria up front: KPIs such as cycle time and cost per transaction, with a measured baseline.
  • Own multi-year roadmaps for process Blueprints and automation, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution.
  • Present to executives in terms of their priorities; flag when work is off track early and plainly, with a fix, and drive to a decision.
  • Lead structured discovery (workshops, process maps) and turn it into a solution design and a first working version in days to weeks.
  • Automate business processes end to end (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, supplier onboarding), deciding what stays in the ERP, what is automated around it, and what AI decides versus people.

  • Translate strategic goals into clear PRDs and technical acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver in continuous build loops (design, build, validate, refine), where each loop proves value and expands scope toward AI-first operations.
  • Lead an AI-first delivery experience, using AI agents and skills to accelerate requirements, build, testing, and documentation.
  • Own delivery end to end through go-live: scoping, build, UAT, data migration, and cutover, managing scope change along the way.
  • Cut scope to the highest-value slice(Day 1 Scope/MVP)) when needed to get live, and justify the trade-off to the customer.
  • Design and run handoff processes, documentation, and enablement that transition ownership to implementation partners and customer teams.
  • Set handoff guidelines, solution architecture documentation, and success criteria for sustained post-deployment success.

  • 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Forward Deployed roles, Strategic or Management Consulting, Product Management, Process Automation, or Business Analysis.

  • Experience translating business requirements into automated workflows, PRDs, and user stories.

title: Salesforce 架構師 (Salesforce Architect)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience
我們正在尋找對協助客戶進行數位轉型與業務流程優化有熱情、有想法的夥伴。您將主導從企業系統願景規劃、策略擬定，到實際導入與落地運行的完整流程，並帶領客戶與團隊運用 Salesforce 平台實現業務願景與目標。同時，您也將有機會持續接觸最前沿的 AI 與 CRM 趨勢及技術，拓展專業能力和職涯邊界。

職位特色

  • 結合策略規劃及落地執行：作為顧問或主要合作夥伴（Prime Vendor）的角色，參與具代表性的轉型專案，從前期策略規劃到實際導入上線，協助客戶將轉型藍圖落實為可執行的成果。
  • 應用前沿 AI 技術：協助客戶評估與導入 Agentforce 等新一代 AI 解決方案。使用各式 AI 工具，提升分析深度、設計品質與交付效率。
  • 端到端 (End-to-End) 參與：從願景規劃、架構設計到上線後的落地運行與持續優化，參與專案各個關鍵階段，累積完整且具深度的實戰經驗。


主要角色類型
依據您的專業背景，入職後將主要參與以下其中一類角色：

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager)：負責專案規劃、進度推動與交付管理。
  • BA (Business Architect)：負責商業策略、流程設計與應用推廣。
  • SA (Solution Architect)：負責整體解決方案、資料模型與多雲架構設計。
  • TA (Technical Architect)：負責技術架構、系統整合、資安與效能優化。


What You'll Actually Be Doing
本職位將根據專案需求及您的專業領域，參與以下各階段的任務：

  • A. 戰略與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)：負責制定組織及系統整體的轉型構想與藍圖。組織與業務領域轉型設計：策劃業務流程改革及組織變革的整體架構。規劃組織與業務流程轉型方向，協助客戶建立整體藍圖。系統領域轉型設計：設計企業 IT 架構與 Salesforce 平台發展策略。Salesforce Org 戰略：制定 Salesforce Org（Instance）的活用戰略、治理戰略及發展藍圖規劃 Salesforce Org 的治理模式、使用策略與長期發展方向。Salesforce CTO 顧問：從企業架構或 CTO 顧問角度，協助客戶推動 AI 與數位轉型。變革推動與應用推廣落地：規劃變革管理與推動方案，應用推廣，提升解決方案導入後的落地成效。概念驗證 (PoC)：參與 PoC 設計與驗證，評估方案可行性。
  • B. 專案執行與支援 (Project Execution & Support)：從需求定義到上線發佈，在各階段提供支援或執行實務工作。根據專案特性選擇瀑布式（Waterfall）或敏捷式（Agile）開發。專案管理：參與專案規劃、進度推動與執行管理。需求定義：進行需求訪談、需求分析與流程引導。設計：主導或參與應用設計、架構設計與詳細設計，並審查相關成果。開發與測試：領導實作與測試工作，或制定開發標準及品質管理流程。遷移與部署：執行資料遷移與部署上線，或制定遷移策略並支援執行。CI/CD：協助建立開發標準，開發環境設計、構建與運維等 DevOps 流程。
  • C. 治理與最佳化 (Governance & Optimization)Salesforce 治理 (Governance)：協助建立 Salesforce 治理機制與 CoE (Center of Excellence) 運作模式。設計權威 (Design Authority)：建立或參與設計審查與架構治理流程，確保設計品質。設計品質最佳實踐 (Best Practice)：提供設計最佳實務與優化建議，提升專案交付品質。架構最佳化 (Architecture Optimization)：針對既有環境進行 Org 健檢、架構診斷與最佳化建議。



You're Our Person If...

  • 實務經驗：在以下任一領域具備 7 年以上的實務經驗，並曾擔任主要推動角色：A. 策略規劃與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)；B. 治理與持續優化 (Governance & Optimization)；C. 專案推動與執行 (Project Execution & Support)
  • 領導力：具備 3 年以上團隊帶領或專案領導經驗（職稱不限）。
  • 溝通能力：能與客戶高階主管（含C-Level）及相關利害關係人進行有效溝通，推動共識形成與專案進展。

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience:

In this highly visible role, the Manager, Revenue Recognition Strategy will lead our Standalone Selling Price (SSP) program, including methodology, periodic analysis, reporting, controls, and audit support. SSP determines how revenue is allocated across the products and services in every bundled deal, so your work directly affects the accuracy of our reported results and how confidently the business can launch new pricing, packaging, and go-to-market initiatives. The role also supports monthly and quarterly processes and shares responsibility for SOX compliance, the integration of acquired entities, and system projects within the Revenue Recognition team. As a subject matter expert in Revenue Recognition, you will support our internal revenue team and business partners in reviewing, guiding, and implementing new go-to-market initiatives. You will thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment and work across many functions, including Finance, Product, Sales, Business Technology (BT), and external vendors. You will also need to understand a wide range of issues and business models driven by acquisitions, revenue recognition requirements, and strategic shifts in go-to-market strategy. The position reports to the Director, Revenue Recognition.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:

  • Lead the end-to-end SSP process, including methodology, periodic refresh, data analysis, calculations, and documentation, and continue to enhance and streamline it as the business evolves
  • Partner with business teams to address technical revenue recognition questions on new deal models, pricing and packaging changes (including bundles and potential material rights), and partnerships, and assess SSP implications before launch

title: Customer Success Manager, Marketing Cloud Next (Public Sector)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Marketing Cloud Next is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

This role specializes in guiding organizations through seamless migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms—including Granicus GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement —to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. By identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, the CSM strategically aligns solutions with the customer’s top priorities, projects, and goals.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
  • Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.


Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
  • Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Core Technical Skills Required

  • Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform. Able to architect solutions end-to-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
  • Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to Marketing Cloud Next — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect’s technical approach.
  • Subscriber Data Model & Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
  • Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement ) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to Marketing Cloud Next equivalents.
  • Journey & Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and priortize complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Flow native design patterns.
  • Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post-migration deliverability strategy.
  • Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API-triggered sends and event-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA’s implementation approach.
  • Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
  • Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end-to-end Marketing Cloud Next solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
  • Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
  • Workshop Facilitation & Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
  • Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory’s MDLC wave delivery model.


Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

  • AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
  • Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
  • AI Engagement Monitoring: Use AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
  • Collaborative Learning: Actively seek out Agentblazer training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
  • Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnostic questions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
  • Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
  • Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
  • Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields.
  • Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
  • Possesses industry-relevant expertise and is actively honing skills in a relevant functional area, with an understanding of the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
  • Actively seeks out relevant learning activities, approaches obstacles as growth opportunities, and seeks experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.
  • Position requirements: Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. Company visa sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.


Cloud/Platform Requirements (included with the above):

  • 3+ years of experience supporting customers using Marketing Cloud Next or Legacy Marketing Platform knowledge
    • Marketing Cloud Next - Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform - Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder
    • Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement )
  • Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
  • Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends
  • Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud
  • Knowledge of Salesforce product suite and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy, including knowledge of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Administrator


Note: This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Fixed-term contract
Duration: 12 months
Start Date: February 2027

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.


Who are we looking for?

  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Swedish (essential)

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

title: Customer Success Manager, MuleSoft
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

You are customer-obsessed and serve as the strategic partner and point of accountability for the success of our most complex MuleSoft enterprise customers. You have a deep curiosity to learn customers’ unique culture, business processes, and integration challenges in order to tailor the best possible customer success program for their needs. Unlike traditional software where value is unlocked at implementation, MuleSoft value is realized through continuous adoption, optimization of integration architectures, and expansion of API-led connectivity across the enterprise.

You maintain a relentless focus on your customers’ business goals, partnering to ensure a smooth transition from implementation to long-term value realization. You act as the voice of the customer internally, partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Sales to drive high adoption, satisfaction, retention, and expansion.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration, value realization, adoption, and expansion.
  • Orchestrate the Relationship: Serve as the strategic partner for the customer, collaborating during the implementation phase to ensure seamless transition to adoption and long term value realization of integration and API initiatives.
  • Drive Adoption and Consumption: Proactively manage and maintain the roadmap for platform adoption. Drive optimization of API usage, integration patterns, and automation aligned to the customer’s digital transformation goals to ensure they’re getting full value from their investment.
  • Demonstrate ROI: Define, track, and demonstrate quantifiable business impact and ROI. Move the conversation from API calls to value (e.g., process automation gains, operational efficiency, faster time-to-market) to drive long-term value realization.
  • Executive Relationships: Represent Salesforce with expertise and credibility, partnering with and presenting to senior client executives (CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects) and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Identify New Use Cases: Proactively scout the customer’s business to identify new integration opportunities and use cases that align with business objectives and drive additional platform adoption.
  • Remove Barriers and Manage Risk: Act as the primary orchestrator to proactively identify and minimize risks, remove blockers for adoption, and anticipate obstacles before they impact customer success. Address technical hurdles, architecture questions, and business process friction that prevents scaling of integration capabilities across the enterprise.
  • Drive Expansion: Build the business case for expanding MuleSoft footprint across additional business units, use cases, and integration patterns. Partner with the Sales team to secure renewals and drive expansion of the contract.
  • Voice of the Customer: Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Services to represent customer feedback and critical issues with a focus on outcomes, not just escalation.
  • Partner with Customer Architects: Ensure the integration architecture and API strategy is optimized to support increased connectivity, reusability, and scalability, preventing technical debt from throttling expansion.
  • Champion Center for Enablement: Act as a trusted advisor. Build and nurture a Center for Enablement (C4E) within the customer organization to drive bottom-up adoption, governance best practices, and peer-to-peer advocacy of API-led connectivity.
  • Commercial Strategy and Lead Generation: Act as the primary engine for growth. You are responsible for identifying signals that indicate a customer is ready for contract upsell and partnering with Sales to build the business case for increased investment.



You're Our Person If...

  • Work experience in Customer Success, Enterprise Sales, Professional Services, Technology Consulting, or SaaS platform implementation with demonstrated expertise in integration technologies.
  • Proven success managing large, complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders and business units
  • Established ability to develop relationships with senior executives (Director/VP level) and influence technical strategy
  • Deeper technical knowledge of integration architectures, API design patterns, and platform best practices
  • Demonstrated history of driving incremental Annual Contract Value (iACV) through expansion sales
  • Integration Platform Experience: Experience with MuleSoft and/or relevant competing Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) platforms with understanding of API-led connectivity, system integration patterns, and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Adoption and Expansion Mindset: Proven track record of driving platform adoption, managing complex enterprise accounts, and identifying expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: A strategic, customer centric approach to problem solving focused on driving business value and outcomes, not just resolving technical issues.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills with proven ability to translate technical concepts into business terms and partner with senior client executives from IT teams to C-level.
  • Project Management: Strong orchestration and project management skills, including scope control, stakeholder alignment, timeline ownership, and executive-ready reporting.
  • Agility: Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast paced, high growth environments, with willingness to wear multiple hats and confidence challenging norms to drive customer outcomes.



Even Better If...

  • MuleSoft Certifications: MuleSoft Certified Integration Foundations, MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect, MuleSoft Catalyst Consultant, or Salesforce AI Associate certifications are a strong plus.
  • Technical Background: Experience with software development processes, design methodologies, APIs, web services, databases, cloud platforms, and modern integration patterns.
  • Consulting Experience: Background in management consulting services with track record leading cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution of complex business and technical challenges.
  • Expansion Track Record: Proven history of uncovering new opportunities within existing accounts and partnering with Sales to close expansion revenue. Experience with ‘Land and Expand’ account strategies.
  • Industry Context: Experience working with Enterprise level customers across industries requiring complex integration strategies (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, etc.).
  • AI and Agent Technologies: Foundational understanding of AI and agent technologies. Awareness of how AI capabilities can enhance automation, improve customer experiences, and drive business value through intelligent workflows. Curiosity and willingness to learn how AI augments traditional integration approaches.



Note: this role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week.

You will partner across Corporate Finance, Product Finance, and Go-To-Market (GTM) Finance to deliver a consistent, trusted view of company-wide performance. The role requires a builder’s mindset with AI, strong technical depth in data, and the business judgment to connect data signals to forecast outcomes.

Building with AI & Data Infrastructure

  • Design and build AI-enabled workflows, agents, and tools that automate manual, repeatable analysis and reporting, reducing cycle time and analytical risk
  • Use LLMs, copilots, and automation platforms alongside SQL and Python to accelerate data preparation, pattern identification, anomaly detection, and insight generation
  • Build bespoke datasets and analytical frameworks to support emerging business questions across the enterprise
  • Maintain dashboards and self-service reporting (e.g., Tableau) where they provide durable value for cross-functional partners
  • Champion AI adoption within Finance & Strategy (F&S) by sharing best practices, prototypes, and reusable components with the broader team

Business Analysis & Partnership

  • Deliver analyses on historical trends, forecast drivers, and emerging business questions to inform planning and decision-making
  • Contribute a Finance & Strategy (F&S) perspective to forecast cycles, connecting data signals to drivers, risks, and variances
  • Partner with Corporate Finance, Product Finance, GTM, and Analytics/Ops teams to align on metric definitions and data sources, and to keep operational data consistent with financial reporting
  • Own the integrity of the datasets behind your work, validating against source systems and serving as the first line of defense for anomalies
  • Translate findings into clear business terms and recommendations for senior F&S stakeholders

We are looking for an Offensive Security Researcher with an attacker mindset to discover, analyze, and remediate security vulnerabilities across our products and platforms.

This role focuses on identifying root causes, architectural weaknesses, and recurring security anti-patterns, and implementing secure-by-default solutions that prevent vulnerabilities.

You will work alongside engineering teams to analyze design decisions, improve security posture, and support overall application security maturity.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Conduct offensive security assessments (manual testing, code review, architectural analysis, threat modeling) across application ecosystems.
  • Identify critical, high-impact, and systemic vulnerabilities alongside isolated issues.
  • Perform security research to identify emerging attack vectors, abuse cases, and bypass techniques relevant to our applications and platforms.
  • Partner closely with software engineers, tech leads, and architects to:Explain risk, impact, and exploitability.Design and implement effective remediations.Ensure fixes are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with engineering realities.
  • Execute Secure by Default initiatives by:Applying security guardrails, patterns, and baseline controls.Remediating insecure defaults and unsafe configurations.Preventing vulnerabilities through platform-level and framework-level updates.
  • Review application and platform designs early in the development lifecycle to prevent vulnerabilities before release.
  • Apply security standards, best practices, and architectural guidance during application development.
  • Share security knowledge and offensive techniques with engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with detection, monitoring, and incident response teams to improve visibility into real-world exploitation.



You're Our Person If...

  • 3+ years of experience in Application Security or Offensive Security with an attacker mindset.
  • Demonstrated experience finding and remediating vulnerabilities in complex applications.
  • Strong understanding of:Web application security (OWASP Top 10 and beyond)Authentication & authorization flawsAPI securityInjection attacks, logic flaws, and access control bypassesSecure design and threat modeling
  • Hands-on experience with manual security testing (beyond automated tools).
  • Ability to translate complex security findings into clear, actionable guidance for engineers.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with engineering teams.



Even Better If...

  • Published security research or CVEs (technical blogs, advisories, whitepapers, or conference presentations).
  • Experience implementing platform-level or framework-level security improvements.
  • Background in vulnerability discovery, security research, or red teaming.
  • Experience implementing Secure by Default or security-by-design concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Ability to balance security requirements with product velocity and developer experience.

  • 戦略的伴走とロードマップ策定:顧客のビジネス・技術目標をヒアリングし、現状分析から目標達成を加速する「導入パス(アダプション・パス)」やイネーブルメント計画を策定・実行する。顧客と共にロードマップを作成し、四半期ごとにQBR(Quarterly Business Review)を実施する。
  • 製品活用とガバナンス推進:Salesforce全クラウド・製品群(Sales、Service、Slack、Tableau等)の機能を駆使して活用を推進し、組織戦略・ガバナンス・変更管理(チェンジマネジメント)のベストプラクティスを指導する。
  • プロジェクトのオーケストレーションとリスク管理:顧客の期待値に応じた支援プランを立案・推進し、社内リソース(SA、アーキテクト、営業等)を適宜アサイン・連携させる。目的達成に対するリスクを早期に察知し、アカウントチームと協力して軽減策を講じる。
  • エグゼクティブ・コミュニケーション:CIO、CTO、ビジネス役員などの経営層・意思決定者とエグゼクティブレベルの関係を築き、安定稼動やビジネス効果創出をリードする。技術的な製品変更、障害、サポート終了(EOL)などのアップデートを能動的に伝達する。



You're Our Person If...

  • ビジネスコンサルティング、カスタマーサクセスマネージャー、テクニカルアカウントマネジメントなどのバックグラウンドをお持ちの方(特にBtoC・営業領域での経験)
  • 技術製品の説明が可能な知識レベルをお持ちの方
  • 顧客経営層とのスムーズなコミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方
  • 日本語が流暢な方
  • 社内外のメンバーを巻き込みながら、全体をオーケストレーションするリーダーシップスキルをお持ちの方



Even Better If...

  • 特定の業界、事業部門(LoB)、またはクラウドにおける深い専門知識をお持ちの方
  • 信頼できるアドバイザー(Trusted Advisor)として顧客のビジネス価値向上を牽引した確かな実績をお持ちの方
  • Cレベル(経営層)との効果的な対話力、困難な議論のファシリテーション力、異議申し立てへの柔軟な対応力をお持ちの方
  • Salesforceの製品・プラットフォーム機能、およびガバナンス・エンタープライズアーキテクチャへの深い理解をお持ちの方
  • 技術的・ビジネス的概念を素早く把握し、明確に説明できる方
  • 基本的な英語の読解力をお持ちの方


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。


The Experience

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) leverages deep business, industry, and product knowledge to partner with customers on a Signature support plan. By specializing in a specific line of business (LoB), cloud, or industry, the CSM shares the customer's perspective and language, building strong relationships from executive leadership to the front line to drive value realization through Salesforce products and maximize return on investment (ROI).

This role directly supports the digital journeys of a diverse range of customers varying in market segment, company size, and solution complexity, serving as the ideal partner in delivering value.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic Partnership & Roadmap Planning: Gather customer business and technical goals, and develop and execute an adoption path and enablement plan that accelerates goal achievement based on current-state analysis. Build a roadmap together with the customer and conduct quarterly QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews).
  • Product Adoption & Governance: Drive adoption by leveraging functionality across all Salesforce Clouds and products (Sales, Service, Slack, Tableau, etc.), and guide customers on org strategy, governance, and change management best practices.
  • Orchestration & Risk Management: Plan and drive support plans tailored to customer expectations, assigning and coordinating internal resources (SAs, architects, sales, etc.) as needed. Proactively identify risks to goal achievement and work with the account team to mitigate them.
  • Executive Communication: Build executive-level relationships with decision makers such as CIOs, CTOs, and business executives, leading toward stable operations and business impact. Proactively communicate technical product changes, outages, end of life (EOL), and other updates.



You're Our Person If...

descriptionHtml:

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

GTMA Trust - Full-Stack Software Engineer – PMTS


Join our dynamic team at Salesforce and make a real impact!


GTMA Trust engineers keep Digital Wallet — the product that lets customers manage, budget, and track usage entitlements across their Salesforce investment — reliable at scale. This is a follow-the-sun team that doesn't just monitor and fix; it owns the operational, technical, and data-integrity backbone underneath a live billing/usage platform where mistakes have direct revenue and customer-trust consequences. As a PMTS, you set the technical direction for how the team protects that trust — architecture, tooling, governance, and the practices that let a small trust org support a much larger surface area.

As a PMTS on this team, you will:

  • Own and drive resolution of the most complex, ambiguous, highest-impact production issues — spanning provisioning, billing/usage pipelines, and cross-org data reconciliation (data lake objects, usage/entitlement records tied to tenant billing,  mismatches, tenant provisioning, sandbox-vs-prod attributions) — going beyond triage into systemic root cause and org-wide fixes.
  • Act as a technical gatekeeper and escalation authority for high-risk production changes: knowing when a "point fix" needs a real rollback path instead of repeat manual sign-off.
  • Set the technical direction for service health: define what "critical signal" means, design instrumentation/alerting/dashboard strategy, and drive Ops Review reporting that leadership and partner teams rely on.
  • Identify and lead multi-quarter structural fixes — including auto-detect-and-fix tooling that eliminates recurring manual interventions — rather than accumulating one-off patches.
  • Act as the technical anchor during major incidents and cross-team escalations (including revenue- or deal-critical customer situations), representing GTMA Trust on incident bridges and negotiating shared-issue closure with partner teams like Data360
  • Build and maintain the team's institutional knowledge: root-cause catalogues, runbooks, and enablement docs that let any engineer — not just tenured ones — resolve recurring classes of issues correctly.

Additionally, you will:

  • Partner at a peer level with product engineering's senior technical leadership, shaping roadmap and design decisions before they're finalized.
  • Be the primary technical voice and SME representing GTMA Trust to Product and partner engineering teams.
  • Define and evolve the team's development process, culture, and codebase standards.
  • Set the bar for the hybrid engineering model — quality and completeness of work, not just velocity.
  • Mentor and grow engineers in technologies, tools, processes, and career development.
  • Present designs and strategy to senior internal/external audiences, setting the standard for design review quality.
  • Define test strategy and automation frameworks that reflect real production risk, not checkbox coverage.
  • Participate in on-call rotation as an escalation point for the hardest real-time problems.
  • Lead adoption of AI-native and agentic engineering practices team-wide — owning concrete patterns like AI-assisted root-cause analysis on support requests/alerts before a human engages, building reusable skills/plugins, and reshaping workflows across the SDLC.
  • Coach the team progress along the AI proficiency journey, coaching orchestration-level use of agentic tools and identifying where automation can safely replace manual toil (e.g. approval triage, root-cause drafting, reconciliation queries).

Required Skills:

  • A related technical degree, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions
  • Deep knowledge of object oriented programming and expert-level experience with at least one object oriented programming language (Java, JavaScript, C++, C#, Ruby, Python)
  • Proven experience designing observability and monitoring strategy (e.g., New Relic, Splunk, Grafana) at a system or team level, beyond just consuming dashboards others built
  • High proficiency in at least one high-level programming language and web framework (NodeJS, Express, Hapi, etc.)
  • Proven understanding of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax
  • Validated understanding of database technologies such as SQL, PL/SQL, and relational database schema design, including at scale (data pipelines, large-scale reconciliation, schema correction)
  • Experience designing automated testing strategy and frameworks (Java, JUnit, JSUnit, Selenium) that other engineers build against
  • Demonstrated, hands-on proficiency with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, agent orchestration/agent teams) applied across the SDLC, including planning, validation, and review workflows, with the judgment to know when to trust automation and when human validation is non-negotiable
  • A strong communicator, experienced explaining complex technical concepts and driving alignment across designers, support, other engineers, and leadership
  • Passion for ensuring the customer has an exceptional experience using our products, and the judgment to prioritize systemic fixes over recurring firefighting
  • Curiosity about systems, and a demonstrated ability to root-cause deep, ambiguous, cross-system puzzles
  • You are motivated by helping other engineers succeed and grow. You proactively look for ways to remove toil, mentor others, and multiply the team's impact beyond your own hands-on work

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience building and operating highly scalable, self-healing web applications and services
  • Experience designing and leading gated, phased production rollouts of automated systems (canary/pilot/full rollout)
  • Experience with Agile software development and test-driven development
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent field, or equivalent depth of experience
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity, and driving cross-team consensus without formal authority
  • Track record of contributing reusable tools, skills, or plugins that raised the whole team's (or org's) baseline capability
  • Desire to drive problems to closure, including problems that require convincing other teams to act

Job Category
