Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Director/Senior Director, Industry Strategist joins our Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub, combining deep industry insight with implementation expertise. This person is a recognized subject-matter expert on the life sciences ecosystem, with a focus on commercial pharma but not exclusive to it. They drive implementation success, insights, and velocity across both Salesforce-led and partner ecosystem-led programs, ensuring our accelerators and delivery artifacts translate real customer business processes into usable, adopted product capability. They also inform global GTM strategy and help educate Sales, Industry Advisor, and Services Sales teams on the GTM playbook, a meaningful contribution to the role but not its primary measure of success. This is a senior, high-visibility role requiring executive presence, sound independent judgment, and the ability to operate with significant autonomy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the industry point-of-view strategy on trends, regulatory shifts, and competitive positioning across the life sciences ecosystem
  • Partner with product, engineering, customer success, and sales leadership to map customers' business processes and business journeys against product capabilities, ensuring implementation teams understand the key requirements of key roles across the life sciences ecosystem
  • Map customers' user personas to product capabilities, defining business processes for key customer personas, for example MSLs (Medical Science Liaisons) or FSRs (Field Service Reps), and ensuring reusable templates exist to implement against these personas at scale, formally identifying and escalating product gaps based on real customer business processes
  • Guide the Acceleration Hub's builder teams to create the right usable, adoptable industry accelerators and delivery artifacts, and drive their adoption across SF-led and partner-led programs
  • Serve as a trusted, senior voice with customers throughout their implementation journey, advising and challenging executive stakeholders toward modern approaches that drive success without sacrificing required capabilities or regulatory compliance
  • Coach partners and internal Salesforce consultants on industry best practices, and enable sales teams to communicate value and integrate real customer and user insights into proposals
  • Partner with Business Value Services (the internal value-engineering team that builds the ROI and financial business case for customer transformations) to shape business value narratives, and translate that output into measurement frameworks for evaluating customer outcomes post-implementation
  • Connect customer and ecosystem insight to future product direction, using post-implementation evaluation as a lever to influence the product roadmap rather than only being driven by it, ensuring the role both informs and is informed by what is current, planned, and needed next
  • Contribute industry and implementation insight to global GTM strategy, and support the GTM playbook by educating Sales, Industry Advisor, and Services Sales teams
  • Collaborate with product marketing to shape industry-specific value propositions and enablement content
  • Represent the company as an external thought leader: webinars, conference talks, analyst briefings, customer advisory boards
  • Own reporting on implementation velocity, adoption of accelerators, and delivery insights across SF-led and partner ecosystem programs
  • Deliver polished, high-impact updates to internal leadership and external customer executives

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in life sciences/commercial pharma with deep domain expertise (12+ preferred for Senior Director)
  • Extensive experience implementing CRM solutions in commercial pharma, or advising IT teams as a product owner or key stakeholder on CRM implementations
  • Demonstrated, senior-level ability to map ecosystem roles/personas to product and technical capabilities and identify capability gaps against real customer business processes
  • Deep working knowledge of life sciences regulatory requirements and how they constrain or shape implementation approaches
  • Track record leading or advising implementation programs in a strategist, consulting, or product ownership capacity, ideally with prior people or program leadership experience
  • Experience coaching consultants, partners, or sales teams, and partnering with business value or value-engineering functions to build outcome and measurement frameworks
  • Strong executive presence, a confident and direct voice, and the ability to synthesize complex industry dynamics into clear narratives for C-level audiences
  • Comfortable moving fast and driving decisions with incomplete information
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM/forecasting tools a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

What Success Looks Like

  • Improved implementation velocity and success across SF-led and partner ecosystem-led programs
  • High adoption of industry accelerators and delivery artifacts by builder and delivery teams
  • Recognized as a trusted, challenging industry voice internally, with customers, and externally in the market
  • Partners, internal consultants, and sales teams measurably better equipped to communicate value and apply user insights, with post-implementation outcomes tracked against a defined measurement framework
  • Field and customer insight demonstrably shaping the product roadmap, not just responding to it
  • Meaningful, credited contribution to global GTM strategy and playbook education for Sales, Industry Advisor, and Services Sales teams

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit.   • Act as a trusted advisor: Draw on your deep knowledge of enterprise architecture, business solutions and technology to align customer needs with the power of the Salesforce platform.

  • Strong experience selling to large enterprise accounts (Large Enterprise).
  • Expertise and experience managing large, complex accounts at the highest IT and executive levels.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills at the executive level.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Marketing Cloud & Data 360 Solution Architect

DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team's expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE

Salesforce is currently seeking a Marketing Cloud & Data 360 Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team within Professional Services. This role is centered on being a "Data & Engagement" subject matter expert, leading the design and implementation of enterprise-grade customer engagement and data management solutions. Marketing Cloud and Data 360 expertise is required (similar Martech and CDP expertise is also acceptable), to drive cross-cloud success and unlock enterprise AI and personalization use cases. Deeper Data 360 specialization is considered a plus on top of this core requirement.
The Solution Architect is responsible for architecting scalable, data-driven engagement solutions across enterprise landscapes, ensuring customer data is unified, governed, and activated effectively across channels. You will work closely with Project Managers and Technical Architects to ensure on-time, fully functioning integrations. The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial atmosphere, communicates tactfully with business operations, and effectively designs, tests, and deploys complex marketing and data solutions. You must be an excellent communicator who can tailor delivery to a variety of audiences.

YOUR IMPACT

Through our extended onboarding program of formal certification, internal training, knowledge transfer, hands-on experience and closely working with other Consultants, Architects and Project Managers you will become a Salesforce Domain Authority at the forefront of our offerings, delivering outstanding customer success.

  • Become a Trusted SME: Act as the primary authority for Marketing Cloud and Data 360 to support project delivery, including how data and engagement architecture relate to the success of Agentforce and AI-driven personalization.
  • Strategic Design: Drive the creation of application and technical design documents (Blueprints/FSD) which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer's infrastructure.
  • Unified Customer Engagement: Design and guide customer's enterprise data and engagement architecture, highlighting the importance of Data Governance, consent management, and ensuring solutions adhere to security and privacy regulations.
  • Technical Excellence: Provide guidance on integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and environment management. Lead code reviews and define coding standards (SQL, SSJS, AMPScript).
  • Stakeholder Management: Facilitate and influence Executive Customer stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI.
  • Risk Mitigation: Troubleshoot key customer implementation issues and demonstrate the ability to drive to a successful resolution through proactive risk management.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Fluent in English and French
    Marketing Cloud and Data 360 Expertise:     Direct, hands-on experience designing and configuring Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio) and Data 360 — Ingestion, Unified Profile, Insights, and Activation — and how they integrate . Equivalent experience with a similar Martech or CDP platform is also acceptable.
  • Martech Expertise : Deep expertise of Martech Ecosysem, Customer journey orchestration, Digital campaign management and Optimization
  • Architectural Proficiency: Solid understanding of system designs and integration patterns, data modeling, MDM, development Lifecycle and Deployment (DevOps)
  • Solution Documentation: Ability to clearly and articulately document solutions, including data flows, engineering flowcharts, and technical artifacts.
  • Requirement Translation: Ability to create a solution based on client requirements and map business processes into our technical product suite.
  • Cross-Cloud Integration: Knowledge of API patterns (REST/SOAP) and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CRM, data lakes).
  • Technical Leadership: Lead inter-team meetings on technical and business challenges; conduct solutions testing and validation.
  • Mobility: Travel to client sites for onsite discovery and solutions presentations (estimated 25%-50%).
  • Education: Engineering School Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

PREFERRED

  • Marketing Cloud Expertise : 6+ Years of direct experience with Marketing Cloud, including designing and building multi-channel journeys, increase customer engagement and optimize campaigns ROI.

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You’ll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You’ll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you’re looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn’t it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers’ time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You’ve built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You’ve implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform

Key Responsibilities

  • Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
  • AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
  • Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
  • Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
  • AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
  • Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development. 
  • Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
  • AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
  • Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.


Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
  • Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
  • Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
  • Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
  • Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
  • Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
  • Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
  • Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
  • Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
  • Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks

À propos du poste
Un impact client dès le premier jour. Une vision stratégique claire et une exécution qui dure.

Salesforce recrute des Deployment Strategists — des Strategic Builders qui sont des conseillers en contact direct avec les clients, définissent la stratégie IA, façonnent des solutions agentiques et pilotent une adoption mesurable pour les entreprises clientes. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery aux côtés de Forward Deployed Engineers, en traduisant des défis métier complexes en déploiements d'IA agentique qui passent en production et génèrent une valeur réelle. Les missions sont ciblées et limitées dans le temps — généralement 12 semaines ou moins — et peuvent porter sur un compte stratégique unique ou sur plusieurs clients simultanément. Votre impact ne s'arrête pas au déploiement : vous vous assurez que les clients tirent une valeur durable et scalable des solutions construites par votre équipe.

  • Ownership complet du cycle de vie : Pilotez l'engagement client de bout en bout sur l'ensemble du cycle de valeur — Identifier → Engager → Déployer → Consommer — en assumant les résultats à chaque étape, pas seulement lors de la découverte ou de la conclusion du deal.

Animez des ateliers de conception, des sessions de design d'agents et des analyses jobs-to-be-done. Concevez des solutions couvrant la plateforme d'IA agentique de Salesforce, Data Cloud et les systèmes d'entreprise, avec une gouvernance IA responsable intégrée dès le départ.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About the Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

  • Edge Caches
  • Realtime Services
  • Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
  • International Data Residency (IDR)
  • Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).
We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.


We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
  • Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
  • Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
  • Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
  • Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
  • Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
  • Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
  • Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
  • Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If:

  • You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
  • You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
  • You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
  • You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
  • You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
  • You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
  • You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
  • You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
  • An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If:

  • You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
  • Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Building
 

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.



Nice-to-Haves
 

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 

  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.
  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.
  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.
  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.



Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 

  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.
  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.
  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.
  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.
  • Développer et maintenir des dashboards de performance des agents et des reportings KPI clients pour suivre la santé des déploiements et les résultats business.
  • Contribuer à des preuves de concept et des MVP qui passent de l'esquisse au déployable en jours, pas en mois.
  • Co-construire aux côtés des clients et partenaires, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en les montant en compétences au fil des missions. Laisser les équipes plus capables après chaque engagement qu'avant.
  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.
  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.



Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 

  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.
  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.
  • Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage parmi Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Apex — et êtes prêt à en ajouter d'autres selon les besoins.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des LLMs et du prompt engineering. Vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un prompt a échoué et ce que vous changeriez.
  • Vous comprenez la modélisation de données, les APIs et les patterns d'intégration suffisamment en profondeur pour les concevoir, pas seulement les consommer.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans une salle avec des équipes commerciales et des architectes clients.
  • Vous livrez du code de qualité et évaluez les outputs IA avec la rigueur d'un ingénieur.
  • Vous explorez activement le paysage IA/data en évolution — en testant de nouveaux outils, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles, et en restant sincèrement curieux de ce qui arrive.
  • Vous vous épanouissez dans le groupe de travail qui construit quelque chose, pas seulement qui en parle.
  • Vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée de voyager ~25% du temps pour travailler directement aux côtés des clients.



Atouts supplémentaires
 

  • Expérience sur la plateforme Salesforce ou certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarité avec les frameworks d'agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex) et les patterns d'orchestration
  • Expérience pratique des plateformes de données cloud (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

This is a hands-on architecture role for a technical leader who can define a compelling platform experience and help deliver it in production. You'll shape how agents work, how they connect to tools and models, how they use enterprise knowledge, and how they support developers across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Your work will help teams adopt AI safely and effectively, improve developer productivity, and avoid solving the same platform problems independently.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own the strategy and architecture for a powerful agentic platform experience that enables teams to build, compose, deploy, and operate agents across Salesforce. Set architecture and adoption direction for MCP, including server and client patterns, tool discovery, interoperability, identity, authorization, and lifecycle management.
  • Define reusable platform capabilities for agent orchestration, tool and skill integration, agent runtimes, state and memory, human oversight, evaluation, and production operations.
  • Set technical direction for agentic framework adoption, including the use of Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph. Guide framework integration and evolution while keeping the platform coherent, extensible, and adaptable to new approaches.
  • Establish patterns that help teams move from prototypes to dependable production agents, with clear paths for customization, evaluation, observability, and ongoing improvement.
  • Drive new AI-enabled developer experiences across the SDLC, including code understanding and generation, test creation, code review, debugging, modernization, documentation, and release or operational workflows.
  • Define how MCP fits into agent runtimes and the broader platform, enabling agents to connect to enterprise tools and systems through secure, governed, and reusable integrations.
  • Define the architecture and evolution of a secure, extensible LLM Model Gateway that provides consistent model access, policy enforcement, observability, resilience, and governance across providers and deployment types.
  • Drive a cost-effective model portfolio spanning small language models (SLMs) and large language models (LLMs). Evaluate when to use hosted, open-weight, fine-tuned, or specialized models for different workloads.
  • Develop ways to measure and improve model economics, including cost per successful task, token and context efficiency, retry rates, inference utilization, and the impact of model or routing changes.
  • Own the strategy for context engineering and enterprise knowledge management so agents can access relevant, grounded, and permission-aware information.
  • Guide the architecture of enterprise retrieval systems, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Graph RAG, and determine how they work with enterprise data, knowledge sources, and agent workflows.
  • Set shared standards for security, privacy, governance, reliability, observability, evaluation, and human oversight across agents, models, tools, and data.
  • Stay close to implementation by prototyping ideas, validating architecture through working systems, reviewing critical designs, and helping teams resolve technical tradeoffs.
  • Align engineering, product, security, data, and infrastructure partners around platform strategy, adoption, and delivery.
  • Communicate architectural decisions clearly, influence across teams, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
  • Design complex systems where AI agents fit smoothly into human workflows, and ship secure, high-quality software with AI as a core part of your own development workflow. Build and maintain the shared system context that lets AI work accurately, and review code, whether written by people or AI, for correctness, quality, security, and performance.

  • You have hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph, including the ability to evaluate their tradeoffs and establish scalable platform patterns.
  • You have experience designing model gateways, inference platforms, model-serving systems, model orchestration layers, or equivalent shared services.
  • You have experience evaluating models against real workloads, with a practical understanding of quality, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost tradeoffs.
  • You are familiar with SLMs, LLMs, model routing, fine-tuning, quantization, inference optimization, or other ways to improve cost and performance.
  • You have experience building enterprise knowledge or retrieval systems using RAG, Graph RAG, search, or related approaches.
  • You have experience designing application programming interfaces (APIs) and extensible integration patterns. Familiarity with MCP or comparable tool and protocol ecosystems is a plus.
  • You have expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as identity and authorization, data platforms, retrieval and search, context management, workflow orchestration, platform security, or developer experience.
  • You understand software development workflows and how to assess whether AI capabilities improve developer experience, productivity, and engineering outcomes.
  • You use sound judgment around security, privacy, reliability, performance, and operational cost in fast-changing technical environments.
  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, security, and business teams.
  • You bring a genuine AI-first approach to engineering. You use AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor to move faster and work across the stack, and you write precise, structured prompts that make AI output reliable, secure, and production-ready.
  • A related technical degree required.

title: AI Native Delivery Consultant
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

職務の目的「グローバル標準手法とAIを駆使し、日本のデリバリーの変革を自ら主導する」

本ポジションは、グローバル標準手法である Salesforce Professional Services Methodology (SPSM) をベースに、グローバルの Global Delivery Center (GDC) が主導する AI-Native Delivery（AI-Native Agentic Delivery）を自ら主導し、日本の Delivery Method の変革を通じてお客様のビジネス成果を支援する役割です。

AI-Native Delivery とは、従来の「人が一つひとつ手作業で構築する」デリバリーから、「AIエージェントが技術成果物（メタデータ・設定・コード・テスト・ドキュメント等）を生成し、人が意図の定義・検証・承認・ガバナンスに注力する」新しいデリバリーモデルへの転換を指します。GDCが世界規模で確立したこのモデルを日本市場に導入・定着させ、日本のデリバリーのあり方そのものを変革することが最大のミッションです。

お客様にとっての Trusted Guide（信頼できるガイド）として、業務の可視化と意図の明確化を起点に、Agentforce をはじめとする Salesforce ソリューションの設計・構築・検証・本番展開・定着化・内製化までを一貫してリードし、お客様のビジネス成果と ROI（投資対効果）を最大化します。

本ポジションの特徴

(1) SPSMをベースにGDC主導のAI-Native Deliveryを自ら主導し、日本のデリバリーを変革する

グローバル標準手法である SPSM を土台に、GDCがグローバルで確立した AI-Native Delivery を、日本のお客様のプロジェクトで自ら主導します。単にグローバルの手法を適用するだけでなく、日本固有のビジネスコンテキストや商習慣に合わせて最適化し、日本の Delivery Method そのものの変革をリードします。GDCの世界水準の技術力・知見と密に連携しながら、日本市場における AI-Native Delivery の推進役を担います。

(2) AI-Nativeプロジェクトのデリバリーを主要な工程で自ら主導する

AIエージェントによる自動化（agentic automation）を、エンドツーエンドのAIプロジェクトデリバリーの主要な工程に適用し、デリバリーのタイムラインを大幅に加速します。要件分析／ユーザーストーリー作成／意思決定の記録／自動ビルド・デプロイ／オブザーバビリティという5つの主要な工程でエージェンティックな自動化を活用し、各工程でAIが生成・実行し人が検証・承認する「AI generates, humans decide（AIが生成し、人が判断する）」を実践します。生成の速さと人による品質統制を両立させ、Trusted Guide として工程全体を主導します。

(3) AI-Native Delivery を軸に、広範な技術領域へ拡大する

技術領域は Agentforce にとどまらず、Data Cloud、Salesforce プラットフォーム全般（Sales / Service / Marketing）、外部AIサービス連携まで広がります。AIツール群を適材適所で活用し、デリバリーのスピードと品質を両立させます。従来型と比べて高い生産性を実現し、短いサイクルでの開発サイクルを推進します。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • AI-Native Delivery の主導と日本市場への定着 GDCがグローバルで確立した AI-Native Delivery と SPSM を、日本のお客様のプロジェクトで自ら主導する。日本固有のビジネスコンテキストに合わせて手法を最適化・適用し、日本の Delivery Method の変革をリードする。
  • AI-Nativeプロジェクトのデリバリー（agentic automationの活用） エンドツーエンドのAIプロジェクトデリバリーを加速するため、以下の主要な工程でAIエージェントによる自動化を活用し、各工程を主導する。要件分析: 複雑なお客様要件の抽出・分析・構造化を高速化し、手作業による認識合わせのループを最小化する。ユーザーストーリー作成: 詳細で着手可能なユーザーストーリーと受入基準を自動生成し、スプリント計画の時間を大幅に短縮する。意思決定の記録: 重要なアーキテクチャ上の決定や設計上の選択を自動的に文書化し、継続的で信頼できる「唯一の情報源（source of truth）」を維持する。自動ビルド・デプロイ: エージェンティックなワークフローにより、コード生成・CI/CDパイプライン・環境構築を効率化する。オブザーバビリティ: 能動的なモニタリングとトレーシングを実装し、エージェントの最適なパフォーマンス・信頼性、およびデプロイ後の迅速なトラブルシューティングを確保する。
  • 品質統制 AIエージェントが生成したメタデータ・設定・コード・テスト・ドキュメントを レビューし、検証し、承認する。生成の速さだけでは価値にならず、人による検証と承認をセットにして初めて成果になるという原則を徹底する。LLMの柔軟性とルールベースの正確性の境界を見極め、ハイブリッドなアプローチで決定論的に制御する。
  • 成果ベースのデモンストレーション ステータス報告資料ではなく、実際に動作するソフトウェア（実画面・実フロー・実データ）でビルドの成果を実証する。
  • GDCとの協働 グローバルのGDCと密に連携し、その世界水準の技術力・知見を活かしながらデリバリーを推進する。お客様と直接対話してスコープを合意し、GDC側へは日本固有のコンテキストを排除した明確で誤解のない指示として伝達する。



You're Our Person If...

  • 実務経験: 5-11年以上のエンタープライズ・システムにおけるコンサルティング、または要件定義から設計・開発・テスト・本番移行に至る構築プロセスの主導的な実務経験。
  • IT構築プロセスの理解: 戦略策定・意図定義から要件定義、設計・開発・テスト・移行に至る一連のプロセスの深い知見。
  • AIリテラシーと実務活用経験: AI・LLMを活用したソリューション構築、またはAIツール群を用いた実務効率化の経験。「推論・確率ベース」と「ルールベース」の双方の基礎理解。
  • 論理的コミュニケーション力: 意図を明確に言語化し、お客様やチームと合意形成できる力。
  • 言語能力:日本語: 流暢（お客様と円滑に合意形成できること）英語: ビジネスレベル（GDCのメンバーと技術的な詳細を議論・指示できること）



Even Better If...

  • 業務分析・モデリング（UML / BPMN / DMN 等）の経験
  • 顧客折衝・合意形成、エンタープライズアーキテクチャの経験
  • API／インテグレーション設計、新技術導入提案・PoC の経験
  • Salesforce プラットフォーム（Apex / Flow / Data Cloud）の開発経験
  • Agentforce をはじめとする対話型AI・エージェント開発（プロンプトエンジニアリング、AIオーケストレーション、エージェントフレームワーク）の経験
  • 異文化環境での協働経験、およびインドGDC等の海外技術者と英語で協働した経験
  • Salesforce 認定資格（Administrator / Platform Developer / Application・System Architect 等）



SPSMをベースにGDC主導のAI-Native Deliveryを自ら主導し、日本のデリバリーの変革を通じてお客様のビジネス成果を支援します。特定の役割に固定されず、AI-Native Delivery の全フェーズを幅広く担当します。

本ポジションで得られる経験グローバル標準手法（SPSM）とAI-Native Deliveryを、自ら主導して日本市場に導入・変革する実務経験AI・データを前提とした最先端デリバリーモデルの専門性意図定義から定着化までを一貫して担う、業務変革の実務経験複数の技術領域を横断する総合的なコンサルティング能力グローバルチーム（GDC）と協働し、グローバル標準手法を日本市場に適用する経験

求める人物像AIを武器にできる方: 従来のやり方に固執せず、AIや新しいテクノロジーを積極的に取り入れ、デリバリーの形そのものを進化させたい方。変革を自ら主導できる方: グローバル標準手法とAI-Native Deliveryを日本市場に導入し、日本のデリバリーのあり方そのものを変えていく当事者意識を持つ方。Trusted Guide たりうる方: 「自ら建てる」から「方向付け・レビュー・承認する」への発想転換を楽しみ、AIの生成物を的確に検証・判断できる方。高い当事者意識: 案件の成功に向けて自らプロセスと品質をコントロールするプロフェッショナリズムを持つ方。戦略的リーダーシップ: 文化や背景の異なる多国籍チームを統合し、共通のゴールへ力強く導ける方。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

私たちは「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。


【柔軟な働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】

  • ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
  • フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
  • 充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
  • ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Account Executive, Growth Market Sales
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Account Executive, Growth Market 
Our Growth Market Team is part of our wider Enterprise Sales Teams, focusing on working with exciting growth organizations. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied customers and personalized training and career opportunities.


Why Join Salesforce as an Account Executive?

This team is extremely tight knit; we celebrate our differences and wins and learn from losses. You’re joining our Ohana, and we’re all working towards the same goals.
This role is the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in all things Salesforce. You will get exposure to a range of internal teams and business units, so your overall knowledge of how we work and operate will grow very quickly.
We have a strong and tenured leadership team who come to work every day full of energy and looking for opportunities to support the team. We offer formal and informal training for all people coming into this role, and this will be entirely focused around your strengths and goals. We encourage 360 degree feedback, so you have the opportunity to take your own initiative and blaze your own trail.
 

Day to Day

  • Our Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.
  • You will use your new business development skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.
  • Close opportunities at assigned existing accounts and drive sales at new accounts
  • Drive sales within assigned segment (medium size business)
  • Acquire new logos within assigned territory
  • Speak to Salesforce offerings as they relate to the customer’s needs and engage other Salesforce resources as required
  • Manage high volume of accounts and sales

Who you are

We have an open mind in Growth Market and we’re not just looking for Account Executives who have experience in SaaS. If you have been in a quota carrying sales role looking after end-to-end sales processes, then we want to talk to you!
Embody a growth mindset – You’re thinking ahead and have a plan for yourself.
You're able to craft a point of view, hold an opinion, and build credibility as a ‘Trusted Adviser’ within your customers.
Self awareness is very important, and you must understand your ‘why’. You’re naturally curious and will be excited about the chance to absorb all Salesforce has to offer.
We don’t need you to have used Salesforce before, but it would have an advantage. A genuine passion for technology, disruption and innovation is also ideal.
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

  • 5+ years of IT software sales experience
  • Business level of Korean and English language skills

Working at Salesforce

  • Working at Salesforce isn’t all about selling. It’s also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including: a week-long product bootcamp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.
  • Benefits
  • We are pioneers of the Pledge 1% model, providing product, grants and community service to those in need. We are proud to be#1 in PEOPLE's Top 50 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list.
  • We provide every employee with 7 paid volunteer days off a year, and donation matching for all approved charitable donations.
  • We provide other world-leading benefits to all our employees, including;
  • Health, life insurance, retirement saving plan
  • Monthly wellness allowance
  • Flexible time off & leave policies
  • Parental benefits
  • Perks and discounts


------
Growth Market Account Executive
Growth Market 팀은 광범위한 엔터프라이즈 영업 팀의 일부이며, 흥미로운 성장 조직과 협력하는 데 중점을 둡니다. 다양한 고객과 함께 빠르게 변화하는 팀에서 일하고, 개인 맞춤형 교육 및 경력 개발 기회를 얻을 수 있습니다.


Salesforce Account Executive로 합류해야 하는 이유
우리 팀은 매우 긴밀하며, 서로의 차이점과 성공을 축하하고 실패로부터 배웁니다. 여러분은 우리의 ‘오하나(Ohana)’에 합류하게 되며, 우리는 모두 같은 목표를 향해 나아갑니다.
이 역할은 Salesforce의 모든 것을 경험할 수 있는 완벽한 기회입니다. 다양한 내부 팀과 사업 부문에 노출되어 우리의 업무 방식과 운영 방식에 대한 전반적인 지식을 빠르게 넓힐 수 있습니다.
우리는 매일 활력이 넘치고 팀을 지원할 기회를 찾는 강력하고 숙련된 리더십 팀을 보유하고 있습니다. 우리는 이 역할에 새로 합류하는 모든 사람에게 공식 및 비공식 교육을 제공하며, 이는 여러분의 강점과 목표에 완전히 집중될 것입니다. 우리는 360도 피드백을 장려하여 여러분이 주도적으로 자신의 길을 개척할 수 있도록 지원합니다.


일상 업무

  • Account Executive는 기존 고객 및 신규 리드와 소통하여 전체 Salesforce Customer 360 플랫폼을 판매합니다. 담당 지역 내 주요 팀원 및 의사 결정권자와 긍정적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 관계를 구축하고, 고객이 Salesforce 투자를 통해 가치를 실현하도록 돕는 데 능숙해집니다.
  • 따뜻한 리드와 화이트스페이스 영업을 통해 새로운 비즈니스 개발 기술을 활용하여 기회를 창출합니다.
  • 할당된 기존 계정에서 기회를 성사시키고 신규 계정에서 매출을 창출합니다.
  • 할당된 세그먼트(중견 기업) 내에서 매출을 주도합니다.
  • 할당된 지역 내에서 새로운 로고를 확보합니다.
  • 고객의 요구와 관련된 Salesforce 제품을 설명하고 필요한 경우 다른 Salesforce 리소스를 참여시킵니다.
  • 많은 계정 및 영업을 관리합니다.

어떤 분을 찾고 있나요
우리는 Growth Market에서 열린 마음을 가지고 있으며, SaaS 경험이 있는 Account Executive만 찾는 것은 아닙니다. 엔드 투 엔드 영업 프로세스를 담당하는 할당량 기반 영업 역할을 수행한 경험이 있다면, 우리는 여러분과 이야기하고 싶습니다!

B2B buying has changed. Buyers research on their own, decide as a group, and expect fast, personal answers on the channels they prefer. Sales Cloud is building what comes next: one revenue motion where marketers, sellers, revenue operations teams, and AI agents work the same accounts together, inside the CRM.

As Director, Product Management for B2B Revenue Automation, you own the product strategy that brings sales and marketing together. At Salesforce, we're seeking outstanding individuals to join our team as an Apromore Account Executive with a strong technical background and expertise in process intelligence & AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will be pivotal in driving revenue growth, encouraging enduring client relationships, and applying innovative process intelligence technology to redefine customer engagement across Benelux, the Nordics, and Switzerland.


About Apromore

Apromore is a global leader in AI-driven process intelligence technology. Now part of Salesforce, Apromore provides organizations with an "Intelligent Process Twin" to gain complete operational transparency. As enterprises rush to scale AI, Apromore bridges the gap between process perception and reality, acting as the critical backbone that enables organizations to systematically discover, de-risk, deploy, and govern Agentic AI automation across the enterprise.


About the Role

As a part of our Apromore AE selling team, you will act as a strategic hunter and evangelist for Apromore, Salesforce’s process intelligence platform, focusing heavily on Agentic AI adoption. You will target enterprise clients across Benelux (Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg), the Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland), and Switzerland who are scaling AI into production, positioning Apromore as the definitive mechanism to identify the ideal high-propensity, high-ROI use cases for AI agents (such as Agentforce).

You will navigate complex, enterprise-grade B2B sales cycles by helping C-level executives move away from broad anecdotes and scope precisely defined, value-driven automation pipelines. We are looking for individuals with strong experience in selling process intelligence/process mining solutions, understanding AI and cloud-based services, and designing bespoke B2B solutions for technical and business leaders alike.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Drive Agentic AI Adoption in Northern Europe: Employ your wealth of sales knowledge to position Apromore as the key solution for scaling AI initiatives such as Agentforce across Benelux, Nordic, and Swiss enterprises, showing customers how clean process context, clear handoffs, and well-understood workflows are required to deploy agents safely and productively.
  • Deliver Value-Based Messaging: Target executive decision-makers across Automation/AI, Digital Transformation, Operational Excellence, and Risk & Compliance to map process frictions directly to financial business impact.

  • Manage Full Sales Lifecycles: Own end-to-end B2B sales processes—from pipeline generation and prospecting to qualifying and closing complex enterprise software transactions within your assigned territory.
  • Sustain Continuous Value Post-Deployment: Shift clients from an initial deployment mindset to long-term partnerships. Drive ongoing account expansion by selling further process intelligence capabilities to ensure realized value scales with their business.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Value Engineers, Solution Consultants, and regional Salesforce sales teams to deliver a unified "One Salesforce" enterprise experience.

What you should have:

  • 10+ Years of Enterprise Software Sales Experience: Proven track record of selling enterprise SaaS, cloud software, or complex business analytics tools to executive buyers, specifically within the Benelux, Nordic, and/or Swiss markets.
  • Proven Process Intelligence Expertise: Deep background selling process intelligence and related technologies, such as process analytics, task mining, and simulation (e.g., from Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS).
  • Technical Acumen: Sophisticated intuition for business and the ability to conduct technical in-depth discovery mapping, aligning clients' existing architectures to the Apromore platform.
  • Strong Technical Selling Skills: The ability to explain complex process intelligence concepts to non-technical clients and translate data/architecture discussions into clear business outcomes.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistently surpassing sales targets within a technical sales environment, underscoring your proficiency in intricate, multi-stakeholder sales processes.
  • Language Skills: Fluent/Native in English. Fluency in Dutch, a Nordic language (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish), German, or French is highly preferred.
  • Industry/Vertical Knowledge: Deep insight into key regional industries such as Retail & eCommerce, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, or Manufacturing & Supply Chains.
  • Education: A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with an extensive background in technology sales.

Characteristics:

  • This role requires an outstanding blend of technical depth and sales competence, with the ability to articulate complex AI-driven solutions to a diverse mix of customers.

  • Set the bar for design reviews, code reviews, testing, and CI practices across your teams.
  • Mentor and elevate senior/lead engineers and peer teams, primarily through reviews, and lead service-ownership practices — on-call rotations, readiness reviews, and automation.
  • Command the room: explain broad initiatives, high-level architecture, and technical vision with clarity and confidence to VP-level leadership, Product, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Dutch (essential)

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?

Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values

  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups

  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

The Experience

Collectors are directly responsible for converting the accounts receivable portfolio into cash, positively impacting Salesforce’s cash flow by collecting payments directly from customers.

Healthy cash flow is viewed by the investment community as both an efficiency and financial measure, and it is a component of our stock price. It also funds operating expenses as well as investments in research and development, enabling us to fuel growth.

In this role, you will manage an assigned Enterprise portfolio and drive process improvement across all market segments within collections. You will also support non-standard collection efforts through M&A, AWS, MuleSoft, Tableau and more, positioning yourself as a go-to expert for both core and specialty collections.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Manage an assigned Enterprise portfolio, balancing standard collection efforts and process improvement initiatives with support for M&A, AWS, Tableau, MuleSoft, and other specialty collections.
  • Evaluate account solvency and customer willingness to pay, facilitate payments by providing required documentation (e.g., invoices, payment instructions), and negotiate payment plans for distressed accounts per the established approval matrix.
  • Resolve billing disputes with Sales Operations, Sales teams, and other internal stakeholders; escalate significant payment issues to Collections and Sales management; and partner with Credit Analysts on financially distressed accounts.
  • Perform collection activities in line with Salesforce’s policies and processes, including executing account suspensions on delinquent accounts, providing suspended account details to the Write-Off and Bad Debt team, and contributing to process improvement projects as assigned.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have a degree or equivalent relevant experience. We evaluate experience against the Values & Behaviors for the role (e.g., extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience).
  • You have at least 1 year of credit collections experience in a high-growth environment (or equivalent), including experience contributing to process improvement initiatives and/or project management.
  • You have strong organizational and customer relationship skills and can manage high transaction volumes and a variety of customer interactions.
  • You show initiative and curiosity, including actively experimenting with AI tools. You thrive in a team, work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate results on deadline in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.



Even Better If...

  • Experience with specialty or non-standard collections (e.g., M&A, AWS, MuleSoft, Tableau)
  • Experience negotiating payment plans or resolving billing disputes with Sales and Finance partners

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddies who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Who are we looking for?


  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Spanish is Essential

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations


  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.

    Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Sales Graduate Rotation


  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation


  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

What’s in it for you?


  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:
