  • インダストリー強化 & パートナー・エコシステム連携
    • 業界トレンドに沿ったアーキテクチャ構想: インダストリー専門アドバイザーと協業し、最新の業界動向と技術プラットフォーム（自律型AI AgentforceやData Cloud等）を組み合わせた最適なソリューションモデルを策定します。
    • 既存システム環境との統合設計: お客様が保有するマルチDWHや基幹系システムとSalesforceプラットフォームのデータ連携・システム統合アーキテクチャを設計・最適化します。
    • アライアンス・パートナー協業の推進: エコシステムパートナー（データ連携、DevOps、AppExchange等）との共同ソリューション設計や市場展開を推進します。
    • 外部カンファレンス・イベントでの発信: 大型ITイベントやエグゼクティブ向けセッションでの登壇・事例紹介を通じて、最先端の技術価値を広く発信します。
  • 組織への貢献・ナレッジシェア & チーム育成サポート
    • ソリューションアセットの共有: 高難度案件で確立したアーキテクチャパターンや提案フレームワークを標準化し、ソリューションエンジニアリング組織全体へ展開します。

You're Our Person If...

日本を代表する大手企業の変革に寄与: 個別システムの導入にとどまらず、業界をリードするエンタープライズ企業の経営層とともに未来のIT姿を描く、社会的インパクトの大きい役割です。

最先端テクノロジー（AI×Data）の実践: 自律型AI（Agentforce）や次世代データプラットフォーム（Data Cloud）をはじめ、時代を先駆けるテクノロジーを駆使した高度なソリューション設計に挑戦できます。

ソリューションエンジニアとしての専門性とキャリアの拡大: 高度なアーキテクチャ設計力、Executive交渉力、広域なソリューション展開力を磨き、ソリューションエンジニアとして市場価値の高いキャリアを形成できます。

The Strategic Solution Engineer (Strategic SE) is an expert who designs strategic solution architectures and leads technical proposals for the most important, large-scale enterprise customers and the most complex deals, especially in industries such as B2C retail, consumer goods, and life sciences. Going beyond individual product implementations, you will take a cross-product view and integrate Salesforce's full product portfolio (Agentforce, Data 36O, Data Foundations, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Industry Cloud, Tableau, Slack, etc.) and the partner ecosystem, turning customers' management challenges and business transformation Vision into realistic, advanced architectures.


You will work alongside Account Solution Engineers (Account SEs), who drive individual deals, as a specialist who supports architectural vision from a broader IT landscape and long-term technology perspective. You will bring integrated coverage across all products (All Products), not limited to any single product framework.


Building on your experience earning customer trust and driving business, you can expand your impact beyond individual proposals to industry-wide technology vision, partner collaboration, sharing technical knowledge with the team, and Executive Alignment with C-level leaders (CxO).

    • Leading solutions for large, complex deals: Lead the overall architecture design and concept visualization for proposals requiring highly advanced technical requirements and system configurations, guiding them to success.
  • Industry enhancement and partner ecosystem collaboration
    • Architecture vision aligned with industry trends: Work with industry advisors to define optimal solution models that combine the latest industry trends with technology platforms (such as autonomous AI Agentforce and Data Cloud).
    • Integration design with existing systems: Design and optimize data integration and system integration architectures between customers' multiple data warehouses and core systems and the Salesforce platform.
    • Alliance and partner collaboration: Drive joint solution design and go-to-market with ecosystem partners (data integration, DevOps, AppExchange, etc.).
    • Sharing at external conferences and events: Communicate cutting-edge technology value broadly through speaking and case presentations at major IT events and executive sessions.
  • Organizational contribution, knowledge sharing, and team development
    • Sharing solution assets: Standardize architecture patterns and proposal frameworks established on complex deals and roll them out across the Solution Engineering organization.
    • Mentoring and collaboration: Provide on-the-job training through deals and share knowledge with team members, helping raise the team's technical skills and proposal quality.

  • Experience in solution design and technical proposals in enterprise IT (CRM, AI, data integration platforms, cloud architecture, etc.) (10+ years recommended)
  • Track record of presenting to and building consensus with executive and IT leadership such as CIOs, CTOs, and IT department heads (Executive Alignment)
  • Logical thinking to grasp complex business challenges and translate them into mid- to long-term technology vision and system architecture
  • Communication and orchestration skills to collaborate smoothly with diverse stakeholders such as sales, solution engineers, specialist advisors, and partner companies
  • Strong curiosity about cutting-edge technology (AI, data platforms, etc.) and a self-driven motivation to learn and test
  • Fluent-Level Japanese
  • Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or MIS (Management Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience

Even Better If...


  • Industry knowledge and proposal/implementation experience in retail (department stores, supermarkets, convenience stores, apparel, specialty stores, food service), consumer goods, life sciences, etc.
  • Knowledge of, or design and build experience with, Salesforce platforms (Sales/Service/Marketing/Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, Tableau, Slack)

  • Business-level English (collaborating with global teams, gathering the latest overseas information, etc.)

  • Contribute to the transformation of leading Japanese enterprises: Beyond implementing individual systems, this is a high-impact role where you envision the future of IT together with executives of industry-leading enterprises.
  • Put cutting-edge technology (AI × Data) into practice: Take on advanced solution design using leading technologies such as autonomous AI (Agentforce) and the next-generation data platform (Data Cloud).

You own end-to-end delivery for your engagements. This covers scope, plan, budget, risk and quality, from kickoff to go-live and handover. You lead the Salesforce project team, run steering committees and manage the customer relationship up to director and VP level. You partner with Program Executives and Professional Services leadership on the most strategic accounts. The ideal candidate combines Life Sciences domain credibility (pharma, biotech, medtech or related sectors) with IT or management consulting delivery experience. You use that credibility to advise customers, partners and internal teams.

Engagement Delivery Senior Managers help deliver AI and Agentforce transformations. These speed up drug commercialisation, simplify field and HCP engagement, and modernise commercial and medical operations through intelligent agents. You are measured on delivery outcomes, risk management and customer confidence.

AI and agentic delivery are part of how you work: You use AI tooling and agentic workflows to reduce manual effort, speed up insight and improve how your teams deliver. You show the productivity gains our Life Sciences customers expect from Salesforce.
Engagement success is well defined and honored: You set the delivery approach, governance and plan, and align customer stakeholders on objectives, outcomes and KPIs.

Customer outcomes have clear ownership: You are the delivery contact for your engagements. You communicate on expectations, performance, governance and escalations with the customer and within Salesforce, up to director and VP level. You earn trust through accurate forecasting, honest risk communication and follow-through.

The delivery team performs better because you lead it: You lead, coach and uplift architects, consultants and project managers without positional authority. You contribute to the processes, assets and methodologies that raise delivery standards across Life Sciences.

The full engagement is yours to deliver: You oversee delivery from scoping to go-live and are accountable for meeting contractual commitments. You own engagement financials: forecast, utilisation, change control and bid-versus-delivered margin.

Value delivered turns into adoption and consumption: You drive the changes needed to meet customer objectives, especially around AI and agentic capabilities. You use your Life Sciences and product expertise to link solution design, governance and stakeholder decisions to measurable business impact.

Risk is identified and managed early: You identify, mitigate and escalate risk early, and you bring a recommended path, not just a problem statement. You manage regulated-industry risk, including GxP and validation, data privacy and promotional compliance.

Customer relationships create new opportunities: You build relationships that help Salesforce expand its work with customers. You work with Sales, Success, Technology, Product and Support to drive adoption and keep One Salesforce alignment. You also partner with Resource Management on staffing and Resource Requests, and with Sales on scoping, SOW shaping and Services Work Exception governance.

- Demonstrated use of AI productivity tools, automation or agentic workflows in professional services or program delivery, with measurable impact on efficiency or customer outcomes
- 8+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for execution across scope, financials, risk and customer outcomes
- 3+ years leading large, complex, multi-workstream programs or a portfolio of engagements ($3M+ scope) with measurable outcomes
- 3+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech or related sectors), enough to engage credibly with commercial, medical, regulatory and IT stakeholders
- Experience leading cross-functional delivery teams across geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority
- Experience managing engagement financials: forecasting, revenue control, utilisation and delivered-versus-bid margin
- Working knowledge of system implementation and operational readiness in regulated Life Sciences environments (for example GxP/CSV, data privacy and promotional compliance)
- Proven ability to run steering committees and customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations on budget, resources, timelines and outcomes
- Strong executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, tailored to technical, commercial and regulatory audiences
- Ability to operate as a billable IC where the engagement requires it

Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on delivery of Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations, with the ability to advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation
- Knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field and HCP engagement, omnichannel, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls and data-driven customer insights

PMP, PgMP or SAFe certification, or equivalent program management discipline

Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.

  • Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities
    The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes.



Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
  • Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases, with AI-generated insights validated through human judgment.
  • Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies, including the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to maintain delivery speed and code health.



Core Automotive Domain Implementation
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:

  • Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
  • Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
  • Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
  • Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
  • Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.



AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing

  • Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
  • Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.



Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship

  • Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
  • Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
  • Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.



Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.

  • Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience
    To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.



Minimum Qualifications

  • Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
  • Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
  • Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
  • Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
  • Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
  • Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
  • Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
  • Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
  • Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
  • Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
  • Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
  • Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.



While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.

  • Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning
    Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.



Target Certification Requirements

Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:

  • Certified Platform App Builder
  • Certified Platform Developer I
  • Certified Agentforce Specialist
  • Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
  • Certified Integration Architect



Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.

Introduction Month

Build and demonstrate how capabilities across the Salesforce AI Labs portfolio can work together to deliver measurable customer outcomes faster.

You will show what customers can achieve with current capabilities, explore what becomes possible through new combinations, and make the path between the two clear.

What you will do

  • Build connected solutions. Create working prototypes, API integrations, and agent workflows spanning multiple products and enterprise systems.
  • Start with the business problem. Work with customers, portfolio leaders, and go-to-market teams to identify use cases where combining capabilities produces meaningful additional value.
  • Create compelling demonstrations. Develop reliable, repeatable experiences that make complex technology understandable and show a clear connection between customer needs, system actions, and business results.
  • Tell the story at every level. Present to executives, customers, developers, and sales teams, adapting the depth while preserving technical credibility.
  • Explore the next opportunity. Use rapid experimentation to test new agentic experiences and architectures. Clearly distinguish available capabilities, working prototypes, and future concepts.
  • Make the work reusable. Package reference architectures, integration components, demo environments, and playbooks that other teams can adopt.
  • Measure value and speed. Establish baselines and evaluate outcomes such as implementation time, process cycle time, cost to serve, service resolution, and customer experience.
  • Connect learning to product decisions. Surface integration gaps, customer demand, and technical constraints to product and engineering leaders, with evidence from what you build.



What you bring

  • A track record of personally building customer-facing software, integrations, or technical prototypes that solve real business problems.
  • Strong coding skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or comparable languages, with the ability to build and debug across services and a usable demonstration interface.
  • Fluency in modern API architectures, including authentication, webhooks, event-driven integration, data contracts, and reliable execution across systems.
  • Practical experience building with models and tools from providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic, alongside relevant open-source agent frameworks and harnesses.
  • Understanding of tool calling, retrieval, orchestration, context management, evaluations, observability, and human approval within agent workflows.
  • Sound judgment about model limitations, reliability, latency, cost, data access, and the requirements for moving from prototype to customer deployment.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, including the ability to deliver a live demonstration and explain its business significance.
  • The initiative to work through ambiguity, learn unfamiliar products quickly, and ship useful iterations with a small team.
  • The ability to turn a broad ambition into a testable use case with a credible path to customer value.



Experience that would be especially useful

  • Forward-deployed engineering, applied AI engineering, solutions engineering, or customer-facing solution architecture.
  • Building demonstrations or proofs of value involving multiple enterprise products.
  • Process intelligence, workflow automation, customer research, customer service, or digital experience platforms.
  • Creating reusable technical assets that support several customers or go-to-market teams.
  • Startup or founding-engineer experience with direct customer engagement.



What success could look like in the first 90 days

These are proposed initial outcomes, to be calibrated to product access and team capacity:

  • First 30 days: Understand the portfolio, map integration opportunities, and select two high-value customer scenarios with business sponsors and measurable outcomes.
  • By 60 days: Deliver one working demonstration across multiple products, with a clear story, documented dependencies, and an initial evaluation of reliability and value.
  • By 90 days: Validate the scenario with customer or field teams; package it for reuse; and propose the next build priorities based on evidence.

This person will ideally be a strategic transformation leader who can identify business problems, turn them into AI opportunities, rapidly validate solutions, and build the case for enterprise scale.

Our P2C Agentic Excellence function ensures every AI tool and capability in the seller's ecosystem earns its place — governed for quality, discoverable by sellers, trustworthy wherever sellers encounter it, and scaled for impact. We define how Salesforce turns distributed agentic innovation into trusted, measurable P2C value at enterprise scale.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic Consulting & Advisory: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to VP/SVP leadership. Bring a fresh perspective to complex operational challenges, shape multi year transformation strategies, and recommend bold, practical paths from opportunity to execution.
  • Business Analysis & Process Design: Analyze complex Prospect to Cash workflows to identify friction, simplify processes, define business requirements, and translate strategic priorities into actionable technical and operational solutions.
  • AI & Technology Innovation: Champion practical adoption of emerging AI technologies across the business. Identify high value opportunities to apply Agentforce, generative AI, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows to augment human capability, improve productivity, and redesign how work gets done.
  • GTM Innovation: Partner directly with GTM teams to uncover meaningful business problems and identify opportunities for AI driven innovation. Translate real world user needs into clearly defined use cases, apply frameworks such as Jobs to Be Done to understand the work being performed, and rapidly prototype potential solutions using low code, no code, and emerging AI technologies.
  • AI Governance: Help ensure AI capabilities are trusted, effective, and ready for enterprise use. Establish clear standards for quality, business relevance, responsible AI, and user experience, partnering with product, technology, security, and governance teams to evaluate new capabilities and determine when they are ready to progress toward broader adoption.
  • Experimentation, Rapid Innovation: Lead structured experimentation to turn promising ideas into validated solutions. Define hypotheses and success measures, develop and test prototypes with real users, capture evidence and learning, and use data to determine whether an innovation should be iterated, stopped, or advanced into broader product and engineering development.
  • Value Realization: Define how AI and transformation initiatives create measurable business value. Establish success metrics, quantify improvements in productivity, growth, seller experience or operational performance, and build evidence based business cases that demonstrate whether successful capabilities warrant broader investment and scale.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Change Leadership: Build strong alignment across diverse teams and senior stakeholders. Use compelling, data driven storytelling to create clarity, navigate competing priorities, manage organizational risk, and drive decisions across complex matrixed environments.
  • Operational Excellence: Bring structure, discipline, and repeatability to a fast moving innovation environment. Establish effective operating rhythms, prioritization practices, decision frameworks, and performance measures that help teams move quickly without sacrificing quality.



You're Our Person If...

  • 5+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives, business transformation, management consulting, or enterprise business analysis initiatives.
  • Domain Expertise: Experience in Prospect to Cash (P2C) business processes, sales operations, enterprise quote-to-cash workflows, or complex enterprise system implementations.
  • AI Tool Experience: Hands on experience using generative AI, agentic platforms, low code/no code tools, or AI assisted development environments

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Global Brand & Creative team within Marketing is responsible for bringing the Salesforce brand to life across our full portfolio of marketing and creative work. From building global brand and demand generation campaigns to creating experiences like Dreamforce, our multidisciplinary team of designers, copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and creative leaders partners across the organization to deliver impactful, brand-defining work.


The Integrated Campaigns Creative team translates Salesforce’s products, technology, and customer moments into compelling cross-channel creative experiences and stories.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Designer on the Integrated Campaigns Creative team, you will support creative design and production for Salesforce's Missionforce marketing initiatives.


Missionforce is Salesforce's AI-powered platform for government, public sector, defense, and national security organizations. By bringing together trusted AI, data, and cloud technology, Missionforce helps agencies modernize operations, improve service delivery, and drive better outcomes for the communities and missions they serve.


This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for a designer with strong visual design skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to translate established creative concepts into polished, production-ready assets across multiple channels. Working closely with the Missionforce Creative Lead, Art Director, Creative Project Manager, and cross-functional partners, you will help bring integrated campaigns and marketing initiatives to life through high-quality design and production.


Much of your work will focus on adapting approved creative concepts, extending campaign designs across formats, and ensuring assets are delivered on brand, on time, and to the highest production standards. You'll also have opportunities to contribute design ideas and creative solutions within established brand and campaign direction.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the craft of design, thrives in a collaborative environment, and takes pride in producing thoughtful, pixel-perfect creative.


What You Will Do:

  • Execute high-quality design and production work across Missionforce integrated campaigns, demand generation, digital, social, presentations, content, and events.
  • Adapt and extend approved creative concepts, key art, and campaign designs across multiple formats, sizes, and channels while maintaining visual consistency.
  • Partner closely with the Missionforce Creative Lead and Art Director to translate creative direction into polished, production-ready deliverables.
  • Develop digital and print assets, including banners, social graphics, email creative, presentations, event collateral, infographics, and other marketing materials.
  • Prepare, organize, and deliver final production files that meet channel specifications, brand guidelines, and technical requirements.
  • Apply strong typography, layout, composition, image editing, and visual design skills to ensure a high level of craft and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with Creative Project Manager to understand project requirements, manage timelines, incorporate feedback, and deliver work on schedule.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously, proactively communicating progress, questions, and potential roadblocks.
  • Maintain consistency with Salesforce brand standards while adapting creative for Missionforce audiences and marketing objectives.
  • Leverage design tools, templates, and emerging AI technologies to improve production efficiency and streamline creative workflows.
  • Contribute design recommendations and creative problem-solving within established concepts and direction.

What Experience You Have:

  • BA or BFA in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design, production design, or digital design within an in-house creative team, marketing organization, or advertising agency.
  • Experience with motion design, storyboarding, and animation is a plus, with the ability to bring creative concepts to life through motion. Proficiency in Adobe After Effects is a plus.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating hands-on design execution, production expertise, and the ability to adapt creative concepts across multiple channels and formats.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, with experience using Figma. Familiarity with Canva is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of digital and print production processes, including file preparation, resizing, layout adaptation, and production specifications.
  • Strong visual design fundamentals, including typography, composition, color, layout, and brand consistency.
  • Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns, demand generation, social, digital advertising, and event-related creative.
  • Ability to work from established creative direction while applying independent judgment to solve design and production challenges.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines, and incorporating feedback efficiently.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with generative AI and emerging creative tools to support design and production workflows is a plus.

Why You Are Excited About This Role:

  • You love the craft of design and take pride in delivering polished, pixel-perfect creative.
  • You enjoy taking strong creative concepts and bringing them to life across a variety of channels and formats.
  • You thrive in a collaborative environment, working closely with Creative Leads, Art Directors, Project Managers, and fellow designers.
  • You enjoy balancing creative problem-solving with hands-on design execution and production.
  • You are energized by opportunities to work on integrated campaigns and experiment with new tools and more efficient ways of working.

NOTE: By applying to the Sr Designer posting recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring these roles will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.


BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
  • World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead.com
  • Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership

Are you a performance leader who still loves the details? A systems performance expert? A builder of teams and of systems? Want to be part of something big? How about owning the performance of the distributed database technology that is powering growth of the Salesforce Platform across the globe? SalesforceDB is the transactional database behind Salesforce CRM. It runs more than 1.1 trillion transactions per month on thousands of database instances.

The Salesforce Database team is fast-paced and highly collaborative, and works across all areas of our distributed transactional database technology stack. We are seeking a Senior Director to own the SDB Performance technology line: the strategy, the organization, and the results that drive Salesforce DataBase.

You set direction on a year-plus horizon and you are accountable for it. You craft and deliver the V2MOM for the performance portfolio. You are a subject-matter expert in how a large distributed database behaves in production, and you build the managers and principal engineers who turn that expertise into shipped improvements. You are comfortable making hard calls on priority, resourcing, and trust, and you stand behind the outcomes.

Our performance organization partners closely with database and storage system developers, query processing engineers, application performance engineers, infrastructure engineers, and our analytics team to deliver all the pieces that add up to high performance in production at scale. Your organization's improvements ship across the whole production fleet every release, and some of our work is published at database research conferences such as CIDR. We are a high-performing team with high standards: we value integrity, rigor, and continuous learning.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Own the SDB Performance technology line. Craft and deliver the V2MOM for that portfolio, on a planning horizon of a year or more
* Set the direction for performance and scalability across the database engine, storage service, and query processing, and bring peer leadership along to see it through
* Be accountable for architecture: own the architectural decisions of the performance organization, and hold a consistent architecture and design process with partner clouds
* Own performance qualification of SalesforceDB releases, and deliver a record of successful performance capabilities across release qualification, production performance, capacity management, and query and systems optimization
* Lead benchmarking and modeling that guide hardware selection and capacity planning for the fleet, and the telemetry, dashboards, and analysis that show how the production fleet performs against its targets
* Hold the organization to trust standards, including scalability, service health, and the performance plans behind every release. Put proactive plans in place for systemic performance issues and technical debt
* Drive a production-first culture of service ownership. Personally coordinate performance-related production incident response within the cloud, and defuse cross-cloud performance issues on behalf of the database
* Make the hard resourcing decisions that keep the portfolio on its commitments, and shift teams as business priorities move
* Stay close to teams and customers who feel database performance, and use that insight to change what we build and how we operate
* Lead a collection of teams that make up the performance portfolio. This role manages other engineering managers
* Develop talent from Manager through Director, and coach engineers from early career through principal
* Build a high-performing, inclusive, geographically distributed organization. Motivate your teams and peer leaders. Share bad news early, solve the problems you can solve, and escalate when scope requires it
* Be the partner senior leaders in other clouds call when performance, capacity, or release risk is on the table. Build durable relationships with directors, senior directors, VPs, and the architects who support this area, and keep those architects informed and empowered

You're Our Person If…

* BS or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Subject-matter expertise in the performance of large-scale databases, storage, or distributed systems
* Proven record of owning a technology portfolio and delivering successful services or capabilities across multiple releases, on a year-plus horizon
* 10+ years of engineering management experience, including 5+ years managing other managers, and a track record of developing both managers and senior individual contributors
* 15+ years of experience in performance engineering or software engineering on databases, storage, or distributed systems, including 5+ years leading performance, scalability, or release-qualification teams
* Performance engineering background on systems software, ideally databases, storage, or distributed systems, with strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management) and the technical depth to engage on designs and code in Java or C/C++
* Hands-on experience with load, benchmark, and regression testing, ideally for multi-tenant workloads at scale, and with root cause analysis of performance and scalability problems in complex distributed systems
* Strong SQL and performance data analysis (CPU, latency, throughput, per-tenant resource use)
* Accountability for architecture and for trust outcomes, not only for a single team's sprint
* Strong judgment on prioritization, resourcing, and when to escalate
* Excellent communication across database, storage, infrastructure, application performance, and analytics teams: you can set a vision, tell the truth about risk, and bring peer leaders with you
* Integrity, high energy, and a growth mindset: you report what the data shows, seek feedback, and keep learning, with a collaborative style

Even Better If…

* MS or PhD in databases or distributed systems
* Deep knowledge of database internals: optimizer, query execution and optimization, storage, transactions, concurrency control, memory management
* Experience with performance workloads, system benchmarks, release qualification, and production performance investigation
* Splunk or similar telemetry, dashboards, and fleet-scale performance management
* Systems programming experience (C/C++ or Java), profiling, JVM tuning, and heap dump analysis
* SQL, Linux, data analysis and visualization, and experimental design

As the Dedicated Sales Leader for strategic accounts in Korea, you will drive growth across the top-tier Digital Nature sector. In this high-visibility role, you will forge deep, strategic partnerships with iconic Korean enterprises, accelerating their digital transformation by embedding Tableau’s analytics platform enterprise-wide.


You will empower key accounts to unlock maximum value from their data across line-of-business (LoB) operations, sales, and customer experience. This position focuses on driving strategic growth, high-level executive engagement, and sustained customer success.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic Account Management: Develop and execute a comprehensive account plan for a designated key account, aligning Tableau’s solutions with their core business objectives to meet and exceed sales quotas.
  • Executive Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong, C-level relationships across the client’s organization, acting as a trusted advisor on their data and analytics journey.
  • Full-Cycle Sales: Drive the entire sales cycle from opportunity identification to closure, expertly managing a complex pipeline and navigating large enterprise procurement processes.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive cross-functional collaboration across a virtual account team of Sales Engineers, Customer Success Managers, and other specialists to deliver compelling product demonstrations, evaluations, and comprehensive solutions.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Meticulously manage and track all customer and transactional information in Salesforce (CRM), providing accurate and regular reporting of your pipeline and forecast.
  • Market Expertise: Serve as an expert on the competitive landscape, staying current with industry trends, and effectively communicating Tableau’s value proposition.

You're Our Person If...

  • Languages: Native or business fluency in Korean is a must, and business proficiency in English is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: You have 7+ years of enterprise solution sales/consulting experience.
  • Client Expertise: You possess a deep understanding of the Korean digital native business culture and have a proven track record of successfully selling to large conglomerates.
  • Proven Performer: You have a history of consistently overachieving sales quotas and experience managing complex, seven-figure software deals.
  • Solution Seller: You are an expert in value-based or solution selling of enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., BI, data analytics, CRM, ERP).
  • Go-Getter: You are self-directed, resourceful, and have a strong work ethic. You are driven to build strategic relationships and maximize account revenue.
  • Excellent Communicator: You have outstanding presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and business audiences.
  • Technically Savvy: You are proficient with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and other business tools. A Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
  • Company Builder: You are always on the lookout for great talent to help us continue building one of the best companies in the world.



The Experience

한국 전략 고객을 담당하는 전담 세일즈 리더로서, 디지털 네이티브 분야 상위 기업의 성장을 이끌게 됩니다. 이 역할은 가시성이 높은 포지션으로, 한국을 대표하는 기업들과 깊이 있는 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고, Tableau의 분석 플랫폼을 전사적으로 도입하도록 지원하여 디지털 전환을 가속화합니다.

주요 고객이 현업 부서(LoB) 운영, 영업, 고객 경험 전반에서 데이터의 가치를 극대화하도록 지원합니다. 이 포지션은 전략적 성장, 경영진 수준의 높은 커뮤니케이션, 그리고 지속적인 고객 성공에 중점을 둡니다.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 전략적 어카운트 관리: 담당 핵심 고객사를 위한 종합적인 어카운트 플랜을 수립하고 실행하며, Tableau 솔루션을 고객의 핵심 비즈니스 목표와 연계하여 영업 목표를 달성하고 초과 달성합니다.
  • 경영진 관계 구축: 고객 조직 전반에서 C-레벨과 탄탄한 관계를 구축하고 유지하며, 고객의 데이터 및 분석 여정에서 신뢰받는 어드바이저 역할을 수행합니다.
  • 전 단계 영업: 기회 발굴부터 계약 체결까지 전체 영업 사이클을 주도하며, 복잡한 파이프라인을 능숙하게 관리하고 대기업의 조달 프로세스를 원활히 진행합니다.
  • 부서 간 협업 총괄: 세일즈 엔지니어, 커스터머 석세스 매니저 및 기타 전문가로 구성된 가상 어카운트 팀 간의 협업을 이끌어 설득력 있는 제품 데모, 평가, 종합 솔루션을 제공합니다.
  • 파이프라인 및 예측: Salesforce(CRM)에서 모든 고객 및 거래 정보를 꼼꼼하게 관리·추적하고, 파이프라인과 예측을 정확하게 정기적으로 보고합니다.
  • 시장 전문성: 시장 환경에 대한 전문가로서 업계 동향을 지속적으로 파악하고, Tableau의 가치 제안을 효과적으로 전달합니다.



You're Our Person If...

  • 업계 경험: 7년 이상의 엔터프라이즈 솔루션 영업/컨설팅 경험이 있습니다.
  • 고객 전문성: 디지털 네이티브 비즈니스 문화를 깊이 이해하고 있으며, 대기업 대상 영업에서 성공한 검증된 실적이 있습니다.
  • 검증된 성과: 영업 목표를 꾸준히 초과 달성한 이력이 있으며, 복잡한 규모의 Enterprise 계약을 관리한 경험이 있습니다.
  • 솔루션 셀러: 엔터프라이즈 SaaS 플랫폼(예: BI, 데이터 분석, CRM, ERP)의 가치 기반 또는 솔루션 영업 전문가입니다.
  • 셀프 스타터: 자기주도적이고 기지가 있으며 강한 직업 윤리를 갖추고 있습니다. 전략적 관계를 구축하고 고객사 매출을 극대화하려는 의지가 있습니다.
  • 뛰어난 커뮤니케이터: 탁월한 프레젠테이션 및 커뮤니케이션 역량을 갖추고 있으며, 복잡한 개념을 기술 및 비즈니스 청중 모두에게 명확하고 설득력 있게 전달할 수 있습니다.
  • 기술 활용 능력: CRM 시스템(Salesforce 우대) 및 기타 업무 도구에 능숙합니다. 학사 학위 또는 이에 상응하는 경험을 우대합니다.
  • 컴퍼니 빌더: 세계 최고의 기업 중 하나를 계속 만들어 나가기 위해 훌륭한 인재를 늘 찾고 있습니다.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. title: Sr Director/Director, Sales Service Leader (Head of Manufacturing, Professional Services)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

日本の基幹産業である製造業界（ハイテク、自動車・モビリティ、重工・産業機械、素材・プロセス製造等）のエンタープライズ顧客を対象に、デリバリ（プロジェクト成功・価値実現）と、プロフェッショナルサービス、およびSignature Success PlanのGTM（Go-To-Market / サービス営業推進）との両面を包括的に統括・リードする部門責任者です。

顧客の経営課題や事業変革、AI時代における「Agentic Enterprise（自律型AIと人が協働するエンタープライズ変革）」を見据え、初期構想策定からマルチクラウド・大規模実装、定着化、継続的イノベーションまでを一気通貫で推進します。

ビジネス責任（Bookings、Revenue、Margin）を担うとともに、配下のピープルマネージャーを通じてチーム全体の成長、Equalityの浸透、エンゲージメント向上を牽引します。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • GTM戦略の立案・推進およびビジネス成長 (Go-To-Market & Business Growth)インダストリーGTM戦略の策定: 日本の製造業界における市場動向、顧客課題、テクノロジートレンド（AI、データ統合、サプライチェーン、アフターサービス変革等）を踏まえ、プロフェッショナルサービスの年次・中長期GTM戦略を策定・実行する。パイプライン創出とオファリング推進: ライセンス営業部門（Enterprise AE / RVP）、ソリューションエンジニア（SE）、アライアンス部門と緊密に連携し、製造業特化型のオファリング（スマートファクトリー、サービタイゼーション、アフターサービス基幹刷新、サプライチェーン高度化等）を通じたパイプラインの創出と案件獲得をリードする。ビジネスKPIの達成責任: 製造領域全体の年間Gross Bookings（受注額）、CTO/Signatureアタッチ率、パイプラインカバレッジの目標達成に対してコミットし、フォーキャストの精度管理を行う。
  • デリバリ統括・プロジェクトエクセレンス (Delivery Leadership & Operational Excellence)ポートフォリオガバナンス: 製造業における全アクティブプロジェクトの健全性を監視し、デリバリ品質、納期、コスト、収益性（Delivery Margin）を担保する。エグゼクティブスポンサーシップ & クリティカルエスカレーション対応: ミッションクリティカルな大規模案件において、顧客CxO/ステークホルダーとの信頼関係を維持し、最高位のエスカレーションポイントとして迅速かつ的確なリスクヘッジ・意思決定を行う。デリバリモデルの高度化: グローバルデリバリセンター（GDC）やオフショア/ニアショアの活用比率を高め、アジャイル/MVPアプローチやFit to Standardの標準化を通じて、プロジェクト期間短縮（Time-to-Value）と利益率向上を実現する。高い顧客満足度 (CSAT) の維持: 納品後のビジネス成果創出を支援し、高いCSATスコアの獲得と、将来の顧客リファレンス（事例化）獲得を推進する。
  • 製造業向けイノベーション & AI変革の推進 (Industry Solutions & Agentic Transformation)Agentforce / AI活用の先導: 自律型AIエージェント（Agentforce）やData Cloudを活用した製造業向け最先端ユースケースをデリバリ現場およびGTMに取り入れ、市場におけるソートリーダーシップを確立する。パートナー協業 (SIer/GSI): 製造業の基幹刷新に強みを持つ大手SIパートナーとの協業モデルを確立し、エコシステム全体でスケールするデリバリ体制を構築する。
  • 組織マネジメント & 人財育成 (People Leadership & Talent Cultivation)2nd Line Leadership: 配下のAccount Partner Manager、Engagement Managerなどのフロントラインマネージャーを指導・育成し、自律的で高業績なマネジメント組織を構築する。チームビルディングとキャリア支援: コンサルタント、アーキテクト（FA/TA/SA/BA）、マネジメント層のコンピテンシー評価、能力開発（Learning Plan）、サクセッションプランニング（後継者育成）を実行する。Equality & カルチャーの醸成: Salesforceのコアバリュー（Trust、Customer Success、Innovation、Equality、Sustainability）を体現し、心理的安全性が高くインクルーシブなチームカルチャーを育む。



You're Our Person If...

  • 実務経験:ITコンサルティングファーム、SIer、または大手エンタープライズソフトウェアベンダーにおける12年以上のプロフェッショナルサービス、デリバリ、またはソリューションセールス経験5年以上のピープルマネジメント経験（複数のチームやマネージャー層を束ねる2nd Lineマネジメント経験、または30名以上の組織マネジメント経験を歓迎）
  • CRM・AI/エージェント技術の知見:CRM（SFA/Service/Marketing）やデータ統合基盤を活用した、エンタープライズ顧客の顧客接点・業務変革に関する知見生成AI・AIエージェント技術の動向を継続的に把握し、ビジネス価値に結びつけて顧客経営層へ語れることAIを活用したデリバリ変革（要件定義・設計・テスト・開発の生産性向上、AI前提のサービスモデル設計等）の実践経験、または、AIエージェントを活用した顧客変革プロジェクト（PoC〜本番展開・定着化）の推進・統括経験
  • インダストリー知見:日本の製造業（自動車、ハイテク、電機、重工・機械、化学・素材等）の業務プロセス、バリューチェーン、業界特有の経営・IT課題に関する深い理解製造業のサービス・保守・顧客接点領域におけるAI/CRM活用事例・動向の知見
  • デリバリ & セールス実績:数億円〜十億円規模の大規模エンタープライズIT導入プロジェクトにおけるデリバリ責任者（エグゼクティブスポンサー/デリバリ統括）としての成功実績サービスビジネス（Bookings / Revenue）のP&L管理、またはGTMをリードした実績
  • リーダーシップ & コミュニケーション:顧客CxOレベルとの高度な交渉力、合意形成力、強固なパートナーシップ構築力社内クロスファンクショナル（ライセンス営業、SE、アライアンス、製品開発、グローバルチーム等）を巻き込み、共通目標に向けてリードするアライメント能力
  • 語学力:日本語：ネイティブレベル（円滑なエグゼクティブコミュニケーション、プレゼンテーション、交渉が可能なこと）英語：ビジネスレベル（グローバルリーダーシップとのディスカッション、社内承認交渉、ベストプラクティス連携が可能なこと）



Even Better If...

  • クラウドプラットフォーム（SaaS/PaaS）を活用した基幹系・業務系DXプロジェクトの統括経験
  • Salesforce製品群（Core、Data Cloud、Service Cloud、MuleSoft、Agentforce等）に関する深い理解、認定資格、またはAgentforce等を用いた導入プロジェクトの経験
  • オフショア/ニアショア（GDC）やグローバルデリバリモデルの導入・運用推進経験。
  • 製造業におけるサプライチェーン改革、フィールドサービス/保守業務改革、CRM/SFA刷新のコンサルティング実績

Success Managerは、ビジネス、業界、製品に関する深い知見を活かしてお客様とパートナーシップを築き、お客様がSalesforceへの投資から得るビジネス価値とリターンを加速できるよう導きます。この役割では、Success Managerは1つ以上の事業部門(LoB)、特定のクラウド、または業界を専門とし、お客様の言葉で語り、お客様の価値実現を確実にします。主要なステークホルダーレベルで連携し、強い信頼関係を築き育むことで、お客様のデジタルジャーニーの推進を支援します。Success Managerは、お客様のニーズに応じて、市場セグメント、規模、ソリューションの複雑さ、ライフサイクルが異なるお客様と直接協働します。理想的なSuccess Managerは、お客様の言葉で語ることができるクラウドの専門性と業界スキルの両方を備えています。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Customer Success Methodologyを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して、目標の理解とケイパビリティの評価を行い、ビジネス目標とテクノロジー目標の達成を加速するための提案を行う
  • お客様のSalesforce導入状況に関する理解と知識を深め、すべてのCloudにわたるSalesforceの機能を広める
  • お客様のニーズに基づき、組織戦略、ガバナンス、チェンジマネジメントのベストプラクティスについてお客様をガイドする
  • プラットフォームの機能をお客様のビジネス優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示すことができる
  • お客様が掲げるビジネス目標の達成を妨げるリスクを積極的に特定し、アカウントチームと協力してリスク軽減計画を策定する
  • 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント計画を示した、包括的な活用推進パスを作成し、実行する
  • お客様の主要なビジネス課題と成長の可能性を理解することで、お客様のビジネスにビジネス価値とイノベーションをもたらす
  • お客様のITおよびビジネスのエグゼクティブリーダーシップ、スポンサー、意思決定者との間に経営層レベルの関係を築き育み、お客様のビジネスおよびITのスポンサーやステークホルダーに対する当社のパートナーシップとコミットメントを確固たるものにする
  • アカウントチームおよびSalesforceのエグゼクティブと協力しながら、お客様が目標を達成できるよう、経営層から現場まで、アカウント内で効果的にネットワークを構築する
  • 適切な場合、成功を推進するために必要な追加のSalesforceサービスやアドバイザリーの専門家を提案する
  • 製品の技術的な変更、性能低下、障害、サポート終了、その他の関連する最新情報を積極的に伝える
  • 日本語の流暢な運用能力(読む、書く、聞く)

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。



The Experience

The Success Manager leverages deep business, industry and product knowledge to partner with customers and guide them to accelerate business value and return from their investment with Salesforce. In this role, the Success Manager will specialize in one or more line of businesses, a specific cloud or industry to speak the customer language and ensure customer value realization. They are aligned at key stakeholder level, building and fostering strong relationships to help customers progress on their digital journey. Success Managers are working directly with customers that can vary in their market segment, size, solution complexity and life cycle, depending on the customers needs. The ideal Success Manager, will possess both a Cloud specialization and industry skills that enables them to speak the customer language.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Leverage our Customer Success Methodology and partner with customers stakeholders to understand their goals, assess their capabilities and provide recommendations to help them accelerate achievement of their business and technology objectives
  • Develop an understanding and knowledge of customer's Salesforce implementation and evangelize the capabilities of Salesforce across all of our Clouds
  • Guide a customer on org strategy, governance and change management best practices based on customer needs
  • Can demonstrate hands-on Salesforce product knowledge by applying platform features and functions to customer business priorities and roadmap
  • Proactively identify risks to the customer achieving their stated business goals and work with the account team to build a risk mitigation plan
  • Produce and execute a comprehensive adoption path showing the current state, target future state with timeline, and an underlying enablement Plan
  • Deliver business value and innovation to a customer's business by understanding our customers' key business challenges and potential for growth
  • Build and foster executive-level relationships with the customer's IT and business executive leadership, sponsors and decision makers to solidify our partnership and commitment to the customer business and IT sponsors & stakeholders
  • Working collaboratively with the account team and Salesforce Execs, effectively network within accounts from the Executive-Level down, in order to help customers achieve their objectives
  • When appropriate, recommend additional Salesforce services and advisory experts needed to drive success
  • Proactively communicates technical product changes, degradations, outages, end of life and other relevant updates
  • Fluency in Japanese language skills (reading, writing, listening)



You're Our Person If...

  • 7+ years of proven experience in business consulting or solution sales
  • Demonstrated experience in the CRM space, including defining customer business challenges, driving sales process transformation, delivering solution proposals, and leading implementation and adoption
  • Strong consulting ability to understand customers' business objectives and help define and execute strategies and roadmaps that address their challenges
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and drive alignment among diverse stakeholders, including customers' Sales and IT teams and executive leadership
  • Proven ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders and take ownership of initiatives that deliver customer business value
  • Business-level or higher proficiency in Japanese (reading, writing, and speaking)

    Even Better If...
  • Experienced professional with 7-10 years of Manufacturing industry expertise
  • In-depth knowledge in one or more line of businesses (LoB) - a specific cloud or industry
  • Strong consulting skills and proven results working as a Trusted Advisor to drive business value for customers
  • Ability to drive effective and influencing conversations at the C-level; facilitate difficult discussions and adept at handling objections
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce product and platform features, capabilities, and best use is highly desired
  • Able to articulate the importance and value of Governance to Business and IT executives
  • Good understanding of enterprise architecture principles strongly preferred
  • Ability to quickly grasp and distinctly explain technological and business concepts

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

The Experience


私たちCustomer Success Strategyチームは、Salesforceの戦略部門であるStrategy & Programsに属し、契約後（Post Sales）のお客様を支えるCustomer Success Group（CSG）の目標達成に責任を持っています。グローバルや他領域の戦略チームと連携しながら会社のGo-To-Market（GTM）戦略をCSGの施策に落とし込み、お客様との関係の維持・拡大に向けて、CSGのリーダー陣の意思決定をデータと戦略的思考で支えています。

CSG Data & Insights Analystは、CSG内の特定の部門に固定されず、CSG全体を横断して支援するポジションです。チーム内のBusiness Partner（CSG各部門のリーダーの参謀役）や、営業戦略・財務・オペレーション・イネーブルメント（人材育成）など多様な部門との連携を主導しながら、お客様のSalesforce活用促進・解約リスクの最小化というCSGの重要な目標の達成に貢献します。

本ポジションは単なるレポーティング担当ではありません。Customer Successのビジネスモデル・業務プロセス・KPIと関係者（Stakeholder）の状況を理解したうえで、取り組むべきビジネス上の問いを自ら設定します。そして、データの収集・分析や分析用のデータマート・ダッシュボードの整備を通じて、意思決定を動かすInsightを届けることが求められます。戦略をビジネスの現場で実現することに情熱を持ち、周囲とのコラボレーションを楽しめる方を歓迎します。


What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Problem Framing：Customer Successのビジネスモデル・KPIとStakeholderの状況を踏まえ、取り組むべきビジネス上の問いと分析の優先度を主体的に定める
  • Insight Generation：お客様のSalesforce活用促進・製品利用量（Consumption）・解約リスクに関わる動向をデータで分析し、具体的な改善提案に落とし込む
  • Decision Support：Business Partnerと対等な立場で連携し、CSGのリーダー陣との議論、営業戦略部門との連携、経営層の意思決定といった場面で必要となるInsightを迅速に届ける
  • Analytics Foundation：分析手法・プロセスの継続的な改善に加え、AIによるデータ活用の広がりも見据え、データ品質の確認・データ定義の整理・アクセス管理などのデータガバナンスの整備にも、関係部門と連携しながら取り組む

You're Our Person If...


  • 経験：データを用いて事業課題の分析や意思決定の支援を行う業務（例：経営企画・事業企画、営業企画、データアナリストなど）における5年以上の実務経験があり、Customer SuccessまたはSaaSのビジネスモデル・業務プロセスへの理解がある
  • テクニカルスキル：SQLによるデータ抽出・集計の実務経験に加え、BIツール（Tableau等）でのエグゼクティブ向けダッシュボード構築、CRM（Salesforce等）・クラウドDWH（Snowflake等）のデータを活用した分析、Excel / Google Sheetsでの定量分析・財務モデリングのうち、複数の実務経験がある
  • ビジネススキル：Stakeholderの課題を踏まえてデータ活用の方向性を自ら判断し、複数の依頼を優先度管理しながら、分析結果をシニアリーダーに提言した経験がある
  • 語学力・コミュニケーション能力：ビジネスレベルの日本語力（日本語での会議進行・資料作成ができる水準。日本語能力試験N1相当以上）と、英語でのビジネスコミュニケーション力（英語での資料読解・会議参加・プレゼンテーションなど）がある

Even Better If...


  • Python / R等を用いた統計モデリング・機械学習などの高度な分析経験
  • Tableau関連の認定資格またはSnowPro認定資格
  • コンサルティングファーム・SaaS企業での戦略・分析業務の経験、または営業戦略部門・全社データ分析部門と連携した経験
  • データガバナンス（データ品質管理、データ定義・メタデータの整備など）またはデータエンジニアリング（分析用データを自動で整備する仕組みの設計・構築など）の実務経験

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best.   • updates and technical feature rollouts.

Salesforce and Google Cloud have embarked on a groundbreaking partnership worth $2.5 billion to revolutionize customer relationship management (CRM) through advanced artificial intelligence (AI). By integrating Google's Gemini AI models into Salesforce's Agentforce platform, we're enabling businesses to harness multi-modal AI capabilities—processing images, audio, and video—to deliver unparalleled customer experiences. Join our team of talented engineers and help us advance the integration of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Software Security Engineer to join our GCP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing our security posture across various domains, focusing on development, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, and the security of distributed and scalable distributed systems. This role requires hands-on experience with security systems, a deep understanding of modern threats, and the ability to drive security improvements through engineering solutions.

As a Software Security Engineer, you won’t just find vulnerabilities, you’ll engineer the systems that prevent them. You will play a pivotal role in securing our distributed micro-services architecture on GCP, moving security by building automated, high-performance tools that empower our entire engineering organization.


What You'll Actually Be Doing:

  • Security Engineering & Automation: Build and integrate high-performance security tools and custom scripts into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, SCA, SIEM) to automate manual toil.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and secure Terraform/IaC templates to ensure our cloud infrastructure is hardened by design before it ever reaches production.
  • Vulnerability Leadership: Lead the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, using a risk-based approach to prioritize remediation across network, cloud, and application layers.
  • Architecture & Threat Modeling: Partner with DevOps and Product teams to conduct threat modeling and architectural reviews, ensuring new features are resilient and scalable.
  • Compliance & Governance: Act as the technical lead for audits (SOC2, ISO 27001), leveraging automation to provide evidence of consistent monitoring and timely closure of risks.
  • Production Resilience: Troubleshooting and resolving complex security issues in production using distributed tracing and modern monitoring tools.



You're Our Person If...

  • Engineering Mindset: 5+ years for SMTS, 7+ years for LMTS; 9+ years for PMTS in Security Engineering with a focus on building tools, not just managing them.
  • Coding Proficiency: Strong experience in Go, Java, or Python with a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and automation.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise: Deep experience with GCP (similar) and Terraform for managing cloud security posture (CSPM) and infrastructure.
  • Security Domain Knowledge: Practical experience with network protocols, OS hardening (Linux), and modern attack vectors.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A desire to work cross-functionally with DevOps to embed security into the SDLC.



Even Better If...

  • You have experience with secure software development lifecycle practices.
  • You know container security tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Overview

We're looking for a dynamic, strategic, and outcomes-driven Public Sector Account Executive to drive Data Foundations growth across government agencies, departments, and public sector organisations. In this highly visible role, you will build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, identify new opportunities for engagement, and position Salesforce's industry-leading data management and analytics platform as a critical enabler of digital transformation across the public sector.

This is a quota-carrying role where you will act as the "CEO" of your territory, owning the strategy, engagement model, and execution plan across your assigned accounts. You will lead complex sales cycles in partnership with cross-functional teams and help government organisations address challenges related to data silos, data quality, fragmented reporting, and the need for trusted, unified data to drive better decisions and outcomes.

By bringing together strong account planning, consultative selling, and public sector insight, you will help agencies and departments modernise how they manage, govern, and activate data — enabling smarter policy decisions, improved service delivery, and accelerated mission outcomes.

This is not a typical software sales role. As a Public Sector Account Executive for Data Foundations, you will play a direct role in helping government organisations transform how they collect, connect, and trust their data. You will engage with decision-makers across agencies and departments to understand strategic data priorities, navigate procurement complexity, and align Data Foundations solutions to government-wide transformation agendas.

Success in this role requires a strong ability to build executive relationships, create demand, and drive long-term strategic engagement across a complex public sector environment.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
 

  • Territory Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive territory plan across government agencies and departments, identifying whitespace, prioritising target accounts, and building a clear engagement strategy aligned to agency data priorities and transformation goals.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Build detailed account plans that map stakeholders, business priorities, data environments, procurement pathways, and growth opportunities across assigned accounts.
  • Sales Leadership: Own and manage the end-to-end sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through to solutioning, negotiation, and close. Consistently meet and exceed sales targets through disciplined execution and value-based selling.
  • Executive Engagement: Build and nurture trusted relationships with senior government stakeholders, including department leaders, program owners, data and analytics leaders, IT executives, and procurement contacts. Establish yourself as a credible advisor who understands the public sector data landscape.
  • Drive New Engagement: Proactively create and expand engagement across agencies and departments by uncovering data challenges, initiating strategic conversations, and building momentum for Data Foundations solutions within both existing and new accounts.
  • Solution Selling: Identify complex data management, data quality, and analytics challenges within public sector organisations and position Data Foundations solutions to deliver measurable business and mission value, including improved decision-making, operational efficiency, and citizen service outcomes.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Lead and coordinate cross-functional support across Business Development, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Alliances, and leadership teams to drive account strategy and deliver a strong customer experience.
  • Government Market Insight: Maintain a strong understanding of the public sector landscape, including agency data priorities, procurement frameworks, policy considerations, funding cycles, and digital transformation trends.
  • Forecasting and CRM Discipline: Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity updates, pipeline visibility, and forecast hygiene in Salesforce CRM.


You're Our Person If...
 

  • Proven Enterprise Sales Success: Demonstrated success in enterprise software sales with a track record of meeting and exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Public Sector Experience: Experience selling into government agencies or departments, with a strong understanding of how public sector organisations operate, buy, and deliver transformation programs.
  • Data & Analytics Expertise: Familiarity with data management, data governance, analytics, or data platform solutions, and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for government stakeholders.
  • Strategic Territory Management: Ability to build and execute territory and account strategies that create long-term pipeline and drive growth across a defined public sector portfolio.
  • Consultative Selling Skills: Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders, uncover business needs, articulate value, and lead strategic, solution-based sales conversations.
  • Executive Presence: Confidence engaging senior leaders and navigating complex account environments with credibility, commercial acumen, and strong communication skills.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Ability to orchestrate internal resources effectively and lead virtual teams to drive aligned execution and customer outcomes.
  • Resilience and Adaptability: Strong interpersonal skills, curiosity, and a growth mindset, with the ability to navigate long sales cycles, evolving priorities, and ambiguity.
  • Technology Affinity: Passion for digital transformation and an understanding of data platforms, analytics, data connectivity, and enterprise technology ecosystems. Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud or related solutions is advantageous.

Tableauのミッションは、 お客様がデータを「見て、理解し、活用できるように支援すること」です。 Tableau はビジネスインテリジェンス市場に影響を与え、常に成長を続けています。

Account Executiveは、担当する業界・規模のお客様に対して、当社の革新的な製品とソリューションを提案し、販売目標を上回る成果を追求する重要なポジションです。

単なる製品販売にとどまらず、お客様の潜在的な課題を深く掘り下げ、最適な解決策を提示します。市場調査からリード獲得、商談の創出、製品デモンストレーション、導入支援、そしてクロージング、さらには契約後のカスタマーサクセスまで、営業プロセスのすべてを主体的に動かすダイナミックなポジションです。

今後営業として専門性を高めていきたい、データドリブンな世界を醸成させていただきたい方にフィットするお仕事となっています。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 戦略的アカウントプランニング: 担当地域・業界における市場動向を分析し、中長期的な営業戦略を立案・実行。目標を達成し続けるためのパイプラインを構築します。
  • フルサイクル営業の遂行: 新規商談の創出から、製品デモによる価値提案、商談管理（CRM）、契約締結まで、営業プロセスの全フェーズを完結させます。
  • リソースのオーケストレーション: ソリューションエンジニア、製品サポート、マーケティングなどの社内リソースを巻き込み、顧客にとって最適なソリューションを構築します。
  • リレーションシップの構築: 顧客企業の経営層から現場担当者まで、多層的な関係性を構築・維持し、Tableauのファンを増やします。
  • インサイトの共有: 競合情報や市場のフィードバックを収集し、製品開発やマーケティング戦略へのインプットを行います。



You're Our Person If...

  • ソリューション営業の経験: 関西圏の大手企業向けに、無形商材やITソリューションの提案営業経験（目安3年以上）。
  • 圧倒的な目標達成意欲: 常に高い基準を自らに課し、活動量（コール、デモ、訪問）と質の双方からKPI・目標を達成してきた実績。
  • コミュニケーション能力: 複雑な技術的概念を、顧客のビジネス価値に翻訳して伝えられる高い言語化能力。



Even Better If...

  • SaaS/ソフトウェア業界経験: SaaSビジネスモデルへの深い理解、またはBI製品（Tableau、Power BI、Looker等）の知見。

  • Architect and build production-grade observability solutions — monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing — that enable proactive detection and autonomous remediation.
  • Design and implement AI/ML-powered operations tools, including anomaly detection, predictive analysis, intelligent runbook automation, and MCP-based operational agents.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to define and uphold SLAs/SLOs, and coach junior engineers through pair programming, design reviews, and code reviews.

  • Solid background in incident management and SRE principles: on-call, root cause analysis, postmortems, SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and toil reduction.
  • An AI-first approach to engineering, with experience applying AI/ML to operations and using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor) in development workflows.

Senior/Lead Performance Engineer, Distributed Database Systems


The Experience

Do you specialize in systems performance? Do you love working with data and automation? Want to be part of something big? Help build the distributed database technology that powers the growth of the Salesforce Platform worldwide.


SalesforceDB is the transactional database behind Salesforce CRM. It runs more than 1.1 trillion transactions per month on thousands of database instances.


The Salesforce Database team is fast-paced and collaborative. We work across all areas of our distributed transactional database technology stack. We are seeking performance engineers to deliver the tools, analysis, and optimizations that take SalesforceDB to new levels of performance and scalability with every release.


Our performance engineers partner closely with database and storage system developers, application performance engineers, infrastructure engineers, and our analytics team. Together, we deliver all the pieces that add up to high performance in production at scale. Your improvements ship across the whole production fleet every release. Some of our work is published at database research conferences such as CIDR. We are a high-performing team with high standards. We value integrity, rigor, and continuous learning.


What You'll Do


• Drive the design and scalability of our database stack with development teams, from research and conception through delivery in production.

• Find optimization opportunities by profiling the database engine and storage service. Help us meet the performance and scale needs of our largest customers and newly onboarded applications.

• Identify the root cause of performance and scalability problems. Then fix them yourself or drive the fix with the owning team.

• Lead benchmarking and modeling that guide hardware selection and capacity planning for the fleet.

• Build the telemetry, dashboards, and analysis that show how the production fleet performs against its targets.

• Own performance qualification of SalesforceDB releases. Build and run the workloads and benchmarks that decide whether a release goes to production.


You May Be a Great Fit If You Have


• A related technical degree, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of performance engineering on systems software, ideally databases, storage, or distributed systems.

• Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and memory management.

• Strong coding skills in Java or C/C++.

• Practical experience with load, benchmark, and regression testing, ideally for multi-tenant workloads at scale.

• A track record of root cause analysis for performance and scalability problems in complex distributed systems.

• Strong SQL and performance data analysis skills (CPU, latency, throughput, per-tenant resource use).

• Experience with telemetry, dashboards, and monitoring against performance targets.

• Fluency with Linux, OS internals, and shell/Python scripting.

• Clear communication and collaboration skills across database, storage, infrastructure, application performance, and analytics teams.

• Integrity and a growth mindset: you report what the data shows, seek feedback, and keep learning.


Additional Qualifications That Could Set You Apart


• MS or PhD in databases or distributed systems.

• Deep knowledge of database internals: optimizer, query execution, storage, transactions, and concurrency control.

• SQL query optimization.

• Splunk or similar log analytics for performance monitoring.

• Java and C/C++ profiling, JVM tuning, and heap dump analysis.

• Statistical analysis and experimental design.

  • Running discovery: Interviewing platform use case owners continuously to keep the roadmap grounded in real demand, not assumptions
