The Experience

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Interns for Summer 2027 who want to help build the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research internship. You will work like a founder within Salesforce: exploring high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, and seeing how ideas are validated with customers and turned into production-ready solutions. You will have the freedom to propose and explore new ideas, alongside mentors and research scientists, with access to Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, bring energy and focus to their work, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this internship offers a unique opportunity to do research with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with research scientists and engineers on a project focused on real-world product impact, with the opportunity to publish your work at top-tier conferences.
  • Explore research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.
  • Help turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.
  • Build models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.
  • Learn how research partners with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or experience building AI research into real-world systems.
  • You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.
  • You are motivated by real-world impact and care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.
  • You bring expertise in one or more core focus areas:
    • Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.
    • Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.
    • Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.
    • Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.
  • You can conduct research with guidance from mentors, and you are ready to grow toward independence and translate ideas into impactful systems.



Even Better If...

  • You are a PhD or MS candidate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
  • You have experience building and scaling ML models for real-world applications.
  • You have strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g., ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).

  • You are a fantastic problem solver, able to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

Salesforce is hiring a Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead DNS Engineering, the team that owns the DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) services infrastructure behind every Salesforce product. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for authoritative and recursive DNS across Salesforce data centers and Hyperforce public cloud, self-service DNS and IPAM APIs, and DNS security, including DNSSEC and DDoS resilience. You'll set the multi-year strategy, own availability for this Tier-0 service, and lead the move to cloud-native, multi-provider DNS with automation and AI-assisted operations. The role suits a leader with 12+ years in software engineering, 5+ years leading teams, and deep experience with DNS and large-scale distributed systems.

Every customer request to Salesforce starts with a DNS lookup. The DNS Engineering team owns this layer for Salesforce: the authoritative and service-discovery DNS that sits in front of every Salesforce product, in our first-party data centers and across Hyperforce on the public cloud. We also own the DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) platform and the self-service APIs that engineers and automated pipelines use to manage records, zones, and IP space every day.

The team's work spans large, mission-critical systems:

  • Authoritative and recursive DNS on BIND and dnsdist, running on fleets across many data centers and serving very high query volumes with strict latency and availability targets (3 & 4 nines).
  • Public cloud DNS on AWS Route 53 and GCP Cloud DNS, plus Kubernetes-native DNS automation (external-dns) for Hyperforce workloads
  • DDI platform and APIs: services that wrap commercial DDI platforms (such as Infoblox) so record and IPAM changes are safe, validated, and auditable
  • Security and resilience: DNSSEC, DDoS protection, hardening against dangling records and subdomain takeover, and multi-provider failover
  • Infrastructure as Code and automation: Puppet, Terraform, Spinnaker, and CI/CD pipelines with staggered, datacenter-by-datacenter rollouts, plus observability through Splunk, Grafana, and Argus
  • Third-Party DNS vendor relations: Our DNS infrastructure uses third-party DNS vendors to manage DNS zones on misc commercial enterprise DNS platforms.



As Senior Manager of Software Engineering for DNS Engineering, you'll lead the organization that keeps this layer fast, secure, and always available. You'll set its technical direction toward a cloud-native, highly automated, AI-assisted future. You'll lead tech leads, POs and senior engineers. You'll be accountable for availability and live-site health. And you'll partner with the platform, networking, security, and product teams that depend on DNS.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Set strategy and own delivery. Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for Salesforce DNS and DDI, and own execution from architecture through delivery to operational excellence across first-party and public-cloud environments.
  • Lead and grow the organization. Hire, develop, and keep a diverse, high-performing team of engineers. Set clear goals, manage performance, remove obstacles, and develop the next generation of technical leaders.
  • Own availability and trust. Treat DNS as Tier-0 infrastructure. Set availability, latency, and change-safety targets (SLOs), lead the incident and problem-management process, run blameless postmortems, and drive the fixes that keep the same incident from happening twice.
  • Modernize the platform. Lead the move toward cloud-native, multi-provider DNS on Hyperforce, including migrations, provider abstraction, Kubernetes integration, and retiring legacy systems, without disrupting customers.
  • Automate through AI and self-service. Grow self-service DNS and IPAM APIs, policy-as-code, and automated validation. Use AI-assisted development and agentic tooling to cut toil, catch risky changes before they ship, and speed up investigations.
  • Strengthen security posture. Champion DNSSEC, DDoS resilience, secure-by-default record management, protection against dangling records, and timely patching of third-party software, in partnership with Security.
  • Balance the portfolio. Weigh feature delivery, live-site work, operational load, and tech-debt paydown against each other, and make clear, data-driven tradeoffs that you can explain to leadership.
  • Partner across Salesforce. Represent DNS in architecture and planning forums. Turn the priorities of the platform, networking, Hyperforce, and product teams into a ranked roadmap with measurable outcomes, and resolve cross-team dependencies.
  • Communicate upward and outward. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership, and act as the senior escalation point for DNS during critical incidents.



You're Our Person If...

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
  • A record of building and scaling diverse, high-performing infrastructure or platform teams, and delivering complex, highly available production systems
  • Deep understanding of DNS and core internet protocols (DNS, DNSSEC, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, load balancing) and how they behave at scale
  • Experience owning Tier-0 or Tier-1 services in a 24x7x365, multi-datacenter environment, including on-call, incident management, and SLO-driven operations
  • Hands-on background in distributed systems, Linux, and backend development (Python or Go preferred), with sound judgment on system design, reliability, and operational risk
  • Experience with public cloud (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure), containers and orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Puppet, or similar)
  • Experience driving engineering productivity with AI-assisted development tools and automation
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders and peer organizations
  • A BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience



Even Better If...

  • Experience running authoritative and recursive DNS at internet scale (BIND, dnsdist, PowerDNS, Unbound, or similar) and with managed DNS services such as AWS Route 53
  • Experience operating DDI/IPAM platforms (such as Infoblox) and building self-service APIs on top of them
  • Led large migrations from data centers to the cloud, or from one provider to many, for critical network infrastructure
  • Background in DDoS mitigation, anycast, traffic engineering, or global traffic management
  • Experience building agentic or ML-driven tools for detecting, investigating, and fixing operational problems
  • Contributions to open source or to IETF/DNS community standards work

descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

We are seeking a Manager of Pricing Product & Operations to serve as the business owner and functional lead for our Success Plans Pricing Calculator. In this role, you will bridge the gap between commercial pricing strategy, field deal support, and technology.

While technical development, engineering, and deployment are executed by our Digital Enterprise Team (DET) partners, this role is the functional authority on pricing fundamentals, tool logic, and requirements. You will act as the primary point of contact for our sales teams who have questions about our pricing calculator while navigating deal scenarios, lead business requirements definition, and analyze and track key pricing KPIs to inform senior leadership reviews.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Field Support and Troubleshooting: Serve as the subject matter expert and frontline resource for Account Execs and Deal Desk for deal scenarios in the pricing calculator.
  • Commercial Enablement: Lead training sessions and create practical reference guides to upskill commercial teams on calculator workflows, pricing logic updates, and best practices.
  • Product Ownership & Requirements: Define, prioritize, and document comprehensive business requirement documents (BRDs) and functional specifications for the DET team who builds and maintains the tool.
  • Pricing & Packaging Methodology Integration: Partner closely with the broader Success Plan Pricing & Packaging team to translate evolving pricing frameworks, service tiers, and rate structures into clear system logic.
  • UAT & Release Coordination: Define test scenarios and lead business-side User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate tool accuracy against pricing policies before DET pushes releases to production.
  • Systems Integration Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams to ensure seamless end-to-end data flow and connectivity between the calculator, CRM, and downstream CPQ or billing engines.
  • Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs): Perform advanced data analysis on quoting patterns, regional discounting trends, and tool utilization to build and present strategic insights for senior leadership reviews.
  • Governance & Delegated Authority: Establish, maintain, and audit approval threshold logic, exception triggers, and delegation-of-authority matrices encoded in the tool.
  • Continuous Tool Evolution: Track feature adoption, gather frontline commercial feedback, and manage the functional enhancement roadmap to reduce quoting friction and improve quote turnaround time.



You’re Our Person If...

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience across Pricing Operations, Commercial Finance, Revenue Operations, or Deal Desk, with proven success acting as a functional lead or business product owner for commercial tools.

The Experience

The Digital Marketing Technology organization powers Salesforce’s global digital presence, serving as “Customer Zero” for our own products — Salesforce, Informatica.com, MulesSoft.com, and Tableau.com — across Content, Identity, and Event experiences. Events Technology is the engine behind Salesforce’s flagship and regional events — including Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX, Tableau Conference, Connections, World Tours, and countless webinars and field events — spanning registration, event marketing, attendee personalization, agenda/session management, badge and check-in systems, live streaming, and post-event video on demand and reporting.

We are seeking a Software Engineering Architect to take on a leadership role for Events Technology. Reporting directly to the VP of Engineering, you will own the architectural strategy and architectural coherence for the event technology ecosystem — from registration and attendee experience through agenda management, event marketing, and on-site/virtual delivery — ensuring these systems operate as a unified, scalable platform that drives event business value at the scale of Dreamforce and beyond.

In this role, you are a strategic partner to Product Leads, Engineering, and Event Marketing. You should have the ability to (if needed) dive deep into code and configuration — prototyping complex flows (e.g., registration and personalization workflows, AgentGraph-driven attendee assistance) and validating architectural decisions through hands-on reference implementations. You will serve as the architectural bridge between Product, Engineering, and event marketing, influencing the roadmap of the Salesforce products we consume by providing high-fidelity feedback based on our internal implementations at event scale.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Horizontal Architectural Strategy for Events Technology. Define and drive the software architecture vision across the events technology portfolio. You will be responsible for ensuring architectural integrity and integration across domains including, but not limited to:
  • Event Platforms: Registration, attendee management, agenda/session builders, badge & check-in, capacity and waitlist management for large-scale events (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX, World Tours).
  • AI & Agents: Agentforce (Atlas/AgentGraph), conversational agents for attendee support, and digital labor applied to event operations.
  • Data & Identity: Data Cloud (Ingestion/Activation), Identity Resolution, Unified Attendee Profiles, and OAuth2/TBID for event authentication.
  • Marketing & Orchestration: Event Journey Orchestration, Messaging Services (email/SMS/push for event communications), and Transactional Services.
  • Core Platform: Web Application Development for event sites, Headless CMS for event content, Knowledge Graphs, Federated Graphs (GraphQL), and Streaming/ML integrations for real-time event analytics.
  • Strategic Prototyping & Hands-on Leadership. You will validate high-stakes architectural decisions through hands-on prototyping and code-level deep dives. You are expected to build “walking skeleton” implementations of new technologies (e.g., deterministic Agentforce workflows for attendee check-in or session recommendations) to educate leadership on technical choices and set clear patterns for engineering teams to follow, without becoming a bottleneck for critical path delivery — especially given the hard, immovable deadlines of live events.
  • Engineering Multiplier. Shift from individual “hero” delivery to enabling the broader engineering organization. You will empower event engineering teams by establishing architectural standards, conducting design reviews, and resolving cross-team technical blockers ahead of high-traffic event moments (registration launches, keynotes, on-site check-in surges). You will operate as a peer and consensus-builder to architects in adjacent verticals, driving alignment on standards without requiring direct managerial authority.
  • Cross-Pillar & Product Collaboration
  • Product Strategy: Partner with Product Leads across Events, Marketing, and DMT to align technical capabilities with 3-4 quarter event and roadmap calendars.
  • DET Alignment: Collaborate with architects in the broader Digital Enterprise Technology across pillars to drive DET-wide initiatives and common architecture patterns, ensuring event technology stays aligned with enterprise-wide standards.
  • Product Feedback Loop (Customer Zero). Maintain deep technical engagement with T&P teams (specifically Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, and Marketing Cloud). You will be the architecture voice of Events Technology, running the highest-scale, highest-visibility events on Salesforce’s own products, and providing feedback on APIs, limits, and capabilities to improve the products before they reach external customers.


You're Our Person If...

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 5+ years in an architectural role, designing distributed systems at enterprise scale.
  • Broad Domain Expertise: Demonstrated experience architecting solutions that span multiple technical domains relevant to event technology. Must have specific exposure to or understanding of: Data Cloud, Agentforce/AI Agents, Marketing Journey Orchestration, Identity, Content Management, and event/registration platforms.
  • Event Technology Experience: Direct experience with event registration, attendee management, agenda/session tooling, or ticketing platforms — ideally at large scale (thousands to tens of thousands of concurrent attendees) and under fixed, non-negotiable event-date deadlines.
  • Hands-on Proficiency: Ability to read and write code/config when necessary to validate designs. Comfortable spinning up a POC to prove a point or debugging a complex integration issue to unblock a team, particularly under the time pressure of an upcoming event launch.
  • Strategic Influence: Proven ability to influence Product Leads and Engineering Leadership (Directors/VPs). Ability to articulate the trade-offs between “building right” (long-term health) and “building fast” (market and event-date demands).
  • Salesforce Ecosystem: Expert-level understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, specifically regarding Data Cloud ingestion patterns and Agentforce architectures.
  • Experience in building scalable applications based on micro-service architecture in public cloud infrastructure, able to withstand event-day traffic spikes: AWS components like API Gateway, Lambdas, SNS, SQS, ElastiCache, AppSync etc.
  • Experience in building Conversational agents, Co-Pilots, and Autonomous agents for attendee-facing use cases, familiarity with Large language models.
  • Experience in building integrations and pipelines to AWS SageMaker ML platform.
  • Experience with Data streams at high scale (Apache Kafka, Kinesis), especially for real-time event and check-in data.
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and Graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune).
  • Experience in working in teams with Agile software delivery and DevOps practices.
  • Well-versed with CI/CD principles, and experience in solving issues in a distributed services ecosystem, including load and scale testing ahead of a major event.
  • Experience mentoring lead engineers.
  • Ability to evaluate a problem space and make a technology decision based on what’s best for the event attendee and customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with both business (event marketing) and technical customers.
  • AI Proficiency & Fluency: Hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling — using LLMs/copilots for code generation, debugging, and design exploration as part of your own daily workflow — plus working knowledge of prompt engineering and agent orchestration patterns, going beyond simple assistance to designing and evaluating AI-driven workflows and systems.


Even Better If...

  • Experience transitioning legacy “service-provider” models into scalable “product-led” engineering organizations.
  • Experience with Federated GraphQL architectures.
  • Direct background in Event Technology, Digital Marketing, or AdTech domains — particularly large-scale conference or field-event platforms.
  • Experience with on-site event technology: badge printing/scanning, kiosk check-in, mobile event apps, and real-time capacity/session-fill monitoring.

  • Build and maintain timelines, project plans, and communication artifacts to ensure everyone is operating from the most recent and accurate information

Evaluates AI output for quality and data handling. Prompt engineering is table stakes.
  • Technical Depth: Sufficient technical grounding to converse credibly with engineers, scope technical projects, and identify architectural risks.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Proven ability to use quantitative metrics and signals to prioritize work, measure impact, assess risk, and document decisions for organizational reuse.

Program Execution & Strategic Alignment

  • Navigating Ambiguity: Proven ability to establish structure, define workflows, and drive momentum when strategy and scope are fluid. Knows when to go manual now and automate later, and breaks ambiguous tasks into milestones with explicit accuracy bars and explicit deferrals.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Experience leading complex programs that bring together multi-disciplinary teams with differing workflows and competing priorities.
  • Enterprise & Executive Presence: Direct experience supporting enterprise deals, including executive briefings and customer-facing communication.
  • Process Optimization: History of identifying operational bottlenecks and delivering high-value process and automation improvements.

Even Better If...:

Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you’ll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

The Senior Builder Experience

  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You’re the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the highest engineering standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly.
  • AI-Supported Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AI product evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You’re expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce’s most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can’t — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.

  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity.

Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team.

This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window.

The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
  • Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
  • Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
  • Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub’s Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
  • Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
  • Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
  • Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
  • Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
  • Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
  • Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub’s deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
  • DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
  • Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
  • Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
  • Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub’s DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.



You're Our Person If...

  • Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
  • Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
  • Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
  • Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
  • Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
  • Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.
  • Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce — Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates — defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams.
  • Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments.
  • Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration — capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting — using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar — for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments.
  • Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.
  • 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
  • 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
  • Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
  • Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
  • Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows — ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines



Even Better If...

  • Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
  • Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
  • Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
  • Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
  • Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
  • Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
  • Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
  • Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

  • People Leadership: You lead a team of configuration specialists. You manage the team's capacity allocation while establishing a high-performance culture through coaching, feedback, and career development.

You establish deployment frameworks, Quality Assurance standards, peer review protocols, and release controls to ensure high configuration accuracy, business continuity, and zero production downtime.
  • Stakeholder & Project Management: You lead projects from inception through delivery, and partner with business and Information Technology leadership to align on strategic priorities and solution architectures.
  • SOX & Risk Management: You own the operational control framework for SOX compliance across approval rule systems. You ensure team adherence to change-management protocols and lead team engagement with internal and external auditors.
  • Operational Excellence: You establish and track team performance metrics (e.g., production incident volume, cycle times, error rate) and use them to scale the team throughput as volume grows.



You're Our Person If...

  • People Leadership: You have 3+ years of experience directly managing or developing teams in technical operations, revenue operations, or business systems, with 7+ years of overall operational experience.
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Management: You have 3+ years of experience managing enterprise software configuration delivery pipelines, including architectural review, intake prioritization, User Acceptance Testing frameworks, change control, release management, and ongoing production support.
  • Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) & Compliance Ownership: You have direct experience working with SOX compliance frameworks, defining audit controls, and enforcing strict risk-mitigation standards across team workflows.
  • Process Optimization: You have experience establishing team Key Performance Indicators, delivering executive performance reports, and using operational metrics to optimize workflows, scale team throughput, and ensure output quality.
  • Executive Stakeholder Management: You have experience aligning priorities across multiple organizations, such as Revenue Recognition, Finance, and Information Technology.

Engineering at Qualified

Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.


Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup—backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.


The Role

Product Core builds the foundational product systems everything depends on: identifying prospects, scheduling and routing meetings, synchronizing data with calendars and go-to-market platforms, executing workflows, and supporting enterprise authentication. We also enable customers and partners to extend the product through public APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. These capabilities power critical parts of the customer journey and have a meaningful impact on conversion, revenue, and customer trust.


The team also builds the data, context, and execution capabilities behind our agentic product experiences, including meeting preparation, routing investigation, and product explainability.


As an engineer on Product Core, you'll operate as a technical leader: leading complex initiatives from early design through production, shaping architecture, writing substantial production code, influencing technical direction, and helping other engineers do their best work.


What You'll Do

  • Lead complex product initiatives from an ambiguous problem through technical design, implementation, launch, and ongoing ownership
  • Build reliable meeting-booking, calendaring, routing, and workflow experiences that directly affect customer conversion and revenue
  • Build and evolve integrations with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, collaboration, calendaring, and data-enrichment platforms
  • Build intuitive public APIs and reliable webhooks that let customers and partners extend the product
  • Design for the realities of third-party systems: API limits, OAuth credentials, inconsistent data, retries, synchronization, and partial failures
  • Advance AI-assisted capabilities such as meeting preparation, routing investigation, and explanations of product behavior
  • Improve the scalability, observability, security, and supportability of critical production systems, and own difficult customer issues to their root cause
  • Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design and code reviews, and mentorship

Who You Are

  • A track record of independently delivering complex SaaS capabilities from design through launch and ongoing operation
  • Strong full-stack skills, with particular depth in backend systems, APIs, relational data models, and background processing
  • Experience building or operating integrations with complex third-party platforms
  • Sound technical judgment around reliability, data integrity, security, and incremental system evolution
  • Excellent debugging skills across application, integration, and data boundaries
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: you influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others
  • Product-minded: you care about UX and customer outcomes, not just implementation
  • Experience with modern web frameworks (Rails/React/Postgres/AWS is a plus; adaptability matters most)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, scheduling, routing, enrichment, or workflow products
  • Familiarity with OAuth, webhooks, synchronization pipelines, rate-limited APIs, or eventual consistency
  • Experience with enterprise identity systems such as SSO, SAML, or SCIM
  • Experience building production AI or LLM applications, agent tooling, or explainability features

Why Join Qualified

  • Own systems that move revenue: Meeting booking, routing, and workflows sit directly in the customer conversion path. When they get better, customers win more deals.
  • Integration problems with real depth: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, sync, and partial failure: the hard, interesting problems of connecting enterprise systems at scale.
  • AI as a core product surface: Advance the context and execution layer behind Piper's agentic experiences, from meeting preparation to product explainability.

Salesforce - the leader in enterprise cloud computing and one of the top 10 places to work according to Fortune magazine - is seeking an Incident Response Analyst for our Government Cloud Security Operations team.

As part of the Salesforce National Security (SNS) Infrastructure Security Team, the Incident Response Analyst will work on the 'front lines' of Salesforce environments supporting US Government agencies and departments performing national security functions.  The Infrastructure Security Team, protects our critical infrastructure and our customers' data from the latest information security threats. The team is responsible for 24x7x365 security monitoring, security operations, real-time analysis of security alert data,  and rapid incident response across SNS Cloud environments.

PLEASE NOTE: Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation as well as your having and maintaining the specific level of U.S. government background investigation and clearance required for this role.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • The Incident Response Analyst will respond to and investigate cyber security events within the SNS Cloud environments, track and document security events and incidents in a ticketing system, and analyze log data for signs of malicious activity in a Security Information and Event Manager (SIEM).
  • The Analyst will need to work across multi-disciplined teams to coordinate incident response actions for high-priority, high-transparency operations security issues to drive toward a resolution while meeting required service-level agreements, escalating as appropriate, and providing regular updates to senior leaders.
  • This position offers a challenging opportunity to be exposed to a diverse set of security disciplines, including incident response, forensics, reverse engineering, malware analysis, intrusion detection, network security, and system security.
  • This position provides opportunities to automate workflows and processes, develop new analytics and apply mitigations for adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and hunt for undetected indicators of compromise.
  • This position may require you to provide periods of 24x7 on-call support on an as-needed basis.
  • As we work with Government customers, this position may require occasional local travel to customer sites.



You're Our Person If...

  • The candidate must be a U.S. citizen and must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret/SCI security clearance with Polygraph.
  • A related technical degree, such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years experience in cybersecurity, engineering, and/or incident response roles.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills required for coordinating responses to sophisticated incidents across the organization with many non technical and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem solving ability to determine solutions to encountered or anticipated challenges.
  • Strong technical understanding of the information security threat landscape (attack vectors and tools, best practices for securing systems and networks, etc.).
  • Experience with AWS Cloud, Splunk, Azure Sentinel, or ElasticStack, etc. preferred.



Even Better If...

  • Technical understanding of the information security threat landscape, to include attack vectors, tools, best practices for securing systems and networks, etc.
  • Technical understanding of TCP/IP network protocols and application layer protocols (e.g., HTTP, SMTP, DNS, etc.).
  • Familiarity with incident response and security operations within cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Mac OSX, Microsoft Windows, and Linux/Unix system administration and security controls.
  • Technical understanding of AWS, Azure, or GCP administration and security controls.
  • Experience creating and managing event and metric dashboards with tools like Splunk, Kibana, Grafana, etc.
  • Experience with data query languages, such as SQL, SPL, GraphQL, etc.
  • Scripting language (i.e. Bash, Python, etc.) and workflow automation experience.
  • Operational experience monitoring devices such as network and host-based intrusion detection systems, web application firewalls, database security monitoring systems, firewalls/routers/switches, proxy servers, antivirus systems, file integrity monitoring tools, and operating system logs.
  • System forensics/investigation skills, including analyzing system artifacts (file system, memory, running processes, network connections) for indicators of infection/compromise.
  • Relevant information security certifications, such as CISSP, GCFR, GCIA, GCIH or other related certifications.

  • Strong technical competence paired with consultative selling skills, including articulating a clear return-on-investment value statement.

Pengalaman

Salesforce menawarkan peluang menarik bagi para Profesional Penjualan yang telah terbukti mampu melampaui target penjualan di bidang teknologi. Tujuan kami adalah membangun organisasi yang terdiri dari Account Executive yang cermat, berwawasan luas, dan berkomitmen terhadap visi kami untuk mengubah lanskap perangkat lunak. Dengan tingkat kepuasan pelanggan sebesar 95%, alat CRM/Otomatisasi Salesforce eksklusif yang disukai oleh para perwakilan penjualan, serta basis pelanggan yang sangat setia, ini merupakan kombinasi yang kuat untuk meraih kesuksesan penjualan. Talenta penjualan terbaik dari seluruh dunia bergabung dengan kami karena mentalitas “mengubah dunia” yang kami anut; kesempatan untuk berprestasi dalam lingkungan tim yang dinamis dan berbasis kinerja di sini.


Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk menggerakkan inisiatif penjualan strategis di seluruh perusahaan ke dalam wilayah yang mencakup kunjungan ke perusahaan-perusahaan terbesar di Industri Jasa Keuangan di seluruh Indonesia dan Malaysia. Akun Anda akan terdiri dari campuran klien dengan peluang pendapatan tambahan dan prospek. Anda harus mampu memperkirakan aktivitas penjualan dan pencapaian pendapatan sambil menciptakan pelanggan yang puas dan dapat dijadikan referensi.


Apa yang Sebenarnya Akan Anda Lakukan

  • Melampaui target penjualan bulanan dan triwulanan dengan menjual solusi Salesforce ke akun-akun perusahaan di wilayah yang ditugaskan, sekaligus mendorong perolehan bisnis baru dan memperluas akun yang sudah ada.
  • Membuat dan memelihara daftar akun target yang memenuhi syarat serta strategi wilayah pemasaran, mengembangkan pipeline melalui pencarian prospek, pengetahuan pasar, dan penjangkauan strategis.
  • Memimpin proses penjualan dari awal hingga akhir, melibatkan Insinyur Penjualan, Layanan Profesional, Eksekutif, dan Mitra sesuai kebutuhan untuk memposisikan Salesforce melalui penjualan berbasis nilai dan pengembangan kasus bisnis.
  • Menjaga data pipeline yang akurat dan terkini serta menyajikan perkiraan bulanan yang dapat diandalkan.

Anda adalah Orang yang Kami Cari Jika...

  • Anda memiliki rekam jejak keberhasilan dalam menjual ke akun perusahaan besar, idealnya di segmen Industri Jasa Keuangan.
  • Anda memiliki pengalaman yang signifikan dalam penjualan solusi perusahaan, dengan konsisten melampaui target kuota dan pendapatan.
  • Anda mampu menggerakkan dan menutup kesepakatan perusahaan yang kompleks dan melibatkan banyak pemangku kepentingan.
  • Pengalaman akan dievaluasi berdasarkan kesesuaian dengan kompetensi inti untuk peran ini (misalnya, peran kepemimpinan di luar kurikulum, pengalaman militer, kegiatan sukarela, dll.).

Akan Lebih Baik Lagi Jika...

  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam perencanaan dan pelaksanaan akun strategis.
  • Rekam jejak penjualan kepada eksekutif tingkat C di unit TI dan bisnis di Indonesia dan Malaysia.
  • Kompetensi teknis yang kuat dipadukan dengan keterampilan penjualan konsultatif, termasuk kemampuan menyampaikan pernyataan nilai pengembalian investasi (ROI) yang jelas.

descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

The Experience


The Renewals Team is responsible for managing and forecasting the entire book of renewals business. They forecast and track renewals trends and highlight adoption issues for the company.

The Renewals team partners with sales, customer success manager and support to execute retention strategy. They are responsible for conducting account review, risk assessment and due diligence while developing a renewal strategy. Renewal team members take ownership and maintenance of all renewal opportunities (direct customers and indirect through resellers), forecasting, negotiation, generate upsell/cross sell opportunities, engaging internal resources and closing renewals prior to contract expiration.

As a Scale Renewals Manager you start to handle a large number of renewals. Volume of contracts managed each month tends to be around 50 ~ 100(depends on assigned territory) for Direct and Reseller’s customers in Japan, Korea and Taiwan. You own driving the renewal to completion. You partner with the account team and develop a renewals strategy for every customer. You build quotes, review contract terms, negotiate pricing, look for up-sell opportunities, and handle objections. It is also needed to plan how to improve the current operation process and manage some contractors or outsource partners who are doing renewal management for small size of contracts .

You will be measured on renewal rate, contract term length, and KSO (Key Strategic Objectives) driving specific sales goals of your renewals and ability to negotiate favorable terms.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Drive all managed renewals thoroughly in assigned territory by identify risk as early as possible as well as generating revenue growth opportunity via add-on, upsell, upgrade, price adjustment (working location is Japan Tokyo Office)
  • Achieve or exceed monthly renewal targets and provide senior management with an accurate forecast and risk analysis of all assigned accounts
  • Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies for contract renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing the customer relationship
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales and Customer Success Group Leadership
  • Closely monitor at risk accounts. Work with Customer Success, Support, and Services leadership to resolve customer issues and help remove barriers for the team
  • Serve as point of escalation for critical customer issues; provide summary of the overall ‘health’ of the account and use of our services
  • Answer customer questions and successfully negotiate issues related to renewal contracts
  • Attend and lead monthly regional calls to discuss renewal forecast, top renewals, at risk accounts (if required)
  • Managing some contractors or outsource partners to deal with high transaction volume customers.
  • Help develop and educate renewal best practices across the team
  • Maximize account growth opportunities by playing an active role on the account team and helping to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities upon contract renewal
  • Own, drive and manage the renewals process in collaboration with the account team
  • Work with internal resources (Competitive Intelligence, Pricing, Product Management, Customer Success, Account Executives, etc…) to develop comprehensive ‘win’ strategies for renewals
  • Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure
  • Communicate risk clearly and take the lead in developing resolution strategies
  • Accurately maintain a rolling 180 day weekly forecast of renewals of your territory



You're Our Person If...

  • High-level fluency in Japanese language (speaking, reading, writing, listening)
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (TOEIC 730+ )
  • 3 years or relative experience or sales/account and/or renewal management experience from a software or SI/solution Selling industry are preferable.
  • Vast knowledge or experience of Business Application (CRM/SFA/MA experience as user/sales is preferable)
  • Fundamental understanding of Salesforce product solutions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Considerable interpersonal skills are mandatory, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
  • Strong negotiation skills that allow for value-based contract negotiations
  • Knowledge of restructuring contract term and condition relating legal, finance and billing
  • Excellent computer skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Google Apps)
  • Degree or Relevant Work Experience Preferred



Leadership Qualities

  • PASSION: Passionate about Customer Success
  • BEGINNERS MIND: Always learning, approaches each interaction with open mind, great listener and hands-on
  • LEADERSHIP: Self-aware and strategic thinker; proficient at building strong relationships
  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team
  • URGENCY: Ability to move fast and drive business value and results
  • OHANA: Embodies Aloha culture: A team player that everyone enjoys working with and has a generous heart
  • TRUST: Trust the company’s core values
  • ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of uncertainty and change

What is a Solution Engineer?

Also known as a "Pre-Sales Engineer" or "Sales Consultant," the Solution Engineer presents our product offerings to prospects and customers, builds confidence in our technology, and helps remove technical objections throughout the sales cycle. To do this, Solution Engineers draw on their technical and sales skills to gather business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, and configure and demonstrate solutions that deliver business value.

Specialist Solution Engineer

Are you a technically minded, curious communicator who loves turning data into clear, compelling stories? As a Specialist Solution Engineer, you'll be the subject matter expert for Tableau and its family of products, including Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics. You'll help customers across LATAM become more data-driven by showing how a trusted, governed semantic foundation turns data into decisions. You'll work side by side with Account Executives and account-team Solution Engineers to bring the value of Analytics to every conversation.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll support the technical sales cycle for Analytics, from discovery and storytelling demos to hands-on workshops, showing customers the "why" and the "what." You'll listen closely to business and data needs, then demo how Tableau helps customers define metrics and business rules once and reuse them in governed, trusted analytics. You'll show how analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics works, and how recent innovations such as Tableau Knowledge, Tableau Studio, and Tableau Semantics fit the customer's existing data stack. You'll also act as an evangelist for Analytics with internal teams, helping them position Tableau with confidence.

Your Impact

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand each customer's business goals and challenges throughout the sales cycle
  • Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders by understanding their data and analytics strategy and identifying the right Tableau solution
  • Run discovery sessions and workshops with business users to define and build solution prototypes
  • Build and deliver customized demos that prove business value, including semantic models (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources) and analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics
  • Present the value of Tableau clearly to business users, managers, and leaders
  • Demo and position Tableau's latest innovations, such as Tableau Knowledge and Tableau Studio, and show how they fit with the customer's existing data stack
  • Contribute technical responses to RFPs/RFIs
  • Enable the broader Solution Engineering team and adjacent teams to position Analytics within the Salesforce portfolio, through webinars, best practices, and knowledge sharing
  • Share customer feedback with the Product and GTM teams
  • Manage several customer engagements at once across LATAM, prioritizing with the sales team
  • Keep growing your expertise in Tableau, CRM Analytics, and the Salesforce platform
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed


What we're looking for

We're seeking a proactive, collaborative professional with presales or technical experience in the software/IT industry or as an end user of analytics tools. You bring solid technical knowledge and hands-on expertise in data visualization/analytics or BI.

  • Experienced: 3+ years in technical pre-sales, consulting, or analytics roles, and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or equivalent experience
  • Technically strong: Hands-on experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or similar BI tools (Power BI, Looker). Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, and building visualizations. Python and/or JavaScript is a plus
  • Specialized knowledge: Familiarity with data modeling, semantic layers, and data warehouse concepts. Experience building demos or proofs of concept is a plus
  • Strong communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication, and the ability to present in person and online to diverse audiences
  • Languages: English and Spanish required
  • Sales-minded: Able to support the sales team with business value articulation and product positioning
  • Creative: A mindset that looks for new ways to solve customer problems and bring fresh ideas to customers and the team
  • Organized: Strong time management to run multiple projects and sales cycles in parallel
  • Team player: Committed to team goals as well as individual ones


How you differentiate yourself

  • Salesforce certifications (Tableau Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist, CRM Analytics, Administrator)
  • Experience with semantic layers or metrics layers (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources, dbt, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Prior experience as a Salesforce power user or admin

We have successfully moved past the "0 to 1" phase. We have a product that works, customers who love it, and the backing of Salesforce. Now, we are entering the "1 to 100" phase: scaling our architecture to handle global demand, hardening our systems for enterprise-grade resilience, and integrating deeply with the Agentforce ecosystem. This is your chance to help lead that transition.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

As a Production Support Engineer (PMTS), you will be a senior technical member of staff within our embedded reliability team. You aren’t building the foundation alone—you’ll work alongside a group of engineers and product owners to ensure the Agentforce Operations platform is the most reliable AI-powered engine in the industry.


This is a role for an engineer who loves the "scaling" problem. You will focus on production excellence, performance tuning, and infrastructure automation. Because you are embedded in the product organization, you’ll have a seat at the table during design reviews, ensuring that as we add new agentic capabilities, they are built to scale from day one.

We want people who have a proven track record of delivering real, measurable outcomes and get excited about the prospect of getting to own and steer the direction of our technical architecture.

  • Technical Leadership: As a Principal-level member of technical staff, the team will be expecting you to provide the expert insights to help guide and steer the technical direction of our team. 
  • Mentorship: The LMTS and SMTS members of our team will be looking to provide both formal mentorship via direct engagement as well as informal mentorship via setting a high bar of technical excellence. This is not a role where you will work in a silo - close collaboration amongst the team is required and expected and it will be your job to initiate that.  
  • Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our automated environments, focusing on making our "infrastructure-as-plugins" model more robust and developer-friendly.
  • AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring our models have the GPU resources and data pipelines required to deliver real-time supply chain insights.
  • Production Excellence: Lead the "1 to 100" hardening of our observability stack. You won’t just respond to incidents; you’ll build the tooling that prevents them and the telemetry that explains them.
  • Performance Engineering: Deep-dive into SQL optimization, API latency, and cross-service communication to ensure our data-intensive supply chain platform remains performant under heavy load.
  • AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.

You're Our Person If...

  • 9+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and scale.
  • Proven Scaling Experience: You have previously helped take a product through a high-growth phase (the "1 to 100" journey), dealing with the technical debt and architectural shifts that come with it.
  • Effective Communicator: This is an integral role within our organization as you’ll be responsible for implementing the product vision and then communicating that reality back to a variety of stakeholders with varying degrees of technical expertise. As such, strong communication abilities are a must. 
  • Coding Mastery: You are an expert in writing production-grade code in either Golang, TypeScript, or Python—you view automation as a software engineering problem.
  • Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Observability Expert: Demonstrated experience with properly instrumenting applications and platforms with SLO-based monitoring and alerting. 
  • Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.
  • Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.
  • AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.
  • Ownership Mentality. We are a senior team who operate with a high degree of autonomy. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can independently identify issues and own the solution all the way through final implementation.  

Even Better If...

  • M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Database Specialist: Strong experience with PostgreSQL at scale (partitioning, indexing, query tuning).
  • Distributed Systems: Advanced knowledge of microservice orchestration and durability patterns, including hands-on experience with Temporal for workflow reliability and Istio service meshes for secure, observable service-to-service communication in high-growth SaaS environments.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Tracing, profiling, monitoring, logging, dashboard creation - we’re looking for someone who has demonstrated prior results across a wide breadth of the monitoring and observability stack. Specific experience in Prometheus, Grafana, and Pagerduty is desired. 
  • Search Indexing: Prior experience with Elastisearch implementations or Typesense.

  • Leadership GTM stratégique : définir et exécuter la stratégie Go-to-Market (GTM) d'un territoire entreprise à forte valeur, en mettant l'accent sur l'acquisition de nouveaux clients et le développement de marchés vierges.

  • Exécution de transactions complexes : piloter des cycles de vente à forts enjeux impliquant de multiples parties prenantes (500 K$ à plus de 1 M$ d'ACV), de la découverte initiale à la signature.
  • Synergie interfonctionnelle : diriger une équipe dédiée d'architectes de solutions, d'ingénieurs avant-vente et d'experts en services professionnels, tout en tirant parti de l'écosystème de partenaires de Salesforce.

  • Solide expérience de l'acquisition de nouveaux clients et de la cartographie de territoire au sein d'organisations matricielles complexes.

About the team


Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline. Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove controls worked months ago. We're replacing it with a model that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets.

  • Risk-informed, control managed. We monitor, validate, and improve the controls that stand against threats and failures.
  • Visibility and invention. We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture, and we invest in the people who build it.
  • Always in front. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.

You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.

What you'll be doing:


As a Sr. Security Governance Engineer, you'll translate enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and risk expectations into measurable, technically actionable controls. You'll help build a governance framework where policies and standards are version-controlled, validated, and integrated into engineering workflows. Over time, you'll grow into a Security Control Family Owner for domains such as IAM, Cloud, Application Security, Cryptography, Data Protection, or Infrastructure Security. The focus is governance, control design, and policy ownership. It is not hands-on software development.

  • Policy and standards: Develop and maintain security policies, technical standards, and control requirements. Manage the policy lifecycle: versioning, approvals, exceptions, reviews, and change management. Keep them aligned with architecture, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations.
  • Governance-as-Code / Policy-as-Code: Define structured, machine-readable policy and control requirements. Work with engineering to turn them into guardrails and validation criteria, using tools like OPA/Rego or cloud-native policy frameworks. You won't necessarily own the implementation. Review implementations for alignment with policy intent.
  • Control framework: Maintain a common control framework with clear objectives, ownership, and validation criteria. Establish traceability from regulation to policy to control to implementation. Set expectations for preventive, detective, and compensating controls, and support continuous evaluation of control effectiveness.
  • Control family ownership: Act as the SME and point of contact for your assigned domains. Interpret regulations, assess gaps, exceptions, and emerging risks, and recommend improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work with Security Engineering, Product Security, Cloud Security, IAM, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Legal, and business teams. Bring a governance perspective to architecture and design discussions.

Expected Outcomes

  • Decision speed: Rules are obvious, decisions are fast, and outputs are predictable, with governance built into the engineering workflow.
  • Scalable governance: Policies and control requirements are clear, consistent, and technically actionable.
  • Governance-as-Code adoption: Requirements are version-controlled, traceable, and integrated into security practices.
  • Alignment and visibility: Written policies, technical guardrails, and implemented controls match. Regulations, risks, controls, and evidence are clearly linked.
  • Control family SMEs: Dedicated owners set policy direction and technical standards for each domain.

What you should have:

  • U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required — we're unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
  • 7+ years in information security governance, security engineering, technology risk, or related functions
  • Strong grasp of security policies, standards, control frameworks, and governance processes
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS
  • Ability to turn regulatory and security requirements into measurable control objectives
  • Working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP), IAM, application, infrastructure, and data security
  • Understanding of control design (preventive and detective), risk assessment, and exception management
  • Familiarity with modern development practices, cloud environments, and CI/CD
  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Governance-as-Code or Policy-as-Code, and policy engines such as OPA/Rego or HashiCorp Sentinel
  • Familiarity with YAML, JSON, Git, infrastructure-as-code, and DevSecOps
  • Experience with GRC platforms, Common Controls Frameworks (CCF), and OSCAL
  • Exposure to security posture management, compliance validation, architecture reviews, or AI governance

How We Work:

  • Engineering-first. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
  • Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
  • Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
  • Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams as peers, not gatekeepers, and solve problems with them, not at them.
  • Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
  • Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.
